articleTitle: Coordinated Optimization of Power Rating and Capacity of Battery Storage Energy System with Large-Scale Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy power in China, the accommodation of renewable energy has faced a new challenge. The Large-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) is a promotive way to improve the accommodation of renewable energy. In this paper, a method for power rating and capacity optimization of BESS is proposed based on sequential production simulation technology. An optimization model is established to maximize the utilization of renewable energy, considering constraints of system power balance, the operation mode of BESS, and conventional units. The annual hourly curtailment time sequence of renewable energy is incorporated as inputs with the target of utilization rate as constraints for optimizing the power rating and capacity of BESS. In the case of studies, an annual hourly curtailment time sequence in a province of China is tested, and the optimal power rating and capacity of BESS of the province are obtained. The testing results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Electric Vehicle Clusters Considering Uncertainty of User Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is a large uncertainty in the participation of electric vehicle (EV) users in demand response, which brings great challenges to the optimal scheduling of EVs, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for EV clusters is response to this issue. Firstly, the uncertainty of user demand response is described by the number of intervals, and the EV user demand response model is established. Secondly, the fuzzy C-means clustering method is used to cluster the EVs connected to the power grid, and the energy boundary model of the EV cluster is established. After that, an optimal scheduling model for EV clusters is constructed that takes into account the uncertainty of user demand response, with the goal of minimizing the variance of regional load fluctuation and maximizing the benefits of the aggregator. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method model is verified by actual examples, and the results show that the model can effectively reduce the variance of load fluctuations in the region and the scheduling cost of EV.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatch of VRE/Hydro/Thermal Hybrid Energy System Considering Uncertainty of VRE Based on a Novel Multi-objective Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Low-carbon economic dispatch (LCED) and utilizing variable renewable energy (VRE) are the essential means to combat climate change and achieve carbon neutrality, whereas the problem of LCED for hybrid energy systems integrated VRE is multi-objective, high-dimensional and non-convex. Moreover, the uncertainty of VRE also enhances the complexity of LCED. Based on the status and trend of energy development, this study constructs a LCED model of wind/photovoltaic/hydro/thermal hybrid energy system (WPHTHES) considering the uncertainty of VRE. Meanwhile, proposing a scenario assessment method to evaluate the impact of VRE uncertainty on economy and carbon emission. Then, designing a multi-objective African vulture optimization algorithm for solving the problem of LCED. Finally, two cases are adopted to quantitatively analyze the performance of this algorithm and the impact of VRE uncertainty. The results show that the proposed algorithm performs better than three competitive algorithms given in published literature. Moreover, the operation cost and carbon emission will raise with the increase of uncertainty ranges.

articleTitle: A Multi-type Energy Storage Control Strategy for Promoting Renewable Energy Consumption and Active-Support Ability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of a new type of power system based on renewable energy will seriously degrade the system frequency characteristics and the level of safety and stability, which needs to be solved urgently. In order to promoting new energy consumption and active-support ability, this paper proposes a multi-type energy storage system(MTESS) control strategy based on frequency domain decomposition algorithm on the side of renewable energy power station (REPS), which can realize the multi-type energy storage system to efficiently meet the requirements of reducing the curtailment rate and compensating for the power prediction error, energy storage demand in the complex process of primary frequency modulation demand in random high frequency. Finally, the feasibility and superiority of this control method are proved by the analysis of practical examples.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Look-ahead Economic Dispatch Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power systems are experiencing a variety of challenges driven by renewable energy, which calls for developing novel dispatch methods such as reinforcement learning (RL). Evaluation of these methods as well as the RL agents are largely under explored. In this paper, we propose an evaluation approach to analyze the performance of RL agents in a look-ahead economic dispatch scheme. This approach is conducted by scanning multiple operational scenarios. In particular, a scenario generation method is developed to generate the network scenarios and demand scenarios for evaluation, and network structures are aggregated according to the change rates of power flow. Then several metrics are defined to evaluate the agents’ performance from the perspective of economy and security. In the case study, we use a modified IEEE 30-bus system to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation approach, and the simulation results reveal good and rapid adaptation to different scenarios. The comparison between different RL agents is also informative to offer advice for a better design of the learning strategies.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Planning of Integrated Energy System Considering a Reward and Punishment Ladder-type Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As global environmental pollution and climate warming seriously threaten sustainable development, the power industry is facing huge pressure of carbon emission reduction. Integrated energy system (IES) can improve the efficiency and cleanliness of energy. In order to further improve the low-carbon performance of the integrated energy system, this paper introduces the carbon trading mechanism into the planning of the integrated energy system. The carbon emission flow (CEF) model of the IES is proposed, and the carbon emission is reduced to the load side by calculating the carbon emission intensity of each node. The low-carbon planning model of the IES is established by using the carbon trading mechanism, the power and gas systems and energy hubs (EHs) are independently planned to realize the optimal low-carbon economy of the whole system. A case study is conducted to verify the proposed model. The example results show that the carbon emission responsibility sharing on the load side can bring carbon emission benefits and effectively reduce the carbon emission of the IES.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Distributed Generation Based on African Vultures Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous impact of environmental pollution, the traditional generator represented by fossil fuels is gradually being replaced by renewable energy generators. Different from the conventional optimal planning, which only includes photovoltaic (PV) and wind turbines. This paper adds the use of fuel cells (FC) and miniature steam turbines with PV systems and wind turbines, which can make up for the defect of fluctuation of its output power. In addition, a multi-objective model considering power loss, voltage profile, and investment cost is established and solved by the African vultures optimization algorithm (AVOA). Finally, the simulation is based on IEEE 33 and 69 node distribution network (DN) systems. The results show that AVOA has a fast convergence speed and strong optimization characteristics, and can improve voltage distribution after distributed generation (DG) access. The simulation results show that the power loss and voltage profile decreased by 57% and 58% at the IEEE 33 and 64% and 61% at the IEEE 69 node after being connected to DG.

articleTitle: Efficiency Optimization Design of Three-Level Active Neutral Point Clamped Inverter Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional power electronic converter design mostly adopts the sequential design method, which relies on manual experience. In recent years, power electronics automation design has attracted much attention by rapidly optimizing the parameters of power electronic systems by computers, but most of them cannot provide design solutions to adapt to changes in design requirements. Taking the efficiency optimization design of the three-level active neutral point clamped (ANPC) inverter as an example, this paper proposes a power electronics automation design method based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL), which can realize that quickly obtain the optimal design parameters according to the design objectives when the design requirements of converter change. Firstly, the overall efficiency optimization framework for the inverter based on DRL is introduced; then the efficiency model of the inverter is established; after that, the agent is continuously trained through the self-learning of the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm, and an optimization strategy that minimizes power losses is obtained; the strategy can quickly respond to design specification changes and provide design parameters that maximize efficiency; finally, a 140 kW experimental prototype is built, and the experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Engineering Design and Practice of Grouped Distribution Station Areas Based on Flexible DC Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale distributed photovoltaics are access to low-voltage distribution station areas (DSA), as well as electric vehicles and energy storage. It brings about problems of power quality and operation control, and puts forward a higher requirement of power supply for DSA. In addition, the traditional DSA has load-imbalance and difficulty in capacity expansion of transformer, which is a challenge of power grid upgrade. Therefore, this paper provides an engineering design of grouped DSAs based on flexible DC interconnection to solve the above problems, and a practical case is presented.

articleTitle: A Multiple Market Trading Mechanism for Electricity, Renewable Energy Certificate and Carbon Emission Right of Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A multiple market trading mechanism for the VPP to participate in electricity, renewable energy certificate (REC) and carbon emission right (CER) markets is proposed. With the introduction of the inventory mechanism of REC and CER, the profit of the VPP increases and better trading decisions with multiple markets are made under the requirements of renewable portfolio standard (RPS) and carbon emission (CE) quota requirements. According to the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the proposed model, properties of the multiple market trading mechanism are discussed. Results from case studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Methodology to Diagnose Transformer Faults Based on Principal Components Analysis and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A methodology, combining the principal components analysis (PCA) and the artificial neural network (ANN), to diagnose transformer faults based on dissolved gas analysis (DGA) data is proposed. The main features extracted from DGA data by the PCA are used as the input of the ANN to train and test the classifier. The proposed methodology is tested with practical transformer fault data. The test results show that a higher diagnosis accuracy can be achieved by using the main features extracted by the PCA as compared to that by the original features or the optimal feature combinations obtained by feature selection methods.

articleTitle: The Coordinated Droop Control Strategy for Interline Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes the novel droop control for interline power flow controller (IPFC). The IPFC denotes the equipment that controls the different AC line’s power flows. To suppress the frequency fluctuation of IPFC’s connected AC system, the additional active power signal is added to the mainly control converter with a droop control concept. The droop control concept is simulated as the AC generators’ primary frequency modulation. Such the more frequency adjustment room can be reached and fluctuations can be decreased.<sup>1</sup>

articleTitle: Voltage Stability Analysis Considering the Impact of Distributed Photovoltaic Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, increasing distributed photovoltaics (PVs) are penetrated in the load side of power systems. As a result, distributed PV will have a certain impact on the voltage stability of power systems. In this paper, the impact of the penetration and fluctuation of PV on the voltage stability of power systems is analyzed. A continuous power flow based voltage stability index is proposed, after which the approach to compute the index is proposed. Then, the method to simulate the fluctuation of PV is introduced. Based on the proposed voltage stability index, the impact of PV penetration location, penetration rate, and fluctuation on the voltage stability of power systems is simulated in IEEE 14 bus system. The results have shown that the penetration of distributed PV in the demand sides of power systems can help to improve power system voltage stability.

articleTitle: Analysis on Adjustable Potential of Air-Conditioning in Aggregated Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load aggregator has become an important participant in demand response, and the air-conditioning in the aggregated loads is a typical kind of flexible resource with great potential for demand response. In order to analyze the adjustable potential of air-conditioning in the aggregated loads, this paper presents an analysis method combining statistical analysis and mechanism modeling. More factors such as weather and economy are considered in the baseline load analysis to identify more accurately the total amount of air-conditioning load. The controllable capacity coefficient is defined and assessed by simulation based on the mechanism model of air conditioning load and the control strategy of participating in demand response. Combining the two parts, this paper proposes a method which is feasible in wide application and has a certain analytical precision, thus effectively realizing the analysis of the adjustable potential of air conditioning load in the aggregated loads.

articleTitle: Multi-fidelity Gaussian Process for Distribution System Voltage Probabilistic Estimation with PVs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing penetration of behind-the-meter PVs causes challenges to maintain voltage security due to the lack of distribution system visibility. This paper proposes a nonlinear autoregressive Gaussian process (NARGP) approach to fuse limited number of SCADA/AMI data together with historical pseudo measurements for distribution node voltage probabilistic estimation. The high-fidelity SCADA data are fused with the low-fidelity AMI and pseudo measurements by the autoregressive algorithm embedded in the Gaussian process. This allows us to use multi-fidelity data to achieve entire distribution system voltage visibility. Numerical results carried out on the IEEE 123node system demonstrate that the NARGP method is able to obtain high accuracy in estimating bus voltage and quantifying estimation uncertainties as compared to other approaches.

articleTitle: Voltage Ripple Suppression Strategy of DC Bus in AC-DC Hybrid Microgrid Based on Bidirectional Interface Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In AC-DC hybrid microgrid, the instantaneous power fluctuation of interface converter caused by the unbalance of AC voltage leads to the double frequency fluctuation of DC voltage, which affects the normal operation of hybrid microgrid. Aiming at the above problems, the mathematical model of bidirectional interface converter in an αβ coordinate system is established, and the transmission characteristics of double frequency power of AC and DC subnets are analyzed under unbalanced conditions. On this basis, the bidirectional Buck/Boost fluctuating power compensation circuit is introduced into the DC side of bidirectional interface converter. The unified control strategy of AC unbalance voltage and DC double frequency pulsation voltage based on improved bidirectional interface converter is designed in detail. The voltage ripple on the DC bus can be transferred to the additional capacitor, which can vary over a wide range. In addition, the average voltage of the additional capacitance can be controlled to be lower or higher than the DC bus voltage, which provides the possibility to further reduce the additional capacitance and the capacitance capacity of the DC bus. Therefore, the bidirectional interface converter can compensate both the AC unbalance voltage and the DC double frequency pulsation voltage with its own power margin under the condition of small DC bus capacitance. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Energy Management Strategy with Internal Pricing Sensitivity for Residential Customers Based on Reinforcement Learning and Internet-of-Things
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we study the transactive energy trading behavior of residential customers as prosumers. It is assumed that prosumers can schedule intelligent energy management strategies for typical electric appliances, such as air conditioners, water heaters, electric vehicles and washing machines, through deep reinforcement learning techniques with full consideration of internal price sensitivity among residential users. We build the corresponding software and hardware simulation platform to bridge the gap between theoretical research and practical implementation through Internet-of-things technology. The experimental results show that the proposed intelligent energy management strategy can deal better with the energy management problems of distributed resources on the user side, and effectively overcome the disadvantages of the individual resource transaction mode on the demand side across the distribution network, the low degree of decision-making intelligence, and the lack of refined regulation manners. In this way, the further localized energy transactions become available and implementable, which enables a better user- side gamified energy ecosystem and new energy business models.

articleTitle: Smooth Transition of Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter to Hexverter During Single-Arm Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The modular multilevel matrix converter (M<sup>3</sup>C) is the most promising topology for high-voltage and bulky-power ac-to-ac conversion. The M<sup>3</sup>C has inherent capability for arm failure riding-through by removing specific arms and maintaining steady operation. The Hexverter with six arms is a common target topology for M<sup>3</sup>C reconfiguration during arm faults, nevertheless, the transition strategy is not sufficiently investigated. The existing solution is designed for fault cases with poor compatibility with the M<sup>3</sup>C controller. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel strategy to achieve smooth transition from the M<sup>3</sup>C to Hexverter for single-arm failure riding-through purpose. The available Hexverter configurations under different arm failure conditions are analyzed, and arm mapping relationship between each Hexverter sub-configuration and the M<sup>3</sup>C is established. Then, the strategy to achieve Hexverter operation is proposed by circulating current injection, and the implementation method into the M<sup>3</sup>C control system is provided, which enables smooth transition between normal operation and the Hexverter mode. Validness of the proposed transition strategy is verified by simulation tests conducted in the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Storage Optimal Scheduling in Distribution Network Based on the K-means++ Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed energy storage technology can solve the problems of load peak-valley difference faced by distribution networks. Reasonable and efficient dispatch of distributed energy storage is a significant approach to play its performance in distribution network. However, the direct participation of large-scale distributed energy storages in distribution network will bring about many problems, such as the explosion of the dimension of decision variables and the difficulty of convergence of the solution results. In this paper, large-scale distributed energy storage is aggregated into a small number of characteristic clusters based on typical characteristic quantities, and an aggregation-scheduling model is established to deal with massive distributed energy storage resources participating in distribution network operation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the dimension of variables and lower the level of the solving difficulty, which can proceed to schedule the distributed energy storage reasonably and intensify the feasibility in optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Reactive Power Compensation Optimization under High Integration of Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reactive power compensation optimization of Fujian power system under high integration of renewable energy sources (RES) is discussed in detail in this paper. Firstly, the possible reactive power compensation problem for transmission system and distribution system is proposed, respectively. Secondly, the influence of large scale of off-shore wind power into transmission system compensation is introduced. Thirdly, the influence of centralized photovoltaic into distribution system compensation is introduced. Finally, several suggestion is proposed for the future reactive power compensation for power system with high penetration of RES.

Author Keywords: high integration of renewable energy sources

articleTitle: The Research on High Proportion Wind Power Integration in China’s Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy crisis has promoted the rapid development of large-scale new energy grid integration. China is to promote the renewable energy integration. However, the deviation between the distribution of renewable power resources and the load center causes a series of grid integration problems, so it is necessary to evaluate the renewable energy resources and their impact on the energy system. This paper systematically reviews the onshore wind resources in mainland China, and analyzes the internal resource composition of the wind power based interconnected power system. The fast unit commitment technology is used to establish the time series production simulation model of power system, and thermal power units, energy storage system and interregional transmission were considered. The results show that the distribution of wind resources and loads has a significant impact on stabilizing the system fluctuations caused by wind power fluctuation, the significant difference in net load is the main factor leading to the increase of flexible resource demand.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Power and Gas Energy Systems Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid improvement of user-side multi-energy load demand response ability, how to effectively use the demand response variation to realize the optimal scheduling of integrated energy system has become the main research direction. An optimal scheduling model of integrated energy system based on power and gas interconnection considering demand response is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the scheduling framework of the integrated power and gas energy system is constructed, and the demand response participation scheduling method is analyzed. Secondly, the natural gas network and the key coupling equipment of power and gas are modeled. Based on the idea of virtual power plant, the equivalent unit output model of incentive demand response is established, and the optimal scheduling model of integrated power and gas energy system considering demand response is further constructed to formulate the optimal scheduling scheme of integrated energy system (IES). Finally, an example shows that the proposed strategy can effectively improve the clean energy consumption rate of IES and reduce the overall operation cost of the system.

Author Keywords: power and gas integrated energy system

articleTitle: A Review of Key Technologies for Converting Thermal Power Units to Condensers in New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Around the requirements of green and low-carbon development of energy, in the context of building a new power system with new energy as the mainstay, the transformation of thermal power units into condensers can not only play the role of thermal power units to hold up the supply, but also provide a new way for the transformation and development of thermal power generation. The problem involves theories and methods in the fields of power system stability, thermal power unit transient analysis, excitation control, generator transformation and remaining life assessment, which is a common bottleneck and difficult problem of multidisciplinary cross-fertilization. This paper summarizes and analyzes the impact of thermal power units retrofitting to condensers on power systems, key technology research and economic evaluation, and proposes relevant research ideas and specific routes.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Stability Modeling and Analysis of Power System with Integrated Photovoltaic Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the current penetration of renewable energy generation in the power system is gradually increasing, small disturbances in the power system are inevitable. Combining the grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) system with energy storage is an effective way to improve the immunity of the new-type power system. This paper firstly uses an eigenvalue-based small-signal stability analysis method to model the small-signal of the grid-connected PV-storage system. Then calculate the eigenvalues of the state matrix to summarize the oscillation modes and main participating variables in different modes. The system stability is judged by observing the trace of the eigenvalues with varied grid strength and controller parameters. The results show that there are nine oscillation modes of the system. The grid strength is the main factor affecting the system’s stability. When grid strength is weakened, the system stability decreases. Due to the occurrence of medium frequency oscillations, the system is destabilized under the very weak grid. The controller parameter is the second factor affecting the system stability, and appropriate adjustment of the phase-locked loop (PLL) proportional factors can improve the system stability of small disturbances. The state variables related to energy storage will become the dominant part affecting the stability of the PV-storage system.

articleTitle: Black Hole of Sound: Constructing an Anti-eavesdropping Area Using Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the miniature design and ubiquitous use of voice recording devices, the need for anti-eavesdropping has become essential, especially in confidential meetings. Previous studies prevent eavesdropping by injecting a noise into the recording devices using electromagnetic waves or ultrasounds, hoping that the noise can cover the voice recording in similar frequencies. In this paper, we propose a new anti-eavesdropping method that attenuates the voice recording instead of covering it. As the voice recording is suppressed to a low volume, it is difficult to recover sensitive information even using noise reduction techniques. The key idea is to inject an inaudible high-frequency noise that can saturate the preamplifier in the microphone circuit. In addition, to avoid unintentionally interfering with non-eavesdropping devices such as conference microphones, we construct an anti-eavesdropping area using an acoustic parametric array, which can transmit the high-frequency noise into a confined area of choice. Based on the above methods, we built a proof-of-concept anti-eavesdropping system and achieved good experimental results on 4 smartphones and 2 voice recorders.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of Active Distribution Network and V2G Charging Stations Considering the Load Characteristics of V2G Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the MILP methodology is utilized to collaboratively plan the active distribution network (ADN) and Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) charging stations. This research considers the load characteristics of V2G charging stations in different areas, including residential areas, office areas, and commercial areas. In addition, the paper discusses the impact of energy storage system (ESS) and capacitor bank (CB) on planning costs. Besides, a demand response model is developed based on the influence of time-of-use tariff. The modeling also takes into account the load attributes of different nodes, including constant impedance, constant current and constant power characteristics. The present methodology was tested in IEEE 33-nodes distribution system. The planning results of three cases were compared, providing reference for planning issues considering V2G charging stations.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Method for Low-Carbon Development of Wind-Light-Biogas-Storage Integrated Energy Microgrids in Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Remote areas are rich in renewable energy resources, but the comprehensive utilization rate is not high; and due to restrictions of bitty terrain, the reliability of power supply is relatively low. To realize safe, clean and reliable energy supply in remote areas, integrating clean energy such as wind-lightbiogas resources and constructing integrated energy microgrids (IEM) with renewable energy as the main body is one of the important ways to promote low-carbon, safe and efficient development of power systems in remote areas. Therefore, this paper presents a multi-objective programming method for IEM planning considering the coordinated operation of wind-light-biogas-storage. Firstly, based on the in-depth analysis of operation and correlation characteristics of various energy conversion equipment in IEM, equipment models in wind-light-biogas-storage IEMs are established. Then, with the minimum system cost and the maximum utilization of clean energy as the objectives, the multi-objective planning method of IEMs is proposed, while planning and operation constraints. Finally, NSGA-II algorithm is used to solve the programming problem, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Medium and Long Term Carbon Emissions and Carbon Neutrality Scenarios Forecast of Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fujian Province is the first ecological civilization province in China. In order to research and judge the development trend of medium and long term carbon emissions in the province and deploy medium and long term emission reduction measures after the carbon peak in advance, it is necessary to analyze the province’s medium and long term carbon emissions under different scenarios. This paper uses the EKC-STIRPAT model and the scenario analysis method to construct three scenarios of baseline, accelerating transformation and deep optimization scenarios, then uses the trend extrapolation method to further extend the carbon emission of Fujian Province trajectory forecast to 2070. Further considering the development trend of carbon removal capacity in the medium and long term, it is expected that Fujian Province will achieve carbon neutrality in 2063, 2057 and 2054 under the baseline, accelerating transition and deep optimization scenarios, respectively. If the ocean carbon sink and soil carbon sink are further considered, the carbon neutralization time of Fujian Province will be advanced to 2053, 2049 and 2046 in the three scenarios, respectively. In the next stage, Fujian Province needs to take more measures to remove carbon and increase carbon sinks, and at the same time fully tap the carbon sink resources in the ocean and other fields to ensure that the carbon neutrality goal is achieved as scheduled.

articleTitle: Ferroalloy Submerged Arc Furnace Control Strategies for Wind Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power generation worldwide, the wind power consumption problems have become increasingly prominent, which seriously restricts the further development of wind power. Energy-intensive loads have capabilities for power adjustment, which can be employed as demand-side response resources to participate in power system peak regulation and improve the level of wind power consumption. This paper takes ferroalloy submerged arc furnaces as an example and proposes control strategies for ferroalloy submerged arc furnaces for wind power consumption. Case studies and simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies, which provides a new method for large-scale wind power consumption.

articleTitle: An Economy and Reliability Co-optimization Planning Method for Regional Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the Regionally Integrated Energy System (RIES) contains a large number of electric/cooling/heating loads with flexible regulation ability, which provides the possibility to improve the reliability of the energy supply of RIES. In this paper, a planning framework with ‘source/load/storage’ cooperative operation strategy is proposed for improving the RIES economy and reliability. Firstly, the Energy Hub (EH) and Integrated Demand Response (IDR) model of RIES have been established, the EH model includes energy conversion, Multi-energy Storage Systems (MESS), and PV. Secondly, this paper presents a mathematical planning model of RIES which integrates techno-economic and reliability objectives. Finally, the planning scheme is analyzed using a northern RIES for enhancing its reliability. The numerical results point out that the proposed integrated planning is an effective approach to improving the RIES's reliability and economy.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Based Efficient Data Fusion Model for False Data Detection in Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyberattack on power system brings new challenges on the development of modern power system. Hackers may implement false data injection attack (FDIA) to cause unstable operating conditions of the power system. However, data from different power internet of things usually contains a lot of redundancy, making it difficult for current efficient discriminant model to precisely identify FDIA. To address this problem, we propose a deep learning network-based data fusion model to handle features from measurement data in power system. Proposed model includes a data enrichment module and a data fusion module. We firstly employ feature engineering technique to enrich features from power system operation in time dimension. Subsequently, a long short-term memory based autoencoder (LSTM-AE) is designed to efficiently avoid feature space explosion problem during data enriching process. Extensive experiments are performed on several classical attack detection models over the load data set from IEEE 14-bus system and simulation results demonstrate that fused data from proposed model shows higher detection accuracy with respect to the raw data.

articleTitle: Research on Cost-Benefit Analysis and Arbitrage Strategy of Energy Storage for Industrial Users
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reduction of energy storage cost and the improvement of time of ues(TOU) mechanism jointly promote the development of energy storage on user side. The energy storage on user side can reduce the power consumption cost and even realize arbitrage through peak shaving and valley filling. This paper evaluates the economy of energy storage on user side by calculating the net annual value(NAV) while considering the benefits of saving electricity, reducing transformer capacity, residual value recovery, energy storage system cost, civil engineering and installation cost, operation and maintenance cost and other factors. In this paper, the economy of adding energy storage to four typical industrial loads is calculated respectively, and the charging and discharging scheme of energy storage device is given.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Stability Emergency Control Strategy Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality, and build a clean, low-carbon, safe, controllable, flexible, efficient, intelligent, friendly, open and interactive new-type power system, a large number of conventional generation units have been replaced by renewable energy sources, resulting in the reduction of the inertia coefficient of the power system and the deterioration of the transient frequency stability. After the HVDC blocking of a power grid, taking the sending end power grid as an example, a large amount of active power surplus leads to the increase of frequency, which may lead to the transient frequency instability of the power grid. However, the operation modes of the power system with high proportion of renewable energy sources are complex and changeable, and the manual establishment of different emergency control strategies for massive operation modes leads to a tremendous increase in workload and low efficiency. Therefore, this paper proposes a method, which in turn establishes a fast prediction model of frequency emergency control strategies based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL). From the perspective of data-driven, aiming at the frequency instability issues of HVDC blocking, a fast prediction model of frequency emergency control strategies is established to improve the adaptability of emergency control strategy to complex and variable operation modes. Finally, based on a regional power grid model, the application of this method is explained, and its effectiveness is verified.

articleTitle: Siting and Sizing Planning of Static Var Compensator to Suppress Harmonic Resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An optimal configuration planning of static var compensator (SVC) based on suppressing harmonic resonance is proposed. The installation of SVC changes the natural resonance frequency of the grid. A reasonable configuration of SVC can optimize the impedance distribution and shift the natural resonance frequency to the frequency band far away from the harmonic source. A siting and sizing planning to suppress harmonic resonance is proposed. Initially, the resonance frequency and modal frequency sensitivity (MFS) can be obtained by resonance modal analysis (RMA). Then, the optimal site can be obtained by calculating the participation factor (PF) of the resonance frequency. The static model of SVC is established, and the optimal installation capacity of SVC is obtained based on particle swarm optimization (PSO). Taking the maximum difference between harmonic source and resonance frequency as the objective function, simulations in Matlab/Simulink based on a modified IEEE-9 bus microgrid have been utilized to verify the effectiveness of the proposed planning.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning Model of Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on Bayesian Model Averaging Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase in the penetration of renewable energy and power electronic devices, the modern power systems will face great challenges for the traditional model-based transient stability assessment (TSA). In this study, a new ensemble learning TSA model based on Bayesian model averaging method is proposed. Firstly, the Long-short Term Memory (LSTM) network and multidimensional deep neural network (DNN) is used to establish eight independent machine learning models, according to the generator power angle, rotor speed electromagnetic power and bus voltage features. Since these sub-models can only achieve different accuracies ranging from 50%, 84.28% to 95% even for the simple test system, it can not have sufficient generalization ability for real world TSA applications. Then the pre-trained sub-models are weighted and averaged by Bayesian model averaging method to obtain the ensemble learning model. Case studies of electromechanical transient simulation are analyzed on the modified IEEE 39-bus test system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. The prediction accuracy of the ensemble learning model can reach a stable performance of 94.83%, which has great potential for future online TSA applications.

articleTitle: State Evaluation of 500 kV Transformer in DC Bias Based on Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the direct current (DC) bias level of the transformer, an evaluation method based on information fusion is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the features of vibration signals in the time, frequency and time-frequency domains under different severity of DC bias are collected and analyzed. Then, a multi-level evaluation model combining radial basis function (RBF) artificial neural network and improved analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is established. The RBF neural network takes the features as input and outputs the probability of the DC bias level initially. Then, the outputs of RBF are assigned certain weights via improved AHP, and the evaluation of DC bias of transformers can be realized. The proposed method is verified based on field data from 500 kV transformers of China Southern Power Grid. The results show the accuracy and feasibility of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting with Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate short-term load forecasting (STLF) is important for power system operation and energy trading. A two-encoder one-decoder model for STLF is presented in this paper based on frequency enhanced decomposed Transformer (FEDformer). It can integrate contextual information and load data by adding timestamp encoding in embedding. Fourier transforms converting data to frequency domain are adopted to better capture the detailed structures and save computational cost with a linear complexity to the sequence length. A mixture of experts for the seasonal-trend decomposition method is used to learn the data distribution and captures the global profile. The proposed model is tested on an ISO-NE dataset to conduct day-ahead forecasting. Comparison results with various existing methods have shown the outstanding performance of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Submarine Cable Burial Depth Trend Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of submarine cable working, the fault caused by the change of buried depth becomes more and more prominent. However, because the change of submarine cable burial depth is difficult to detect, a prediction method of submarine cable burial depth change trend based on convolutional neural network and long short-term memory unit combined neural network is proposed. First established considering dynamic characteristics of submarine cable material thermal resistance, thermal road model, according to the cable core temperature data, calculate the submarine cable burial depth data sets, then using convolution neural network mining cable buried depth data set that is associated with the time node characteristic vector and the input results into long short-term memory in the network optimization training. Thus, the development trend of submarine cable buried depth can be predicted. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by the prediction trend analysis of submarine cables buried in an offshore oil production platform. Compared with single convolutional neural network model and single long and short term memory neural network model, this method has higher prediction accuracy and higher prediction efficiency.

articleTitle: A Simplification Method for Robust Optimization of Power System Based on LMP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problem of robust DCOPF with the uncertainty from load and renewable power is considered. Intuitively, high load power and low renewable power output tend to increase the cost of controllable generators. Thus in most cases, the worst case of load power takes its upper bound and the worst case of renewable power takes its lower bound. As a result, the number of uncertain variables can be reduced. However, there are also counter-examples where the worst case is the opposite case. To study which uncertain variables can be reduced to deterministic ones, we summarize the connection between locational marginal price (LMP) and the worst case of uncertain variables. A simplification method based on LMP is proposed to reduce the number of uncertain variables. Simulations on 14bus, 118-bus, and 300-bus test systems have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach in reducing computation time.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis of Aerodynamic Damping on Transmission Line System’s Wind-Induced Vibration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission lines are typical wind sensitive systems. Transmission tower failures often bring huge economic losses. Studies on the characteristics of random wind field and wind-induced responses of transmission tower-line coupling system can provide important reference for improving the safety of transmission lines. This paper carried out wind-induced vibration analysis based on a 500 kV transmission line. Multiple random wind field between 10 m/s and 30 m/s are considered. The wind-induced vibrations of the conductors and the shield wires are calculated in different conditions based on whether aerodynamic damping or the influence of transmission tower is considered. The calculation results show that the aerodynamic damping can significantly reduce the conductors and the shield wires’ downwind amplitude. When the influence of transmission towers is taken into account, the amplitude of some conductors’ vibrations in the aerodynamic damping case is larger than that in the non-aerodynamic damping case. Besides, the shield wires’ high frequency vibration can be more significant in the aerodynamic damping case.

articleTitle: Unit Commitment with Nonconvex Cost Model in Deep Peak Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, China witnessed a dramatic growth of renewable energy generation, but the integration of renewable energy like wind power and solar power will bring some disturbance to the power system, thus the demand for deep peak regulation has continued to rise. In this context, more coal-fired units need to participate in deep peak regulation to absorb renewable energy, deep peak regulation of coal-fired power plants requires coal-fired power plants to adjust the output of the unit below the minimum technical output of the unit. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out deep peak regulation adaptation transformation for traditional coal-fired power plants and put oil into the boiler, so that coal-fired power plants can operate safely below the minimum generating output. After the unit is adapted and put into oil, it will bring about the cost of transformation and the cost of oil investment. The increase in these costs will make the total cost curve of the unit become a non-convex cost curve. Aiming at the difficulty in solving unit commitment optimization with non-convex cost curve. This paper introduces an unit commitment (UC) optimization method considering the non-convexity of power generation cost caused by deep peak regulation. Taking the 118-node system [17] as the research object, the simulation results in the UC of all units participating in peak regulation and all units not participating in peak regulation are given. The results show that when the non-convex cost curve is linearized, the increase in 0/1 variables will lead to slower solution speed of the unit combination program.

articleTitle: A Novel Economic Dispatch Method in Active Distribution Grids with Correlated Uncertain Power Injections
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solving the correlated uncertain power injections of wind power generations and photovoltaic power generations is a tough challenge for economic dispatch in active distribution grids. Although the chance-constrained method can solve this problem, it takes more time to determine the chance constraints. Therefore, a cumulant-based optimal method is proposed to solve the chance-constrained model for the economic dispatch problem with correlated uncertain power injections. Firstly, we set power injection adjustments as variables and established the economic dispatch model. Secondly, based on the Cholesky decomposition and the Cornish-Fisher series expansion, we calculate the cumulants of correlated uncertain power injections and establish the explicit expressions of chance constraints in power injection spaces. Thirdly, combined with the cumulants, a heuristic algorithm is used to solve the economic dispatch model. Optimization results for the modified PG&E69-bus distribution grid are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Control Scheme for VSC-MTDC System with multiple Renewable Energy Sites Based on Optimal Power Flow and Droop Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs a hierarchical control system to improve control performance in a multi-terminal high voltage direct current based on the voltage source converter (VSC-MTDC) transmission system. In this control scheme, the primary control layer employs droop control, while the secondary control layer has developed optimal power flow control (OPF) for maintaining the variation of DC voltage and regulating the active power, and simultaneously minimizing power loss. In the event of a power disturbance or a change in power generation or consumption in the DC system, based on OPF results a new stable droop operating mode is established to stabilize DC voltage variation and regulate active power in the network. A ±400 kV four-terminal VSC-MTDC test network has been developed by using PSCAD and MATLAB simulation tools to assess the proposed control scheme. The primary controller is designed in PSCAD, and the secondary optimum control technique is applied in MATLAB. The results of steady-state and transient operating modes demonstrate that the planned control technique can achieve DC voltage regulation and keep active power, and minimize the power losses in the MTDC system.

articleTitle: Calculation and Emission Reduction Effect Evaluation Model of Wind Power Lifetime Carbon Emission under Carbon Neutralization Target
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Taking a 2MW wind turbine as an example, this paper established an assessment model of carbon emissions in the whole life cycle of a typical wind turbine. The total carbon emissions and emission coefficient of the whole life cycle of a wind turbine are calculated by focusing on five stages: fan manufacturing, fan transportation, wind farm construction, fan operation and maintenance, fan decommissioning and dismantling. The calculation results show that the carbon emission coefficient of wind turbine is about 21.73g-CO2,eq/kWh. The carbon emission level of wind turbine manufacturing stage is the highest, accounting for about 75%, followed by the operation and maintenance stage of wind farm, accounting for about 11%. The carbon emission level of other stages is relatively small. By obtaining the carbon emission results of the whole life cycle of wind power generation, the key links of wind power carbon emission are clarified, which is expected to point out the direction of regulating wind power carbon emission, so as to better achieve the low-carbon target.

articleTitle: A Combined Clustering Scenario Reduction Method Base on Potential Decision Results for Generation Expansion Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Driven by the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, the capacity of renewable energy (RE) will begin to increase by leaps and bounds. The uncertainty of RE will challenge the operation verification of generation expansion planning (GEP). In this paper, a combined clustering method based on potential decision results is proposed for scenario reduction (SR) to reduce the scale of operational constraints. By solving the GEP model based on one single scenario, the multidimensional input domain is transformed into the potential decision result domain. The SOM and k-medoids clustering methods are combined to reduce the scenario while retaining the advantages of both methods. Then the XJTU-ROTS system is used as an example to verify the effectiveness and advantages of the method. The results show that compared with traditional clustering methods, the proposed method has the best SR effect under the optimal number of clusters.

articleTitle: Forecast of the Size of Transactions Involving Adjustable Loads in the Peaking Market Based on VMD-AdaBoost-SVM Based Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Predicting the adjustable loads participating in the regulation market is a key technology to achieve optimal grid dispatch and economic operation. In this paper, we propose a Variational mode decomposition (VMD)-AdaBoost-Support Vector Machine (SVM) based method for predicting the adjustable load in the regulation market. Firstly, we introduce an index named the peaking potential values representative of the real value of the loads. which is decomposed by the variational modal decomposition for data learning. To enhance the prediction accuracy, an adaptive augmentation algorithm (AdaBoost) is used to synthesize multiple SVM weak classifiers into a single strong classifier to produce an more effective classification for predicting the peak regulation potential of adjustable loads. Simulation experimental results show that the method has higher prediction accuracy and its prediction is better than that of SVM and SVM- AdaBoost algorithms.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit Model Based Photovoltaic Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of renewable energy, more and more attention is being focused on predicting the solar photovoltaic field. Efficient and accurate prediction of photovoltaic power generation is crucial for the stable operation of the power system. In this paper, a model based on a convolutional neural network and the bidirectional gated cyclic unit is proposed, denoted as the CNN-BiGRU mode, for ultra-short-term photovoltaic power prediction. Firstly, the Pearson correlation coefficient is used to analyze the correlation among PV output power and meteorological factors, and the total irradiance and scattering irradiance are selected as the model's input variables. Secondly, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to mine potential connections among data, and a bidirectional gated loop unit (BiGRU) is used to capture temporal dependencies among data. Finally, meteorological factors and corresponding historical data of PV power are selected, and then the output power of the PV power station is predicted by the CNN-BiGRU algorithm. Example analysis shows that the model can reduce the data dimension and improves the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Development of AC/DC Power Electronics Energy Router with Multi-scenarios and Multi-modes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy router is an important component in the energy internet, which can realize the interconnection, exchange and routing of energy and information among all links. With the deep integration of the cutting-edge digital information technologies such as power generation technology, power grid technology, big data and Internet of Thing, the requirements for the friendliness, flexibility, intelligence, reliability, and stability of applications to energy router are increasing. Taking scientific research institutes and universities as potential customers, this paper researches and develops a power electronics energy router with clear positioning, strong support and high efficiency that adapts to multi-scenarios and multi-modes. The energy router is able to achieve functions of displaying operation modes and verifying control principles to meet the needs of scientific research experiments and talents training.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Phase-locked Loops in Grid-connected VSC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The performance and applicable environments of various PLLs are different, studying their characteristics and analyzing their applicable environments have profound significance for the practical application of PLLs. However, the existing literature lack of horizontal analysis of PLLs. In all kinds of PLLs, the frequency-fixed SOGI-based PLL (FFSOGI-PLL) and the dual SOGI-PLL (DSOGI-PLL) can eliminate the effects of second harmonics, and the structure is simple and stable, the synchronous reference frame PLL (SRF-PLL) is the most widely used PLL. In this paper, SRF-PLL, DSOGI-PLL and FFSOGI-PLL are applied to the grid-connected VSC system, the mathematical models of them are established, the performance of these three PLLs is compared and analyzed under various alternating current (AC) system failures, and the actual engineering scenarios of their application are summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis of Safety Index in Substation Considering the Damage of External Ground Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to analyze the influence of the damaged structure of the grounding grid outside the enclosure of the substation on the safety parameters of the station, to improve the safety and stability of the operation of the substation, and to reduce the outage maintenance time in case of failure in the station, the simulation of the main grounding grid and the external grounding grid of the specific substation is established in CDEGS The test model simulates the change of power frequency grounding resistance and safety parameters such as contact voltage and step-by-step voltage after three different forms of off-site grounding grid are damaged. It is concluded that when the external grounding grid of the specific substation is damaged, the safety parameters in the station will no longer meet the requirements of relevant regulations. The research results of this paper can be concluded as follows: The damage of the grounding grid laid outside the enclosure of the substation provides the reference research steps.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Line Loss Data Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to help power companies and customers reduce the huge economic losses caused by line losses, it is important to obtain line loss information in advance. A line loss prediction method based on hidden Markov model is introduced to predict the line loss rate of future lines. Firstly, based on the line loss rate data collected by the station monitoring device, the data are preprocessed. Then, aiming at the problem that the network line loss fluctuates in a certain range due to the uncertainty of photovoltaic output and the time-varying operation state of the power grid, the fuzzy C-mean clustering method is used to transform the processed line loss rate sequence into a fuzzy time range. Considering that the time-varying line loss rate does not have a time-varying electrical connection, but the electrical connection is the line loss rate and the new energy output and the station area load rate, a hidden Markov model (HMM) of line loss is constructed to depict the conversion relationship between the line loss observation state and the hidden state, and to characterize the mapping relationship between disturbance and line loss. Finally, according to this conversion relationship, the prediction of the line loss rate of the line at the future time is realized. Through the actual measurement of the line loss in a province in central China, the accuracy of the method is verified, and the accuracy of the prediction result is as high as 80%.

articleTitle: Collaborative Emergency Control Strategy Providing Transient Stability After HVDC-link Blocking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Continuous commutation failures of line-commutated high-voltage direct current converter caused by AC faults lead to the blocking of HVDC-link. This may seriously threaten the stability of post-fault power system. Therefore, a collaborative emergency control strategy making use of DC power support is presented to guarantee transient stability after HVDC-link blocking. Firstly, the control enabling criterion is defined based on the variation characteristics of the phase trajectory slope during the first swing, while the analytical equation between the needed control quantity and the system parameters is derived. Secondly, the mathematical relation between the provided control quantity and the number of HVDC-links participating in the power support is deduced, and the participation sequence is determined on the basis of the post-fault stable equilibrium points. Additionally, the time delay of the whole implementation is considered. Finally, the effectiveness of presented control strategy is validated using the improved IEEE 68-bus AC/DC hybrid power system.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Combination Model Based Load Forecasting Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the ongoing energy transition, the proportion of distributed energy resources on the demand side continues to increase. Due to its uncertainty and randomness, massive distributed energy resources have brought new challenges to accurate load forecasting. In order to improve the forecasting accuracy, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting framework based on the dynamic adaptive combination of multiple forecasting models. The framework can decide whether and how to combine various forecasting models for the next period based on the prediction error of each model in the previous period. Based on the load and meteorological data of a region in Jiangsu Province in recent two years, the proposed load forecasting framework is demonstrated to achieve higher prediction accuracy than different single models.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Economic Dispatch of Integrated Energy System with Liquid Storage Carbon Capture Power Storage Considering Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the background of "carbon peaking" and "carbon neutrality", this paper proposes a low carbon economic operation strategy for integrated energy system with liquid storage considering demand response in order to improve energy utilization, optimize equipment operation flexibility, and further reduce carbon emission level and operation cost of integrated energy system. In this paper, we propose a low-carbon economic operation strategy for integrated energy systems with liquid storage that takes into account demand response. First, we introduce a carbon capture device with liquid storage in an integrated energy system to flexibly dispose of the CO2 generated from the operation of a thermal power unit. Second, we introduce a demand response policy to guide power users to modify their inherent power consumption patterns and adjust their power demand through an incentive mechanism, thereby modifying the power load curve and reducing the peak-to-valley difference. Finally, a low-carbon economic operational model of an integrated energy system with optimal total system operation cost is constructed, the CPLEX commercial solver is used to solve the constructed model, and the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is compared and validated by setting several operational scenarios.

articleTitle: Impacts of DGs in Active Distribution Network Considering Bi-Directional Power Flow and Carbon Emission Flow Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power grid is facing a low-carbon transition and the carbon emission flow (CEF) theory has become a useful tool to simulate the carbon consumption clearly. Studies have shown that when distributed generators (DGs) connected to distribution network, assuming that either node receives power flow only from the upstream node, the carbon intensity (CI) of downstream node would be affected. However, the carbon intensity of the upstream node is also affected if there is a bi-directional power flow in the system. This article focuses on the impacts of DGs in active distribution network (ADN). By utilizing the graph and data from revised IEEE 33 bus system, we are capable of not only analyzing bi-direction power flow with corresponding CEF in ADN, with case studies illustrating the CI of each node and the line with reverse power flow, but also proposing a simple optimal dispatch model considering CEF modeling, which could be solved without iterative method thus distinguish from previous research on this issue.

articleTitle: Modeling and Active Power Control of a Hydropower-Dominant Hybrid Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The dynamic modeling and the ultra-short time scale active power control of a hydropower-dominant hybrid energy system (HES) are studied in this paper. A five power sources HES includes hydropower plants (HPPs), pump storage power plants (PSPP), battery energy storage system (BESS), photovoltaic (PV) and wind power (WP) generation system is firstly simulated by MATLAB/Simulink. For the requirements of power tracking and smoothing target, active power control strategies considering the response characteristics of controllable resources are proposed. Simulation results and quantitative comparisons reveal an ideal control strategy, which has a better power regulation performance and can effectively relieve the burden of the hydropower system.

articleTitle: Short-Term Offshore Wind Speed Prediction Based on OWT-LSTM-ARIMA Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of offshore wind speed make a single prediction model less accurate. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, this paper proposes a combined offshore wind speed prediction model based on the combination model of orthogonal wavelet transform (OWT) -Long -Short Term Memory Network (LSTM) -Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model. The OWT is first used to decompose the offshore wind speed series into low-frequency sub-series and high-frequency sub-series to reduce the impact of volatility. The LSTM model is used to predict the high frequency subseries, and the ARIMA model is used to predict the low frequency subseries. Then the prediction results are fused to form a complete prediction of the offshore wind speed series. In addition, K-Medoids algorithm is improved to simulate the extreme weather at sea represented by lightning to further prove the superiority of the combined model. The results show that the combined model has higher prediction accuracy and stronger stability than the single model.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Park-Level Integrated Electric and Heating System Considering Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Park-level integrated electric and heating system (PIEHS) is a typical form of the integrated energy system (IES). The reasonable scheduling of PIEHS is necessary for promoting the transformation of the energy industry and is also a realistic demand for the low-carbon transformation of integrated energy park. Therefore, considering the carbon trading mechanism, the cost of carbon trading of the PIEHS is introduced into the objective function, and the low-carbon operation model of PIEHS is established. Two scenarios were set up on the P6H10 system to simulate and validate the proposed model. The results show that considering the carbon trading mechanism in the model can effectively promote the operation of low-carbon equipment such as distributed PV, energy storage, and CHP units in the PIEHS, which has a positive effect on the low-carbon transform.

articleTitle: Adaptive Carbon-Electricity Dual Pricing Mechanism for EVs Orderly Charging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the "dual carbon" background, carbon transaction cost has also become a factor to influence the variations in electricity price. In order to promote the energy conservation and emission reduction of household charging vehicles, this paper inlines the coupling relationship between the step carbon price and time of use (TOU) electricity price and proposed an orderly charging strategy for electric vehicles (EVs) based on stepwise carbon price and adaptive TOU price. The disorderly charging model of EVs is given with the Monte Carlo method. Meantime, a stepwise carbon price including reward and penalty sectors, as well as an adaptive TOU price model are established respectively. The proposed optimal EVs orderly charging strategy is solved by NSGA-II, a multi-objective genetic algorithm. It is verified that the incentive carbon-electricity dual pricing mechanism can effectively smooth the load profile and decrease carbon transaction costs. The sensitivity analysis of different carbon trading mechanism parameters is also studied. Simulation results show that the total cost of EVs optimal scheduling is largely reduced, which verifies the rationality and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Engineering Data Analysis of Sub/Super-Synchronous Oscillation between Wind Farm and MMC in Zhangbei Project
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To analyze the problem of subsynchronous and supersynchronous oscillation in the operation of Zhangbei renewable energy flexible DC power grid project, the voltage and current waveforms obtained from on-site recording data are analyzed. Fourier analysis shows the oscillation frequency is 44 Hz and 56 Hz. But in the dq-rotating coordinate, the curves of I<inf>d</inf>, I<inf>q</inf>, U<inf>d</inf> and U<inf>q</inf> are all composed with 6 Hz oscillation. At the same time, there is also a 6 Hz oscillation on the recording curve of DC current and DC voltage. It can be inferred that the 6 Hz oscillation on AC side and DC side is coupled with each other. This paper believes that this power oscillation phenomenon is due to the lack of DC current control. When the wind power rises rapidly, the capacitor voltage of VSC station is oscillated caused by control delay. This is the reason of oscillation of DC and AC voltage.

articleTitle: Constructing Method of Multi-regional Photovoltaic Power Output Scenarios Based on Conditional Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The randomness and fluctuation of PV power threaten the safe and stable operation of the power grid seriously. The construction of PV power output scenarios set based on the power prediction results is an important basis for the stochastic optimization of dispatching of the power system. To deal with the uncertainty problem of multi-regional PV output, a novel method of generating multi-regional PV output scenarios based on conditional generation adversarial network (CGAN) is presented. The method takes the PV power prediction data as the conditional value and generates the PV output scenarios set with considering the spatio-temporal correlation characteristics by CGAN automatically. The results show that the proposed method can construct the potential PV output scenario curves better, where the spatial correlation characteristics of the multi-regional PV clusters are clearly reflected.

articleTitle: A Generalized Data Recovery Model against False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recovering the compromised data after encountering a cyberattack is of prime significance for the subsequent controls and dispatches in smart grid. However, the previous recovery methods generally require some impractical assumptions or are only applicable in specific scenarios. To address it, a generalized data recovery model is proposed. It can be promptly activated to recover the pre-attack data after receiving the attack detection signal without making other assumptions. First, the measurement data inertia phenomenon is utilized to infer the preliminary values of measurements. Then, a generalized data recovery model is proposed. To analyze the recovered performance, two weighted parts are considered in the proposed recovery model, i.e., the attacked state estimation result and the inferred measurement values. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed recovery scheme are verified by conducting comprehensive experiments on the IEEE 30-bus benchmark.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy System of Offshore Oil and Gas Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, unmanned and low-carbon offshore oil and gas platforms have become a development trend. In order to meet the low-carbon operation of unmanned oil and gas platforms, this paper constructs an offshore oil and gas micro energy system considering the access of renewable energy, and realizes the low-carbon operation of offshore oil and gas platforms. Firstly, in order to deal with the uncertainty of renewable energy, a low-carbon system of floating power to gas-associated gas storage is constructed, and an offshore oil and gas micro energy system considering the access of renewable energy is established; Secondly, the heterogeneous flow coupling model of the system is established, and the stochastic fuzzy economic optimization model of the system is constructed considering the source and load uncertainties; Finally, through numerical simulation, it is verified that the application of renewable energy in offshore oil and gas platforms is conducive to reducing operating costs and environmental pollution, while considering the source load uncertainty and reasonably selecting the confidence level is conducive to ensuring the stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Prediction Method of Power Systems Considering Unit Coal Consumption
