publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The carbon emission of the power systems accounts for nearly 40% of the whole society carbon emission, and it is the key area of future emission reduction. At this stage, coal-fired power units are the largest carbon emission source in the power system. In order to more accurately simulate the carbon emission trend of the power system, this paper proposes a power system carbon emission prediction model that considers the change trend of coal consumption of coal-fired power units. Firstly, a carbon emission measurement model of power system based on carbon emission factor is established; secondly, combined with the national average coal consumption of coal-fired power units from 2005 to 2020, a load forecasting and coal consumption forecasting model of coal-fired power units based on Logistic curve are proposed; For example, considering the low-carbon transition of the power structure, the carbon emission trend of the power system in the medium and long term in Fujian Province is simulated, and relevant suggestions for low-carbon development are put forward.

articleTitle: Broadband Oscillation Monitoring Scheme for Coastal Wind Farm in East China Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to build a new-type power system with new energy as the main body, East China Power Grid will vigorously develop coastal wind power resources in the future, and continuously increase the proportion of wind power installed capacity. However, there have been many broadband oscillation events due to wind power control instability or the interaction between wind turbine and grid in the real high-proportion of wind power systems. Some researches focus on the oscillation mechanism and suppression methods on the wind farm side, from the perspective of large power grids, it is rare to study the rapid source traceability and emergency control strategies after oscillation occurs. In this regard, this article starts from the actual situation of East China Power Grid, analyzes oscillation risk after grid-connected large-scale coastal wind farms in the future, and studies the oscillation traceability method, monitoring device layout and monitoring system architecture. Then a broadband oscillation monitoring scheme suitable for coastal wind farms in East China Power Grid is proposed, which ensures the safe and stable operation of the East China Power Grid in the process of developing to a high-proportion new energy power system.

articleTitle: An Island Partition Method with Energy Storage Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the massive access of distributed generation (DG) and energy storage (ES), the distribution network (DN) can continue to supply power to important loads through island partition after losing the superior power supply, so as to improve the reliability of the system. However, due to the need to consider the sequential characteristics of ES, radial operation constraints of DN, secondary outage constraints of load and load priority, island partition is a complex NP hard problem. Therefore, an active DN island partition method of DN with ES based on genetic algorithm is proposed in the paper, which is characterized by incorporating radial constraints into the island partition model, selecting island benefit as the objective function. The repeated iterative calculation of genetic algorithm can ensure that the solution is better and has high versatility, which is a better solving method for the complex island partition problem. In addition, the sequence characteristics of ES, DN interconnection switch and secondary outage constraint are both considered in the island partition model at the same time. Finally, a case study for the improved PG&E 69-bus system is carried out based on genetic algorithm, which proves that the proposed method can finally solve island problem efficiently and get a great island partition scheme.

articleTitle: Polynomial Approximation of Transient Voltage Stability Region Boundary in the Parameter Space Based on Collocation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transient voltage stability region boundary (TVSRB) in the parameter space corresponds to a set of system variable parameters, under which the transient voltage trajectory of a key bus marginally meets the criterion of transient voltage stability. This paper proposes a method for polynomial approximating TVSRB in the parameter space based on collocation method. Firstly, an improved transient voltage stability index (TVSI) is proposed based on a practical criterion for transient voltage stability, which varies smoothly rather binarily as system parameters crossing TVSRB and hence can be better approximated by polynomials. Secondly, the relationship between TVSI and system variable parameters is approximated by polynomials using collocation method, and then adopted to derive approximated TVSRB by equaling it to be critical value of TVSI. The feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method is verified by the case studies of IEEE 9-bus test system. The obtained approximated TVSRB can be used to monitor system transient voltage stability or serve as the stability constraints of system operation and control.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Dispatching of Regional Power Grid Considering the Constraints of Carbon Quota
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of the power industry, power dispatching plays an important role in reducing carbon emissions. With the gradual development of carbon trading in China, low-carbon dispatching considering carbon trading has attracted wide attention. In this paper, considering the current carbon quota constraints, a two-level optimization dispatching model for regional power grid with distributed generation cluster is established. The influence of four different factors, i.e. the grid price of renewable energy, the proportion of renewable energy generation, load and carbon constraints, is analyzed. Low-carbon dispatching needs to optimize the unit combination and output according to the requirements of carbon emission reduction, which is an effective way to achieve carbon emission reduction quickly. The examples analysis and verification show that the proposed dispatching model can increase the output of high-efficiency and low-emission units, improve the power generation efficiency of low-carbon units, and provide incentives for low-carbon transformation of power generation enterprises.

articleTitle: Consider the Preliminary Safety Assessment of Power System under Gas-electric Coupling Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In an integrated energy system, due to the characteristics of multi-energy flow in the system, it brings inconvenience to the overall analysis, and the characteristics of multi-system coupling allow some faults to propagate between different systems. The topology of the network results in the existence of some key nodes in the system. For the analysis of the network structure, the weak points that affect the security of the system can be found, which can provide guidance and supplements for subsequent security assessments.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation of Integrated Energy System Considering Multiple Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) can realize the complementary energy supply of various energy forms such as electricity, heat and gas, so as to promote the consumption capacity of renewable energy and improve the comprehensive utilization efficiency of energy. The IES capacity planning considering multiple uncertain factors is closer to the actual situation, and it is also the basis for realizing multi-energy coordination and IES optimal operation. Aiming at the volatility of renewable energy such as wind and solar energy and natural gas prices, this paper proposes an IES capacity planning model considering multiple uncertain factors. The duality robust counterpart (DRC) algorithm is used to convert the uncertain problem into a deterministic problem. Finally, an IES capacity planning model with the minimum sum of investment and operation and maintenance costs as the objective function is obtained. The case studies show that the proposed model can economically and reliably satisfy the various types of load demands in the system throughout the planning cycle.

articleTitle: Deployment of Independent Energy Storage in Urban Area Based on Double -Layer Optimization Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China and neibouring countries in Great Mekong Subregion have all proposed carbon netuality and net-zero emission commitment, considering the continuous growth of power demand in central urban area, grid-side independent energy storage will play an important role in alleviating local system operating pressure. Overall optimization and implementation of appropriate business model are crucial to the sustainable and healthy development of independent energy storage. Firstly, A two-layer model of "scale optimization and spatial deployment" for key districts in central cities was implemented considering the regional peak shifting demand and the marginal nodal power cost. Secondly, a case study on the power grid in urban center of Guangdong province was carried out. Based on the optimization of deployment of energy storage, this article finally proves that rational deployment of urban energy storage can effectively improve the safety and reliability of the central urban system, and at the same time achieve the optimal investment benefit of the unit, which will promote the healthy and stable development of independent energy storage.

articleTitle: An Advanced Control Strategy Applying Reduced Order Extended Kalman Filter Algorithm for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor, the estimation of rotor position is an essential issue. The classical Kalman filter algorithm has been previously proposed to estimate rotor position, but it is commonly subject to parameter nonlinear characteristics. This paper presents an advanced control method based on Reduced Order Extended Kalman Filter (ROEKF) to deal with control issue of PMSM in low-speed region. The EKF is able to address the nonlinear characteristic of permanent magnet synchronous motor, where the reduced-order matrix can reduce computational burdens. Then, simulation verification is performed in MATLAB/Simulink and PSIM. In addition, experiments are performed to validate the proposed control method in a three-phase inverter-fed drive system using gallium nitride (GaN) power device. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control algorithm can quickly and accurately track the rotor position of PMSM.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Scheme of Large-scale Renewable Energy Transmitted Through Series Hybrid DC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to realize the collection and long-distance transmission of large-scale renewable energy in the "Three North" and southwest regions of China, two renewable energy transmission schemes through series hybrid DC system are proposed, including renewable energy island transmission and grid connection transmission. The series hybrid DC system adopts the hybrid structure of line commutated converter (LCC) and modular multilevel converter (MMC), which can make full use of the advantages of LCC and MMC. The paper presents the operation control strategy of hybrid DC system under two operation modes, and designs the startup strategy of hybrid DC system under different operation modes at the sending end. Finally, a simulation model is established in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the feasibility of the transmission schemes and the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Data-driven Method and Interpretability Analysis for Transient Power Angle Stability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale grid connection of Renewable energy sources as well as modern power electronics devices, the accuracy and rapidity of transient stability evaluation in power grids are increasingly stringent.The data-driven power system transient stability assessment can achieve online real-time prediction by learning the temporal characteristics before and after faults, but its application is limited by its inherent black-box nature. In this paper, an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) model-based transient stability assessment method is proposed for power systems, which can optimize the prediction accuracy while ensuring immediate response. To improve the interpretability of the evaluation results, the Yellowbrick algorithm is used to interpret the evaluation model prediction results from the perspective of feature importance, and the correctness of the interpretation results is verified by making predictive attribution analysis on a single sample based on Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) algorithm, which provides a reliable basis for online assessment of grid transient stability.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Joint Planning Method of Distributed Photovoltaic and Battery Energy Storage System Based on NSGA-III Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the aggravating of the energy crisis, the penetration rate of distributed photovoltaic (DPV) in the distribution network (DN) is getting higher and higher. In view of the adverse effects caused by DPV access to the DN, this paper proposes a multi-objective joint planning method of DPV and distributed battery energy storage system (DBESS). First, considering time of use (TOU) price and the security and economic indicators of DN, the annual average comprehensive cost, voltage fluctuation and network loss of the DN are taken as the optimization objectives, and taking the location and installed capacity of DPV and DBESS as decision variables based on the results of cluster division, a multi-objective joint planning model of DPV and DBESS is constructed considering the optimal operation of DBESS. Then, an optimization framework based on the third-generation Non-dominant Sequencing Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-III) is further built to solve the model, and the objectives and variables of different planning time scale are processed separately by means of embedding power flow calculation and hybrid coding method. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on the IEEE-33 node benchmark system.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Differential Current Principle for Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault diagnosis of power systems plays a crucial role in power system monitoring and control. When complex fault occurs or uncertain factors appear, such as mal-operation, miss operation and missing messages, the power system diagnosis methods based on switch and protection messages does not provide satisfactory result. A novel fault diagnosis method based on differential current is presented in this paper. The calculation of differential current of electrical equipments using data from fault recorders at fixed intervals is a basic feature of the proposed method, which leads to the simplicity and effectiveness in identifying the fault section. An intelligent fault diagnosis system (IFDS) based on the proposed method is established for on-line fault diagnosis. The IFDS has been applied in a regional power grid and practically verified by several complex faults. Results show that rapid and accurate identification of fault can be obtained with flexibility and portability.

articleTitle: How to Combine Standardization Digital Transformation Technology with Power Business Scenarios: Demand Analysis, Technical Route and Application Practice
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the requirements of digital transformation of power business scenario standards, how to carry out the technical route of digital transformation of power business scenario standards, and what problems exist in the practice of digital transformation of power business scenario standards, this paper puts forward the demand analysis, technical route and application practice of standardization digital transformation of power business scenarios. Firstly, according to the requirements of digitalization of power business scenario standards, this paper puts forward the demand analysis diagram of digitalization transformation of power business scenario standards covering five aspects, including "engineering construction, equipment operation and maintenance, power dispatching, customer marketing and safety supervision". Secondly, aiming at the problem of how to carry out the digital transformation of power business scenario standards, this paper puts forward a technical route of digital transformation of power business scenario standards, which includes four steps: data processing, result output, resource collection, and business application. In view of the application practice of the digital transformation of power standards, the digital transformation scenarios of power equipment management standards covering "unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and robot inspection" are proposed respectively, and the digital transformation scenarios of power supply chain standards covering "smart procurement and smart logistics" are proposed. Finally, the full text is summarized and prospected. The motivation of this research is that the current standardization digital field is in the exploration stage, and no one has proposed how to carry out the standardization digital transformation in the electric power business scenario. The significance of the research is to promote the top-level design in the field of standard digitization, and to sort out the requirements, technical routes and application scenarios for the digital transformation of power standards. The research contribution lies in the innovative proposal of the demand analysis diagram for the digital transformation of power standards, a technical route for the digital transformation of power standards and two application scenarios for the digital transformation of power standards. At the same time, it points out that the digitalization of standards involves not only technical issues, but also a series of engineering issues such as management mechanism.

articleTitle: Automatic Transient Stability Simulation and Assessment Scheme Based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increasing grid-connected renewable energy generation, the operating conditions of power systems are more changeable, which puts forward higher requirements for power system stability. Efficient transient stability simulation and accurate assessment become essential. To this end, an automatic transient stability simulation and assessment (AUTO-TSS&A) scheme is proposed based on the real-time digital simulation system (RTDS). The scheme is composed of two parts, namely the automatic generation of fault scenarios and the automatic assessment of transient stability. The former part automatically switches different fault scenarios based on the script function of RTDS. The latter part accurately evaluates the transient stability using the instability criterion of phase trajectory’s concave-convexity. Through the RTDS simulation of an actual 1000kV grid simplified model, the proposed scheme is proved to be effective, accurate, and efficient in transient stability simulation and assessment of large-scale power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Game and Benefits Allocation Strategies of Multi-energy Complementarity with New Energy and Thermal Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the goal of "achieving carbon peak by 2030 and achieving carbon neutrality by 2060" was proposed, the development of new energy plays a vital role in the power system of our country. At present, China’s new energy development is dominated by wind power and solar energy. However, new energy has the characteristics of high volatility and instability, which bring great challenges to new energy grid connection. How to deal with the problems caused by new energy consumption and grid connection is the direction of urgent research. Based on the current development of the electricity market, this paper builds a cooperative alliance of complementary thermal power and new energy on the supply side, so that thermal power can reasonably lower its output in the peak period of new energy output and reasonably increase its output in the trough period. In this way, promoting the consumption of new energy and the safety of grid connection and maximizing market benefits can be achieved.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for an Incentive-based Demand Response Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Incentive-based demand response is often modeled as a stackelberg game, which usually need complete information of customers. Reinforcement learning is always utilized to solve this problem under incomplete information. Prior to conventional reinforcement learning, which is vulnerable to dimensional disasters because of state and action space discretization, this paper proposed a deep reinforcement learning algorithm that can solve continuous state and action space to obtain incentive-based demand response interaction strategies of both participants under incomplete information. Simulation experimental results show that the results of the proposed method can obtain the optimal solution in the case of incomplete information in different types customers.

articleTitle: A High-accurate Commutation Failure Identification Method for LCC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Line-commuted converter based high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) technology has been developed rapidly. Commutation failure (CF) is one of the most common phenomenon in LCC-HVDC systems. To identify the CF fast and accurately to take efficient measures of control system, by analyzing the relationship between the LCC-HVDC commutation voltage and arm current during the commutation process, this paper proposed a new CF identification method based on commutation voltage and arm current. During the specified sampling time, if the commutation failure factor KCF is positive, it can be judged that the CF occurs. Simulation results show that the proposed method can identify the CF effectively and it is simple and easy to apply in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Optimal Network Reconfiguration Model of Distribution Network for Improving Reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is an important role of the distribution network to ensure the safety and reliability of the customers’ power supply. Network reconfiguration, as an effective distribution network control method, can play an important role in improving the reliability of distribution network power supply. In this article, we first analyze the influence of different operation modes of the grid distribution network on the reliability index, and explain the significance of rationally arranging commissioning lines and tie lines for reliability improvement. On this basis, we propose a reliability improvement model of distribution network considering post-fault network reconfiguration. The model takes the reliability index of the system as the objective function and the commissioning state of the line as the decision variable, and can give the optimal operation topology under normal condition. Numerical experiments show that the optimized network topology has higher power supply reliability than the original topology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Low-carbon Dispatching for Microgrid Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of carbon neutrality, the power industry is becoming the main battlefield of carbon emission reduction. However, the low-carbon transformation of energy structure is a complex long-term task, it needs to be analyzed in combination with the actual situation. This paper is based on the microgrid in the grid connection mode, considering microgrid power output and carbon emission constraints. An optimal model is proposed to reduce carbon emission cost, the optimal economic operation, and build a low-carbon scheduling model of a microgrid system. In this paper, the improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the model and the superiority of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: A Market Clearing Method Considering Dynamic Carbon Price and Carbon Pass-through Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To reduce greenhouse gas emissions, carbon market has received extensive attention as a market-based trading instrument. Meanwhile, the rapid development of electricity market has been witnessed worldwide. Given numerous fossil-fuel-fired units as co-participants produce massive carbon emissions, carbon market and electricity market are deeply coupled. Under such circumstances, this paper proposes a market clearing model considering dynamic carbon price and carbon pass-through factors. Firstly, the basic relevant concept is introduced and the newly clearing model is put forward. Then, the solution method of the model is proposed, which utilize the Lagrange Multiplier Method. Furthermore, a modified IEEE 30-bus system is used to validate the effect of the model. The case study illustrates the effectiveness of proposed method in carbon emission reduction.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of System Reserve Capacity Considering New Energy Uncertainty in Source-Grid-Load-Storage Scheduling Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The shortage of power grid backup is increasing, it is urgent to study the optimization method of reserve capacity under uncertain conditions. Robust optimization methods are mainly used in the study of reserve capacity optimization decision-making under the existing uncertainty conditions, but the results of interval optimization models are too conservative. A robust optimization method for reserve capacity considering the uncertainty of new energy output forecast is proposed. Using reserve capacity resources, a two-layer robust reserve capacity optimization model is established. The conservatism of the optimization results is reduced, and the total cost of the model is further reduced.

articleTitle: A Novel Architecture Design of Power Internet of Things Based on Huawei Internet of Things Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power Internet of Things (IoTs) can realize the access of the whole link equipment of power source, power grid, power load and energy storage in the energy Internet. At present, State Grid has deployed the Huawei IoT management platform to realize the standardized collection of data. However, the current IOTs management platform only realizes the access of MQTT protocol, and lacks the unified management capability for multi-source heterogeneous terminals. In this regard, this paper proposes a novel architecture design of power IoTs architecture. Focusing on the southbound device access and northbound device management of the IoTs management platform, a protocol analysis cloud gateway and a unified cloud edge collaboration architecture are proposed. In order to solve the problem of multi-protocol access, the protocol analysis cloud gateway deploys the parsing program in the form of plug-in in the protocol plug-in layer, which can be flexibly extended for new protocols. Aiming at the problem of device management, this paper proposes a unified cloud edge collaboration architecture, enhances the capabilities of remote management for application and container based on the northbound API interface of Huawei IoTs management platform, and proposes a method compatible with different edge computing frameworks on the edge side. At the same time, an experimental prototype system is built to realize the unified access to Q/GDW 1376, DL/T 698, IEC 101/104 and other types of protocol equipment, as well as the remote management of heterogeneous manufacturers' equipment.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Battery Energy Storage System for Secondary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A model predictive control (MPC) for battery energy storage system (BESS) participating in secondary frequency regulation of power system with dynamic state of charge (SOC) recovery reference value is proposed in this paper. The frequency regulation process of BESS is divided into different stages according to the area control error (ACE) signal of the power system. Considering the effect of frequency regulation and SOC recovery, this paper considers the effect of frequency regulation and SOC recovery, and obtains the optimal output of BESS under different ACE intervals by MPC. The fuzzy controller is used to determine the dynamic SOC recovery reference value when BESS performs SOC recovery, which makes SOC recovery more adaptive to load changes. The corresponding frequency regulation effect and SOC maintenance effect evaluation indexes are proposed. A two-area power system model is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK to verify the proposed strategy under step and continuous load disturbance, respectively. Simulation results show that the proposed method can improve the grid frequency regulation effect and ensures the long-term performance of BESS.

articleTitle: Carbon Flow Tracking based Carbon Emission Accounting of Low-Carbon Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: "3060 goal" has become an important strategic development goal of China. As industrial parks contribute 31% of the country’s carbon dioxide emissions, they naturally become the pioneer and main contributor in realizing the "dual carbon" goal, undertaking the industrial low carbon upgrading. To this end, it is urgent to help industrial parks plan green development paths, develop low-carbon parks, and facilitate industrial transformation and upgrading. However, accounting methods of greenhouse gas emissions in low-carbon industrial parks are not unified, but require in-depth discussions based upon the characteristics of individual industrial parks. Based on carbon flow tracking of industrial parks, this paper firstly analyses the accounting boundaries, energy structure, emission source and gas types, and on this basis proposes carbon emission accounting methods respectively for natural gas-fired power generation, externally purchased electrical energy, fugitive emissions and waste treatment for promoting the establishment of the greenhouse gas accounting system of low-carbon industrial parks. The empirical analysis based on an actual industrial park in Sichuan, China, verifies the applicability and practicality of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Optimization of Source-Grid-Load-Storage Coordinated Energy System for Low-Carbon Community
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cities all over the world are attempting to design and implement both climate change adaptation and mitigation strategies that will contribute to the pursuit of carbon neutrality goal. As a basic structural unit, community plays a crucial role in decreasing carbon emissions and creating low-carbon cities. Multi-energy sources such as electricity, heating, and cooling, are coupled and coordinated with integrated energy system, which is conducive in improving comprehensive energy utilization efficiency and providing more opportunities for the demand side to participate in system optimization. This study focuses on the optimization method of the proposed source-grid-load-storage coordinated energy system with high proportion of renewable energy in the comprehensive community. The results indicate that the optimized system can reduce carbon emission to 38 kg/(m<sup>2</sup>•a) and save 28% of the annual costs, and it is helpful for the energy system design of low-carbon community.

articleTitle: The Development Status and Trend of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor in the Electric Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of environmental protection and energy saving, electric vehicle technology has developed rapidly and has become a research hotspot in the current international automotive industry. The author briefly compares the drive systems of several commonly used electric vehicles and points out the advantages of permanent magnet synchr-onous motors, combined with the current situation of domestic and foreign research, from the aspects of permanent magnet synchronous motor materials and structural processes, control methods and motor topology, summarizes the technical problems faced by permanent magnet synchronous motors for electric vehicles, and looks forward to its application prospects.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Forecasting Method Based on Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a result of technical advances and cost reduction efforts, wind power has become prevalent as a competitive alternative energy sources. Due to the strong volatility of wind speed, it the extensive wasting of resources on wind power is not uncommon. Improving the accuracy of wind speed prediction can avoid this situation and improve the economic efficiency and utilization rate of wind power generation. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid predictive model that combines multiple optimization algorithms. Firstly, based on the envelope entropy, the particle swarm optimization improved by NSGA-II is used to select the parameter of variational modal decomposition. Then, in order to improve the machine learning model’s structure, the sparrow search algorithm is used to determine the optimal parameters of the deep extreme learning machine. Finally, use SSA-DELM to predict each decomposed component to obtain forecasting results with higher accuracy. The example analysis shows that this method has good performance.

articleTitle: A Low-Carbon Economic Scheduling Model of Integrated Energy System Considering Ladder-Type Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The concept of low-carbon development draws public attention. In order to fully tap the emission reduction potential, carbon trading is considered in scheduling. This paper propose a low-carbon economic scheduling model of integrated energy system considering ladder-type carbon trading. First, the model of the reward and punishment ladder-type carbon trading mechanism is established. Then, a low-carbon economic scheduling model of integrated energy system(IES) is proposed. Finally, a typical IES is used to verify the effectiveness of the model and a sensitive analysis is conducted to illustrate the relationship.

articleTitle: A RISC-V System-on-Chip Based on Dual-core Isolation for Smart Grid Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of digital power grids, the large number but low security level of smart power terminals makes the grid easier to face safe risks. In such a context, based on the protection needs of grid terminals, a secure System-on-Chip(SoC) architecture based on the RISC-V processor is proposed, which features dual-core isolation according to the hardware isolation principle and a secure boot based on the chain of trust. A secure serial port is also provided for digital authentication. The implementation of the architecture on FPGA shows that the influence of secure elements on the transmission is minimal.

articleTitle: An Electric Vehicle Charging Load Prediction Method Based on Travel Trajectory Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The charging load of electric vehicles (EVs) has stochastic distribution in the spatial-temporal dimensions. The integration of large-scale EVs brings new challenges to the operation and planning of power systems. In this paper, an EV charging load prediction method is proposed based on travel trajectory characteristics. First, we form the traffic network by dividing the geographical areas determined by their functions and simulate the original location of EVs described by Weibull probabilistic distribution. Then, considering the complex travel trajectories of different types of EVs, a charging load prediction model is constructed for private EVs and electric taxis. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by predicting the charging load of EVs in the urban areas of Nanjing City.

articleTitle: A Joint Optimization Method for Considering Demand Response Trading and Carbon Capture Power Plant Dispatch Based on Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This manuscript suggests a unified optimization approach that considers carbon capture plant scheduling and demand response trading in a carbon trading scenario. A demand response trading model is developed based on a platform, and a low-carbon economic optimization model of the system is created by integrating carbon capture equipment into conventional units, where the model incorporates the demand response trading mechanism and carbon capture equipment. Finally, the proposed low-carbon economic optimization model is evaluated via simulations, and calculation examples are used to analyze the cost of demand response trading and the dispatch cost of carbon capture equipment under the carbon trading market environment, thus demonstrating the efficacy and cost-effectiveness of the proposed method in achieving low-carbon goals.

articleTitle: Optimal Frequency Control Parameters Design of Wind Farm Considering Wind Turbine Grouping
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind farms play an increasingly important role in frequency control of the power system, but the identical wind speed assumption is oversimplified for the actual wind speed distribution difference in large-scale wind farms. This paper proposes a method of designing optimal frequency control parameters for wind farms considering wind turbine grouping. Firstly, the influence of wind speed on the frequency control capability of the wind turbine is analyzed and the principle of wind turbine grouping is proposed. Then, the equivalent frequency response model of grouped wind turbines is derived based on the capacity weighted method, which significantly reduces the calculation burden. Finally, to maximize the frequency nadir of the power system, the optimal frequency control parameters of the grouped wind turbines are solved based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed parameter optimization method, which effectively improves the frequency nadir of the system under the major power shortage disturbance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Optimized KNN Algorithm for the Data Security of DR Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The data of large-scale distributed demand-side iot devices are gradually migrated to the cloud. This cloud deployment mode makes it convenient for IoT devices to participate in the interaction between supply and demand, and at the same time exposes various vulnerabilities of IoT devices to the Internet, which can be easily accessed and manipulated by hackers to launch large-scale DDoS attacks. As an easy-to-understand supervised learning classification algorithm, KNN can obtain more accurate classification results without too many adjustment parameters, and has achieved many research achievements in the field of DDoS detection. However, in the face of high-dimensional data, this method has high operation cost, high cost and not practical. Aiming at this disadvantage, this chapter explores the potential of classical KNN algorithm in data storage structure, K-nearest neighbor search and hyperparameter optimization, and proposes an improved KNN algorithm for DDoS attack detection of demand-side IoT devices.

articleTitle: An Optimal Charging Strategy of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the oil crisis and environmental pollution caused by the development of fuel vehicles, electric vehicles (EVs) are supported and promoted by governments around the world due to their high energy efficiency, environmental protection, zero emissions and low noise. However, due to the randomness and uncertainty of the charging behavior in temporal and spatial dimension, the disordered charging of large-scale EV will cause many adverse effects such as load increase or fluctuation to the power grid. Research on optimized charging strategy for electric vehicle station is conducted considering the uncertainty of charging behavior of EVs, and an optimal charging model of electric vehicle charging station with the minimum peak-to-valley difference is proposed, which is solved by differential evolution (DE) algorithm. The case study demonstrates the impact of disordered charging of EVs on the power grid, and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Battery Energy Storage Application: Regulation and Peak Shaving for a Photovoltaic-Equipped Community
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage stochastic joint optimization problem, which mainly explores the economics of battery energy storage systems (BESSs) providing multiple services simultaneously. The services provided by BESS in this paper include remaining reserves for community photovoltaics (PVs), leasing capacity to provide regulation service to the power grid, and shaving the peak load for the community.

articleTitle: A Highly Fault-Tolerant Distribution Network Fault Diagnosis Method Based on KMP Algorithm and Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, the use of multi-source fault telemetry data in distribution networks is becoming a mainstream method to diagnose faults in distribution networks, but the results are often unsatisfactory due to misreporting and omission of information. Based on this, a highly fault-tolerant distribution network fault diagnosis method combining KMP algorithm and rough set theory is proposed in this paper, which firstly uses KMP algorithm to calibrate the multi-source fault telematics data, then uses rough set theory to filter the features of the calibrated data to obtain the best attribute parsimony combination, and finally feeds the telematics data corresponding to the best attribute parsimony combination into a BP neural network for Finally, the telematics data corresponding to the best combination of attributes are fed into a BP neural network for training. The results of the simulation tests conducted on the Python 3.7 platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Consumer Baseline Load Estimation in Demand Response: A Generative Adversarial Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Customer baseline load estimation plays an important role in the financial compensation settlement for incentive-based demand response. Current studies either rely on baseline load data from other consumers with similar load patterns or need the manual selection of valid features. However, these requirements are hard to satisfy in practice due to the fluctuation and personalization of customer power consumption profiles. To overcome this challenge, we propose a generative adversarial network-based customer baseline load estimation method. First, the estimation problem is converted into a time-series missing data problem. Then, the gated recurrent unit network is adopted to automatically distill the sequential information of historical baseline load data. Further, we take advantage of the generative adversarial network to recover incomplete baseline load data through a game between the generator and discriminator. Case studies based on a realistic dataset of building load demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust Day-ahead Economic Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Considering Load Uncertainties and Power Reserve Revenue
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system integrated with large-scale renewable energy requires additional reserves to maintain power balance. However, from the perspective of regional integrated energy system (IES), it remains a robust optimization problem as to how to quantify reserves supplied to upper grid corresponding to different load uncertainties. This paper proposes a robust day-ahead economic dispatch model of integrated energy system considering heating/cooling load uncertainties and power reserve revenue. It aims at supplying reserves to upper grid while satisfying electric/heating/cooling load balance requirements considering load uncertainty in different scenarios. The proposed model is tested on a multi-energy complementary distributed system project in a province of China and the results turn out that the model is able to maintain the balance between energy supply and selling power reserve.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Calculation and Optimal Design of Steam Carnot Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Carnot battery technology is an emerging energy storage technology, which stores electrical energy as thermal energy through the thermodynamic cycle. It has the advantages of low influence by geographical and environmental factors, low cost, and large storage capacity. This study focuses on a Carnot battery using water as its working fluid and proposes a modified steam Carnot battery. To optimize the performance of the steam Carnot battery, the relationship between main components’ parameters and several indicators is studied through energy analysis, exergy analysis, and control variable method. This paper also discusses the way multi-stage compression affects on Carnot battery. The maximum round-trip efficiency is 0.438 when adiabatic efficiency, the terminal temperature difference in reservoirs and heat exchange efficiency are set to 0. 85, 5 K and 0.9 respectively.

articleTitle: Attack-and-Defend Game Simulation Considering Strategic Bidding and Market Power Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Generators’ strategic bidding behaviors in deregulated electricity markets have been generally studied. However, market operators' abilities to identify and manage market power is gradually improved. This paper proposed a simulation framework around market power simulation, identification. The dynamic balance of market power identifications and strategic bidding behaviors has been studied through simulations.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Electricity-Hydrogen Dominated Highway Service Station Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the tremendous changes on the way that humans use energy, the coupling of transportation network and energy network becomes much closer than ever before. Under this tendency, the highway service station will undertake a big part of the responsibilities of connecting the energy consumers and energy suppliers specifically on the transportation sector. Hence, this paper proposes a novel configuration approach for the highway service station integrated energy system (HSSIES). Dominated by electricity and hydrogen, the HSSIES can operate normally through the cooperations of the different devices. Rich renewable energy sources can be well utilized due to the multienergy conversion in HSSIES, which highly improves the energy utilization efficiency. By applying queueing theory to the traffic flow in the HSSIES, M/G/k model and M/M/k model are selected to model the electric vehicles (EVs) and the fuel cell vehicles (FCVs) respectively, where the static service intensity rate and the average waiting time are used to evaluate the configuration of charging piles. With the consideration of both the planning stage and operation stage, a stochastic optimization model is established to get comprehensive configuration results. A case study is carried out to prove the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Demand Response Framework with Participations of Flexible Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To realize the decarbonization of power systems, many studies concentrate on the carbon emission on the generator side, yet neglect the effect of the adjustment of electricity consumption behavior of flexible loads on the user side on the carbon reduction. Therefore, a low-carbon demand response framework with dynamic carbon emission factors (DCEFs) as incentive signals is proposed to motivate electrical customers (ECs) to adjust their electricity consumption behaviors to indirectly affect the carbon emission of the system. The proposed framework covers 4 steps, i.e., DCEF calculation, baseline load prediction, ECs’ electricity consumption behavior optimization, and carbon reduction benefit estimation. Thus, to effectively inspire electrical consumers to interact with power systems via demand response, a precise DCEF calculation method is established based on carbon emission flow theory. To guide ECs to adjust their electricity consumption behaviors of flexible loads to indirectly reduce carbon emissions, a strategy for electricity consumption behavior adjustment is proposed with electricity consumption models of flexible loads. Finally, the case studies illustrate the validity of the proposed framework in a modified IEEE 33-bus test system. The simulation results show that the proposed framework could help the system operator realize the decarbonization of power systems via demand response.

articleTitle: Harmonic Source Modeling Method Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of power electronics technology, power electronic devices are widely used in life, making nonlinear loads a large class of harmonic sources injected into the power grid. Due to the small capacity and low power of loads for home users, the harmonic problem can be ignored, while industrial users, due to their large capacity and many nonlinear devices, cause serious harmonic problems that cannot be ignored. If the harmonics are not reasonably and effectively intervened, they will flow into a higher level power system and cause a series of related power quality problems, which makes the design of power quality management scheme difficult. In the process of harmonic analysis and management, it is necessary to establish an accurate model of harmonic sources. By applying the power quality monitoring data of industrial users, this paper proposes a harmonic source modeling method. Firstly, preprocess the power quality monitoring data, then the characteristic matrix of harmonic voltage and current is constructed, and the decision tree is built by training the harmonic data, and the unknown harmonic voltage and current values are regressed and analyzed, and finally a harmonic source model based on random forest algorithm is established, and the proposed method is verified by applying the power quality monitoring data of industrial users at 110 kV voltage level in a certain place. The results prove that the proposed method has higher accuracy for harmonic current prediction compared with the traditional harmonic source model, and can accurately evaluate and predict the impact of each harmonic voltage difference on harmonic current, which is beneficial to provide theoretical basis for preventing harmonic pollution and analyzing the influencing factors of power quality characteristics of power system.

articleTitle: Mechanism for PJM Ancillary Service Market to Promote Flexible Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to stimulate flexible resources, there have been many changes in the rules of the PJM ancillary service market. Based on the relevant rules of PJM, this paper systematically analyzes the relevant electricity market operating prices in the past three years, and takes a pumped storage power station as an example to investigate its income in PJM. The research shows that: 1) Even if the ancillary service market has been reformed, the power market still maintains the basic logic with the day ahead market as the core. 2) PJM adopts regulation performance price to provide more returns for flexible resources, but its opportunity cost is only more accurate accounting without special incentives.

articleTitle: Online Identification of Inertia and Primary Frequency Control for Wind Farms with Virtual Inertia Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme for online identifying the inertia and primary frequency control of wind farms with virtual inertia control. The power generation deviation and frequency deviation are defined as the model’s input and output, respectively. With this time-domain input and output, as well as some knowledge of the system structure, the inertia and the primary frequency control can be identified. In order to validate the proposed scheme, both simulation data and field PMU data are applied as the measurement data. In both cases, the identification scheme achieves high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Dynamic Current Carrying Capacity of 110kV oil Immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to alleviate the problem of high short-term load rate in summer, improve the power transmission and transformation capacity of urban power system and improve the utilization rate of transformer equipment, the dynamic current carrying capacity prediction of 110kV oil immersed transformer is studied in this paper. This paper first calculates the hot spot temperature, top oil temperature and 24-hour life loss percentage of the transformer by using GB 1094.7. Secondly, the long-term and short-term memory neural network model (LSTM) is trained and verified. Compared with ARIMA model, it highlights the high accuracy and rapid convergence of LSTM, and predicts the power load data in the next 24 hours according to the historical data of power load in one month. Finally, set the three constraints of hot spot temperature limit, top oil temperature limit and life loss limit, calculate the normal, long-term and short-term current carrying capacity of oil immersed transformer according to the predicted power load data and real-time ambient temperature, and draw a conclusion: hot spot temperature is the limiting factor affecting the long-term and short-term load capacity of transformer, and the long-term current carrying capacity of this transformer is 1.61 times that of the original, The short-term current carrying capacity is 1.64 times of the original, which provides a certain reference for the power dispatching department.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Multi-objective Coordinated Optimal Operation of Source, Network and Load of New Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal distribution strategy of the new distribution system will be affected by factors such as distributed energy and the randomness of different loads. The tractate consider the coordinated operation mechanism of the source network load of the new distribution system, establishes the coordinated optimization operation model of electric vehicle power battery and wind power, and puts forward the technical scheme of the coordinated operation strategy, which provides Provide technical support for wind power planning and design and multi-source-load scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Miscut Angle Modulation on the Anomalous Hall Effect Based Magnetic Sensor for Better Performances
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Magnetic sensors that can detect more than one sensitive axis have attracted much attention due to the ability to increase the accurate and security in monitoring energy quality. However, most of the hall and anomalous hall sensors are naturally only sensitive to the z axis. To address it, we grow Co0.2Fe2.8O4/MgO with different miscut angles to improve the performance and to realize in-plane sensitive to magnetic field. We found that the miscut angle can tune the magnetic anisotropy axis and endow the anomalous hall sensor the ability to sense in-plane magnetic field. The Co<inf>0.2</inf>Fe<inf>2.8</inf>O<inf>4</inf> based device with miscut angle of 3° shows sensitivity of 10.9 V•A <sup>-1</sup>•T <sup>-1</sup> and 2.8 V•A <sup>-1</sup>•T -1 to field along out-of-plane and in-plane axes, respectively It reveals that the miscut angle engineering can effectively improve the performance of magnetic sensor for energy security, car industry, etc.

articleTitle: Analysis of Reactive Power Output Increment Characteristics of the Condenser in UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Condensers are installed in the UHVDC converter station to avoid commutation failure. When a short-circuit fault occurs in the system, the condenser will emit a large amount of instantaneous reactive power and raise the voltage of the bus voltage on the inverter side, which helps avoid continuous commutation failure. Therefore, it is very important to estimate the instantaneous reactive power capability of the condenser. Firstly, the calculation equation of the reactive power output increment of the condenser is derived. Compared with the general instantaneous reactive power formula, the equation given in this paper contains the initial operating state of the condenser, the short-circuit ratio (SCR) of the AC / DC system, and the electromagnetic parameters of both condenser and transformer. Secondly, the influence of the parameters of the AC/DC system and the condenser on the reactive power output increment is analyzed. Finally, through the analysis of the reactive power output increment capacity of the condenser, a scheme to maximize the support capacity of the condenser to the power grid is obtained.

articleTitle: Flexible Magnetic Sensor Based on Fe3O4/Mica Heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Magnetic sensor can contactlessly monitor current in energy system, whose portability is of great importance in practice. Here we grow the Fe<inf>3</inf>O<inf>4</inf> epitaxial thin film on flexible Mica substrate to realize the flexible magnetic sensor. Based on the anomalous hall effect, we found that the hall bar device shows high sensitivity to magnetic field, even at temperature of over 400K. Especially for the 15 nm-thick film devices with medium growth speed, high sensitivity of~13.6V/(A•T) at range of ±2000 Oe has been achieved, which is comparable to the reported anomalous hall magnetic sensors with large measure range. We further examined the flexibility of the magnetic sensor. Under bending fatigue test, the change of hall resistance is less than 3%, which proves the stability of the device under bending. Our finding reveals that the flexible Fe<inf>3</inf>O<inf>4</inf>/Mica heterostructure can be a good candidate for flexible magnetic sensor that can work at over 400K.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Accessories Voltage Measurement Based on Electric Field Inversion and Chebyshev Integral Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage measurement of high-voltage cable is a challenge nowadays. Using non-contact voltage measurement method, it is possible to measure the voltage of cable at a low cost and small volume. This paper proposes a new method to measure the voltage of cable by sticking the electric field sensor on the surface of the cable accessories. Using the Chebyshev integral, the voltage along the surface of the cable accessories can be calculated. To verify the feasibility of the method, this paper calculates electric field distribution by COMSOL Multiphysics. To get higher precision this paper chooses the interval with a high electric field value as the integrating range and compares the precision in the different number of sensors. The results shows that the error of the voltage measurement can be less than 1.5% based on Chebyshev integral using 5 to 6 sensors.

articleTitle: Calculation for Minimum Inertia of Power System Based on Improved GWO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy gradually increases, the rotational inertia level of the system is weakened and the frequency fluctuation characteristics of the system are affected. Therefore, it is necessary to obtain the threshold of inertia required for the safety and stability of the system frequency. Considering generator power regulation dynamics, dead zone and power saturation, a detail system frequency response model is proposed in this paper. Based on this, the system frequency dynamics is numerically calculated according to trapezoidal integral principle. Based on the above frequency calculation, an optimization model about minimum inertia is proposed considering renewable energy plants. And then the improved GWO algorithm based on Levy flight principle is brought up to solve this problem. Finally, a modified IEEE 10-machine 39-node system is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Regulation Approach for Virtual Power Plants with Variable Granularity on Multi-time Scale Considering Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic power output, the stable operation of the power system can be threatened by the large-scale grid connection of renewable energy sources. Virtual Power Plant (VPP) can aggregate distributed resources such as renewable energy, energy storage and flexible loads and operate them in a coordinated manner. By participating in the electricity market and carbon trading market, the economics of VPP can be improved while reducing carbon emissions. This paper proposes a multi-timescale variable granularity coordinated regulation method for virtual power plants, considering the impact of uncertain wind power and photovoltaic output and carbon quota trading on the operational scheduling of virtual power plants. The feasibility of the proposed approach is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Optimization-Based Model for Microgrids with Energy Storage Considering Operation Cost and Net Load Mean Square Error
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When a high proportion of renewable energy is connected to the grid, the net load fluctuation can be suppressed by configuring energy storage. However, the current cost of energy storage is high. This paper proposes a bi-level optimization model that takes into account the dynamic allocation of shared energy storage (SES) capacity in response to electric load demand. The upper-layer objective function adopts EO optimization algorithm, which is to maximize the income of the shared energy storage operator (SESO). The lower-layer multi-objective function is to minimize the sum of the operating cost and the net load mean square error of multiple microgrids, which can be classified as the mixed integer linear programming problem. Then, the solution flow of the algorithm is given. Finally, under the constraints of the hierarchical optimization-based model, solving the problem by the CPLEX solver on the MATLAB platform. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can allocate optimal capacity and reduce operating costs for microgrids. Simultaneously, this method increases the revenue of SESO and promotes the consumption of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Ensemble Clustering Model for Load Pattern Identification under Energy Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric power load pattern recognition from various accumulated load data is performed for energy efficiency improvement, power system operation support, and demand side management. In this study, we develop an ensemble clustering-based framework for electric power load pattern recognition in industrial park. Specifically, it focuses on the electric power load pattern recognition of business office industrial park with air conditioner as the main energy consumption. The hourly air conditioning electric power load data and hourly electric power load data in an industrial park in Suzhou, China, during a year from January 1, 2019 to December 31, 2019 are used in the experiment. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed framework in recognizing the electric power load patterns in industrial park. The identified electric power load patterns could be potentially used to support the decision-making industrial park energy management.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Flow Optimization Regulation Method of Provincial Energy Internet Based on Energy Balance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A provincial energy Internet multi-energy flow optimization regulation method based on energy balance is provided in this paper. This method starts from the perspective of single period and multi-period, and comprehensively considers prefecture-level city and provincial level energy balance relationship, so as to achieve multi-energy flow optimization regulation. Firstly, bus electric and heat balance model are established on the basis of collecting various data and information of prefecture-level city energy resources. Secondly, common bus model of energy balance in prefecture level is proposed, and the equivalent idea to aggregate the same units is adopted. Then the typical electric thermal interconnection energy system model in prefecture-level city is established. Finally, the optimization is solved, and its result information is output. The effectiveness and rationality of optimization regulation for provincial energy Internet multi-energy flow have been verified through simulation examples, providing reference and theoretical guidance for provincial energy Internet multi-energy complementary utilization, resource coordination, economic and efficient operation and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Analysis Method of Power Communication Digital Twin Network Based on Rules and Cases
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to determine the root cause of the fault from the alarm of the power communication network, the fault analysis rule base based on the combination of fault alarm event tree and code book method rules is adopted by using digital twin, and the fault handling case base accumulated gradually is combined to realize the intelligent analysis and handling of the fault. The fault analysis technology combining rules and cases improves the fault handling of the power communication network.

articleTitle: A Multi Time-Scale Robust Aggregation Model for Virtual Power Plant Based on Rolling Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) is an effective solution for the aggregation of distributed resources. To exploit the flexibility inside distributed resources, a multi time-scale robust aggregation Model is proposed in this paper. A day-ahead robust aggregation model based on robust optimization is proposed to formulate a robust feasible region of the VPP. Based on the day-ahead aggregation model, the VPP updates its aggregation model at the next dispatch period according to the latest information to reach a compromise between robustness and economy. The robust optimization problem is solved by an iterative heuristic methodology based on the column-and-constraint generation algorithm. Results from a case study demonstrate that the proposed multi time-scale aggregation method is satisfactory in both precision and calculation speed.

articleTitle: Research on the Sichuan-Chongqing Gas-hydro Bundled Delivery Model Considering the Willingness of Receiving End to Consume
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Replacing thermal power with gas power can promote the realization of the "Carbon peaking and carbon neutrality" goal. Firstly, this paper discusses the development thoughts of gas-hydro integration given the seasonal contradictions of Sichuan-Chongqing hydropower and the advantages of natural gas resources. Secondly, the influence of the willingness of end-end consumption is analyzed on the price of electricity sent to the outside world, and a model of gas-hydro bundled delivery is built. Finally, the economics and carbon emission reduction of gas-electricity replacing thermal power are analyzed taking the example of the Sichuan-Chongqing power grid information in 2019. The case verifies the rationality and feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistance Current Inversion Algorithm Based on Two-valued Function Branch Fitting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the requirements of the smart grid, it is necessary to monitor the current of each frequency component in the grid. Under high-frequency current, the tunnel junction magnetoresistance(TMR) sensor has large measurement error due to magnetic hysteresis. In this paper, an optimization algorithm for TMR sensor measurement based on two-valued function branch fitting is proposed. The algorithm reduces the influence of the magnetic hysteresis of the TMR sensor under high frequency current. Experiments show that this method can improve the accuracy of the TMR sensor to about 1.5% under the current of 5kHz.

articleTitle: A Measurement Optimization Configuration Method Based on Investment Cost Constraints for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale distributed generation connected to the distribution network, the observability of the distribution network is insufficient and the energy management ability is reduced. Considering investment cost constraints and state estimation accuracy requirements, it is crucial to realize the optimal configuration of distribution network measurement. In this paper, a measurement optimization configuration method considering investment cost constraints is proposed to obtain the measurement optimization configuration scheme with the high state estimation accuracy, which is to solve the measurement configuration problem with mixed integer nonlinear programming based on the ant colony algorithm. The results of case study analysis show that the proposed method can effectively improve the calculation efficiency and obtain better measurement configuration results. And it showed the computational performance of the proposed method is far superior to some popular other simplified calculation methods based on Fisher information and circuit representation error in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency, and scalability.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Optimization Model of Power Spot Market under Renewable Portfolio Standard
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China officially began to implement the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) in 2021, which requires power users to take the actual consumption of renewable energy electricity as the main way to achieve the target. At the same time power users can also purchase Renewable energy certificate (REC) and surplus renewable energy consumption as a supplementary means. Based on the above framework, a bilevel multi-agent decision optimization model including renewable energy day-ahead market, conventional energy day-ahead market and real-time market is established under the RPS, and transformed by the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker condition, strong duality theorem and binary expansion method. It is transformed into mixed integer linear programming to find the market equilibrium. The effects of assessment index of RPS, REC price and renewable power penetration on market equilibrium characteristics are discussed. The results show that in the market equilibrium state, the day-ahead market clearing price of renewable energy is equal to the conventional energy clearing price plus the REC price, and with the increase of the penetration rate of renewable energy, the power spot market clearing price of electricity shows a downward trend.

articleTitle: A Resonance-Based Switching-Loss-Free Boost Topology and Its Control Method for Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Boost circuit is the key of grid-connected photovoltaic converter, The existing boost circuit mostly adopts hard-switching modulation with high switching loss, hindering the efficiency improvement. And it also limits the switching frequency, making it difficult to miniature the converter. In this paper, a resonance-based switching-loss- free (SLF) boost topology and its control method for photovoltaics are proposed. Through adding resonant capacitance, auxiliary switch, and the reused energy storage inductor, the resonant cavity is constructed to realize zero current turn-on and turn-off of main switch and zero current turn-off of auxiliary switch. The method greatly reduces the switching loss, decouple the limit of switching loss on frequency, greatly increase switching frequency and reduce the volume of passive components, and increase the power density. This paper gives the designing method of the topology and control parameters, builds a model on matlab/simulink and Opal-RT/RTlab platform, and the simu-lation results show that the main switch realizes zero current turn-on and turn-off while the auxiliary switch realizes zero current turn-off, which verifies the effectiveness of the topology and control method.

articleTitle: Short Term Load Forecasting Model for Process Industry Based on Hybrid RNN-LSTM Algorithm: A Case Study of Textile Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the data of the National Bureau of statistics in 2020, the industrial load accounts for 67% of the total power load, accounting for a considerable proportion of the entire load. If the accurate prediction of short-term industrial load can be realized, it will provide necessary guarantee for the stability and security of the power grid. However, industrial load forecasting was more complex than other types of load forecasting. Then, a prediction model combining the recurrent neural network (RNN) with the industrial load mixing prediction model (RNN-LSTM) and the long short-term memory (LSTM) model was proposed. Compared with the LSTM model, the results show that RNN-LSTM was significantly improved for MAPE, MSE, and MAE.

articleTitle: A Tight Power Balance Disposal Strategy with Electric Vehicle Charging Station Providing Flexible Ramp
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To deal with high volatility and uncertainty of wind power, the power system needs to have sufficient flexibility. With increasing wind power penetration in the power system, the need for flexibility is on the rise. Under the tight power balance state, if only relying on thermal units to provide flexibility, the system flexibility is insufficient. It is necessary to develop flexible resources to reduce wind spillage and load shedding. To address the above problems, a tight power balance disposal strategy with electric vehicle charging station providing flexible ramp is established. The numerical simulations and analysis are conducted on the modified PJM 5-bus system.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation and Economic Analysis of Energy Storage Capacity of New Energy Power Stations Considering the Full Life Cycle of Energy Storage
