publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy power stations operated independently often have the problem of power abandonment due to the uncertainty of new energy output. The difference in time between new energy generation and load power consumption makes the abandonment of new energy power generation and the shortage of power supply in some periods. Energy storage for new energy power stations can solve these problems. Firstly, the expenditure model of independent operation of new energy power station is established. Then, the whole life cycle of energy storage is modeled, and the generation cost of new energy power stations is calculated by cost electricity price. Then, formulate the charging and discharging strategy of energy storage. With the goal of minimizing the total expenditure of the new energy power station and the constraint of meeting the charge and discharge power of regional load power supply and energy storage, the genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem when the power station is configured with different energy storage. Through simulation analysis, this paper compares the different cost of kilowatt-hour energy storage and the expenditure of the power station when the new energy power station is configured with electrochemical energy storage, pumped energy storage, and compressed air energy storage. The calculation example shows the economic efficiency of the new energy power station. At the same time, the sensitive factors affecting the cost of kilowatt-hour energy storage and the expenditure of the power station are analyzed.

articleTitle: Economic and Environmental Benefits of Vehicle-to-Grid in the Power System: A National Study of China’s 2030 and 2060 Dual-Carbon Goal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a systematic evaluation framework of how electric vehicles can impact the decarbonization pathways of the whole electricity system, especially from the vehicle-to-grid (V2G) mode. Modeling of the transition toward a ‘near-zero’ carbon emission system includes the optimization of multi-provincial power dispatch and expansion planning via evolutionary steps of five years from 2020 to 2060. Based on the actual geography resources, statistics of the driving behavior and power generation and consumption data, three electric vehicle charging regimes are considered, namely unmanaged charging (V0G), smart orderly charging (V1G) and V2G. Results show that the implementation of V2G in China can reduce the total cost and unit decarbonization cost of the electricity system by 19.4% and 47.8%, and reduce the carbon emission in 2030 and 2050 by 6.4% and 45.7%. The required extra energy storage would decrease from 1146 GW to 296 GW in 2050. The model and assessment results can be used by policymakers to determine competitive flexibility technologies.

articleTitle: Development of Environmentally Friendly and Efficient New Energy Rail Locomotives for Industrial and Mining Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Diesel locomotive has the problems of high operation cost, serious pollution and high noise, thus an environmentally friendly and efficient new energy rail locomotive is studied in this paper, which can be applied to internal transportation in industrial and mining enterprises. Key parameters design methods for multi scene application are proposed, including locomotive adhesion weight, power and capacity of battery system, starting and continuous traction, motor parameters. Besides, system integration of rail locomotive is presents, which includes motor control unit, locomotive control unit, battery and BMS management system as well as traction motor. Furthermore, experiments are carried out on the new rechargeable rail locomotive, which has been put into operation in Nanjing Iron & Steel Untied Co., Ltd. The results have proved that the track electric locomotive can operate well under different working conditions. Compared with the diesel locomotive, it saves the fuel cost greatly and has higher economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Two-Level Game Optimal Dispatching Model for Integrated Energy System Based on Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of integrated energy system can improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emission, which is of great significance to energy sustainable development. However, the elements of multi-energy participation are becoming more complex in the low-carbon and economic operation for integrated energy system. To solve the above problem, an optimal dispatching model for integrated energy system considering carbon trading mechanism based on two-level game is proposed. Firstly, a utility function using the subjective-objective combination weighting method is constructed, which considers the cost of carbon emission, energy consumption behavior of users, and loss of user satisfaction. On this basis, the evolutionary game is used to analyze the behavior of user dynamic selection of energy suppliers. Secondly, the cooperative game considering the carbon trading mechanism among energy suppliers is applied to increase profits. Finally, the distributed iteration method and improved Shapley value method are used to solve the two-level game model. The results verify the rationality of proposed model and the effectiveness of algorithm.

articleTitle: Coordinated Emergency Control of Transient Frequency and Voltage Stability in Sending HVDC System with Wind, Photovoltaic and Hydropower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: component, formatting, style, styling, insert (key words) Abstract—The frequency problem of sending power system caused by the blocking of HVDC could be solved by emergency control of active power, such as cutting off wind or photovoltaic power plants. However, the voltage safety problem may arise after the accident. Firstly, the mechanism of active power emergency control causing voltage out of limit was analyzed, and the integrated emergency control scheme of active power and reactive power control was proposed, taking into account of the coupling of active power and voltage. Then the coordinated emergency control optimization model of HVDC sending system with multiple control measures was established, taking the minimum control cost as the objective and considering the transient voltage and transient frequency security as constraints. Thirdly, the sensitivity method was used to linearize the model, and the successive linear programming method was used to solve it, so as to realize the coordination of continuous and discrete control measures. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme and solved strategy was verified by the RTDS simulation results based on the actual case of China northwest power grid.

Author Keywords: coupling of the active power and voltage

articleTitle: Double-differentiated Capacity Compensation Mechanism for the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the penetration rate of renewable energy, renewable energy generation will gradually become the main body of power generation in the power system, occupying a dominant position on the power supply side. It is difficult for conventional generators to recover fixed costs in the electric energy market. At the same time, renewable energy generation needs more traditional power sources as support to ensure system stability due to its randomness, volatility, and intermittency. Therefore, to ensure the adequacy of the power generation capacity of the system, it is urgent to establish a reasonable capacity compensation mechanism to ensure the recovery of the fixed cost of flexible power sources especially thermal power. This paper establishes a systematic analysis framework for the adequacy of power generation capacity, designs a double-differentiated capacity compensation mechanism, and proposes a capacity compensation calculation method, which is based on the traditional calculation method of capacity compensation standard, can fully reflect the capacity value and flexibility value. Finally, based on the IEEE 30-bus system and an actual provincial power grid, case studies validate the rationality and feasibility of the double-differentiated capacity compensation mechanism.

articleTitle: Flexibility Balance Mechanism and Flexibility Requirement Quantification of Power System with High Share of Uncertainty Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The renewable power generation such as wind and photovoltaic power bring higher challenges to the flexible operation of power systems due to its characteristics of uncertainty, volatility. In order to improve flexible operation of the power system, the connotation and balance mechanism of flexibility is studied firstly. The flexibility resources and demands are discussed and the reason of flexibility demands increasing is analyzed. On this basis, flexibility requirement quantification is proposed. A multidimensional envelope is model is proposed to describe the fluctuation domain of multidimensional renewable power considering their volatility and correlation, therefore quantifying the flexibility requirement of the system by space projection. The case studies prove the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed flexibility requirement quantification methods.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Power Balance Method for Active Distribution Systems Based on Time Series Operation Simulation with Source-Load-Storage Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction and development of new-type power system with a gradually increasing proportion of new energies, large-scale distributed generations are widely integrated, electric energy substitution is gradually accelerated, load interaction is continuously enhanced, a fundamental change is taking place. In the traditional power distribution system, the clear role boundaries of power supply and power consumption are gradually blurred, the uncertainty of source and load increases, and the difficulty of balancing supply and demand increases. Therefore, this paper focuses on new-type power distribution system's hierarchical partition spatial-temporal balance problem. Firstly, various flexible resource model that participate in the new-type power distribution system’s supply and demand balance are constructed. Then, a new-type power distribution system's hierarchical partition spatial-temporal balance model based on operation simulation and stochastic programming is constructed. Finally, after the analysis and comparison of case studies, the proposed model and method are verified. The results show that the proposed method can realize the optimization of the regional supply and demand balance, and improve the security and economics of the distribution system.

articleTitle: Predicting the Availability of Supply Equipment at EV Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Understanding and characterizing Electric Vehicle (EV) users’ behavior at EV charging stations is beneficial for improving the operation efficiency of EV charging stations through smart scheduling. Recently, the fast development of EV charging infrastructure worldwide and the release of collected real EV charging dataset make it possible to learn from actual observations in practice. In this paper, we investigate the possibility of predicting the usage of electric vehicle supply equipment at EV charging stations using historical user data and weather data. We formulate the prediction problem as a time-series prediction problem. We evaluate and compare the performance of two popular neural network models against traditional methods for predicting the usage of Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) at charging stations using historical data. Experiments show that for workplace charging sites, these neural network models outperform baseline methods and are capable to predict the vacancies of EVSE with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of the Current Situation of Port Shore Power Construction and Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The shore power technology of ships refers to stop using diesel generators during berthing, and the ships are powered by shore power, which plays the role of energy saving and emission reduction, so it is important to study how to promote the shore power technology of ports. Firstly, the necessity of port shore power promotion is introduced, secondly, the main difficulties of shore power technology promotion are analyzed with the examples of domestic ports, among which the economic benefits are evaluated through cost analysis of various types of ports, and finally, specific initiatives for port shore power promotion and application are proposed.

articleTitle: Demand Response Strategy for Electric Vehicles Based on Virtual Power Plant Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the grid-connected absorption problem caused by the output uncertainty of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) and wind turbine (WT), an optimization scheduling strategy of Virtual Power Plant (VPP) based on electric vehicle (EV) for demand response (DR) is proposed. Considering the usage habits of three typical EVs, the operation model of electric vehicle group (EVG) is established. The EV charging response is established by comprehensively considering multiple factors such as EV type, time, and location. The Weber Fechner's law is introduced to describe the relationship between EV charge-discharge response and the incentive electricity price, and then the EV dispatchable potential prediction model is obtained. A VPP optimal dispatch model with a high proportion of WT and PV power generation considering EV as a flexible load is constructed, and the risks brought by the uncertainty of real-time WT and PV output are considered. Finally, the optimal scheduling of VPP is solved based on the improved two-layer particle swarm optimization. The results show that the strategy proposed in this paper can effectively simulate the operation of EV and accurately predict its schedulable potential. And EV participation in DR can increase the gain of VPP and enhance its ability to deal with risks.

articleTitle: A Charging and Discharging Strategy of Cloud Energy Storage with V2G Electric Vehicle Participation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing maturity of energy storage technology, it has been widely used in power system. However, the promotion of energy storage, especially for residential users on the user side, has been limited by its expensive investment cost. As a shared business model, cloud energy storage (CES) can effectively improve this situation. For CES operators, V2G-capable electric vehicles (EVs) can be aggregated to provide ancillary services for CES, which help to reduce the operating cost of CES operators and improve the utilization rate of electric vehicles batteries. Through analyzing the feasibility of electric vehicle participation in CES services in terms of timing and economic, this paper proposes a charging and discharging strategy of CES with EVs participation. In this strategy, the CES operator quantify the cost of battery wear by the discharge of EVs and pay this cost to the EVs owner, which can ensure that the interests of both parties are maximized. A case study based on residential load and electricity data verified the economic benefit and feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology Framework of Integrated Energy System and Recent Progress
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the need to balance economic development with emission reductions, clean and efficient utilization of energy has remained a strategic and research focus on a global scale in recent years. Integrated energy system (IES), which integrates the production, transportation, distribution, conversion, storage and consumption of various energy sources enables the integrated management and economic dispatch of electricity, heat, gas, etc., and plays a critical role in the comprehensive utilization of energy. Building the key technology framework of IES and revealing its development status are of great significance for guiding the planning and operation decision-making of IES. This paper summarizes key technologies of IES and their recent development progress based on the previous technology-focused reports. The paper aims to prompt discussions and inform the further work needed to chart the path of IES in the future.

articleTitle: Study on Market Clearing Mechanisms for Energy and Reserve Ancillary Services with VPPs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high penetration of intermittent renewable generations and the low proportion of conventional units in power system lead to a situation that it is difficult to satisfy the growing reserve demand. Therefore, the reserve capacity of virtual power plants (VPPs) needs to be adequately explored. Focusing on different stages of market development and the degree of shortage of spare resources, three different clearing mechanisms of energy and reserves with VPPs were proposed and compared in this paper. They are energy and the reserves provided by units and VPPs are cleared in sequence, and energy and reserve from units are jointly cleared first, then the reserve from VPPs is cleared separately, and energy and the reserves provided by units and VPPs are cleared jointly. The influence of the participation of VPPs on the market clearing and their cost and profit are analyzed. Finally, the improved IEEE 30-node system is used for simulation verification, and the market economy, clearing price and incentive effect of different models on VPP are discussed.

articleTitle: Pricing Resources in Renewable Portfolio Standard-Constrained Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an energy-reserve co-optimization model with embedded renewable portfolio standard (RPS) requirements is proposed. Accordingly, the associated pricing approach is established based on the marginal pricing principle, which endogenously allocates reserve costs of dispatchable units to renewable generations and loads without out-of-the-market settlements, and awards renewable generations for their contributions to satisfying spatial RPS requirements. Based on the proposed market-clearing mechanism, cost recovery of market participants and revenue adequacy of the system operator are guaranteed. These findings are validated and illustrated on a modified IEEE test system with a high share of renewable integration.

articleTitle: Propagation and Blocking of Gas-Electric Cascading Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the research of integrated energy systems, the security of gas-electric coupling networks is highly valued because of the wide use of gas-fired units (GFU). However, the propagation mechanism of cascading failure from the gas system to the power system has not yet formed a clear framework. In this paper, we present basic modes of such failure propagation in multi-energy systems. Based on the multiple time scale characteristic of gas-electric coupling networks, we also propose a blocking method of such cross-system cascading failure. The numerical example of a large-scale gas-electric coupling system based on real networks in a province of China is used to simulate the propagation and interruption of gas-electric cascading failure in practice, which confirms the basic point of this paper.

articleTitle: A Capacity Pricing Methodology for Pumped Storage Considering the Apportion of Electricity Benefits
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pumped storage has the characteristics of flexible regulation and high grid friendliness, so it is an important and necessary part of new power system to accept high proportion of renewable energy. With the adoption of the new power price mechanism policy of pumped storage in China, it will become the mainstream that the capacity income fees will ensure the investment recovery of pumping storage and this part will be included in transmission and distribution electricity price of local province, while the electricity benefits fees of electricity quantity will cover the loss of pumping and power generation and party divert the capacity price. Based on the investment-revenue model of pumped-storage power station, this paper puts forward a pricing methodology of pump storage capacity pricing considering the apportion effect of electricity benefits, and verifies it through a practical example. The results show that the electricity benefits and auxiliary service income of pumped storage power station in spot market can evidently alleviate the increase of power transmission and distribution price caused by its capacity price charge.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Storage Mode and Configuration Strategy of Gansu Considering Grid Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the guidance of"Double carbon" target, Gansu province is faced with the dilemma of insufficient capacity of new energy absorption and peak shaving. Based on the analysis of the energy storage methods for the new energy sources, it is proposed that the deployment of certain scale pumped-storage hydroelectricity and new electrochemical energy storage will play an important role in enhancing the peak shaving capacity and new efficient energy use of the Gansu power grid. Combined with the planning of the balance between the electric power and peak-shaving capacity of Gansu power grid, the calculation results show that the size of pumped storage construction in Gansu province is about 3200-4400MW by 2030. Therefore, it is necessary to incorporate pumped storage and electrochemical storage into flexible power grid regulation strategies when selecting new energy sources and peak-load regulation power sources in Gansu province.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Management of a Virtual Power Plant Considering Its Participation in Electricity and Carbon Allowance Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the consumption of renewable energy under electricity market mechanism in the process of achieving decarbonization, a virtual power plant (VPP) integrating distributed wind and photovoltaic generators, other dispatchable generation resources, controllable loads and energy storage systems is examined in this work, and an optimal dispatching model of the VPP considering its joint participation in electricity market and carbon allowrance trading market as a whole is presented. Firstly, in order to obtain the sources-load typical scenarios of the power system in a whole year, sources-load curves using variable copula model is constructed. At the same time, taking into account proposed cluster validity index, the generated scenarios are reduced effectively, and a representative day set is obtained, which can depict and represent extreme scenarios well. Secondly, an optimal VPP dispatching model based on representative day set is established to minimize the operating cost, comprehensively considering electricity and carbon allowance trading. Finally, cases studies including deterministic and stochastic optimization are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and analyze the impact of multiple uncertainties, which is of guiding significance for the optimal scheduling of VPP systems in the future.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Gray-scale Satellite Cloud Image and Optimized LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Satellite cloud images can reflect the regional cloud cover information well and have been gradually applied in the field of photovoltaic power prediction. In order to make better use of the cloud image information, on the one hand, the features of the cloud image are extracted, and on the other hand, the cloud image is used for weather classification. Firstly, this paper proposes a weather classification method based on gray interval estimation, and uses gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) to extract cloud image features. Then the LSTM model with Attention mechanism was established, and the hyperparameters were optimized. Finally, in different weather types, combined with cloud map characteristics and power and meteorological data input into the prediction model for error evaluation. The simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of PV power can be further improved by the optimization of cloud features and models, and the prediction error can be increased by 13.75%, 18.66%, and 5.09% on cloudy, Sunny, and rainy days, respectively.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling Method for Integrated Energy System Considering Thermal Dynamic Characteristics of Heat Pipe Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to analyze the influence of the heat pipe network scheduling constraints on the operation economy of the electric-thermal coupled integrated energy system (ET-IES), this paper proposes a day-ahead optimal scheduling method for the ET-IES considering the temperature gradient constraints of the working fluid in the pipe network. Firstly, a mathematical model of energy equipment with ET-IES is established, and a modeling method considering the thermal dynamic characteristics of the heating pipe network is proposed, and its temperature gradient regulation constraints are established. Then, a day-ahead optimal scheduling model of the ET-IES considering the temperature gradient constraints of the working fluid of the heat pipe network is constructed. This model mainly reflects the influence of the heat storage capacity of the heat network on the operation economy of the IES considering the limitation of the working fluid temperature and the limitation of the working fluid temperature gradient. Finally, a case study is constructed to verify the effectiveness of the scheduling method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A New Method to Solve Relative Dielectric Constant of 10kV Three-Core Cables Based on Two-Terminal Zero Sequence Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The relative dielectric constant of insulating layer in the cable is an important parameter characterizing insulation levels. However, the structure of three core cable is complex, whose cores, metal shielding layer and sheath are coupled with each other, so it is difficult to solve the relative dielectric constant. To realize online monitoring of the insulation of three-core cables, this paper proposes a method for solving the relative dielectric constant of 10kV three-core cables based on zero sequence voltage at both ends. Firstly, frequency dependent parameter model was constructed for three-core cables. In combination with zero sequence network, the relationship between the specific value of zero sequence voltage magnitudes at the head and tail ends of the three-core cable and the relative dielectric constant was derived. Then, the least-square parameter identification method is utilized to solve the relative dielectric constant in the relationship. Finally, a cable simulation model is built in PSCAD to obtain the specific value of zero sequence voltage magnitudes at the head and tail ends of the cable in a condition of different frequencies, and the relative dielectric constant is solved by using the least square fitting function in MATLAB. As revealed in simulation results, the derived relationship can accurately reflect variations in the specific value of zero sequence voltage magnitudes at the head and tail ends of the cable along with frequency and the results of the relative dielectric constant solution verify validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Cloud Energy Storage System Serving Multiple High Proportion Renewable Energy Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The global decarbonization process has promoted the continuous development of renewable energy in power system. This trend also puts forward high requirements for the operational flexibility of microgrids. Although energy storage system (ESS) provides an efficient solution to this problem, the wide application of ESS is still hindered by its expensive cost. To address this problem, the concept of cloud energy storage (CES) is proposed with the inspiration of the sharing economy. CES can effectively reduce the cost of ESS and provides a promising business model for the utilization of ESS in microgrids. This paper presents an optimal planning method of CES for high proportion renewable energy microgrids. Firstly, the concept and framework of CES for high proportion renewable energy microgrids are introduced. Then, the optimal energy storage planning model of CES is built to minimize the investment and operation costs of microgrids, considering CES services for distributed renewable energy consumption and peak-valley electricity arbitrage. The model is solved by a two-layered algorithm adapting advanced particle swarm algorithm and Gurobi. Case studies are carried out based on the a CES system serving multiple microgrids. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model, and indicate that CES can reduce ESS application cost through economy of scale and resources sharing.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Active Distribution Network with 5G Communication Base Station Participating in Demand Response Considering Carbon Benefit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building a new power system demands thinking about the access of plenty of 5G base stations. This study aims to promote renewable energy (RES) consumption and efficient use while reducing 5G base stations' own electricity consumption costs by stimulating 5G base stations to participate in demand response and integrating them into the existing active distribution network (ADN) operation framework. Therefore, based on an in-depth analysis of the interaction mode between 5G base stations and the distribution network, this paper proposes an operational flexibility description model for the power use of individual base stations, including the main equipment energy use and the temperature control equipment energy use model, in order to change to fit the increase in power use caused by the fast increase in the number of base stations. Secondly, considering the constraints of both the distribution network and the communication network, we develop an ADN multi-objective operation optimization model that incorporates 5G base stations to minimize the system operation cost and carbon emissions to achieve a comprehensive optimization of the system economy and low carbon benefits. Finally, the validity of the proposed method has been demonstrated true through experimental testing on a modified IEEE 33-node system

articleTitle: Low-carbon Optimal Scheduling for Microgrid Considering the Multi-energy Cloud Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the tendency of global decarburization, the low-carbon operation of power system has aroused great attention on both industry and academy. This paper takes the microgrid as the research object and proposes a low-carbon optimal scheduling method for the microgrid. An accurate carbon emission measuring method of the indirect carbon emission is considered in the low carbon dispatch model for accurate calculating the electricity used by the microgrid. The carbon measure method is developed based on the carbon emission flow analysis theory. Also, a newly proposed equivalent energy storage sharing technology named multi-energy cloud energy storage (ME-CES) is considered as a scheduling resource in the microgrid, and the District Heat System (DHS) is considered as the equivalent energy storage. The numerical simulation is carried out to verify effectiveness of the proposed optimal scheduling method. The results show that the proposed carbon measuring model can accurately calculate the carbon emissions of microgrid system and the optimal scheduling model can effectively reduce the carbon emission of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Load Monitoring for Household Energy Disaggregation: A State-of-the-Art
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continual rise in energy consumption has become a significant issue for power systems. Hence it is important to promote energy saving and reduce consumption for solving this problem. Also, finding solutions to enhance energy efficiency is crucial due to the increase in global energy demand. To improve the effectiveness of a power system network, it is important to monitor, manage, and regulate electrical energy needs on a real-time consumption basis. The development of smart homes includes energy management as a key component. A reliable appliance load monitoring (ALM) system is important for the smart energy management framework. ALM’s objectives include achieving comprehensive energy sensing and disseminating data on energy use. This will make it possible for automated energy management systems to identify appliances that use higher energy. Thereby enabling them to implement energy saving methods such as rescheduling the high power demand to off-peak hours. Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) is one of the most popular energy management strategies in recent years. It enables customers and industries to effectively control their energy use. Utilizing a single energy meter, the NILM technology has gained popularity as an emerging method for tracking events (on/off) and energy use of electrical services and appliances in buildings. Consumers might better understand their appliance behaviour and take the appropriate actions to reduce energy consumption with the aid of information on energy consumption at the appliance level. Hence, the main objective of this paper is to present a comprehensive review of energy management monitoring approaches with an emphasis on non-intrusive load monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin Network Architecture for Power Grid Telecommunication System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large power grid telecommunication system is the base of smart grid. With the development of new power system, the interaction among aspects of power grid (source, grid, load, storage) becomes more and more frequent. So the operation environment of telecommunication system becomes more and more complex. With the higher communication requirements of new power system, it is necessary to improve the ability of telecommunication system perception and operation control for power system. In this paper, an overall architecture of Digital Twin Network (DTN) for power grid telecommunication system is proposed. The architecture contains three layers (DTN physical layer, network layer and application layer), three domains (DTN data domain, model domain and management domain). The Digital Twin Network architecture can support the wide range and multi-layered telecommunication system state perception. It provides supports for the telecommunication department for system operation scheme virtual testing and verification in digital twin space. Combining with the intelligent analysis tools, it increases the support ability for telecommunication system of large power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy for Power-to-Hydrogen System Considering Dynamic Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of energy structure transition and carbon neutralization, the development of efficient and clean hydrogen energy and novel power systems is an important way to reduce carbon emissions and improve the efficiency of energy systems. In the existing research of the integrated electricity-hydrogen system, the limitations and constraints in the conversion process of electric energy and hydrogen energy are often ignored. Therefore, based on the electrochemical theory, a circuit model of the electrolysis cell is constructed, and the dynamic efficiency curve of the electrolysis cell is derived and linearized in this paper. The influence of the fluctuation of locational marginal price in the power grid on the operation of the power-to-hydrogen (P2H) system is analyzed. Based on the dynamic efficiency curve and electricity price, the optimal operation strategy of the P2H system is obtained. Finally, to improve the startup and shutdown times of the electrolysis cell, a penalty mechanism is introduced. Case studies based on the actual unit scale and operation data of New Jersey, and Maryland (PJM) market demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and operation strategy.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Robust Model of Day-ahead Dispatch Considering Carbon Trading and Life Cycle Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: How to achieve the economic low-carbon dispatch while dealing with the influence of renewable energy and load uncertainties is a significant challenge for integrated energy system (IES). This paper proposes a two-stage robust model to cope with uncertainties, and introduces carbon trading mechanism to balance the economy and low-carbon of IES. Meanwhile, life cycle assessment method is employed to accurately quantify the total carbon emission of different energy chain in IES. The strong duality theory and Big-M approach are employed to transform the problem into two mixed-integer linear problems, which can be solved by the column and constraint generation algorithm. Simulation results verify the economy and environmental protection of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Electrothermal Simulation and Insulation Condition Evaluation of Converter Transformer Valve Side Bushing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the laborious heat dissipation structure of the bushings, along with the continuously growing capacity of HVDC transmission projects and the corresponding converter transformers, the intertwined thermal-insulation issue has become the bottleneck for the safe and reliable operation of the valve side bushings. In this paper, the physical model of coupled thermal-electric field in the frequency domain is established considering the wideband harmonics generated by the HVDC converter. On this basis, an insulation condition assessment method is proposed. In order to solve the physics coupling model, this paper proposes a corresponding iterative solution process based on COMSOL Multiphysics. Using the above model and method, this paper analyzes the fields distribution of a bushing model and conducts an insulation evaluation. In the process of designing and maintaining the insulating part, more attention should be paid to the distribution of the electric field. Significantly increased areas and locations will be the weak link in insulation, but the temperature will still be a need-ism factor.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suggestions on the Development of Low-Carbon Technologies in Energy and Industry: A Case Study of Fujian Province in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy and industry are the two major sources of carbon emissions. The development and application of low-carbon technologies in various fields is the key to achieving carbon peak and carbon neutralization. Hydrogen energy and energy storage are two important technologies for low-carbon development in the energy field, and the steel industry and non-ferrous metal industry are the carbon emission industries that are focused on in the industrial field. Therefore, this paper first focuses on the analysis of the development status of the above technologies, and takes Fujian as an example to further analyze; Then the future development trends of low-carbon technologies in the energy and industrial fields of Fujian Province are predicted. Finally, some suggestions are put forward to promote the development of low carbon technologies.

articleTitle: Research on Key Test Technology of UHVDC Transmission Control and Protection Based on Autonomous Controllable Chips
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The transient shock caused by the failure of the UHV DC transmission system is large and covers a wide range. However, the key testing technology for UHVDC transmission control and protection based on self-controllable chips is not yet perfect. This paper studies the overall design of the UHV DC control and protection system; analyzes the influence mechanism of electromagnetic interference, ambient temperature, power supply and other factors on the DC control and protection device, and proposes a general hardware test scheme and functional test for the DC control and protection equipment on an autonomous controllable chip platform scheme; studied the visualization modeling technology of UHVDC transmission system based on PSCAD, proposed a modularized DC control and protection simulation modeling scheme, and built a modular model of autonomous controllable chip DC control and protection equipment; The waveform comparison test verifies the accuracy of the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Virtual Bidding in a Two-Settlement Electricity Market with Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual bidding is a financial instrument that bridges the day-ahead (DA) and real-time (RT) electricity market. With the improved forecasting accuracy, virtual bidding shrinks the gap between the two markets and thus increases social welfare. In this process, arbitrage opportunities exist because participants may hold asymmetric information. In this work, we study the arbitrage behaviors in virtual bidding. Adopting a game theoretical framework, we illustrate how participants’ benefits vary when information asymmetry exists in the process. Moreover, we conduct extensive numerical studies to investigate how participants’ profits with extra information differentiate in various market situations. The numerical studies reveal that although privileged participants with more information than others can take advantage of the information asymmetry to gain profits, not all of them can benefit. In contrast, virtual bidders directly taking the publicly available information must bear a loss.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Forecasting Based on Meteorological Forecast Data of Multiple Isobaric Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering that more than 90% of water vapor is concentrated in the troposphere, and many weather phenomena such as cloud, fog and rain occur in the middle and lower troposphere, a short-term wind power prediction method based on meteorological data of multiple isobaric surfaces in the middle and lower troposphere is proposed. In view of the fact that the power accuracy depends greatly on the accuracy of wind speed prediction, and the current wind speed prediction in wind farms has some problems such as phase lag and system deviation, the decoupling method of wind power conversion model is considered, which firstly corrects the wind speed prediction error and then establishes the wind power conversion model. In detail, based on the multi-layer meteorological forecast data, the optimal feature combination optimization model is established with the maximum average accuracy as the objective function. On this basis, a wind speed correction model based on Conv1D was constructed. Finally, the wind speed - power conversion model is constructed by five kinds of fluctuation process classification, and the corrected wind speed is converted into power. Experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain better accuracy than using correlation coefficients to select feature combinations or only using surface data for modeling.

Author Keywords: optimization of the best feature combination

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Operation of Cascade Small Hydropower Based on Runoff Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of rural energy, small hydropower plays a crucial role in driving rural economic development, as well as promoting energy conservation and emission reduction. Taking the Mengdong River basin, a secondary tributary of the Yuanjiang River as an example, this paper establishes a cascade optimal operation model of small hydropower based on runoff simulation. In terms of runoff simulation, based on the principle of production and confluence of the three water sources-Xin 'an River, the river confluence calculation is carried out, and a semi-distributed hydrological model is constructed to simulate the process of inflow runoff. In terms of optimal operation, the successive approximation dynamic programming method is used to obtain the optimal scheduling scheme. The results show that the Xin 'an River model has a good fitting effect in this basin. The changing pattern of simulated and measured runoff processes is basically consistent, and the Nash efficiency coefficient between series is 0.86. The optimal scheduling model takes the maximum total generating capacity and minimum waste water as the optimal scheduling objectives, achieving a 1.5% increase in the total power generation and a 56.7% reduction in the waste water, and the change in the upstream water level of the hydropower stations meets the safety requirements.

articleTitle: Optimize Design and Manufacture of 130MW Gas Turbine First Stage Blade
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Through the performance analysis and optimal design of the first stage turbine rotor blade of 130MW class gas turbine, the material properties and manufacturing process difficulties of the components are clarified, and the technical specifications of component forming, and precision machining are formulated to realize the independent design and development capability of new products. By integrating the molding and precision machining resources of the gas turbine components in China, developing the molding and precision machining technology of the first-level rotor blades, completing the independent manufacturing of the first batch of samples, and preliminarily establishing the manufacturing industry chain of the high-temperature gas turbine components. In the process of component design and manufacturing, design verification, process certification and quality assessment of key processing links should be carried out, and a supervision system for the whole process of component design and manufacturing should be established to provide technical support for the independent design and manufacturing of gas turbine components.

articleTitle: Roadmap to Carbon Neutrality - Financial Practices for Chinese Telecom Giants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To better achieve China’s carbon peak and neutrality targets, this paper summarizes global telecom giants’ carbon neutrality objectives and their milestones as of 2021. On top of that, this paper explores aims, visions, priorities, and green and sustainable financial practices for Chinese telecom giants in their journey to reach carbon neutrality. First, green low-carbon standards and evaluation framework should be developed and maintained, telecom giants are recommended to jointly formulate a unified carbon emission standard for the telecom industry. Second, innovative green financing mechanisms should be focused, including carbon trading market, carbon account, and other innovative green financing projects/products. Third, green power trading strategies should be studied, designed and validated. Finally, green, low-carbon and eco-friendly culture should be created.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Control Strategy Optimization of Energy Storage System Based on Wind-Storage Combined Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage can cooperate with wind turbines to improve the system frequency stability because of its flexible four-quadrant power adjustment capability. Aiming at the problem of optimal operation and distributed control of the energy storage system in the existing wind-storage joint frequency modulation, based on the distributed consensus theory, design a method of global information perception of energy storage, further aiming to minimize the operating costs of energy storage that assist in frequency regulation of wind farms, consider the energy storage operating state and system power balance constraints, and use marginal cost consistency iteration and power balance correction, finally propose a distributed optimization control strategy for the energy storage system of wind-storage joint frequency regulation. This strategy can correct the marginal cost and power output of the iterative process of energy storage unit based on the total output power and dispatched total power of the energy storage perceived by the global information, so as to ensure the power balance between the supply and demand of the energy storage, and realize the optimal economic operation of the system. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can optimize the state of charge of the energy storage unit, reduce the frequency regulation cost of the energy storage system, and has good economy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Reactive Power Emergency Control Strategy for HVDC Receiving System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the renewable power system, the renewable energy fed by the high voltage direct current transmission system (HVDC) replaces the conventional unit output near the landing point of the HVDC receiving end power grid, resulting in a relatively tense state of dynamic reactive power near the landing point of the HVDC. When induction motors are the main loads of HVDC receiving power grid, after the fault occurs in AC system, the load bus voltage may continue to decline, and the problem of voltage stability, especially the transient voltage stability, is becoming increasingly prominent. In order to recover the voltage quickly, this paper proposes a method of using HVDC converter station as emergency reactive power supply to realize the emergency control of transient voltage stability in HVDC receiving power grid by temporarily reducing DC current. Aiming at the quantitative calculation of DC current, this paper establishes a nonlinear optimization model with the objective of minimizing the energy transmission reduction of HVDC transmission, and uses the global orthogonal configuration method to convert the differential equations in the objective function and constraints into algebraic equations, so as to convert the optimization model into nonlinear programming problem, and obtain the optimal DC current control scheme, namely, reactive power emergency control strategy, which greatly reduces the difficulty of solving the optimization model. Finally, a modified IEEE-14 node benchmark is used to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection System of Power Consumption Data Based on Social Information Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power consumption data has been widely used in many fields. The prediction and analysis of power system data such as power supply and power consumption in power plants plays a significant role in the rational layout and control of energy facilities and improving energy utilization. However, in real application scenarios, due to various reasons such as sensor damage, data transmission failure, memory damage, etc., some paragraphs of power consumption data may have persistent data anomalies. Therefore, how to effectively detect power data anomalies has become a practical and urgent need. In this paper, a spatiotemporal attention-based method SIDM is proposed to detect power consumption data with paragraph anomalies. The Transformer model has excellent performance in capturing the dependencies between variables, and researchers generally use its attention mechanism to capture the mutual influence of data at different times. The SIDM model adds additional spatial attention to its temporal attention to capture the impact of social information on power consumption. By incorporating social information factors such as similar users, related power-consuming equipment, and local climate into the model, verify whether the current data is abnormal. The experimental results on the actual collected power consumption data set show that the effect of the model proposed in this paper is significantly improved compared to the direct prediction without using social information, and compared with other social information fusion detection methods, it has a higher accuracyrate.

articleTitle: A Review and Outlook on the Participation of High Percentage of Renewable Energy in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The goal of carbon peak and carbon neutralization has accelerated the pace of building a high percentage of renewable energy power systems. However, the uncertainty and volatility of renewable energy bring many challenges to the stable operation of electricity market. In the new context of power market reform, it is necessary to establish a better trading mechanism and price subsidy mechanism for renewable energy participation in the market. This paper analyzes the impact of renewable energy participation in electricity market on market operation, market equilibrium and bidding strategies of market players. Then, we propose the potential means to cope with the market risk of renewable energy, compare the market mechanisms and development policies of various countries, and summarize relevant studies on renewable energy participation in electricity market in countries around the world. Finally, the development of a high percentage of renewable energy participation in the electricity market of China is summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Based Wide-Area Protection Scheme for Distributed Cyber Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To tackle the network attack problem, combined with the characteristics of a stealthy attack against a stability control system, a multi-agent wide-area protection scheme for distributed cyber energy systems is proposed. The scheme adopts distributed multi-layer architecture, which is composed of substation stability control devices distributed in different areas and monitoring terminal of control center. By collecting the measurement updates of each station randomly and dynamically, the online real-time detection of the distributed cyber energy system is realized with the specified anomaly detection algorithm. The simulation results show that this method can detect the attack on the distributed cyber energy system in time, and effectively avoid the physical damage of power generator.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Grid-Connected Operation of Multi-Energy Complementary System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid connection of large-scale wind power and photovoltaics has changed the frequency and voltage characteristics of the traditional power grid. The renewable energy generation system with new energy as the main body has put forward higher requirements for the performance of new energy grid connection, including the multi-energy complementary system(MECS) of renewable energy and energy storage. There is no unified measurement standard for the performance of access to the grid. Therefore, starting from the performance of MECS connected to the power grid, such as autonomous frequency regulation, autonomous voltage regulation, active/reactive power control, etc., a performance evaluation method of MECS connected to the power grid is given. Referring to the relevant standards for renewable energy and energy storage grid connection, a three-level index system for evaluating the grid-connected operation performance of MECS including target-level, performance-level and detail-level is constructed. The fuzzy evaluation method is used to analyze the grid-connected performance of a multi-energy complementary power station in Qinghai Province. The validity and applicability of the proposed evaluation method are verified.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Forecasting Method of Multiple Day-Type Load Curves for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional distribution network load forecasting usually can only get the total load result in a certain period, which is difficult to reflect the multiple influence of social and meteorological factors on the load. In recent years, with the gradual integrations of distributed generations and flexible loads, the randomness and uncertainty of distribution network load have been increasing significantly, and the traditional forecasting methods can no longer meet the requirements of planning and operation. Therefore, a data-driven load curve forecasting method for distribution network is put forward in this paper. Firstly, a data-driven model is established for different day types such as holidays, working days and rest days. By combing and applying data-driven techniques, the extraction of potential data law is realized. Then, the valuable information extracted by the data-driven techniques is combined with load forecasting models such as least squares support vector machine and discrete grey model to obtain the load curve of the day to be predicted. Finally, the standard data set provided by the 9th National Student Electrician Mathematical Modeling Competition is used as an example to compare and analyze the forecasting effect. The results show that the proposed method can provide valuable support for distribution network planning and operation.

articleTitle: Deep Facial Expression Recognition Using Transfer Learning and Fine-Tuning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This work proposes a Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based framework for estimating basic facial expressions, which achieves state-of-the-art results and runs in real-time on an android-based device to fulfill the target of intelligent human-computer interaction (HCI). A new CNN architecture is modeled using MobileNetV1 for the facial expression recognition task. CNN training often necessitates a large amount of data. However, most current facial expression datasets fall short of this requirement, making it difficult to train a deep CNN with insufficient data. Using a model pre-trained on ImageNet, and a supplementary dataset (such as FER-2013) in supervised two-stage transfer learning addresses the issue of small datasets (such as JAFFE and CK+) to a great extent. Furthermore, to improve the framework's performance, a center loss is used in conjunction with the softmax loss as a joint supervision signal for CNN training optimization. Validation is carried out on two publicly available datasets, JAFFE and CK+. The model is evaluated based on the average accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix. An evaluation baseline for the CK+ dataset includes eight scenarios. As a whole, the proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods on both JAFFE and CK+.

articleTitle: A Day-ahead Dispatch Strategy of High-Penetration PV Grids with Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The photovoltaic power system has been developed in many areas. Photovoltaic generation is highly dependent on weather conditions and is subject to frequent violent fluctuations, leading to frequent power curtailments and brownouts. In order to solve this problem, this paper mainly studies the day-ahead dispatch strategy of high-proportion photovoltaic grids with virtual power plants. Firstly, the day-ahead forecast of photovoltaic power is carried out. Then a day-ahead alert of the ramp event of Photovoltaic power is given according to the numerical weather prediction (NWP). After that, a price compensation strategy is developed for the grids with a high proportion of photovoltaic power, and the resources in the virtual power plant are encouraged to participate in demand response through price. The simulation example verifies the effectiveness of the optimal dispatch strategy proposed in this paper. The results show that the virtual power plant can participate in the day-ahead optimal dispatch of grids while cooperating with the fluctuation of photovoltaic power, and effectively reduce the operating cost of grids with a high proportion of photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Technology of Photovoltaic Power Station Power Generation Performance Based on Minimum Deviation Combined Weighting Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to further optimize resource structure, reduce the energy gap, alleviate environmental pollution and promote the sustainable development of the whole social energy system, the scientific evaluation and decision-making mechanism of photovoltaic power generation projects need to be established, and the comprehensive evaluation system of photovoltaic power station power generation performance need to be improved. This paper focuses on the comprehensive evaluation system and evaluation method of photovoltaic power generation units. Based on the basic principle of multi-objective, multi-criteria, multi-factors and multi-level decision-making, a comprehensive evaluation system suitable for photovoltaic power generation units is proposed, which considers the advantages and disadvantages of objective weight method and subjective weight method. The minimum deviation combined weighting method is used to calculate the combined weight, and then the comprehensive performance evaluation model of photovoltaic power generation unit is established. The comprehensive evaluation results of the new photovoltaic medium voltage power generation unit and the conventional photovoltaic power generation unit are compared and analyzed, so as to prove the superiority of the design index of the former.

articleTitle: An Investment Sequence Optimization Model for Power Grid Companies Considering Investment Constraints and Effect Feedback
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual advance of the new round of management mode of power grid enterprises must be changed accordingly, and the precise investment of enterprises is also put forward higher requirements. Firstly, the paper starts from the influence factors of power grid investment under the new situation and sets up the evaluation system of investment value of planning project including economic benefit, reliability benefit and environmental benefit. Then, with the goal of maximizing the comprehensive benefit during the planning period, considering the constraints of investment capacity and the relationship between projects, and introducing the feedback mechanism of investment behavior to investment capacity, the investment time sequence optimization model of power grid planning project is established. Finally, 19 planning projects of a certain batch in a province are simulated, compared with the traditional sequential outputting decision scheme, and the differences of power grid investment strategies in different development stages are analyzed. The results show that the proposed model can effectively adapt to the transformation of power grid revenue model under the new situation, which is helpful to realize the precise investment of infrastructure projects.

articleTitle: Distributionally Robust Scheduling of Multi-energy Park Considering Thermal Inertia of Differentiated Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the premise that the room temperature meets the requirements, the differentiated thermal inertia of the building can adjust the thermal energy demand of the room by classification, which helps the multi-energy park to further explore the economy and flexibility. The multi-energy park jointly manages and controls various energy sources and loads, which facilitates the coordination of the thermal inertia of the buildings in the park to fully participate in the operation. Based on this, this paper proposes a distributionally robust optimization model for multi-energy park operation considering the thermal inertia of different buildings. According to the characteristics of different buildings, models of office buildings, industrial plants and warehouses are established respectively. The room temperature is flexibly set based on different building characteristics to coordinate the economy and comfort of the thermal inertia of the building. The numerical results show that the model further improves the system economy of the multi-energy park under the premise of realizing the refined management of buildings.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Operation of Distribution Network Considering Energy Storage and Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The penetration of electric vehicles and energy storage devices in the power system is increasing, and they can participate in the optimal dispatch of the distribution network as adjustable resources. Firstly, based on the tidal model, energy storage operation model and electric vehicle cluster charging station model, a distribution network economic dispatching model is established, with minimization of network loss and minimization of charging cost of energy storage and charging stations as the day-ahead dispatching objectives. Secondly, a distributed solution scheme based on alternating direction multiplication algorithm with master-slave structure is designed for this optimization model to give full play to the autonomous coordination of resources within the distribution network. Finally, the simulation shows that the participation of energy storage and charging stations in the distribution network dispatch is beneficial to the energy storage operator and the distribution network in both directions, and the distributed solution scheme based on alternating direction multiplication algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Study on Mutual Recognition Technology and Coordination Mechanism between Green Electricity Market and Carbon Market in Case of Building-grid Friendly Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To achieve the carbon neutrality goal, emission control and carbon reduction have become the focus of the development of various industries. As an important energy consumption industry, construction has become the focus of carbon reduction department. The main carbon emission of building comes from the electricity consumption during the operation process. Increasing green electricity consumption of building is an important way to reduce carbon emission. However, both the green electricity market and the carbon market have significant environment attribute. Building participate in those two markets will face the problem of repeated calculation about the emission reduction benefits absorbed by green electricity. Therefore, it is necessary to construct a green electricity consumption and carbon market mutual recognition technology to avoid repeated rewards in case of building-grid friendly interaction. This paper firstly analyzes the market mechanisms and research status of domestic and foreign buildings participating in the green electricity market and carbon market, then puts forward the mutual recognition mechanism between green electricity consumption and carbon market in case of the building-grid friendly interaction. Then, the collaborative mutual recognition mechanism is clarified. Finally, based on the mutual recognition technology, the collaborative decision-making model of green electricity market and carbon market for both mandatory buildings and emission-reduction buildings is proposed to maximize the building revenue. The research of this paper provides a path reference for realizing the cooperative win-win emission reduction of building-grid friendly interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wind-Hydrogen Coupling with Coal-to-Methanol System for Green Low-Carbon Methanol Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Coal to methanol (CTM) is the most important source of methanol in China. However, the traditional CTM process needs to produce hydrogen through the water-gas shift (WGS) unit, which results in high CO<inf>2</inf> emissions. In this study, a new coal-to-methanol process coupled with green hydrogen (CTM<inf>HPWE</inf>) is proposed to reduce CO<inf>2</inf> emissions and improve energy efficiency. Compared with CTM process, the carbon utilization efficiency of CTM<inf>HPWE</inf> process is increased by 76.75%, and the energy consumption and CO<inf>2</inf> emissions are reduced by 15.87% and 56.61% respectively. In a grid-powered mode, in which the hydrogen production system is powered by grid, the influence of electricity price and carbon tax on methanol cost is studied. When the renewable electricity price drops to 0.2427 yuan/kWh (the lowest bidding price for photovoltaic in China, 2020), the methanol cost of CTM<inf>HPWE</inf> process will drop to 2565.75 yuan/t, equal to that of CTM process with medium level of carbon tax (240 yuan/tCO<inf>2</inf>). In a wind-powered mode, in which the hydrogen production system is powered by self-built wind farm, through sizing optimization and dynamic operation management of wind-hydrogen system, the maximum wind power accommodation and stable methanol production are both realized under fluctuating wind power input. The economy of the optimized wind-hydrogen-methanol system is evaluated. The results shows that the methanol cost of CTM<inf>HPWE</inf> process is 2245.53 RMB/t, which is comparable with CTM process under the domestic carbon tax reference value (51 RMB/tCO<inf>2</inf>). Our study provides a feasible technical route for the upstream renewable energy accommodation coupled with downstream stable green hydrogen supply in the future.

articleTitle: Hybrid Ultracapacitor-Based Short-Term High-Frequency Energy Storage System for New-Type Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of new-type power systems in China is accelerating as the country puts forward the national strategic goals of peak carbon dioxide emission and carbon neutrality. To meet the minute-level power supplement demands that have appeared in the power system with high new energy penetration, this paper proposed a new type of energy storage system solution which is based on hybrid ultracapacitors. In this paper, the basic principle, classification, and characteristics of hybrid ultracapacitor are first introduced. Then, the main components and typical structure of the hybrid ultracapacitor-based energy storage system are described. The key technologies of the hybrid ultracapacitor-based energy storage system integration are discussed. Finally, the paper prospects for the future development of short-term high-frequency energy storage represented by the hybrid ultracapacitor-based energy storage in the new-type power system. The promising application scenarios of the hybrid ultracapacitor-based energy storage system in the new-type power system are analyzed and illustrated.

articleTitle: Intra-Graph-Based Few-Shot Link Prediction in Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Knowledge graphs (KG) that express the structure of relations between entities have become an increasingly attractive area in research into cognition and intelligence at the human level. One of the most known challenges in KG, which is the fact that a large number of training examples are required for every relation to predict a new triple, has sparked increasing interest in the few-shot link prediction method. Existing work on few-shot link prediction does not fully exploit entity information such as symmetry. In this work, we made a prediction of new triples about relations by observing only a few associative triples. In order to make new predictions of triples, we concentrated on the transfer of the most important common information and the reconciliation of the entity between the set and query set support by using Intra-Graph. Our experiment are lead on two datasets and demonstrated that our results achieved the state-of-the-art in few-shot link prediction.

articleTitle: Study on Steady State Reactive Power Optimization Method of Synchronous Generator to Improve Transient Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In steady state operation, increasing the reactive power output of the generator can improve the transient voltage stability of the system, but at the same time, it will bring the problem of increasing the network loss in steady state operation. Firstly, this paper defines the transient reactive power compensation coefficient to determine the voltage regulated sensitive generating set. Secondly, the voltage transient stability classification model was based on XGBOOST(Xtrem Gradient Boosting) by taking the DC near region key bus voltage, reactive power output of sensitive generator set and fault type as the main input feature quantities. Then, The reactive power output optimization model of the sensitive synchronous generator is established with the constraint condition that the system can maintain voltage transient stability under certain fault types, and the optimization objective is to minimize the network loss of the system. Finally, Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm(PSO)is adopted to solve the optimization model. the simulation verification is carried out on PSASP based on the Jiangxi power grid after azhong-Jiangxi UHVDC operation. The results show that the proposed method can improve the transient voltage stability of the system by optimizing the steady-state reactive power output of the key synchronous generators in the system for different faults, while taking into account the network loss of the system.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Inference of Cascading Commutation Failures of Multi-HVDCs Based on Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-capacity multi-HVDCs connected to the local power grid is a feature of many power systems today. The cascading commutation failures of high-capacity multi-HVDCs will increase the risk of a blackout accident of power systems. Through theoretical analysis, this paper identifies the impact factors of cascading commutation failures of multi-HVDCs. Two evidence probability functions (EPF), i.e., low voltage evidence probability function (LVEPF) and total voltage harmonic distortion evidence probability function (TVHDEPF), are developed for Bayesian inference of the probability of cascading commutation failures of multi-HVDCs. Then, use of PSCAD/EMTDC software establishes a power grid simulation model with multi-HVDCs. The above two EPFs are used to infer the probability of cascading commutation failures of multi-HVDCs by Bayesian theory. The case analysis shows that this probabilistic inference method can reflect the actual situation. The probabilistic inference results have strong objectivity that can ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Smoothing Tie-line Power for Microgrids by Controlling District Cooling System Based on Soft Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energies (RENs) bring significant power fluctuations to tie-line power in microgrids, which may cause high operational risk and deteriorate power quality. As a large-scale flexible load, district cooling system (DCS) is an ideal resource to suppress short-time tie-line power fluctuations through load control. However, the real-time control for DCS is quite challenging due to the following two reasons: i) DCS is commonly a complex thermal system that is hard to be modeled accurately, so that most model-based control methods cannot work for it; ii) Uncertainties from the REN’s power fluctuations make it difficult to achieve zero-steady control results. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a model-free reinforcement learning method for DCS, which can obtain an adaptive control strategy to smooth tie-line power.
