First, the DCS control problem is described as a sequential decision-making problem and modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP). Then, the soft actor-critic algorithm is adopted to solve the optimal control strategy in the designed MDP, which does not need prior knowledge of the DCS model. The implemented experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Preventive Control of Transient Voltage Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage safety is one of the key factors for the stable operation of power systems. In order to avoid the traditional treatment of transient voltage preventive control problem which is difficult and time-consuming to solve, this paper adopts a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to solve the problem and provide decision suggestions for preventive control directly. This paper firstly proposes the quantitative indicators of transient voltage safety for deep reinforcement learning feedback design. Second, the deep reinforcement learning algorithm model is constructed by combining the quantitative indicators of transient voltage safety. Subsequently, this paper validates and analyzes the arithmetic cases by The IEEE 10-machine 39-node test system.

articleTitle: Optimization of Thermal Coal Multimodal Transportation Considering Externalities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China is a major electricity-consuming country which consumes a large amount of electricity resources every year. Currently, thermal power plants are the main electric power supply types in China, and the differences exist between coal production areas and coal demand areas, resulting that a lot of coal transportation activities are needed every year. The transportation of coal will cause serious dust hazards to the surrounding areas, and the transport tool also affect the environment a lot, which has strong negative externalities. It is believed that the reasonable quantification of the negative external costs incurred in thermal coal multimodal transportation and its inclusion in the total cost of thermal coal multimodal transportation is satisfied with the interests of society. Therefore, this paper establishes a multi-objective optimization model considering the external costs of thermal coal multimodal transport, and obtains the Pareto optimal solution set of the constructed model employing a improved Genetic algorithm named NSGA-II. Finally, the influence of external costs and the rationality of the inclusion of external costs are further analyzed.

articleTitle: Improved Hybrid Consensus Mechanism Based on Virtual Power Plant Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous emergence of massive distributed resources, blockchain technology provides a new solution to the trust problem in the energy field. However, some existing researches only use the blockchain to record data and currency transactions, resulting in limited blockchain application scenarios. This paper analyzes the blockchain consensus mechanism in detail, and designs a hybrid consensus mechanism that integrates multiple algorithms. On this basis, a hybrid consensus mechanism based on convex optimization problem is proposed, which deeply integrates the consensus mechanism with the scheduling problem. Experiments show that this consensus mechanism has better performance than a single type of consensus mechanism, and can fully utilize computing resources.

articleTitle: A Coordinative Strategy for Numerous Electric Vehicles in a Resilient Urban Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To tackle the impacts of accelerating climate change and increasing occurrence of natural disasters, it is imperative to enhance the resilience of urban energy system. Particularly in the context of deep electrification of the transport sector and energy system integration, the coordination of numerous electrical vehicles (EVs) can provide a cost-effective manner to mitigate the adverse consequences of high impact and low probability (HILP) contingencies, thus improving system resilience. In this paper, a novel distributed algorithm aimed at coordinating a large population of EVs is proposed to enhance the resilience of urban energy system. The presented method alleviates the load curtailment iteratively by adjusting EV charging/discharging schedules while considering the energy requirements of individual EVs. The effectiveness of the distributed coordinative approach is tested and demonstrated by a series of case studies.

articleTitle: Cycle Iteration Strategy of Integrated Energy System Business Model Based on Cycle Iteration Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of integrated energy services is an effective way to implement the national energy strategy and promote the green and low-carbon transformation of energy industry. However, the exploration and practice of integrated energy system services in China is still in its infancy, and a mature and systematic integrated energy system business model has not yet been established. It is not conducive to the large-scale promotion and development of integrated energy system services. Based on the business canvas theory, this paper firstly considered the behavioral characteristics, value demands, interaction mechanism and industry chain positioning of the integrated energy system, and constructed a three-dimensional business model suitable for the current integrated energy system services from nine aspects, including customer segmentation, value proposition and channel access. Secondly, this paper adopted grounded analysis theory to study the evolutionary iterative path of integrated energy system business model, and summarized the phased iterative evolution strategy of integrated energy system through grounded analysis method. Three levels of open coding, axial coding and selective coding were carried out for the current integrated energy data, and the short-term, medium-term and long-term iteration strategies for the integrated energy system services business model were proposed, and provided a reference direction for the business model development of integrated energy system.

articleTitle: An Active Secondary Check Method for Online or Offline Devices of IoT Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the power Internet of Things (IoTs), more and more edge devices with computing, storage, and communication capabilities are connected to the IoT Management Platform (ITMP) through the MQTT protocol. Currently, one of the problems faced by the platform is that the online status of the device displayed on the platform does not match its real status. The main reason for this is that the online information uploaded by the device is inaccurate. The current solution is to repeatedly extract data through the platform to verify whether the device is online. Due to the huge number of devices, this solution needs to consume a large amount of bandwidth and computing power. We design an active secondary check method (ASCM) to solve the above problem. The core idea of ASCM is to verify the true state of the device by actively initiating multiple check topics when the state of the device changes, so as to ensure the accuracy of the device state switching. The experimental results show that the ASCM can effectively ensure the accuracy of device state switching, thereby improving the accuracy and effectiveness of collecting business data.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control for Multi-level Reactive Power and Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the distribution network is in a state of non-economic operation in a certain area and period, the output voltage at the end of the distribution feeder is too high, the voltage fluctuation in the regional power grid increases, and the problem of unreasonable power flow caused by the distributed power supply connecting to the distribution network to participate in the adjustment, a reactive power and voltage coordination control strategy for distribution network is proposed in this paper . The static var compensator is used as the main reactive power compensation equipment, its location and capacity are planned, and it is supplemented by energy storage and voltage source converters in double-ended DC lines to carry out multi-layer and multi-source coordinated control of system reactive power voltage. It is verified that the reactive power compensation equipment can reduce the voltage deviation, improve the power quality and the power flow distribution, thereby reducing the system network loss.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Based on IGDT Robust Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, under the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, the research on integrated energy "source, network, load and storage" has been the main battlefield for carbon reduction. The carbon reduction path of regional integrated energy system is analyzed and the overall planning is carried out which is an important way to reduce carbon emissions in the power industry. However, the output of wind power and photovoltaics is volatile, which poses a great challenge to the stability and economy of the integrated energy system. In order to improve the low-carbon and economical operation of the integrated energy system, this paper proposes a new type of energy multi-energy complementary system to solve the problem of wind and solar output fluctuations in the regional integrated energy system, integrates and optimizes the energy supply system. First, an optimization model of the regional comprehensive energy system is constructed. On this basis, the optimization goal is to minimize the sum of energy purchase cost, carbon transaction cost, equipment operation and maintenance cost, and daily purchase cost. Aiming at the output volatility of wind power and photovoltaics, the information gap decision theory (IGDT) is used to describe the fluctuation range, which provides a basis for energy service providers to control equipment. The result analysis verifies the low carbon and economical properties of the planning model.

articleTitle: A Review of the Impact of Long-term Climate Change on Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy, such as wind, wave and solar power are vulnerable to climate change. Unprecedented global warming in recent years has led to a long-term transition in the global climate and an increase in the frequency of extreme weather. The reserves and distribution of future wind, wave and solar resources will be affected. To explore the future development path of the high proportion of renewable energy power generation under climate change, this paper summarizes the long-term trend of renewable energy resources under long-term climate change trends, cyclical climate change, and extreme weather. The impact of long-term climate change on the utilization of renewable energy resources and the climate challenges for developing renewable energy in the future are pointed out. For the long-term future renewable energy planning, the paper proposes to build a refined regional energy-climate system to assess the potential of renewable energy and to introduce climate variability into energy systems.

articleTitle: Research on Power User Behavior Analysis and Prediction Based on RFM-Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, the informatization degree of power system is gradually improved. Massive data make it more complicated and difficult for power enterprises to grasp the behavior trend of customers. In the era of big data, the problems exposed by manual statistical analysis are also increasing. How to extract the characteristics of power enterprise customers and make a reasonable prediction of their payment behavior is a challenge at present. In this context, this project analyzes the big data of power enterprise users through data mining technology, and uses RFM model to classify and evaluate power customers. Secondly, the prediction and analysis method of user behavior based on random forest is proposed to provide reference for power enterprises to judge whether customers have default payment and other risk behaviors.Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Low Power Technology of Power Wireless Private Network Based on Computational Offloading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the heterogeneous network architecture of internet of things in power systems, the paper adopts the mobile edge computing architecture based on three layers of computing, and it designed the energy consumption model and delay model for each layer computing. By this way, it realized the task of the smart mobile device from local offloading to small base station edge server and macro station edge cloud server to compute. In order to minimize the energy consumption of power wireless network equipment, this paper adopts the variable substitution decomposition method, and deduces theoretically with the aid of objective function monotonicity, and finally obtains the optimized parameter solution. After simulating the energy consumption generated by different calculation and unloading methods, the proposed optimization scheme can significantly reduce the total energy consumption of the equipment under the condition of small delay.

articleTitle: Vickrey-Clark-Groves Based Settlement Mechanism in Spot Market Considering Deficit Allocation between Load and Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With high renewable energy penetration in the power system, electricity market is confronting with issues of renewable energy sources accommodation and conventional thermal units’ revenue insufficiency. These issues prompt thermal units offer strategically, destroying the assumption of perfect competition and impairing the social welfare further in the Location Marginal Price (LMP) based settlement mechanism. To cope with the aforementioned problems, this paper investigates the application of Vickrey-Clark-Groves (VCG) mechanism in a spot energy market with load bidding and renewable energy units offering. The VCG mechanism incentivizes market entities offer/bid truthfully by removing them in succession and paying their expenses the discrepancy between social welfare. The only shortcoming of VCG-based mechanism is revenue inadequacy problem and this paper design an imbalance payment allocation method to redistribute the deficit in the market clearing process. The case study compares both the traditional and VCG-based settlement mechanism. The numerical results show the proposed mechanism increases the market-wide entities’ profit in a truthful manner and the allocation method cover the imbalance payment successfully.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of Load Adjustable Potential Based on Two-Dimensional Chain Cloud Model Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rise of social electricity consumption and the continuous development of renewable energy, renewable energy has become one of the important resources for the operation of the power system, and it has also brought great pressure to the operation of the power grid. How to evaluate the power consumption of consumers on the power demand side and improve the operation stability of the power grid is an urgent problem to be solved. In this paper, a method of load adjustability potential evaluation based on two-dimensional chain cloud model optimization is proposed, which provides an important reference for power load regulation. Based on the two-dimensional chain cloud model, this method introduces the baseline load and uses the historical data to forecast the load, and then uses Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) to optimize the forecast data to obtain the load adjustability that is most similar to the historical situation. The feasibility and effectiveness of the evaluation method are verified by a specific example.

articleTitle: Sliding-Time-Window and Event-Trigger Based Data Collection Strategy for Non-intrusive Load Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) technology can effectively identify the type and operation state of the electrical equipments in the load, so as to help the better analyze the power consumption state and power consumption of users, and achieve better energy saving and emission reduction and load optimization control. However, the large amount of data collected by non-invasive load monitoring terminals, especially high-frequency data, brings challenges to data acquisition, transmission and training of non-intrusive load monitoring models. Hence, in this paper, a sliding-time-window and event trigger based non-intrusive load monitoring data acquisition strategy is proposed, which can select power equipment of state change events through the event trigger mechanism, and fix the length of collect data samples and ensure not lose equipment state change process of context information by using sliding-time-window. Experiments by using widely used non-intrusive load monitoring algorithm evaluation toolkit that named NLIMTK, and widely used public dataset which named REDD, show that the proposed data collection strategy can not only make non-intrusive load monitoring data collected by the size of the largest decreased by 97.07%, and the prediction performance has improved significantly, which fully demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization and Analysis of Combined Cooling, Heating and Power System Based on Multi-objective Sailfish Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the sake of obtaining the optimal configuration scheme of combined cooling, heating and power systems, a multi-objective optimization method called multi-objective sailfish optimization was developed in this study. After that, its performance was tested using the classic test function. Finally, a multi-objective sailfish optimization algorithm is used to solve the system equipment installation scheme under the following electric load (FEL) strategy and following thermal load (FTL) strategy. The simulation results show that the system under the FEL strategy has better comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: The Connotation, Characteristics and Development of Digitized Distribution Network: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of power grid construction scale, it has entered the era of power big data, realizing the deep integration of advanced digital technology and power system. The construction of digital power grid is an important path to promote the digital transformation of power grid. Focusing on the basic concept of digital power grid, this paper expounds the technical connotation and characteristics of digital power grid in detail, constructing the technical framework of digital power grid, including sensor measurement, edge computing, information connection, digital platform, cross domain intelligence and system security. The paper analyzes the connotation, characteristics and supporting technologies of digital power grid, and constructs the digital power grid architecture. Finally, it prospects the development prospects.

articleTitle: Design of Chemical Enterprise Carbon Reduction Scheme Based on Carbon Handprint Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Product environmental impact analysis by carbon footprint is a highly recognized research method to quantitatively evaluate carbon emission intensity of industrial products. In addition to the traditional carbon footprint method, researchers have recently proposed a carbon handprint method. This method is driven by the concept of describing the positive impact of products on climate. However, the guidance of this method for industrial enterprises' emission reduction plans is not clear. This paper proposes an enhanced evaluation method of product carbon handprint. We compare footprint and handprint methods by considering the improvement of production process. A plasticizer production enterprise in Zhejiang province is taken as an example. This paper establishes four carbon emission reduction methods of such enterprises and makes a quantitative comparison between footprint and handprint. The comparison results show that the input raw materials account for a high proportion of carbon emissions in both methods. However, in the scope of handprint, plasticizer manufacturers could produce modified plasticizers to generate carbon handprint and reduce emissions for downstream customers. The reduction effect of plasticizer on carbon handprint of polyvinyl chloride customers reached 0.983 tCO2-eq/t, twice as much as the reduction of carbon footprint in the manufacturer. Our work shows that product performance improvement can contribute more carbon handprint, this method is more systematic.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Flexible Demand Response of Multiple Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to effectively utilize the potential dispatchable load resources in the integrated energy system under the premise of ensuring low carbon operation, this study propose a low-carbon optimal dispatching model with multiple flexible loads and a stepped carbon trading mechanism. Firstly, a stepped carbon trading mechanism is introduced in the supply side to make the equipment more reasonable and economic supply of energy, thus promoting the consumption of renewable energy. Then, a flexible demand response for multi-loads is introduced in the user side, which stimulates users to adjust the way of energy utilization by a reward mechanism, thus improving the characteristics of users' energy consumption. Finally, multiple scenarios are set up for comparative analysis to demonstrate the effectiveness of the model in terms of low-carbon and economy.

articleTitle: A Composite Line Protection Scheme for Flexible HVDC Transmission Systems with Outward-shifted Current Limiting Reactors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the practical needs of efficiency-improving and cost reduction in the construction, operation, and maintenance process of flexible DC transmission systems, the optimization of DC system topology has attracted more attention in the industry, among which the optimal design of converter installation location, structure, and parameters of such systems has the most trend of popularization and application. However, the such proposal will directly change the path and propagation characteristics of the fault traveling wave (TW) when the DC transmission system fails, significantly change the fault characteristics, and seriously reduce the operation performance and adaptability of any applied relay protection schemes. Based on a comprehensive RTDS model of real system parameters, this paper quantitatively analyzed the occurrence and development law of fault characteristics in the optimized topology, through which the influence of fault attributes on the steepness and subsequent development trend of TWs is widely utilized, and a principle of using difference development sum of local measurements to realize detection, identification and rough location of faults is proposed. The composite of it and a bilateral current direction criterion can effectively improve the anti-interference ability and reliability of the overall protection scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Inter-Converter Harmonic Interaction of Multi-feed DC System Filter Switching Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The harmonics at the AC side of each converter station in a multi-feed DC transmission system have an interaction effect. The definitions of the AC side harmonic absorption and harmonic amplification in the multi-infeed DC transmission system are respectively given, and their occurrence phenomena are described. Some specific switching methods of AC filter combinations may cause the interaction of harmonic currents between converter stations. Based on the harmonic impedance method, this paper defines the harmonic current interaction coefficient of converter stations, which is used to calculate the interaction degree of harmonic currents between converter stations. Taking the multi-converter station system composed of three converter stations as a study case, a harmonic impedance model with AC filters was built, and the influence coefficient of harmonic current was calculated for the characteristic harmonics. The influence coefficient of harmonic current is calculated, and the influence of AC filter combination switching on the interaction of harmonic current of the corresponding loop inverter station is analyzed. The results show that the interaction effects of the 11th and 13th harmonic currents are small, while the interaction effects of the 23rd and 25th harmonic currents are relatively large, and the switching of specific filters will cause the absorption and amplification of the harmonic currents of the AC busbars of each converter station. The absorption and amplification of the harmonic current are analyzed by the current interaction coefficient, and the harmonic attenuation and gain conditions are obtained. Finally, a PSCAD electromagnetic transient simulation model is established to verify the above analysis results.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Location Method of Power Communication Network Fault Using Digital Twin Model Based on Weight Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of fault location, a fault location method of power communication network based on fuzzy set theory is proposed. The membership degree with weight coefficient is introduced to realize the location of fault multi carrier. Combined with the characteristics of power communication network using digital twin model, the determination factors and calculation methods of weight coefficient are pointed out, and the analysis method of fault affecting service is further proposed to realize the analysis of power communication network. The function of fault carrier can be determined quickly in the multi carrier of information network.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Thermally Stable and Safe Power Supply Interval for Regional Power Grids Taking into Account the Influence of Source-Grid-Load Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of new energy and load interacts with the tidal shift of the transmission channel, and the power supply capacity of the regional grid is characterized by strong uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a thermal stability safe supply interval model for regional power grid and its solution method, which takes into account the interaction effect of source and load, and uses the safe supply interval to describe the distribution range of regional power grid capacity. The results of the actual grid show that the power supply capacity distribution under different source-load distribution is in a wide range, and the distribution and capacity of interruptible load have a large impact on the power supply capacity, which verifies the correctness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy and Energy Storage Capacity Allocation of Multi-source Joint Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the utilization rate of new energy, such as wind power and photovoltaic has been widely used, but it also brings great challenges to the frequency modulation of the power system. In this paper, the energy storage capacity of the multi-source combined system is reasonably configured to improve the overall economy of the system while concerning the frequency stability. Firstly, the control strategy and energy storage capacity optimization model of multi-source joint frequency modulation system are analyzed. Secondly, MOPSO algorithm is used to solve the energy storage capacity optimization problem of multi-source joint system. Finally, a comparative analysis is carried out under the two experimental conditions. It is verified that the energy storage results not only meet the needs of frequency modulation, but also take into account the overall economy of the system.

articleTitle: LOW Carbon Economy Optimal Dispatch of Renewable Energy Power System Considering Carbon Rights Trading and Power Generation Rights Trading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, to alleviate a series of problems caused by global fossil energy development and utilization and to respond to China’s "double carbon" target, the domestic power generation rights trading market has been gradually developed. To address the problem that the current results only consider the medium-and long-term trading model of power generation rights but ignore the impact of system operation network constraints, an optimization model of intra-day power generation rights trading is established to maximize social benefits. On this basis, the day-ahead optimization model considering the total benefit after carbon trading is constructed by combining the carbon trading market. Finally, the IEEE-39 bus system (wind-fire) is used to verify the advantages of the described model in enhancing the electricity traded in power generation rights, promoting the consumption of new energy and helping to reduce carbon emissions on the power generation side.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination Strategy of Emergency and Correction Control under High Proportion of New Energy Connected to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale access of new energy sources, the operation mode and the uncertainty factors of the power grid increase, meanwhile the short-term power shock has an increasing impact, which exacerbates the complexity of the system frequency response characteristics and the difference in space-time distribution. Based on the analysis of principles and adaptability of emergency control and correction control, this paper comprehensively considers the operation mode and new energy access, and proposes a centralized control decision-making method based on model and trajectory driving from the perspective of global frequency control. The method also considers the continuously adjustable control resources and low voltage ride through of new energy. Finally, the practicality of the proposed method is verified based on the actual power grid simulation.

Author Keywords: a high proportion of new energy

articleTitle: Study on Measures to Improve the Short-Circuit Thermal Stability of OPGW
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the engineering design of Optical Fiber Composite Overhead Ground Wire (OPGW), thermal stability verification is an indispensable work. Its essence is calculating the short-circuit current flowing through OPGW and verifying whether it meets the technical requirements when the grounding short-circuit fault occurs. The calculation of short-circuit thermal stability is of great significance for verifying and selecting OPGW. This paper introduces the problems that need to be considered in the thermal stability calculation of OPGW, including the selection of the allowable current short-circuit time of OPGW short-circuit thermal stability. By calculating the actual current of OPGW, the thermal stability of OPGW is discussed, and several measures to reduce the short circuit current and heat capacity of OPGW are proposed.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Piezoelectric Folded Cantilever Driven Electric Field Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The security of smart grid highly relies on the designed, which is based on charge induced principle and mutual accurate electrical quantity detection. In this paper, an electric shielding electrodes structure. The electric field distribution and field sensor with piezoelectric folded cantilever actuators was induced charge for sensing units, driving capability of piezoelectric folded cantilever and vibration modal analysis were implemented using the finite element analysis method with COMSOL Multiphysics software. The simulation results show that the resonance frequency of the vibration structure is 5930.5 Hz. At that operation frequency, the output current is up to 3.45 nA and 0.39 nA for a 100 kV/m direct current electric field under a distributed excitation of 10 V and 1 V, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Cascading Failure Search Method of High Proportion New Energy Power System Based on Branch Influence Factor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reviewing the blackouts in recent years, it is found that almost all blackouts are caused by a series of complex fault chain reactions caused by unexpected small-probability faults, resulting in the destruction of the stability of the power grid. Building a systematic and scientific cascading failure risk assessment system and providing efficient and accurate fault cascading evolution path search methods have become important means to prevent, control and even block blackouts caused by cascading failures. Aiming at the cascading failure problem dominated by power flow, a cascading failure search method of high proportion new energy power system based on branch influence factor is proposed in this paper. The effectiveness of the proposed cascading failure search method is verified based on the modified IEEE 39-bus power system.

Author Keywords: high proportion new energy power system

articleTitle: A Short-term Peak Shaving Model of Hybrid Pumped-Storage Hydropower Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a short-term peak shaving model of hybrid pumped-storage hydropower plant (HPSHP). The model takes the unit as the minimum modeling unit and its objective function is minimizing the residual load peak-valley difference. The different operating characteristics of the conventional units and pumped-storage units are differentially modeled, and besides, the binary variables that represent the operation states are introduced to realize decoupling and correlation switching of operating states. In terms of model solving, the original mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem was converted to MILP model by linearization method and modeling skills, and finally solved by CPLEX tool in JAVA environment. Finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by an example of a hydropower station in southwest China.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Coordinative Strategy of Reactive Power and Voltage Control for Frequent Power Flow Fluctuation in New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of new energy and flexible load, the random fluctuation of power system operation is enhanced, and the traditional voltage control scheme is limited. In view of the shortcomings of traditional reactive voltage control in matching the dual characteristics of the source and load in new power system, a multi-time scale coordinative strategy of reactive power and voltage control for frequent power flow fluctuation in new power system is proposed, and the reactive power and voltage control is carried out according to the normal and the unexpected large fluctuation of the power flow. The reactive power and voltage coordinated control mode of hour-minute level is used in the normal fluctuation of power flow. The timely adjustment of voltage deviation and the rapid suppression of voltage fluctuation are realized by MPC rolling optimization and dynamic-static reactive power resource substitution, and sufficient dynamic reactive power reserve is reserved for the system. The reactive power and voltage coordinated control mode of second level is used in the case of non-expected large fluctuation of power flow, and the fast decision-making ability of deep reinforcement learning realizes the rapid recovery of over-limit voltage. An example of a regional power grid in eastern China verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Loss Analysis Method Based on Charging Pile Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accurately calculate and analyze the working loss of DC charging pile, so as to better carry out the operation and maintenance of charging pile. In this paper, a loss analysis method of charging pile circuit is proposed. By calculating the loss of charging pile, the advantages and disadvantages of its performance can be analyzed and the fault can be judged. The characteristics of a charging pile circuit are analyzed, and then the two-stage loss model is established according to its characteristics, which are the VIENNA rectifier loss model of the former stage and the DC/DC isolation loss model of the latter stage. The former stage circuit is PFC network, and its loss includes three parts: power device conduction loss, power device switching loss and passive device loss. The latter circuit is divided into switching network, compensation network and rectifier filter network. The switching network includes conduction loss and turn-off loss of the switch tube, the compensation network includes resonant inductance loss, and the rectifier filter network includes transformer core loss, transformer winding loss and rectifier diode loss. Finally, the operation of the existing circuit is judged by the loss calculation prediction formula. This method can accurately calculate the loss of the charging pile circuit, judge the performance of the charging pile, and predict the fault state of the charging pile.

articleTitle: Comparison of K-Means and Hierarchical Clustering Used in Power Consumption Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to analysis the characteristics of the electricity consumption, a typical consumer’s electricity consumption data from January 1st 2022 to July 27th 2022 is collected. K-Means and hierarchical clustering models are built. The highest temperature, the lowest temperature and the consumption are set as input of the model. The results show that when the cluster of K-Means is 3, although the results can reflect the heating demand, but can not reflect the refrigeration demand. The results of hierarchical clustering can reflect the heating and refrigeration demand both when group average and furthest neighbor is used. The results of hierarchical clustering is more credible compared with K-Means.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistance Current Inversion Algorithm Based on Single-valued Function Fitting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of high-frequency transient current measurement in power system, a magnetic hysteresis optimization algorithm based on single-valued fitting is proposed to measure current. The algorithm is based on the data measured by tunnel junction magnetoresistance (TMR) sensor. The algorithm improves the measurement accuracy of high-frequency current amplitude by optimizing conventional algorithms. Experiments show that the optimized algorithm in this paper reduces the high-frequency current inversion error from 20% of the traditional single-valued algorithm to less than 5%, which has reference value for high-frequency current measurement.

articleTitle: A Wind Power/Photovoltaic/Hydropower/Pumped Storage Power Station System Sizing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with the increasingly serious energy shortage, the energy system towards "zero carbon" is undoubtedly the basis for alleviating energy shortages. This study innovative proposes a two-layer planning model integrating sizing and operation optimization, with zero carbon emission and system revenue as the target, and relying on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Distributional Robust Optimization (DRO). The method to solve the problem of the sizing of power station systems under the uncertainty of scenery output, and to ensure the grid connection of renewable energy under the premise of satisfying the load demand.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Production by Renewable Energy and Future Trend in China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydrogen energy is a clean, flexible, zero-carbon secondary energy source which can be stored and transported long distance. With the continuous increase of installed capacity proportion of renewable energy in the future, it can be used as a carrier to stabilize the fluctuation of renewable energy and optimize the power system operation, helping the country's clean and low-carbon energy transformation. The continuous large-scale development of renewable energy will continue to reduce the cost of green hydrogen production, and green hydrogen may become the future development trend. This paper introduces current status of China's hydrogen energy, and the main renewable energy hydrogen production technologies by wind power, PV power, biomass, etc, and analyzed the obstacles of power system that brought by the green hydrogen production, finally proposed the future development mode of the hydrogen and the power system.

articleTitle: Online Prediction Method of RUL of Lithium Battery Based on CEEMDAN-ILSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of non-linearity of remaining life data caused by the uncertainty of lithium battery discharge behavior and local over optimization in the process of optimizing parameters by swarm intelligence algorithm, a short-term and long-term memory neural network (CEEMDAN-ILSTM) prediction method based on data decomposition and improved whale optimization algorithm is proposed. In this method, the CEEMDAN algorithm is used to decompose the original data to preliminarily simplify the hidden change law in the data, and the improved whale optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the neural network to find out the network parameters that can make the current prediction model have better prediction performance. Through the evaluation on the lithium battery data set provided by NASA, compared with the current mainstream methods, the method proposed in this paper has better prediction performance than other methods.

articleTitle: VSG-Based Extended State Observer and Feedback Damping Control for Low Frequency Oscillations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) could participate in the low frequency oscillations (LFO) of the ac grids, which could make the dc-side state variables response to the ac side oscillations. Utilizing this coupling characteristic, an VSG-based extended state observer (ESO) is designed to estimate the state variables and the power disturbance in the ac grids. Based on the system model, a new state variable is defined to represent the unknown power disturbance of the ac grid, and an ESO can be further constructed to estimate the extended state variables by the dc-side measurements. Subsequently, a state feedback damping control is designed based on the linear quadratic optimal regulator (LQR) method to suppress the LFOs with the estimated state variables. Finally, a converter-station connected with a two-area power system is established by MATLAB, and the correctness of the proposed method is validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the Demand-Side Response Characteristics of the Flexibility Adjustment Ability of the Grid Side
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power system is a recognized complex network system. The simulation process of power system production simulation is a complex physical system accurate solution process, and conventional analytical methods are difficult to effectively achieve simulation goals. Therefore, complex system modeling and simulation methods must be adopted to achieve objective simulation of the operation of the power system. This paper applies the production simulation technology to the scale assessment of flexibility demand, clarifies the technical principle of the production simulation simulator, optimizes the production simulation model, proposes the unit combination and economic dispatch considering safety constraints, and finally builds the production simulation model of the Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan power grid, and finally builds the production simulation model of the Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan power grid based on the simulation data in 2021, and conducts 8760 hours of production simulation time series simulation for the whole year of 2025. It provides theoretical guidance and technical support for the research of demand-side regulation ability.

articleTitle: Study on Combined Classification of Typical Day Load and Solar Radiation Intensity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the long-term planning of the terminal energy supply system with unit commitment as the core, it is necessary to reconstruct the time series curve of short-term load and renewable energy output, and investigate the long-term impact through a variety of representative short-term load and renewable energy output. One of the key issues of such scenario based long-term planning is the acquisition of short-term load and renewable energy output. Obtaining typical day data based on clustering algorithm can ensure the dynamic typicality of typical day data, but it cannot guarantee the overall accuracy of the set of typical days in the annual sense. This paper first gives the index to measure the overall accuracy of typical days, and then based on the dynamic time wraping distance nearest neighbor algorithm, a typical day acquisition method based on the specified sample classes is proposed. Through the maximum and minimum designated sample classes and binary classification algorithm proposed in this paper, and combined with the dynamic time wraping distance nearest neighbor algorithm, it can not only obtain the dynamic characteristics of typical days, but also ensure the typical day acquisition requirements of the annual overall accuracy index. The calculation results based on actual data verify the correctness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: planning of terminal energy supply system

articleTitle: Status Quo Demand Response Mechanisms at Provincial Level of China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Developing the new power system has become a top priority to achieve the goal of "carbon peak and neutrality". However, the intermittent and fluctuating renewable energy from supply-side would dominate the new power system with less regulation capacity, which could harm the safe, stable and economic operation of the system. It is urgent to unlock the demand-side flexibility so as to make up the regulation capacity inadequacy from supply-side. The demand response (DR) would play an increasingly vital role at demand-side and its development in China is just unfolding. In order to provide a systematical overview of current status of DR practice in China, this paper investigates the state-of-the-art (in 2021 and 2022) DR mechanisms and regulations in various provinces of China, then analyzes the pilot practice of load aggregators (LA) and virtual power plants (VPP) in China, and discusses the way forward for developing various types of DR mechanisms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Preventive Maintenance Cycle of Smart Meter Based on Weibull Distribution to Reduce Maintenance Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity meter enterprises do not have enough understanding of the importance of reliability prediction of smart meters and lack of design and research on the reliability life of smart meters, which leads to difficulties in the maintenance and replacement of electricity meters. Therefore, there is an urgent need for a reliable and effective method to estimate the reliable life and remaining life of smart meters, so as to provide decisionmaking basis for the verification and rotation cycle optimization of batch electric meters, improve user experience and save operation and maintenance costs. According to the operation data of smart meters, firstly, the data are processed by drawing Weibull distribution diagram. The results show that the operation time of smart meters follows Weibull distribution; The two parameter Weibull distribution model is established. The parameters of the two parameter Weibull distribution are determined by the least square method and the fitting effect is verified by the K-S test method; And calculated the preventive maintenance cycle under the minimum maintenance cost. When the regular maintenance cost is 40 yuan and the after-maintenance cost is 300 yuan, the minimum maintenance cost per unit time of smart electricity meter is 0.07539 yuan, and the corresponding operation time is about 915 days.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hybrid Multi-Infeed HVDC Transmission Technology and Power Coordinated Control Strategy of Near Area Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the Hybrid MIDC (multi-infeed HVDC) transmission system, the electrical coupling between the converter stations is tight, and the interaction between the AC and DC systems is more complicated. It is necessary to conduct in-depth analysis and research on the dynamic operation characteristics and power coordination control strategy of Hybrid MIDC power transmission system in combination with specific projects. This paper summarizes the problems of power oscillation and emergency DC power support in MIDC transmission systems and their research status. Then, taking a typical double-infeed DC transmission project as an example, an electromagnetic transient simulation model including three-region AC power grids, LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC transmission systems is established. The power step response characteristics of LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC systems are compared through simulation analysis. For Hybrid MIDC, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy for emergency power support between flexible DC and nearby conventional DC & AC systems. Finally, it is verified that it can improve the stability of the power system to a certain extent through the simulation test of the trip fault of the AC system generator set.

articleTitle: Tie-Line Scheduling Based on Equivalents of Regional Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Tie-line scheduling is a crucial issue to realize the hierarchical dispatch and control architecture in China. At present, tie-line schedule is determined manually by operators, which cannot provide satisfactory results to accommodate the variance of the operational status. Although the optimal tie-line schedule can be computed by joint optimization of multi-regional power grids, which involves the whole interconnected network model and is hard to maintain. In addition, the decentralized methods require frequent communications between different control centers, which are always inapplicable in practical engineer. To cope with this issue, this paper proposes a novel tie-line scheduling method based on the equivalent of regional power grids, which firstly employ an equivalent model to represent a group of units in each region. Then the cost function, ramping rate and other characteristics of the equivalent unit are accurately described by piecewise functions. Finally, the tie-line schedule can be obtained easily without synchronous coordination between control centers. Numerical tests demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Privacy Protection Method Based on Improved Schnorr Ring Signature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stable operation of the power grid depends on the security and reliability of data. The characteristics of decentralization, openness, transparency, and traceability of blockchain not only improve efficiency and reduce costs but also face serious privacy leakage problems. Therefore, this paper attempts to propose an improved Schnorr signature algorithm, which improves the traditional Schnorr signature. Firstly, the principle of Schnorr signature is introduced and the flow of Schnorr signature is elaborated; secondly, the ring signature generation function Sign and the ring signature verification function Verify in Schnorr signature are improved, and the algorithm implementation of the improved Schnorr signature is given. Finally, the numerical simulation shows that the improved Schnorr signature is better than the traditional Schnorr signature in terms of signature efficiency, and further improves the level of blockchain privacy protection to achieve higher security.

articleTitle: An Event-based Judgment Method for Distribution Network Faults Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the distribution network fault judgment is mainly realized by the matrix method, the probability estimation method or the information fusion method, which is highly dependent on the real-time accuracy of the power grid data and the correctness of the power grid topology relationship. The fault tolerance is poor, and even when a key signal is missing, the research and judgment may fail directly. For various situations of normal or abnormal operation of the distribution network, based on the massive heterogeneous information (telemetry, remote signaling, wave recording, etc.) of the whole link of the medium and low voltage distribution network, an event template is generated; Equipment types, etc. According to the grid topology, measurement nodes and sensing equipment types, a deep learning-based medium and low voltage distribution network fault event judgment model is established for different locations and types.

articleTitle: Location Decision of Battery Swapping Stations Combined with Battery Swapping Warehouses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The worldwide promotion of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is extremely important to reduce the use of fossil fuels and thus achieve the goal of reducing carbon emissions. The layout and application of EV replenishment facilities largely influence consumers' willingness to purchase EVs, thus affecting the in-depth promotion of new energy vehicles. At the same time, the large number of charging and swapping stations connected to the power grid also has an impact on the existing power system. In this paper, we propose a strategy for the layout of charging/swapping stations, which can be used to promote the development of new energy EV charging modes. Specifically, we propose a model combining charging/swapping stations and swapping warehouses, which optimizes the location and the number of swapping warehouses, enabling EV owners to reach the swapping stations faster, increasing the service coverage, and fulfilling the demand while saving costs and increasing operators’ revenue. Since the battery swapping warehouses are not connected to the power grid, the construction cost and operation cost are much lower than that of the swapping stations. The used batteries are transported back to the charging/swapping station to replenish energy during the low-load hours of the grid, which completes the peak-shaving and valley-filling of the grid load.

articleTitle: Flexible Recovery Strategy of Distribution Network after Wind Disaster with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the problem of fault recovery of distribution network with distributed generation after wind disaster, this paper proposes a novel "island + reconstruction" electricity supply recovery strategy. Firstly, with the maximum electricity supply restoration area as the objective function, the distribution network is formed into a planned island through breadth-first search method. Secondly, the remaining outage areas are reconstructed by the ant colony optimization with the minimum network loss as the objective function. Finally, the feasibility of this scheme is verified by the IEEE33-bus distribution system. Simulation result shows this method can maximize the recovery of electricity supply for the distribution network.

articleTitle: A Non-contact Voltage Measurement Method for Ultra-High Voltage DC Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional voltage measurement for the Ultra-High Voltage DC transmission line faces many problems such as high volume and high insulation cost. The non-contact voltage measurement method can solve those problems and improve measurement accuracy. This paper applies the Chebyshev integral method and the Gauss-Legendre integral method to the electric field inversion problem and takes the inductors as the integral interval. The errors of these methods can be less than 0.5%. The windy situation is also considered to test the sensibility of these methods, which shows that the error in the windy situation can be less than 1.5%.

articleTitle: Integrated Bi-Directional Energy Management Scheme for Electric Vehicle Cluster: A Carbon and Electricity Nexus Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the possession of electric vehicles gradually increases, the charging and discharging strategies of electric vehicle clusters have attracted a broad range of attention. The large volume of uncontrolled charging of electric vehicles increases the power peak during peak periods of electricity consumption. In this paper, we propose an Integrated Bi-Directional Energy Management Scheme for electric vehicle clusters, based on a carbon and electricity nexus perspective. We model this scenario as a mixed-integer programming problem, which aims to maximize profits while achieving temporal shifting of electric vehicle cluster charging loads to decrease the system peak-to-valley difference. The numerical case study shows t charging and discharging of electric vehicle clusters in work areas, residential areas, and highway charging stations.

articleTitle: Knowledge Assisted Deep Reinforcement Learning for Electric Vehicle Charging Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is a promising data-driven approach to solve the electric vehicle (EV) charging problem. However, DRL based charging strategies maybe not always meet the requirements of users. In this paper, a knowledge-assisted algorithm combining twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) algorithm and imitation learning is proposed to control the charging process of EVs. The purpose is to minimize the cost while charging to the desired value. With the assistance of knowledge, the out-of-limit actions are corrected, so only the reward function to constrain the cost needs to be set, speeding up the convergence speed of the algorithm. To make the actor network acquire the capability of charging to the desired value, imitation learning is used to correct the actor network. The simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the knowledge-assisted TD3 algorithm with imitation learning.

Author Keywords: twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm (TD3)

articleTitle: Risk Sharing Method of Robust Optimization Model Considering the Uncertainty of Renewable Energy Output in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, more attention has been paid to the renewable energy clearing method in electricity market. Firstly, this paper deduces the robust counterpart of box robust optimization. Secondly, the box robust optimization model is proposed to deal with the uncertainty of renewable energy. Finally, in the simulation analysis, through the comparison of calculation efficiency and the comparison of different system scale and different penetration rates of renewable energy, it is verified that the proposed risk factor allocation method has a good effect in large-scale systems and has little impact on the calculation efficiency of the model.

articleTitle: Agent Simulation-Based Market Clearing Model for Reactive Auxiliary Services
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reactive power is local and needs to be consumed locally; therefore, this paper investigates a sub-regional local market for reactive auxiliary services, where the power trading agency is responsible for receiving and aggregating the operating cost bids and opportunity loss bids from power generating companies. The power dispatch agency aims to minimize each local market's reactive power procurement costs, thereby minimizing reactive power generation subject to system constraints and voltage support. In this paper, a sub-regional reactive auxiliary services market clearing model with distributed energy participation is proposed and tested on an IEEE 24 bus system with each region as a node. The results show that the reactive market mechanism provided in this paper can incentivize extensive participation of new energy units and maintain sufficient reactive reserves and that the market power of individual units can be controlled within reasonable limits.

articleTitle: Alternatives to the Declining System Inertia in the Power System: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rotational inertia in a system is decreasing as the proportion of variable renewable energy (VRE) increases, posing a threat to system frequency stability and security. This paper systematically presents the typical frequency dynamics, concludes three distinct types of minimum inertia constraints, and illustrates the impact of implementing such constraints on a power system. In order to comply with the irresistible renewable energy development and low-carbon trend, various approaches from various sides of a power system to ensure the frequency stability of a low-inertia grid are also presented.

articleTitle: Research on Structure Optimization of Cold Dielectric High-Temperature Superconducting Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High temperature superconducting (HTS) cable offers the advantages of large transmission capacity, low loss, and environmental friendliness compared to traditional cables. This paper proposes the mathematical model of cold insulated HTS cable. The inner diameter, winding angle, and winding direction of each layer are taken as the optimization variables. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the structure of the cold dielectric HTS cable to achieve the objective of the uniform current distribution. The results show that the current proportion of each layer of the conductor layer is close, and the maximum unbalance rate is less than 1.5 %, while that of the shielding layer is less than 1.2 %. Moreover, the winding direction has little effect on each layer and total inductance. Using n=2, m=2, and n=4, m=2, the species of winding directions can be reduced to 2, which is the key to lowering optimization time.

articleTitle: Rectification and Optimization on Single Component Defect in HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system and avoid abnormal operation or block induced by the single-component defect, the single-component defect optimization scheme of HVDC control and protection system was studied. Based on the typical failure mechanisms and solutions of single control and protection component in HVDC system, a weighted-multivariate comprehensive evaluation model was proposed, verified by practical examples of application. This model is capable of providing suggestions to the optimized design of new projects and grading the urgency and feasibility as well. The reliability design of new HVDC project should follow the ‘N-1’ principle with signal communication mode and complete self-checking logic. This work provides reference and guidance for both the optimization of single component and the design of future system.

articleTitle: Improved Virtual Synchronous Generator Control Strategy for Synchronous Frequency Resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large amount of distributed energy connected to power grid through inverters tends to cause a decrease in the rotating capacity of the grid, which in turn reduces the stability of the grid. To solve this problem, virtual synchronous generator (VSG) can effectively increase the virtual inertia by simulating synchronous generator (SG). With considering power coupling effect, this paper demonstrated that distributed power generation system (DPGS) under grid connection (GC) mode will cause synchronous frequency resonance (SFR) phenomenon by analyzing the small signal model of VSG for different transmission angle transmission lines during the grid disturbance. Then, an improved VSG strategy with correction link is proposed, which can effectively suppress the generation of synchronous frequency resonance. Finally, this paper verifies the correctness of the small signal analysis, the consistent response of VSG and SG, and the suppression effect of the improved strategy on the synchronous resonance through the simulations of the small signal model, the VSG model and the SG model.

articleTitle: Transmission Expansion Planning Based on Light Robust Optimization Modelling Considering Microgrid Capacity Expansion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a 20-year transmission expansion planning (TEP) in a hybrid power system with microgrid (MG) integration based on light robustness optimization modeling considering microgrid capacity expansion (MGCE). The proposed light robust optimization model (LRO) can coordinate the economy and robustness of the TEP problem, and alleviate the over-conservative issue compared with the standard robustness optimization model (RO). Firstly, TEP considering MGCE without uncertainty is selected as the standard method to achieve a standard planning scheme. Then, the MG power uncertainty represented by some interval uncertainty set is considered and an LRO-based TEP model is constructed, in which a cost tolerance parameter is introduced to relax the total investment s to balance the TEP scheme's economy and robustness. The proposed LRO model is solved using the Matlab YALMIP/GUROBI optimization toolbox. An 18-bus test system is used to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model. In addition, a critical solution for LRO can be determined by investigating the relationship between cost tolerance and the infeasible objective.

articleTitle: High-Impedance Fault Pilot Protection Method Based on Zero Sequence Current Comparison in Low-Resistance Grounding Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China's urban distribution network lines are increasingly being cabled, and more and more large and medium-sized cities are using low resistance neutral grounding mode. When the zero-sequence current is lower than the activation value of conventional zero sequential current protection, faults in single-phase low-resistance grounding systems may not be protected. In order to address this problem, a zero-sequence network analysis is used in this paper to determine the features of one-phase ground faults in low resistance grounding systems. As a result of the results, it appears that the transition resistance does not have a significant influence on ration of zero serial current flow across the busbars on either side of the trouble spots. Regardless of the trouble spots, the ratio is always greater than 15, so it is chosen as a protection criterion to construct a pilot protection method for high resistance earth fault in a low resistance earthing system based on zero serial current ratios. Finally, PSCAD simulations are used to verify the correctness of the method and the capacity to withstand transitional impedance above 1kΩ was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Mining Method of Power Grid Monitoring Alarm Association Rules Based on Improved FP-growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The core of current grid monitoring eventization technology is the discrimination method based on the alarm-event correlation rule base. However, with the continuous expansion of the grid scale, the traditional artificially refined rules can no longer meet the needs of monitoring eventization. Based on an improved FP-growth algorithm, this paper proposes a mining method for alarm association rules in power grid monitoring. First, the DBSCAN clustering model is used to replace the traditional sliding time window model to divide the original alarm siganls. Then, based on the FP-growth algorithm, a signal filter is added to eliminate the known signal pairs with strong correlation in the alarm cluster, and the signal is weighted according to the importance of the alarm signal. Next, according to the improved FP-growth algorithm, the association rules of the divided alarm clusters are mined. Finally, through the analysis and comparison of data from the power grid, the effectiveness of this method is verified, and the efficiency of rule mining is further improved, which has a certain reference value for the maintenance and improvement of the alarm-event correlation rule base.

articleTitle: Coordinated Crew Dispatch for Post-Disaster Power Systems and Roads Restoration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extreme natural disasters will cause serious damage to power systems and public roads, and the damage of road networks will directly affect the repair of power components. Therefore, the cooperative repair of roads and power grid elements is of great significance to improve the resilience of power systems. Towards urban power grids, this paper proposes a maintenance personnel dispatch model for the collaborative repair of roads and power grids after extreme disasters. First, a mechanism for the coordinated restoration of power and roads after the disaster is constructed, which unifies the dispatch of the power restoration plan and the road restoration plan of the road administration department. Then, with the goal of minimizing comprehensive benefit loss, considering the coupling of power maintenance path optimization and road dynamic repair process, a coordinated dispatch model of power and road maintenance is established, which is a mixed-integer linear programming model suitable for general solvers. Finally, a case analysis based on the IEEE RTS 79 test system shows that collaborative repair can significantly reduce the travel time of power repair crew, reduce the lack of power supply, and increase the overall social and economic benefits while having a small impact on the road repair goals.

articleTitle: Co-configuration of Hydrogen Equipment for Multienergy System Considering Time Coupling of Carbon Dioxide and Hydrogen
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The cooperation between the power to gas and carbon capture and storage technology can increase the utilization rate of wind power and reduce the carbon emission of the integrated energy system. However, there is a problem of time scale mismatch between electric hydrogen production and carbon dioxide capture, which makes it difficult for carbon dioxide to be used immediately, and there is a risk of storage leakage. In this paper, hydrogen storage and hydrogen fuel cells are used to decouple carbon dioxide from hydrogen in time scale to realize immediate utilization of carbon dioxide, and a cooperative configuration model of hydrogen devices is established. The simulation results that the rational allocation of hydrogen equipment can effectively increase the utilization rate of wind power, and reduce the carbon emission and the total cost of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Combined Heat and Power Dispatch under Different Control Modes Based on Probabilistic Prediction of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High proportion of new energy has become a remarkable feature of modern power system. The intermittency and volatility of new energy generation power bring significant uncertainty to the power system, which greatly increases the risk of the safety and stable operation of the power system. The multi-energy complementarity can efficiently promote the integration of renewable energy. This paper proposes a method of combined heat and power dispatch under different control modes of heat system based on probabilistic prediction of wind power. Firstly, an extreme learning machine method is used as probabilistic prediction model of wind power. The combined heat and power dispatch model is constructed then considering the different heat network control modes constraints. Finally, a case study is performed based on the test system of an integrated electric-thermal energy system and the results indicates the optimality of the control modes considering the uncertainty of wind power prediction.

articleTitle: A Study on Integrated Energy System Long-term Planning Optimization Considering Complementarity and Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Carbon reduction and neutrality receive more and more attention due to concerns about global warming and the energy crisis. The access of renewable energy brings greater volatility and uncertainty to the integrated energy system (IES). Analyzing the relationship between complementarity and economy is the key to maintaining the long-term benefits of IES. To illustrate the multi-energy coordination and complementary effect in IES, a two-stage planning optimization method considering economy and complementarity is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the complementarity quantification index is established by analyzing the correlation of different energy net loads. Meanwhile, the comprehensive economic index is formed considering the system construction, operation, and maintenance. Then, the energy system is modeled, and the device configuration simulation is carried out. Finally, the Pareto solution set of the programming scheme is obtained by the NSGA-II algorithm. Measured by proposed indicators, the annual total costs increase by 15.8% when the system complementarity is enhanced by 41.3%.

articleTitle: Retailer Profit under Renewable Energy and Demand Response Access Considering CVaR
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To achieve its carbon peak and neutrality targets, China is actively building a new power system with renewable energy as the main body and vigorously promoting the reform of power marketization. The disorderly access of a large number of renewable energy sources will bring enormous pressure to the safe and stable operation of the power system and is not conducive to its participation in market competition. The stochastic optimization method is used to construct renewable energy output scenarios, user demands, and real-time clearing electricity price scenarios and reduce them to probabilistic deterministic scenarios. Aiming at the maximum profit of retailers, considering the conditional value at risk to quantify the risk, this paper establishes and solves the retailer's profit model of "renewable energy + demand response" participating in the electricity market. Finally, numerical simulation is carried out with the wind power output data and spot market electricity price data in a certain place. The simulation results verify that the proposed model provides a new method for power supply companies to make power purchase decisions, sell electricity pricing, and risk assessment. Under the premise of certain risk constraints, it has the maximum income.
