articleTitle: Analysis of Subsynchronous Oscillation in MMC-HVDC System with Interactions of Multitype Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, several broadband oscillation incidents in modular multilevel converter based HVDC (MMC-HVDC) have been observed around the world, most of them are discussed in single turbine oriented scenario. In this paper, a multiple turbines participated subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) in MMC-HVDC transmission system and the interfering mechanism between doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) and permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is revealed. With the consideration of dispatch convention, this paper proposes a temporary suppression strategy by redistributing the amount of interconnected turbines. Comparing to those typical oscillation suppression methods, such as impedance reforming, this strategy is able to ease the oscillation and in the mean time reduce the pecuniary losses during the refinement, which is testified by scheduling operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Energy Storage Units Considering Wind Power and Line Failure Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the installed capacity of wind power increases rapidly, dealing with the randomness and volatility of wind power has become an urgent problem of power system. An optimal dispatch method of energy storage units is proposed in this paper, considering wind power uncertainty and transmission line failure. First, the detailed model of wind power uncertainty and line failure are introduced. Second, the problem is formulated based on robust optimization method, ensuring the operation reliability of the power system under the worst operating condition. The two-stage robust optimization problem is solved using the column and constraint generation(C&CG) algorithm. Finally, case studies on the modified 6-bus system verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Short-Term Voltage Security Constrained Reactive Power Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The goal of short-term voltage security (STVS) constrained reactive power optimization is to improve the STVS of the power grid by regulating the operating state of reactive power resources. However, the STVS constraints are high in dimension and contain differential-algebraic equations, so the optimization problem is difficult to solve. To this end, this paper establishes a machine learning model for STVS analysis and proposes a data-driven STVS constrained reactive power optimization method. A simplification for STVS constraints is proposed to reduce the difficulty of solving the optimization problem. The proposed model is tested based on the IEEE-39 model. The results show that: the proposed method can effectively improve the STVS of the power grid, and the calculation speed is fast.

articleTitle: Secondary Battery Energy Storage System Based on Real-Time Synchronous Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the popularity of electric vehicles, a large number of power batteries are facing retirement. This paper constructs the physical structure of secondary battery energy storage system based on real-time synchronous data (SBESS-RSD), fully exploring the residual value of retired batteries. After considering the differences of the secondary batteries, this paper establishes the working modes and dispatching plans such as direct connection, balancing maintenance and idle state, realizing the functions of power following, fluctuation smoothing, peak load shaving. Finally, this paper carries out field tests in areas with limited PV access. The test results proved that the SBESS-RSD could reduce the maximum peak-to-peak difference by 60%, the peak-to-valley difference of transformer load by 20%, and the transformer load rate by 12% through the peak-filling mode, which effectively supported the grid's absorption of distributed PV.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation and Analysis of Coupled Urban Power Distribution and Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: EVs are recognized as distributed loads and power sources with random motion characteristics in the power distribution networks (PDN); therefore, they serve as connecting points for the distribution network and transportation network (PDN-TN), and have significant impact on the stability and reliability of the routine operation of the coupled networks. In order to guarantee the safe operation of PDN-TN, it is necessary to evaluate the reliability of this coupled network. In this paper, the trip chaining theory is applied to describe the travel plan of EVs, and semi-dynamic flow allocation (SDTA) method is adopted to propose a simulation calculation method of energy flow between two networks based on user equalization (UE) criterion. The new reliability evaluation index for energy flow between the coupled networks is further proposed to better evaluate the reliability. Taking into account the daily trip characteristics of EVs, vehicles types, and charging modes, a coupled network reliability evaluation method based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation is put forward. Finally, the practicability of the proposed method is verified by an IEEE-RBTS BUS-6 test system and a 12-node transportation network.

articleTitle: A New Criterion For Fault Component Current Differential Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A new criterion for line protection based on the sampled value of fault component current was proposed. All the sampled value fault component current in the data window were summed up and the fault was discriminated on the new brake-differential plane. Compared with the traditional sampled-value differential protection and sampled-value fault component current differential protection, the new principle eliminated the need for R-S vote mechanism, taking into account both the reliability and operation speed of the protection, while eliminating the need for Fourier operations, and theoretically allowing fast and reliable operation after half a cycle of power frequency. The simulation model was built and the performance of the new criterion was verified by RTDS. The simulation results show that the new criterion can reliably discriminate the in- and out-of-zone faults, operate quickly within half a cycle.

articleTitle: Reserve Demand Assessment Based on Dynamic Percentage of Renewable Generation and Load Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of building a new power system based on renewable energy, the fluctuation of both power supply and load makes the safe and stable operation of the power system more difficult. In order to cope with the uncertainty of renewable energy output, it is urgent to accurately assess the reserve demand of power system. In this paper, a method of reserve demand assessment based on load/renewable energy forecast dynamic percentage is proposed. Firstly, the forecast error characteristics of load/renewable energy are analyzed, and the alternate calculation method is proposed. Secondly, the historical data are divided into multiple groups according to time and predicted value by clustering and similarity comparison. Kernel density estimation was used to fit the probability density function curves of the relative forecasting errors of load and renewable energy in each group, and the relative forecasting error interval under appropriate confidence was obtained. Finally, the reserve demand is evaluated based on the power grid data of a province in northwest China, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by comparing with the actual data.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of External Characteristics of Vanadium Redox Flow Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Vanadium redox flow battery (VRB) has the advantages of high efficiency, deep charge and discharge, independent design of power and capacity, and has great development potential in the field of large-scale energy storage. Based on the grid connection mechanism of VRB energy storage system, this paper proposes an equivalent model of VRB energy storage system, which can not only accurately simulate the external characteristics of VRB energy storage system, but also meet the needs of power grid simulation and calculation. Finally, the proposed model is built and simulated by Matlab/Simulink. The analysis results show that the model can effectively describe the external characteristics of VRB energy storage system.

articleTitle: Study on Stability Margin Trend of Power System Using GHNet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the guidance of peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality, the proportion of the new energy generation will continue to rise significantly. The randomness, volatility and intermittency of new energy make it difficult to arrange the operation mode of the power system, which also brings great challenges to the early warning and pre-control of the dispatching operation. For the power grid stability trend assessment facing the uncertainty of new energy, the core problem lies in finding the typical and dangerous changing processes from numerous possibilities with high efficiency. This paper proposes the grid hierarchy net (GHNet) model and the chain rule of neural networks to search for the most stable and unstable processes to define the security range trend. Firstly, the GHNet model is constructed and well trained. Then, the restraint conditions of new energy are determined by the statistical results of the actual power and predictive power. Finally, a sensitivity analysis is performed by using chain rule and the extreme changing process will be found out by adjusting the predictive operation point according to the sensitivity results. A 114-bus system is used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method for Regenerative Electric Heating System Considering the Supply Capability of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An optimal planning method for regenerative electric heating considering the supply capability of distribution network is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the model of a regenerative electric heating system with a heat pump and a hot water storage tank is established. Then, an optimal scheduling model of regenerative electric heating is constructed, which takes the operation cost as the goal. Finally, a typical integrated energy systems is used as a test system to illustrate the method. The case results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the peak-valley load difference based on the heat storage capacity of regenerative electric heating.

articleTitle: A New Voltage Fluctuation Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Hilbert Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) is a commonly used method to detect the power quality in the power grid, in which the Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), the mode mixing problem often arises for some special signals. In order to further accurately detect the time-frequency characteristics of complex non-stationary disturbance voltage signals in power grid and improve the time-frequency location ability of Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) method, a power quality disturbance detection method based on improved HHT was proposed. For voltage sag, spike and short interruption, harmonic and composite disturbance signals, the proposed method adopts the combined decomposition method (SVD-FM) based on singular value decomposition (SVD) and signal frequency modulation (FM) to reconstruct the original signal and then perform EMD decomposition, so as to solve the mode mixing problem in the EMD decomposition. Then, the energy density of the signal at different time and frequency is extracted from the Hilbert spectrum to locate the start and end time of the disturbance signal. Simulation results show that the proposed method can accurately and quickly obtain the frequency components, amplitude and mutation time of harmonic signals, analyze the amplitude and start and stop time of voltage sag and short interruption signals, and is also suitable for the detection of composite disturbance signals. Compared with the traditional HHT method, the proposed method has higher accuracy and frequency resolution.

articleTitle: Spot Market Clearing Model Considering the Participation of Combined-Cycle Gas Turbines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, combined-cycle gas turbines (CCGT) have received extensive attention from the academic and industrial circles due to its excellent flexible regulation characteristics. However, CCGT is composed of multiple modules, and may have a significant impact on the market clearing process. As a result of this, this paper focuses on the spot market clearing model considering the participation of CCGT, and evaluate the impact of large-scale CCGT on the market clearing. Firstly, the operation model of CCGT is proposed to capture the physical operation characteristics of different modules of CCGT. Then, the spot market clearing process considering the participation of CCGT is formulated as a MILP model. Case studies based on IEEE-30 bus system demonstrate that the operation of CCGT will significantly affect the clearing of the electricity market, and can provide huge flexibility potential for the system operation.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Potential Evaluation of Temperature-Controlled Load Aggregators Considering Demand Response Willingness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The frequency regulation potential of temperature-controlled load aggregators means that, the total load reduction that all the aggregated temperature-controlled load users can participate in the frequency regulation. User demand response willingness refers to the willingness of users to adjust electricity consumption according to the price of electricity sales to provide demand response based on their own demand response elasticity. This paper establishes a user demand response willingness model including two parts of electricity cost change and temperature change, which is used to characterize the relationship between user frequency regulation potential and electricity price; then proposes a time series chained two-dimensional cloud generator algorithm for the willingness model to predict the temperature-controlled load operating state in the temperature-controlled load, and finally establish a two-layer model to optimize the frequency regulation potential of the temperature-controlled load aggregator, with the frequency regulation potential as the solution variable. The effectiveness of the algorithm and the model are verified through calculation examples, and sensitivity analysis is carried out.

Author Keywords: time series chained cloud generator algorithm

articleTitle: Defect Detection and Classification of Photovoltaic Modules Based on Image Fusion Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation and maintenance challenges of photovoltaic (PV) plants are becoming increasingly prominent due to their long service life and environmental factors. Considering the high cost of manual maintenance, intelligent operation and maintenance technology represented by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) inspection has received great attention. The UAV carrying dual-light cameras can collect visible and infrared images of PV modules simultaneously. In this paper, we propose to use the Faster-RCNN model to complete the defect detection and classification of PV modules. The experimental results show that the trained Faster-RCNN model has high recognition accuracy for defects in both types of images. The models trained by the two types of images are combined to jointly complete the task of defect identification and classification of photovoltaic modules, realizing the complementary and fusion analysis of information, which is conducive to the better judgment of defects.

articleTitle: Study on Inter-Turn Short Circuit Fault of Dry-Type Air-Core Shunt Reactor Under Low Voltage with Low Frequency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the inter-turn short circuit fault occurs in the dry-type air-core shunt reactor (DASR), the short circuit loop will consume a large amount of active power, which will cause the equipment temperature to rise in a short time and damage the equipment. Therefore, it is very important to detect the fault in the early stage of the inter-turn short circuit fault. This paper presents a method to detect the number of inter-turn short circuit fault turns of the DASR based on modified active power (P<inf>m</inf>) and modified reactive power (Q<inf>m</inf>), at low voltage with low frequency. The formulas for Pm and Q<inf>m</inf> are obtained by adding correction factors to the formulas for active power and reactive power respectively. Their correction factors are obtained by using genetic algorithm. The variations of Pm and Q<inf>m</inf> under normal condition and short circuit condition with different turns are studied. The inter-turn short circuit fault with different frequency and different fault location is simulated. It provides a feasible method for detecting the inter-turn short circuit fault of the DASR and determining the number of short circuit turns.

articleTitle: Research on F-type Tower of 500kV AC Transmission Line in Heavily Polluted Area
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The flashover of insulator strings in heavily polluted areas is a prominent problem in the construction of transmission line projects. This research innovatively proposes an application scheme of vertically arranged F-type towers in a 500kV single-circuit AC transmission line project in a heavily polluted area in Shanxi Province. The scheme effectively reduces the risk of flashover caused by the accumulation of pollution in the jumper string, ensures the safe operation of the power grid, and greatly reduces the width of the line corridor is reduced, which has great advantages for passing through the industrial intensive area.

articleTitle: A Novel Peer-to-Peer Trading Mechanism for Community Microgrid Considering Market Share Pricing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasingly severe energy situation in the world, many countries and regions are vigorously promoting renewable energy. Unlike traditional thermal power generation, clean energy is widely connected to regional power grids in both concentrated and distributed way. In many communities in the UK, Australia and the United State, distributed rooftop photovoltaics have been widely used to support cleaner local energy consumption. At the same time, developments in energy storage technology have helped mitigate losses from the volatility and indeterminacy of renewable generators. This paper proposed a novel P2P transaction mechanism for community microgrid with centralized energy storage. Market Share (MS) model was introduced to modify the pricing mechanism. The results of case study illustrate that the pricing model and trading mechanism proposed in this paper are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Coordinated Scheduling of Distribution Network and Virtual Power Plants Considering Controllable Thermal Loads and Distributed Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the transformation of clean heating and the construction of distributed photovoltaics (PVs), a large number of virtual power plants (VPPs) have appeared in the distribution network (DN). Moreover, the strong randomness and volatility of distributed PVs also bring many challenges to the operation of the power system. Considering the increasing proportion of controllable thermal loads (TLs) in the power grids, this paper proposes a coordinated optimization method for the DN and VPPs considering these flexible resources. Finally, case studies are carried out on the DN69-VPP4 system, verifying that the proposed method can effectively improve the power grid's operation level on the premise of ensuring users' comfort.

Author Keywords: Coordinated scheduling of distribution network and VPPs

articleTitle: The Simulation Validation of Control Characteristics and Parameters Analysis for Voltage Controlled Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Through simulating the mechanical motion equations of synchronous generator, applying the synchronous generator mathematical model for converter control strategy and formed the voltage controlled virtual synchronous generator. This paper proposed the prime motor regulation and excitation regulation algorithm, and simulating the inertial of synchronous generator. As a result, the voltage controlled virtual synchronous generator has the function of active power frequency regulation and reactive power voltage regulation, and solving the problems of impendences and damping is low under grid-connected with power grid, also supporting the power grid safe and stable operation. By building the Matlab/Simulink models, this paper validates the voltage controlled virtual synchronous generator is able to simulate the operation characteristics of synchronous generator. In addition, this paper analysis the different parameters of virtual inertial, damping, integration and droop effects the control ability by simulation, and proposed the optimal parameters range for engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Mode and Strategy of Adjustable Load Demand Response Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the traditional demand-supply interaction platforms, the connection between demand response aggregators and users are fixed. aggregators and users are fixed. The load aggregator usually manages data as a communication center and is in charge of creating plans for the allocation of demand response resources for several consumers. If the load aggregator jointly and maliciously tampers with the demand response data, causing the user to lose the incentive benefits, or the user changes the instrument data without authorization to obtain improper incentives, it will cause the DR trust crisis. Therefore, establishing a user interaction mode based on distributed demand response interaction system is essential. In this paper, the adjustable load demand response blockchain interoperability model is firstly established, and then designs and analyzes a blockchain interoperability strategy to improve reputation. As an example, it was found that blockchain interoperability strategies with higher reliability values have higher DR success rates than Blockchain interoperability and conventional demand-response interoperability techniques.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy Verification of Integrated Energy System Operation Based on Dynamic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy flow optimization technology of the integrated energy system is used to achieve the strategy of optimal operation. However, how to ensure the effectiveness and reliability of the optimized strategy is the key to the improvement of the energy efficiency of integrated energy system. This paper introduced an optimization strategy verification method with integrated energy simulation platform. One typical integrated energy system scenario is built with both optimized model and physical simulation model. Optimized operation strategy was achieved by solving optimized model with IPOPT method. The operation strategy was used as input of the physical simulation model. Dynamic simulation results showed that physical model simulation deviation with optimized operation strategy was less than 10%. Thus this optimized operation strategy was verified by dynamic simulation, which was effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on Security Verification for Ancillary Service based on Steady-state Security Region
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is an important research area in the field of power system to conduct on-line security analysis on power system and obtain the system’s security margin in real time. With the large-scale access of renewable energy to the power system, the importance of auxiliary service to ensure the secure and reliable operation of the power system has become increasingly prominent in terms of security and economy. The real-time scheduling characteristics of power system are complex and there are many operational constraints, which puts forward higher requirements for the accuracy of security verification calculation. This paper aims to propose a fast security verification method for auxiliary service. Firstly, an analysis model and a fast solution method of thermal security region in multi-dimensional space are established. Then, considering the application requirements of practical engineering, the multi-dimensional security region representation on the two-dimensional plane considering the reserve availability is given to provide technical support for the security verification of auxiliary services.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Oscillation Stability Based on Virtual Inertia and Damping Control with Application of Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a virtual inertia and virtual damping comprehensive control model based on wind farm level energy storage is established to improve the oscillation stability, and the relationship between the control parameters and the real virtual inertia and virtual damping provided by the energy storage system is discussed. In addition, the virtual inertia and virtual damping control based on energy storage is added to the single-machine infinite bus system with permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), and the quantitative relationship between virtual inertia, virtual damping control parameters and oscillation stability is theoretically deduced. Finally, based on the single-machine infinity system and the four-machine system, eigenvalue analysis and time-domain simulation analysis are carried out to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Voltage Profile Enhancement of High Renewable-Penetrated Distribution Systems Using Converter-Interfaced Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing integration of renewable energy resources (RESs) in distribution systems has caused increasing concerns about distribution system voltage quality. Electronic converters have flexible operational ranges and quick response speeds, and converters thus have the potential to mitigate the quick voltage fluctuations caused by the variations of PV power output. With this potential well utilized, the system voltage profile can be enhanced with less cost. In this paper, the reactive power capacity and control algorithms of the converters are discussed, and an optimization model that coordinates the operation of OLTCs, PVs and converter-based loads to enhance the distribution system voltage profile is proposed. Case studies show that the participation of converter-based loads in distribution system voltage regulation improves distribution system voltage quality and reduces total operational costs.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration Method of Source-Load-Storage System in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the industrial park, a source-load storage system consisting of solar cells, batteries, heat pumps and thermal storage is first established. Then, a multi-objective function is constructed by comprehensively considering the operating constraints of each device and the comprehensive energy consumption cost. Finally, through the simulation of examples at different latitudes and different load levels, the optimal configuration results of source-load-storage, the state curve of energy storage equipment, and the economy of the system are analyzed, which verifies the effectiveness of the optimal configuration method of source-load-storage in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Smart Transformer Service Area Based on TTU and SCB
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is a lack of effective management methods to obtain the information and data of devices in transformer service areas. Based on edge computing and IoT perception technologies, this paper proposes a low-voltage smart transformer service area scheme using intelligent transformer terminal unit (TTU) and smart circuit breaker (SCB). TTU is the edge computing device which is introduced to realize the local edge computing and tasks in transformer service areas. SCB is implanted in transformer service area to collect the information and data of devices, such as PVs and EV charging piles. A practical case for PV monitoring is introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on Business Model of Energy Efficiency Public Service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A unified business model of energy efficiency public services is conducive to the development of energy efficiency public service projects. First, summarize the energy efficiency public service business processes. Business roles, business entities, and business activities are then extracted from the business process flows. Finally, business modeling of energy efficiency public services based on UML.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Distributed Resources Application Framework and Key Technologies Based on Cloud-Edge-Device Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale access of distributed photovoltaic, distributed energy storage and electric vehicle to the distribution network drives the transformation of the "source-network-load-storage" regulation mode. Frequent two-way interaction between distribution network and distributed resources puts forward higher requirements for the power Internet of Things. At present, centralized data storage and processing based on cloud computing in the power grid makes massive distributed resource data unable to be effectively applied. In that case, for the challenges in the application of distributed resources in the cloud-edge-device collaborative distribution network, a distributed resource data application framework based on cloud-edge-device collaborative distribution network is proposed to break the interaction barriers between distributed resources and power system caused by limited computing resources. The distributed resource data application framework of distribution network based on cloud-edge-device collaboration provides reference for the hierarchical, distributed storage and processing of massive data in power grid. Finally, based on this framework, the key technology of distribution network distributed resources based on cloud-edge-device collaboration are proposed, which provides a new idea for constructing distributed resource cloud-edge-device collaboration technology with adequate security and economic benefit, as well as lean management and high service quality in distribution network.

articleTitle: User Adjustable Load Demand Response Optimization Strategy Considering Multi-level Dynamic Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet, China attaches more and more importance to the management and regulation of power demand side load resources. In order to improve the management and control of the demand-side adjustable load resources by the power grid, an optimal control strategy is proposed to realize the management of adjustable load resources through multi-level interconnection and flexible management and control. In this hierarchical structure, load aggregators are responsible for the overall control of the regulation task. Regional agents sign contracts with users to promote users' active participation and ensure the completion of demand response business. In addition, they adjust electricity prices to ensure users' satisfaction level and maximize the revenue of load aggregators. Finally, the comparative analysis of numerical examples verifies that the proposed demand response optimization strategy can meet the demand of power grid regulation under the premise of ensuring user satisfaction, and achieve the goal of maximizing the revenue of load aggregators.

articleTitle: Design of Electricity Energy Classification Bidding Market Based on Generating Resource Endowment Difference
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current electricity market is carried out in a unified bidding mode of various types of power generation resources, resulting in insufficient resource competition and incomplete reflection of the value of different quality power generation resources, hindering the long-term development of renewable energy and reducing the willingness of adjustable conventional power supply to provide flexible adjustment ability. Therefore, this paper proposes the electricity energy classified bidding market, sets different value measurement competition space for different types of power generation resources, promotes the rationalization of resource competition and the authenticity of power supply value, and promotes the benign competition pattern of coordinated development of multiple resources.

articleTitle: A Method to Simplify the Markov Model of Protective Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state space approach is a common method for conducting reliability assessment of protective systems. However, as more factors affecting the reliability of protective relay are considered, the system Markov model is becoming more and more complex and its solving efficiency is decreasing. To avoid this, a method to simplify the Markov model of protective system is proposed in this paper. Based on the continuous-time Markov process (CTMP), the theory underlying the state space approach, the method illustrates that the duration of the protective system in the switching states can be neglected. In other words, the protection switching state can be ignored when developing a Markov model of protective system. This method is applied to two existing models, one for a protection/component system and the other for redundant protective systems. The study results show that the method significantly reduces the complexity of the Markov model and improves the solving efficiency without reducing the capability of Markov model to describe the reliability of protective systems.

articleTitle: Quantification of Uncertainty in District Heating System with Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The district heating system(DHS) could realize the flexible consumption of renewable energy by coordinating renewable energy and traditional energy. However, the connection of renewable energy to the district heating system changes its end energy balance. Still, the fluctuation of energy source output and the heat load needs to be considered in the consumption process. We propose a dynamic heat network model and apply Gram-Chalier A(GCA) Series algorithm that enables us to quantify the uncertainty in DHS at both source and load sides. The dynamic model of the heat network is used to characterize the dynamic process inside the DHS. GCA algorithm is used to calculate the probability density semi-analytical formula of the node thermal power. Based on this, the fluctuation interval of node thermal power is calculated by quantile and Bayesian credible interval methods. Study cases show that the proposed models and applied algorithm can effectively calculate the fluctuation interval of the node’s thermal power at both ends of the source and load of the DHS.

articleTitle: Power Transmission Model Based on Power Flow Tracking Technology and Analysis of New Energy Transfer Ratio
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China has witnessed rapid development of new energy, with the proportion of wind and solar power generation increasing from 1.2 percent in 2010 to 11.7 percent in 2021, surpassing the global average. Under the background of actively responding to climate change, accelerating the development of new energy becomes the inevitable choice of China's energy green and low-carbon transformation, and is also the first step of achieve carbon peaking and carbon goals. Based on power flow tracking technology and current decomposition axiom, this paper calculates the utilization share of transmission and transformation equipment. The calculation results can be used as the basis for analyzing the power transmission path and the ratio of new energy transmission of multiple types of power sources including new energy, and provide data support for the assessment of new energy consumption.

articleTitle: Onsite Survey Unlocks Commercial Buildings’ Air-Conditioning Demand Response Potential
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intermittent and fluctuating renewable energy from supply-side urges the demand response (DR) to play an increasingly vital role at demand-side for balancing and flexibility provision. Centralized air conditioning in commercial buildings is expected to have huge demand response potential. As the basis of performing demand response, quantifying the demand response potential and understanding the on-site situation of centralized air conditioning are of great importance. Therefore, this study designs and performs the survey on the demand response potential from commercial buildings’ centralized air conditioning. The survey investigates the amount of flexible load, the communication function of the chiller, the cost of equipment retrofit, and the willingness of users to participate demand response. A total number of 41 centralized air conditioners were deeply investigated, the estimated flexible load is 4924kW, which accounts for 18% of the total investigated load from centralized air conditioners.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Mode of Conventional DC Island Transmission of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the inertia and system security of high penetration renewable energy grid decreases, conventional DC island transmission pure renewable energy which can electrically decoupling between large-scale renewable energy power grid and traditional power grid was proposed. Based on the effective capacity coefficient of renewable energy, calculation method of pure renewable energy installed capacity was proposed. Voltage and inertia support problems were solved by dynamic compensation equipment. Based on the minimum power fluctuation of new energy, the optimal hybrid ratio of wind and PV power was studied. Energy storage allocation under optimal ratio of wind and PV power hybrid transportation was also researched. Empirical analysis was carried out in Northwest Power grid. PSD-PEBL program was used to check the power balance which proves the feasibility of the proposed transmission mode. Case analysis proved the feasibility of the proposed transmission mode and provided a new transmission mode for large-scale new energy transmission in the future.

Author Keywords: high penetration of renewable energy grid
optimal hybrid ratio of wind and PV power

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Early Warning of Wide-Frequency Oscillation Based on Wide-Frequency Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale integration of new energy sources has brought a series of new types of oscillations to the power grid, and the oscillations gradually develop to high frequencies. The existing WAMS-based oscillation monitoring technology can only monitor sub-synchronous oscillation below 50Hz, and cannot cope with wide-frequency oscillations above 50Hz. The existing monitoring methods can only passively respond to the oscillation after the oscillation occurs, and lack active early warning and intervention methods. Based on wide-frequency measurement technology, this paper proposes an engineering method for wide-frequency oscillation risk assessment and early warning of oscillation. Firstly, it discusses the functions and characteristics of wide-frequency measurement technology and devices, and proposes an overall scheme for oscillation risk assessment and early warning based on wide-frequency measurement data. Then, the method of oscillation risk assessment and early warning is discussed in detail from two aspects, which are the statistical analysis of historical data and real-time monitoring data, it can provide guidance and reference for the early warning and analysis of power grid wide-frequency oscillation in the future, and promote oscillation monitoring from passive response to active prevention and intervention.

articleTitle: A Method for Forest Fire Monitoring Based on GA-BP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Forest fires pose a serious threat to power systems, and cause a large number of casualties and property damage. How to accurately monitor the occurrence of forest fires has become a major problem. Although the BP neural network-based mountain fire monitoring can monitor the occurrence of mountain fires and determine the stage of mountain fires accurately, the BP neural network also tends to fall into the problems of local optimum, slow convergence and even non-convergence. In this paper, we propose a method for monitoring hill fires based on genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network, and also introduce the basic principle of genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network, and also use BP neural network and genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network to determine whether hill fires occur and the stage of hill fires based on the data of CO, smoke concentration and temperature generated by forest fires The advantages and disadvantages of the two algorithms for hill fire monitoring are also compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Constraints and Sensitivity Factors of Large-scale New Energy Grid-connected Grids to New Energy Utilization Impact Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, time series production simulation method is used to study the utilization rate of large-scale new energy grid with and without grid constraints. Based on the grid free constraint model, the influences of new energy installation, total social electricity consumption, inter-provincial electricity transmission, flexible transformation scale of coal power and energy storage development scale on the utilization rate of new energy are analyzed. Finally, some suggestions and measures to improve the utilization rate of new energy in S power grid are put forward.

articleTitle: Considering New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale access to non-linear equipment and new energy generation devices, power system harmonics tend to become more and more prominent, and the harmonic components of the system become increasingly complex. Compressive sensing techniques complete the compression of data in the sampling, which effectively reduces the amount of sampled signal data compared to traditional Nyquist sampling methods, overcoming the drawbacks of high complexity of compression at the sampling side and high hardware requirements. Therefore, in this paper, the sparsity characteristics of fundamental, harmonic and interharmonic power system signals are demonstrated theoretically and proposed a fundamental filtering self-adaptive matched pursuit algorithm (FF-SAMP) based on the characteristics. The algorithm in this paper has high accuracy in the estimation of harmonic phase quantities and maintains a certain superiority among the compared algorithms.

Author Keywords: fundamental filtering adaptive matching tracking algorithms

articleTitle: Evaluation of Industrial Coordinated Development in Jing-Jin-Ji Region from the Perspective of Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Regional industrial coordinated development is a key issue for economic circles and urban agglomerations. A comprehensive and accurate evaluation method plays an important role in understanding the effectiveness and shortcomings of regional industrial coordinated development. Existing evaluation methods are mostly based on macroeconomic statistics, which reflect comprehensive effects of multiple factors but pay less attention to technical characteristics. Coordinated development is a dynamic process that requires continuous and sufficient data for evaluation, but continuous macroeconomic statistics covering multiple industries are difficult to obtain. However, electricity can make up for the above shortcomings. With the gradual implementation of the low-carbon strategy, the electrification of terminal energy consumption has become the main trend. Therefore, the electricity consumption can better reflect the industry development. In this paper, we evaluate the industrial coordinated development from the perspective of electricity consumption. We divide the coordinated development into three aspects, namely industrial transfer, industrial specialization, and industrial isomorphism. Each evaluation aspect is assessed from both the perspective of economics and electricity consumption. Case study is carried out based on Jing-Jin-Ji region in China. Results show that sometimes the evaluation based on electricity consumption can more accurately reflect the policy’s implementation and effectiveness. With the help of electricity consumption statistics, more complete and continuous evaluation results can be obtained.

articleTitle: Methodology for Online Accuracy Evaluation of Metering Current Transformer in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The online accuracy evaluation of metering current transformer in distribution system is of great significance for the fair trade of electric power. In this paper, an evaluation system based on edge-cloud architecture is designed. The edge monitoring module has the characteristics of miniaturization and pluggability, and a cloud platform based on electric energy information acquisition system is specially designed to perform real-time evaluation.

articleTitle: Minimum Load Shedding Method across Electricity and Gas Systems Based on the Sensitivity Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of the coupling between the electric power system (EPS) and the natural gas system (NGS), an issue that the gas pressure instability precedes the voltage instability may appear in the integrated electricity-gas system (IEGS). Load shedding is the final guarantee to ensure the stability of the system. Unlike single type of load in EPS, there are two kinds of load in IEGS: electricity and gas. To reduce the overall load loss of IEGS, it is necessary to quantitatively evaluate the impact of load shedding across electricity and gas systems. A minimum load shedding method in the IEGS based on the sensitivity method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the continuous multi-energy flow model, the critical operating point of IEGS gas pressure stability is located, and the node where the gas pressure first becomes unstable is regarded as the weak link. Secondly, the sensitivity index of the weak gas pressure to the electric and gas load is constructed based on the Jacobian matrix at the critical operating point to evaluate the recovery effect of shedding load at each node on the weak gas pressure. Then, the load is shed in descending order of the sensitivity index to restore the IEGS with a sufficient gas pressure margin through the least load loss. Finally, the necessity of considering cross-system load shedding and the effectiveness of this method in reducing the amount of load shedding are verified by case studies.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Guided Fusion for Thermal Fault Diagnosis of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces a thermal fault diagnosis method, called multi-scale guided fusion. The proposed method combines guided filtering and multi-scale decision fusion techniques for thermal fault diagnosis. Specifically, the proposed method has three main steps. First, the Mahalanobis distance between the fault area and the background is estimated, and the initial diagnosis result can be generated. Then, the initial diagnosis result is filtered by using guided filtering with various parameters, and filtering feature maps can be generated. Different filtering feature maps contain complemental spatial structure information. Last, a principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm fuses filtering feature maps to capture the spatial structure information and thermal information, improving the diagnosis performance. Experimental results show that the proposed diagnosis method has a better detection performance than the current state-of-the-art detectors.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Protection of DC Distribution Network and Its Converter Improvement Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC fault protection is one of the key technologies in the development of DC systems. The main technical difficulties include the reliable identification and fast isolation of DC faults. In this paper, a fast protection and converter improvement scheme is proposed from the perspective of protection and control synergy to achieve fast fault isolation in DC distribution systems. Firstly, the overall idea of protection and control synergy for DC distribution systems is analyzed. Secondly, the influence of the structure and control strategy of the improved converter scheme on the fault characteristics of the DC power distribution system is proposed. Finally, based on the principle of fast protection of DC line faults based on the current longitudinal protection, the correctness of its action is analyzed through simulation.

articleTitle: Aggregated Load Assessment of Air-Conditioning Clusters Considering the Heterogeneity of User Identity and Travel Behavior
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The diversification of user needs and the heterogeneity and uncertainty of response behaviors affect the rational use of demand-side resources. In order to more accurately evaluate the demand response behavior of different users and more accurately evaluate the aggregate load of air-conditioning clusters, this paper proposes an air-conditioning cluster load evaluation based on user feature classification considering the uncertainty of user behavior. First, the equivalent thermal parameter (ETP) model of the room is given in combination with the operation mode of the inverter air conditioner and the thermal insulation performance of the house, On the basis of this model, the load model of a single inverter air conditioner is given in combination with the electrical quantity relationship of the inverter air conditioner. Secondly, consider user classification and travel behavior combined with user thermal comfort in the family as a unit, and establish a temperature decision model for different family members at different times. Thirdly, the income level and environmental protection participation of different households are introduced to combine the temperature decision-making model to obtain a 24-hour daily household air-conditioning temperature decision-making model. Combined with the air-conditioning load model, an accurate air-conditioning load aggregation model is obtained. Finally, it is verified that the accuracy of this model is better than the traditional model in the past.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Prediction Based on Improved NWP Data Considering Wind Speed Distribution Inner Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wind farm has only one NWP data point, which cannot accurately reflect the wind resources inside the wind farm. To solve the problem of a poor match between short-term wind power prediction numerical weather forecast and wind farm measured weather. Put forward a kind of based on clustering and temporal characteristics of the modified liters of scale wind power prediction method, first of all, using EOF orthogonal decomposition method to extract the features of each fan, using hierarchical analysis method of the characteristics of the data matrix clustering, and then, each cluster sample selected representative of a fan, using the error transfer characteristic of the NWP data sequence is modified. Finally, The CNN prediction model is used for power prediction, and the weight is determined according to the cluster sample size. A wind farm in northern Hebei, China, is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Performance Optimization of Virtual Synchronous Generator with Matrix Converter Structure Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: VSG (Virtual Synchronous Generator) is a system that takes electronic devices as the core and pursues internal and external characteristics that are equivalent to traditional Synchronous Generators. In order to overcome the defect that the traditional virtual synchronous generator can only be powered by a DC source, this paper replaces the inverter structure with a matrix converter to directly realize the AC-AC conversion of energy, and according to the characteristics of VSG, a simpler modulation method than the traditional matrix converter modulation method is designed. Due to the limitation of the control mode of virtual synchronous generator, its angular velocity cannot be guaranteed to be stable and fluctuates greatly when facing external disturbance. Based on the principle of fuzzy control, this paper designs an auxiliary controller, which obviously optimizes this shortcoming, improve the anti-interference of VSG, make it have better dynamic performance and higher use value. The correctness of the proposed strategy is verified by matlab/simulink.

articleTitle: Trend Analysis of User Power Consumption Behavior Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power consumption behavior of residential users and the adjustable load capacity are essential for the demand-side load regulation. In order to reduce the uncertainty caused by users, this paper proposed a method to analyze user power consumption behavior trend by mining the feature sequences of load resource services. First, the workflow model is applied to generate the feature sequences that represent user behavior. Then feature sequences are segmented into subsequences using the linear regression method, and the changing trend similarity of each subsequence is calculated by the time series similarity measurement. In this way, the behavior trend of users can be investigated by mining the clusters of subsequences with similar variation trends. Experimental results verified the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy-Aware Virtual Machine Integration based Task Scheduling for Green Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, cloud computing and big data technology are developing rapidly worldwide, and data centers are springing up. However, with the construction of the data center in full swing, the problems of low utilization of server resources and high energy consumption are becoming increasingly prominent. In this regard, a minimum slack-time task scheduling method (MSTS) based on the single threshold virtual machine integration strategy is proposed in this paper, which can reduce energy consumption effectively while ensuring the task completion rate. The experimental verification of the MSTS method is carried out on the CloudSim simulation platform through a comparative study against the benchmark solutions, and the numerical results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method in the promotion of energy efficiency compared with the existing solutions.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of LVRT Control of Wind Turbine on Transient Overvoltage of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power capacity into the grid, it is brought about a serious of questions to the security and stability of the power system. In particular, the low voltage ride through (LVRT) ability of wind turbine when the grid voltage sag is the extensive research of the problem at present. This paper firstly clarifies the control switching logic of the wind farm during the grid fault ride-through process and analyzes the transient active and reactive power output characteristics of the wind turbine during the LVRT and recovery process in detail. Secondly, the mechanism of transient overvoltage of wind farm low penetration process deterioration system is discussed. On this basis, the simulation models of DFIG, SVG and energy storage equipment are established, and the PSD-BPA electromechanical transient simulation model of each equipment is built to study the influence of model control parameters on its dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Active Splitting Control of Rotor Angle Instability Based on the Wide Area Branches Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of stability control of large power grid, fast splitting control is an effective measure to block the path of cascading failure, limit the scope of disturbance, and reduce the loss caused by faults. In this paper, the response characteristics of generators and branches in the process of rotor angle swing were studied, and the law of power transfer and instability process in multi-branch interconnected system were analyzed. Secondly, the definition of critical and quasi-critical branches cluster and the identification method based on wide area branch response were proposed, and the rotor angle instability criterion based on the response characteristics of critical branches and the out-of-step cut-set searching method based on joint quasi-critical branches were proposed. Finally, the simulation results for the actual HVDC/AC hybrid power system show that the proposed strategy has the advantages of accurate location of out-of-step cut sets and fast active splitting control; it can effectively reduce the risk of new energy low-voltage off-grid and so on.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Node Voltage Sag under the Scenario of DG Connected to Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Scientific assessment of the voltage sag risk level at each node of the power grid is the prerequisite for voltage sag management. In view of the lack of consideration of the low voltage ride through characteristics of distribution generator (DG) and power grid topology in the existing methods, this paper proposes a node voltage sag risk assessment method under the grid connection scenario of DG. Firstly, a fast and accurate solution method based on Fibonacci method is proposed for the exposed area. Then, the exposed area overlap index, DG isolation risk index and connectivity index of nodes are proposed respectively. Based on Entropy TOPSIS method and expert experience, the objective and subjective evaluation indexes of node voltage sag risk are obtained respectively. Combined with subjective and objective indexes, a comprehensive evaluation method of node voltage sag risk is constructed. Finally, based on the Monte-Carlo principle, the IEEE 30-nodes system is simulated to verify the rationality of the proposed comprehensive assessment method of voltage sag risk.

articleTitle: MCES: Multi-classifier Ensemble System for Malware Detection and Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development and advances of information and networking technologies in Cyber-physical Power systems (CPPS), the frequency of information exchange between CPPS and the external networks is significantly increasing, leading to an ever-growing risk of cyberspace threats and attacks, e.g., malware injection to the CPPS. The existing detectors against malware are mainly based on static analysis, which deals well with known malware, but cannot cope with unknown or obfuscated malware. To this end, this paper proposed a novel multi-classifier ensemble system (MCES) for malware detection based on behavioral analysis. The developed detection model of MCES is a hierarchical learning model with kernel components consisting of base classifiers and one meta classifier. The proposed solution is assessed through experiments based on in total 14800 malware and 14800 benign samples. The numerical results demonstrated that MCES outperformed existing machine learning-based classifiers in identifying malware through application program interface (API) call sequences. The proposed model achieved the highest accuracy of 97.54%, and the highest recall of 97.85% in comparison with the state-of-the-art deep learning based malware detectors.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Scheduling of Commercial EVs for System Restoration of a Damaged Power-Transportation Coupled Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With large passenger and battery capacity, commercial electric vehicles (CEVs), such as electric buses and electric trucks can act as both urgent transports in transportation networks and energy backup units in power networks after natural disasters cause damages to the power-transportation coupled network. To enhance the system resilience, it is necessary to properly optimize the operation of CEVs to satisfy both the trip demand and restoration requirements of the system. This paper proposes a scheduling strategy for the CEV fleet in a power-transportation coupled network. By scheduling the plug-in locations, charging/discharging profiles, and the navigation paths of the CEV fleet, the model provides energy support for the damaged power network, maximizes the revenue of urgent trip service, and minimizes the energy consumption cost. The coupled power and transportation constraints are explicitly described in the model, which are formulated into a mixed-integer second-order cone program and efficiently solved by off-the-shelf solvers. Numerical experiments are conducted to validate the superiority of the proposed method based on the IEEE 69-bus distribution network and the Sioux Falls transportation network.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Technology Development in Energy and Transportation Based on a Review of a Practical Study in Southeastern China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Low-carbon technologies in the field of energy and transportation are of great significance for achieving carbon peaking and carbon neutralization. Due to the frequent communication of domestic related technologies and the low barriers between provinces, low-carbon technologies can be gradually promoted throughout the country after being recognized by the market. Therefore, this paper first combs the development status of low-carbon technology in China, and pertinently refines the development stages of corresponding technologies in Fujian Province, and excavates the advantages and disadvantages of the current situation. And then predict the development trend of low-carbon technology in Fujian Province. Finally, some suggestions for the development of low-carbon technologies in Fujian Province are given.

articleTitle: Application-Driven Data Management Framework for Wind Farms by Cloud-Edge-End Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the utilization efficiency of servers in data transmission, computing and storage for wind farms, an application-driven data management framework is constructed based on cloud-edge-end collaboration technology. This paper first systematically sorts out the features of business data in wind farms from time dimension and application objects. Then, a cloud-edge-end collaborative framework and server resources allocation scheme are proposed according to the demands of business for data processing. In addition, taking the data quality improvement as an example, the cloud-edge-end collaborative business splitting, reorganization and distribution schemes are developed to improve the quality and values of raw data with high reliability, high bandwidth and low energy consumption. Finally, the performances in data transmission, storage and energy consumption between cloud-edge-end collaboration and traditional centralized computing are compared to illustrate effectiveness and advantages of the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Game-Based Defense Strategies against False Data Injection Attacks under Complete and Incomplete Information Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The false data injection attack(FDIA) and corresponding defensive measures can be viewed as a two-party zerosum game. An attack and defense game model is established to propose the optimal defense strategy against FDIA. The attackdefense game space is set, the measured values in the phasor measurement unit(PMU) are taken as the attack and defense target, and the attack and defense effects are evaluated by the load shedding. The optimal defense strategy is obtained by solving the Nash equilibrium point. Simulation tests are carried out on IEEE 14 bus system, and the results of complete and incomplete situations are discussed.

articleTitle: Generalized Benders Decomposition Algorithm Incorporating Matheuristics to Solve Large-Scale Power Facility Location Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the change of energy structure and the development of energy internet technology, the penetration rate of distributed generation is gradually increasing, and the location of distributed generation has an important impact on the distribution network line losses. In this paper, a mixed integer quadratic programming model with separability is considered to optimize the location of distributed generation and to reduce line losses in distribution networks, which measures line losses in distribution networks in terms of the quadratic term of current. In order to solve the problem of large-scale distributed power facility location problems with separability, a Benders decomposition algorithm incorporating matheuristics is proposed, which first decomposes the original problem into a mixed-integer linear programming master problem and a convex quadratic subproblem with separability, and then separates the generalized Benders cuts form solving the subproblem at the root node relaxed solution of the master problem. A simple in-out Stabilization technique is applied in order to efficiently raise the lower bound of the master problem at the root node. In order to avoid the use of branch-and-cut algorithms to solve the master problem to obtain optimal feasible solutions, two matheuristic repair strategies are proposed for the root node relaxation solution to obtain high-quality feasible solutions. Experimental results on 90 large-scale power facility location problems show that matheuristic repair strategies for the root node relaxation solution can find the global optimal solution.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Generation Market Transaction Based on Sales Risk Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy power generation due to output instability, it is easy to cause transaction contract default resulting in new energy power generation consumption difficulties. This paper puts forward an electric power sales model to establish the risk control strategy of electric power sales and assist the transaction of new energy power generation market. Through the study and evaluation of contract default risk in new energy electricity sales transaction, the risk point of contract default in new energy power generation transaction is analyzed, and the corresponding risk default compensation model is constructed. The risk of new energy generation under market transaction strategy is studied by using the sales risk division method control, construct auxiliary services corresponding to different power contract deviations, and put forward auxiliary services analysis and risk avoidance strategies for new energy power generation with different transaction risks. Finally, the feasibility of sales risk control strategy to improve the consumption of new energy power generation is verified by a case.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Full Life Cycle Carbon Emissions of Source-Grid-Load-Storage in Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the tracking of carbon footprint and the calculation of carbon emissions can provide theoretical method and technical support for targeted carbon reduction actions. Most of the existing studies focus on the carbon emissions of a single power source, and it is impossible to estimate the carbon emissions of the entire power system from the source-grid-load-storage. In this paper, a specific calculation method for the full life cycle carbon emissions of source-grid-load-storage is proposed, and the carbon emissions of the main type of power sources, including construction, operation and decommissioning stages are analyzed, and specific calculation methods are given in detail. Finally, according to the proposed calculation method, the carbon emissions from source-grid-load-storage of the power systems are calculated to obtain the main source of carbon emissions in North China in 2025. The results of this paper can provide data support and improvement direction for future power system carbon reduction actions, and have substantial guiding significance.

articleTitle: Prospect and Economic Analysis of Photovoltaic Hydrogen Production + HCNG Power Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problems that the continuous access of new energy power generation leads to the gradual loss of the balance and regulation ability of the existing power grid, conventional power supply and pumping and storage system, and the difficulty in sustaining the balance mode of "source follows load" of the traditional power system, this paper attempts to explore the role of photovoltaic hydrogen production in the new energy industry chain and energy interconnection through the prospect and economy of power storage through hydrogen doped natural gas (HCNG) in combination with the development trend of the power and energy industry, The prospect and economy of photovoltaic hydrogen production + hydrogen doped natural gas power storage are analyzed, and a new source network load storage optimization strategy based on hydrogen doped natural gas transmission is proposed. It is proposed that the more feasible mode is photovoltaic hydrogen production + first stage: compressed hydrogen energy storage + second stage: natural gas mixed with hydrogen pipeline transmission + parallel second stage: gas storage (tank) storage. Finally, through the establishment of a hydrogen field cogeneration system model with the purpose of local new energy power generation, hydrogen production, long-distance hydrogen transmission, including waste power consumption, to realize the integration of source, network, load and storage, Compare the scale, capacity and economy of power generation transmission storage and power generation hydrogen production hydrogen blending transmission storage, verify the feasibility of the proposed source network load storage optimization strategy, and finally give relevant suggestions and development strategies.

articleTitle: Positive Sequence Currents Similarity Based Active Distribution Network Protection Scheme Using One-Class Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Overcurrent protection scheme used widely in distribution networks cannot meet the selectivity and reliability requirements of active distribution networks. Besides, due to the complex fault characteristics of distributed generators, the new schemes based on single fault characteristics have not made breakthroughs. This paper proposes a new protection scheme based on the similarity of positive sequence currents (PSCs) at both ends of the line, which utilizes a one-class classification algorithm to fuse multiple fault characteristics of PSCs. Considering the data scarcity of internal and external faults, the normalized PSCs of normal operation are used to reflect the characteristics of external fault because the normalized PSCs of them have nearly same similarity characteristics theoretically but distinctly differ from internal fault, where the PSCs are integrated as a feature vector and normalized by maximum value normalization method. Besides, the phase angle difference of PSCs, caused by the data asynchronous problem, is corrected by calibrating the sudden change time of PSCs for sufficiently utilizing phasor angle beside amplitude. In summary, the normal operation data is firstly normalized and corrected with a certain correction error, then serves as input to train an OCC algorithm. The determined classification boundary is used for protection criterion setting to discriminate external fault from internal fault. The PSCAD simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme.

articleTitle: New Energy Inter-provincial Trading Optimization Method Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Trans-regional and inter-provincial surplus new energy electricity trading is an important way to overcome the disadvantage of energy supply and demand reverse distribution in China and promote the consumption of new energy electricity. This paper focuses on the trading plan optimization of new energy stations in sending province, and studies the power optimization method of surplus new energy trading stations. Firstly, based on the probability prediction of the output of the new energy station, the method of calculating the probability distribution of the surplus power of new energy is studied. Then, the conditional value at risk (CVaR) theory is applied to establish and solve the surplus new energy trading power optimization model. Finally, an example is established with the historical data of a certain area to verify the validity of the model and method, and based on the statistical results, a method to determine the reasonable model parameters in engineering application is given.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Extreme Weather on Freshwater Fishery Power Grid Based on Resilience Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are many freshwater fisheries in China, and the potential for all-electric operation mode of freshwater fisheries with distributed generation is huge. The electrical equipment of the all-electric operation freshwater fishery is susceptible to extreme weather and the reliability of power supply is low. This often causes great economic losses to the fishery, and it is particularly important to improve the stability of the fishing distribution network in response to such problems in the supply and distribution of electricity to the fishery.Therefore, this paper introduces the distribution network resilience model to characterize the ability of the grid to resist extreme weather, and takes the IEEE-30 node network as an example, respectively calculate the original distribution network resilience index and the distribution network resilience index after adding DG in typical extreme weather scenarios, and verify the positive effect of distributed power supply on the distribution network resilience.
