First, the analysis of the influence of extreme weather on the distribution network model, the quantitative relationship between weather elements and power grid failure rate based on extreme weather occurrence is established; Next, selection method of distribution network based on system information entropy, The selection of fault scenarios should be based on the time-variable fault rate of the distribution network, Select according to the probability and possibility of the scene, Thus, the fault scenario to be analyzed is effectively obtained in extreme weather; Once more, according to the degree of —— load loss and recovery time of the main factors considered in the resilience of the distribution network, Establishing the calculation method of the resilience assessment index of the distribution network; Last, Through simulation examples, Calculated that in typical extreme weather scenarios, The original distribution network resilience index is 0.665, but the distribution network resilience index after being connected to DG is increased to 0.794, The effectiveness of the resilience analysis method and the positive effect of DG access on improving the resilience of the power grid are verified.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Decision-making Method of Intra Day Unit Startup and Shutdown Considering Prediction Error
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the intra day dispatch, in order to meet the peak load demand, it is necessary to make a decision in advance whether to open more thermal power units. On the premise of ensuring the economic operation of the power grid, an auxiliary decision-making method for intra day unit startup and shutdown considering the probability distribution of load prediction error is proposed. Based on the historical forecast data and actual operation data, the functional relationship between the expected value of power shortage and the relative error of forecast during the peak hours of daily load is constructed, and a unit decision-making model considering load reduction, unit startup and shutdown, and the lowest comprehensive cost is proposed. The influence of different standard deviations of load forecasting errors on unit startup and shutdown decisions and the change of schedulable load power is analyzed. The results show that the proposed method can provide the most economical decision-making suggestions for unit startup and shutdown in a day when analyzing the startup strategies and schedulable load power adjustment strategies under different standard deviations.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Scheduling for Aggregated Electric Vehicles and Photovoltaic Considering Dynamic Distribution Locational Marginal Price
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of photovoltaics (PVs) and electric vehicles (EVs) connected to the distribution network, the distribution system will face the risk of bidirectional congestion. However, the output of PV and the flexibility of EVs are uncertain, which will bring challenges to congestion management. This paper proposes a distributed optimal scheduling strategy for aggregated EVs and PV considering dynamic distribution locational marginal price (DLMP). Firstly, the static robust optimization method is used to deal with the uncertainty of EVs and PVs. Then, the dual decomposition theory is used to formulate the interactive rules between the distribution system operator (DSO) and aggregators. Finally, the distribution network congestion is alleviated according to the DLMP. The case study based on the improved ieee-33 bus system verifies the rationality and effectiveness of the strategy. The results show that the proposed strategy can effectively solve the congestion of distribution network considering the willingness of the aggregators to purchase and sell electricity.

articleTitle: A Study on Adaptive Protection System of Distribution Network Based on Passive Protection Terminal of Ring Network Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the distribution network with high permeability distributed energy access, distribution network fault current distribution network operation mode, the influence of the distributed power control strategy, and the existing in ring network cabinet configuration does not meet the high sensitivity and high reliability requirements of the active power of fuse protection, in this paper, an adaptive protection system for active distribution network is proposed by using the passive protection terminal installed in the ring network cabinet and the protection host configured at the dispatching end. The protection host receives SCADA data of distribution network scheduling to obtain the topology of active distribution network, uses distributed power supply voltage and grid voltage to adaptively calculate the passive protection setting value, and sends the setting value to the passive protection terminal through communication to realize the adaptive protection function of active distribution network. Finally, the simulation model is established, and the fuse protection of active distribution network and the adaptive protection system with passive protection terminals are compared, and the sensitivity and reliability of the adaptive protection scheme are verified.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Assessment of Natural Gas Pressure Energy Utilization Based on AHP-Anti-Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing emphasis on reducing carbon emissions and the growing demand for energy, natural gas, as an efficient and clean energy, has taken an increasing proportion in China's energy structure. At present, the natural gas pressure energy (NGPE) has a single energy use mode, one-sided evaluation indicators of pressure energy utilization benefits, and lack of evaluation methods, leading to low energy utilization rate of NGPE, insufficient operation benefits and systems that cannot be accurately evaluated, which seriously hinders the development and promotion of NGPE utilization technology. In view of the above problems, this paper first proposes a comprehensive utilization system of NGPE, which improves the utilization efficiency of NGPE. Then, it proposes evaluation indicators from three aspects of equipment stability, system economy and environmental protection to comprehensively evaluate the benefits of the comprehensive utilization system of NGPE. At the same time, in order to avoid the defects of subjective and objective weights and reduce the interference of human factors on the weights, A comprehensive evaluation method based on the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) – anti-entropy weight method is proposed, which improves the rationality and accuracy of the weight. Finally, the effectiveness of the evaluation method proposed in this paper in reflecting the operation level and defects of NGPE comprehensive utilization system is verified through case analysis.

articleTitle: Intel SGX-Based Trust Framework Designed for Secure Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a branch of artificial intelligence science, machine learning (ML) uses big data in its training process, but data owners usually refuse to give their data away due to data rights and potential risks in data privacy. Instead of acquiring data from owners, transferring the ML model to data providers might be a safer way to access data, while avoiding data leakage. Two concerns about this safer way of access are data theft by the ML model and the theft of the ML model in the provider environment. Our newly designed trust execution framework based on Intel Software Guard Extensions (SGX) builds a secure communication mechanism between data users and providers and a trusted execution environment based on SGX hardware isolation, which protects the two-way security of both data and the ML model. The framework also realizes the porting of the python interpreter in SGX, which simplifies the programming of ML algorithms in SGX.

articleTitle: Research on Trading Strategy of Distributed Generation and User Power Based on Blockchain Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of the power system reform and the continuous improvement of the penetration rate of distributed energy, the power market is facing new opportunities and challenges. In this context, a research on the trading strategy of distributed power and user electric energy based on blockchain platform is proposed. This mechanism and model can effectively alleviate the computational pressure on traditional trading platforms and protect the privacy of user information. It can not only ensure the security time limit of P2P operation, but also improve the system and reduce the risk of information exposure of the transaction parties.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Park-Level Integrated Energy System with Multiple Energy Chambers Based on Fuzzy-AHP
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The park-level integrated energy system (IES) integrates various heterogeneous energy, such as cold, heat, electricity, gas, etc. The complementary and coordination between varied energy is an important way to improve the consumption of renewable energy and accelerate low-carbon transformation. However, the comprehensive evaluation indicators and methods of the system are still in the primary stage, and the evaluation system needs to be further improved. First, this paper establishes a comprehensive evaluation index system based on its characteristics; Then, the analytic hierarchy process is utilized to solve the weight of the park-level IES; To form the corresponding quantitative results, the fuzzy evaluation method is used to build the fuzzy relationship between the evaluation index of the IES and the evaluation satisfaction; Finally, the assessment of the parklevel IES is obtained by combining the index weight value with the quantitative results.

articleTitle: Modeling and Implementation of Real-Time Power Market Based on Autonomous Controllable Optimization Solver
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The clearing model of real-time power market is a typical linear programming problem. In the current spot market pilot areas, relevant technical support systems use foreign commercial optimization solvers such as CPLEX and GUROBI as tools for real-time power market modeling and calculation. In recent years, domestic optimization solvers have developed rapidly in linear programming. Excellent products such as Cardinal Operations COPT and Alibaba MindOpt have emerged, realizing the independent control of optimization solvers. This paper analyzes and compares the differences between the autonomous controllable optimization solver and foreign mainstream products in parameter setting, algorithm function, function interface function and use mode, and establishes a unified modeling interface suitable for multiple solvers, so as to achieve the effect that different solvers can be called at one modeling. Secondly, according to the mathematical model of real-time power market, the modeling and calculation of real-time power market clearing model are realized based on the unified modeling interface. Finally, the application of real-time solver and controllability in foreign power market is verified by the independent test of real-time solver.

articleTitle: Policy Recommendations to Further Decarbonize the Yunnan Power System with Rising New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the frontier province in southwest China, Yunnan has made outstanding progress in the energy sector and deployed considerable renewables in the past decade. However, with the promotion of new energy such as wind and solar power, issues between the rising stochasticity, intermittency, and variability of new energy generation and relatively stable load profiles are more intensifying, challenging the province on the way to further decarbonization of its energy sector. As a result, this paper presents the current development of the Yunnan power system, then analyzes the prospects of developing new energy, and teases out the challenges facing the future new-type power system in Yunnan. Finally, to further decarbonize the Yunnan power system with rising new energy, policy recommendations are concluded with respect to strengthening key factors guarantee and resources planning, promoting new energy plus energy storage actively engaging in grid interaction, retrofitting existing coal power units for more flexibility, developing new flexible resources based on the integration of generation, grid, load, and storage, bolstering market role in resource allocation and facilitating demand-side response, as well as improving the electricity pricing mechanism for a new-type power system.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Planning Optimization Model of Active Distribution Network Considering Flexible Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of low carbon distribution network, this paper proposes a mixed integer second-order cone programming model for active distribution network considering carbon emission and flexible load. The objective is to provide the investment strategy with the minimum total cost under the premise of satisfying network operation constraints and CO<inf>2</inf> emission ceiling. Considering the uncertainty of new energy, load and energy price, a scenario clustering method based on K-means was proposed. The decision variables of the model include replacing overload lines, investing in new energy and energy storage devices, and investing in voltage control devices such as voltage regulators and capacitor banks. The polynomial voltage dependent flexible load, network reconstruction and carbon emission limit constraints are considered. Aiming at the nonconvex nonlinear characteristics of the programming model, the network reconstruction was modeled as a mixed integer linear programming form by using the virtual demand method, and an improved second-order cone relaxation method based on Taylor expansion was proposed to solve the problem of the traditional second-order cone relaxation caused by the flexible load model. Finally, the model is solved under the framework of two-stage stochastic programming. The model was tested by a 69-node system, and the results show that the proposed model not only has a lower total planning cost, but also contributes to reducing carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Fast Frequency Response Control Strategy of High-Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, high-proportion photovoltaic (PV) integrated into distributed system is one of the typical scenarios. Due to large-scale distributed PV power, the primary frequency regulation (PFR) capability of the power system tends to weaken gradually. To improve this, it is necessary to improve the PFR capability of distributed PV power. In this paper, the related standards and technical requirements of fast frequency response for distributed PV power are introduced firstly. Secondly, the PFR control modes of PV generation are described, including centralized control mode and distributed control mode. Finally, the necessity of optimizing the PFR parameters is analyzed, and a scheme of setting parameters according to the PFR control mode of PV unit is proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy improves the system frequency characteristics effectively.

articleTitle: Online Activity Detection with Predicting and Classifying Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Online activity detection means that the model gives the type of action that is happening in real time which is important for management and security of data center in energy stations. Online activity detection is more practical than offline activity detection for such video surveillance cases. However, online activity detection is more difficult in that only part video stream of an activity is available. So we construct invisible future features and connect them with historical features for the classification of current actions. We propose a novel two-stage Predict-Classify TRansformers (PCTR) for online activity detection with two transformers, where one is for predicting features of near future, and the other is for classifying activity by incorporating observed information and the predicted future information. More specifically, the predicting transformer has an encoder and a decoder, where the encoder models the temporal context of observed information, and the decoder predicts the near future features. Then the encoder of the classifying transformer recognizes ongoing activity by integrating observed features and the predicted features. We conduct extensive experiments on THUMOS’14 datasets to validate the proposed PCTR and get excellent performances.

articleTitle: Security Risk Analysis for the Control System of Low-Voltage Distributed Generation with Single and Multi-terminal Device Modelling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years varieties of terminal devices and different communication modes are introduced into the power system due to the rapid development of the control system of low-voltage distributed generation(CSLDG) and renewable energy, which brings about many security problems. To ensure the performance of the CSLDG, it is essential to analyze the security risks of the system, and quantify the attack impact. This paper presents a modelling method of single and multi-devices. The static and dynamic security risk analysis are also studied, based on which a quantitative attack impact metric is proposed.

Author Keywords: control system of low-voltage distributed generation

articleTitle: Influence of New Energy Penetration on Frequency Correction Control of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In engineering, the frequency correction control system of power grid can restore the frequency to the required range after serious faults of the power grid through the coordination of step difference rounds and fixed control measures. With the increasing proportion of new energy in the power grid, the startup mode of the power grid changes in a wide range with the output of new energy, and the risk of mismatches in fixed frequency correction control strategies continues to increase. A typical system is established to analyzed the relationship between different rounds and control applicability of frequency correction control system. The analysis conclusion points out that the traditional frequency correction control strategy is difficult to adapt to the scenarios where the proportion of new energy is high, and urgent to improve the ability of primary frequency modulation and new control methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Thermoelectricity in Integrated Energy System Based on Waste Heat Recovery from Power to Gas and Flexible Thermoelectricity Ratio
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the anti-peak shaving characteristics of wind power and the problem of wind curtailment caused by the ‘fixing electricity by heat’ of CHP units, an optimal scheduling method in integrated energy systems based on waste heat recovery from power to gas(P2G) and flexible thermoelectricity ratio in CHP is proposed. First, the P2G energy coupling mechanism and the feasibility of P2G waste heat recovery and utilization are analyzed. P2G equipment is introduced into the system and the remaining heat is recycled and utilized to promote wind power grid-connected consumption. Then, the principle of flexible thermoelectric ratio adjustment of CHP is analyzed, so that CHP can adjust the thermoelectric ratio following the trend of wind power output and the energy supply pressure of electric heat load, so as to improve the wind power consumption capacity of the system. Finally, the optimal scheduling model of the integrated energy system is constructed with the goal of minimizing the daily operating cost. The simulation example shows that the proposed scheduling method optimizes the thermoelectric coupling relationship of the system, effectively improves the wind power absorption capacity of the system, and has good social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of μPMU Considering Measurement Channels and Topology Reconfiguration of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, micro-synchronous phasor measurement unit (μPMU) has gradually become an important means for sensing the high frequency and high dynamics of new distribution system. In order to satisfy the economy of the μPMU optimal configuration and the topology diversity after the distribution network topology reconfiguration, the μPMU configuration of distribution network is optimized. First, the influence of zero injection bus on the observability and redundancy of the system nodes is analyzed, a μPMU configuration model of the distribution system is established with the constraint of complete system observability. In the proposed model, the distribution network comprehensive objective function of the minimizing average measurement redundancy is established under minimizing the measurement channels and maximizing the multiple topologies. Second, a multi-strategy enhanced binary gray wolf optimization algorithm (MSEBGWO) is proposed to solve the proposed model. The original binary gray wolf optimization algorithm (BGWO) is improved in four aspects to improve the algorithm optimization ability and convergence speed. In the proposed algorithm, the number of top-level wolves is increased, then the new sigmoid transformation function, the nonlinear adaptive convergence factor and the random opposition-based learning are adopted. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed μPMU configuration method are verified by the example analysis of IEEE33-bus and PG&E69-bus systems.

articleTitle: A Detection Based on OMES and MTAD-GAT for False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The false data injection attack (FDIA) is a new attack method aiming at power system state estimation. A successful FDIA can avoid the traditional bad data detection (BDD) and falsify measurements without detection. As a result, the dispatching center makes wrong decisions threatening safe and stable power system operation. A detection based on model-driven and data-driven methods is proposed. Optimal measurement equipment scheduling (OMES) is model-driven to calculate score 1 at each timestamp. Multivariate time-series anomaly detection via graph attention network (MTAD-GAT) is data-driven to get scores 2 and 3. The three scores above calculate the final inference score, which can maximize the overall effectiveness of FDIA detection. Timestamp can be identified as attacked if its final score is larger than a threshold chosen by Peak Over Threshold (POT) automatically. With the coordination of MTAD-GAT, OMES performs better detecting FDIA than the Support Vector Machine-Gabor Transform (SVM-GAB) method and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XG-Boost) method validated by simulations on the IEEE 14-bus system.

articleTitle: Development Ideas and Overall Infrastructure of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Energy Internet is a new ecological energy system with renewable energy as the priority, power energy as the basis, multi-energy coordination, supply and consumption coordination, centralized and distributed coordination, and wide participation of the public. It has attracted wide attention. In view of the development ideas and overall structure elements of Energy Internet, firstly, the research status and significance at home and abroad are investigated from the aspects of planning, design, control, evaluation and transaction of Energy Internet. Secondly, on the basis of explaining that the Energy Internet is a horizontal multi-source complementary, vertical source, network, load, storage and other links highly coordinated, energy and information highly integrated intelligent energy network, and the Energy Internet is divided into levels. Then, a general structure of Energy Internet based on the concept of hierarchical partition control is proposed, and the architecture of Energy Internet is expounded from application, software, hardware, data, deployment, etc. Finally, according to the new business and business form of Energy Internet development, the corresponding development ideas are put forward, and the key technologies that need to be laid out in the key technical directions of Energy Internet, such as planning, power generation, transmission, power transformation, distribution, power consumption and business model, are further elaborated.

articleTitle: Discussion on Security and Stability Control Technology Adapted to New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building a new electric power system that is based on new energy sources is an important measure for peaking carbon emissions and achieving carbon neutrality. It is also the development direction of China's power system transformation and upgrading. The large-scale integration of new energy into the grid will lead to a significant increase in the fluctuations on both sides of the source and load, which will bring major challenges to the balance adjustment and flexible operation of the power system. The stability characteristics, security control and production mode of the power system will be fundamentally changed, and the security operation of the power grid will face greater risks. Starting from the status quo of power system security and stability control technology, this paper introduces the characteristics and challenges of the new power system, analyzes the new requirements for the operation control of the new power system, and focuses on the online refresh technology of the stability control strategy, the precise load control technology, and the adaptation to "active". The low-frequency and low-voltage load shedding technology of power distribution network and the broadband oscillation emergency control technology of power electronic power grid are four aspects. And proposes the development direction of the new power system security and stability control technology.

articleTitle: Novel Pre-diagnosis Strategies for Medium-Low Voltage Arc Flash
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distribution networks in modern power system, the high-power density featured electrical equipment has become more concentrating in medium-low voltage level, which may lead serious safety risks such as serious arc faults or arc flash incidents. To better protect personnel and equipment from dangers, a fast and reliable arc detecting and locating method is thus essentially to be developed. However, due to the issues such as low sensitivity, delayed detection, complex structure, susceptible to interference by other sources, the application of traditional approaches, especially in weak system source and high arcing resistance featured medium-low voltage arc flash, are severely restricted. To avoid those limitation, a spatial magnetic field analysis based hybrid preemptive detection method of arc flash is fully investigated in the work. With the categorizing analysis of geometric configuration, mathematical modeling incorporated MHD approach is developed, which can be effective fast identification of vertical structure and parallel structure of the arc due to the insulation breakage or aging. With a series actual cases based simulations, the transient dynamics of arcing current, and the relationship among arc fault location, discharge types and magnetic field is derived, which offered valuable information for medium-low arc mitigation and hazard prevention.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Benefit Evaluation of Smart Grid with Pumped-Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of a high proportion of new energy access, pumped storage as a mature energy storage method has entered a period of rapid development. Aiming at the mismatch between the value contribution of pumped storage and the burden of beneficiaries, this paper classifies the contribution of pumped storage according to the principle of "who benefits, who bears", and focuses on the new energy consumption, peak regulation and frequency regulation in the operation stage. Qualitative and quantitative analysis of the auxiliary services contribution were carried out with an actual calculation example in a certain province. The calculation results showed that the main contribution of pumped storage is reflected in the promotion of new energy consumption, accounting for 47%~64% of the total revenue. The larger capacity pumped storage corresponds to the smaller contribution of unit capacity. The introduction of the spot market could increase the pumped storage contribution of unit capacity by up to 13.98%, which had a great guiding significance for the future development of pumped storage.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Integrated Energy Systems Based on Synergistic Optimization of Flexible Loads and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid promotion of renewable energy and the development of new power systems in China, it has become a priority to solve the imbalance between the load and renewable energy output power of integrated energy system (IES), and to improve the economy and flexibility by using energy storage and flexible load co-optimisation. Based on this, an IES model integrating renewable energy output power uncertainty model, flexible load model and energy storage device model is constructed. Finally, the model is solved using the commercial solver CPLEX. The simulation results show that the proposed IES model can effectively improve the operating economy of IES and its renewable energy consumption capacity, and provide a theoretical reference for the collaborative scheduling and unified planning of various energy sources.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of the Green Power Trading Research Based on the CiteSpace and VOSviewer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The green power trading system is expected to boost renewable energy development and accelerate its transition to a low-carbon regime world widely. With the trend of research popularity in the green energy trading field, this paper utilizes bibliometric methods, and employs the CiteSpace and VOSviewer to map the knowledge of 348 research articles in the Web of Science core database from 1997 to 2022 retrieved by specific ways on the topic of green power trading. The research literature is summarized and analyzed in terms of annual publications, keyword hotspots, authors, research institutions and countries, with the aim of providing references for the research development of green power trading in China. Based the lessons learned from the existing articles, China will be able to develop the green power trading markets, policies and systems with unique Chinese characteristics, so as to increase the depth and breadth of China’s research on green power trading.

articleTitle: Transient Performance Optimization of Grid Forming Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increased penetration of renewable energy sources (RES), the power system is emerging a lower inertial characteristic. This can lead to a higher rate-of-change of frequency (RoCoF) and the voltage instability issue during grid disturbance conditions, thus threatening the security of the power grid. Accordingly, researchers have recently proposed a novel grid-forming (GFM) control strategy. Compared to the traditional grid-following (GFL) control method, the GFM control can emulate the dynamic behaviors of the synchronous generator (SG), inherently providing inertial support to stabilize the grid frequency and transient AC voltage. However, it may lead to abnormal transient stress, such as over/under DC voltage and AC overcurrent, raising the risk of unexpected tripping. The paper will present the operating principles of multiple types of GFM and GFL control strategies, and evaluate their dynamic performance during the grid voltage variation events. To address the issue of transient stress, the paper will propose a novel control strategy for suppressing the over/under DC voltage and AC overcurrent so that prevented disconnection of the GFM converters. The proposed method is validated with an example of PV generation scenario, and the effectiveness in improving the dynamic performance has been demonstrated by studying the frequency variation cases.

articleTitle: Wind Power Investment Decision-Making Optimization Model Based on Real Option Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, China's renewable energy power policy is in the transition stage from fixed on grid electricity price to quota system. Considering the length of the parallel period of the two policies and the relative market share of the two policies, a wind power investment decision model under the uncertainty of green certificate price is established based on the real option principle, and the optimal investment opportunity of wind power generators is solved by using the dynamic programming method. The parameters are calibrated according to the actual situation of wind power development in China, the key factors influencing investment decisions in the policy and their action mechanisms are analyzed, and the model results are empirically discussed in combination with the average price of wind power green certificates in the trial stage of green certificate trading. The results show that the longer parallel period of fixed feed in tariff and quota system and the higher proportion of fixed feed in tariff policy are conducive to reducing the investment threshold, while the increase of green certificate price growth rate and volatility will delay investors' investment decisions. While effectively encouraging investors to invest in wind power projects, the market share of the quota system policy should not be higher than 50% at the current stage in order to achieve the goal of full parity Internet access and the formal implementation of the quota system policy in the early stage of the "fourteenth five year plan" for wind power.

articleTitle: A Data Augmentation Method for Multi-energy Parks Considering Different Scenario Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important physical carrier of the Energy Internet, multi-energy parks are currently mostly demonstration- based, with few samples and limited access to user-side measurement data. In the planning stage of the park, it is an urgent problem to study how to generate enough energy assessment data to meet the planning requirements from, for example, a small amount of cooling, heating and electricity load data. In this paper, a data augmentation method for multi-energy parks is proposed to expand the sample size by considering factors such as different administrative districts, functional areas, seasons and weather conditions, which is based on path distance of Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) as a metric between time series samples. In addition, the feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated by a case study, which lays a solid data foundation for the planning, design and evaluation of regional multi-energy parks.

articleTitle: An Optimal VPP Grouping Method for Deep Peak Regulation Ancillary Service of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a high proportion of renewable energy connected to the power grid, it is necessary to optimize the grouping of flexible resources on the demand side to facilitate regulation and control in order to solve the shortcomings of decentralized and poor direct control of flexible resources on the demand side and meet the demand for deep peak regulation ancillary services of the power grid. In this paper, an optimized grouping method of virtual power plant (VPP) is proposed, which takes into account the peak regulation profits balance index of VPPs and the modularity structure index based on electrical distance. Firstly, the flexibility adjustment ability of various demand side flexible resources is analyzed, and the peak regulation profits balance index is proposed and combined with the modularity index reflecting the structural characteristics of the VPP. Then, the maximum weighted sum of the two indexes is used as the objective function to establish the VPP optimized formation model, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve it. Among them, the peak regulation profits balance index is obtained by simulating the participation of VPPs in the peak regulation ancillary services market based on typical day scenarios and calculating the peak regulation profits of each VPP. Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Active Frequency Support Control Method Based on Cooperative Regulation of New Energy Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the active support capacity of new energy stations, give play to the advantages of different energy sources, and improve the efficiency of new energy stations actively participating in frequency modulation. Firstly, the general framework of active frequency support control technology is proposed; Secondly, considering the flexibility and rapidity of the inertial support and primary frequency modulation service of the new energy station in the short time scale, the virtual synchronization active inertial support technology and the multilevel model predictive control primary frequency modulation technology are proposed to give full play to the rapid response ability of the new energy equipment; Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example. The method proposed in this paper provides a new method for the coordination and optimization regulation of multi type new energy stations, and has a specific and important reference significance for the safe and stable operation of power grid with the gradual increase of the proportion of new energy.

articleTitle: A Real-time Intrusion Detection Method for Industrial Control Network Based on Heterogeneous Feature Extractor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Industrial control network intrusion detection system has higher requirements for detection rate, false positive rate, and real-time performance. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposed a new type of feature extractor abstracting mapping from the original low-level feature set to the high-level feature set. This feature extractor is composed of 3 heterogeneous sub-feature extractors 1D CNN, LSTM, and SAE. Secondly, the integrated feature set passes through a random forest (RF) classifier. Thirdly, combined with the regularity and stability of the industrial control network, a suspected host inspection method is designed based on the sequential hypothesis testing of real-time network traffic. This method uses the individual learner results of the above 3 feature extractors. Combining the above, two-stage fusion (SHT-RF) is carried out to realize real-time industrial control network intrusion detection, and achieve the purpose of improving the detection rate and enhancing the robustness of the system. Finally, it is verified on the CICIDS2017 data set. The detection rate of the proposed method is 99.59%, and the false positive rate is 0.09%. Compared with other machine learning methods, it has achieved a good improvement effect.

articleTitle: A Dispatch Model of Annual Generation Plan Considering Seasonal Pumped Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy increases, the regulation ability of the system becomes insufficient. Therefore, how to maintain the power balance and ensure the safety, stability and economic operation of power system is an important topic in the field of power system. In this paper, to achieve power balance on the medium and long-term time scale, an annual generation plan model considering seasonal pumped storage is established. Assuming that the daily operation status of thermal power units remains unchanged, and seasonal pumped storage pumps water and generates power once each day, the generation plan of each type of unit and the scheduling of seasonal pumped storage are formulated. Finally, the model is validated by the XJTU-ROTs 2017 test system with high renewable energy penetration and the results show that seasonal pumped storage is effective in optimizing resource allocation in the power system.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Microgrid Status Recognition Method Based on Grey Relation Analysis and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the overall efficiency of energy use and the level of renewable energy accommodation, electricity-gas-cold-heat multi-energy microgrids have become a development trend in the energy field. The degree of coupling between electricity, gas, cold and heat in the multi-energy microgrid is constantly strengthening, and the number of devices is also increasing. Accurate perception of the state of the equipment has become a necessary condition for the optimal control of the multi-energy microgrid. Based on the gray correlation degree algorithm, this paper establishes the connection characteristic database between device parameters and typical states. And on the basis of the contact feature database, the multi-classification support vector machine is used to classify the real-time operation data of the equipment to achieve efficient identification of the status of the multi-energy microgrid. Finally, simulation verification is based on an actual cold-heat-electricity-gas combined multi-energy microgrid. Simulation results show that compared with the traditional method, the proposed method in this paper can identify the status of multi-energy microgrid faster and more accurately.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Path Planning Based on Real-time Traffic Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the future transportation environment, smart electric vehicles will interact with smart urban transportation networks on a large scale. Firstly, this paper constructs an electric vehicle model and smart transportation network model using a graph-theoretic approach, and combines them to form a joint interaction model of "electric vehicle-transit network". Secondly, the Dijkstra’s algorithm is applied to plan the vehicle’s route to determine the distance of each trip, and the road weights are obtained by calculating the travel time using the vehicle’s speed based on the road class and the real-time traffic information of each time period and perform charging path planning. Finally, the planning scheme of the route is simulated and evaluated by using MATLAB. The simulation results show that, compared with the nearest charging path planning navigation strategy that is widely used nowadays, the EV charging route design based on actual traffic data given in this paper is more realistic and provides the best route navigation strategy taking into account the combined effects of several factors mentioned above at the same time.

articleTitle: Rapid Identification of Power Supply Line Galloping in Night Vision Scene Based on YOLOv5 Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power supply lines of open-pit mine are usually constructed in the wild with a large geographical span, and the galloping disaster of the power grid increases due to the influence of bad weather conditions. Especially in view of the weak light, low definition, low signal-to-noise ratio and low illuminance of fixed surveillance shooting at night, if the threat of line galloping cannot be quickly identified, once the galloping occurs it may cause the power supply line itself to break and tower to damage, etc. Therefore, this paper proposes a rapid identification method for line galloping threat in power supply lines without spacers. Firstly, the target enhancement of the power supply line is carried out by using the dark channel prior theory. Secondly, the YOLO(You Only Look Once)v5 model is used to detect the power supply line. Then, the line field is segmented, and the galloping trajectory of the power supply line is extracted using the ranging metric calculation. Finally, combined with the experience and knowledge of 35kV line galloping abnormality in open-pit mine, rapid risk warning of line galloping at different levels is realized. The result shows that the method can monitor the galloping of transmission lines in real time.

articleTitle: Construction of Uncertainty Models for Renewable Energy Systems on Multiple Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The output of the renewable energy system has strong randomness and volatility, and the construction of the uncertainty model of the system is of great significance to the power system planning. Scenario generation is a common method to analyze uncertainty problems by constructing deterministic scenarios. Since traditional scenario generation methods are sensitive to abnormal data, they cannot handle large-dimensional data well when the time scale is large. K-Medoids and Dynamic Time Warping (K-Medoids+DTW) methods can reduce the impact of abnormal data and generate scenarios for renewable energy output and load changes at multiple time scales. On this basis, the vector autoregressive model (VAR) is used to construct supply and demand matching patterns in different scenarios. This paper uses the historical data of renewable energy, adopts the improved clustering algorithm to generate typical scenarios, and builds a source-load supply-demand matching model, and finally verifies the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Application and Prospect of Reinforcement Learning in Power Prediction on Source and Load Sides
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale access of a high proportion of new energy sources, there is a high degree of uncertainty on both sides of the source and load, which brings huge challenges to the optimal dispatch of the power system. Therefore, accurate power prediction information of the source and load can provide important decision support for the dispatch of the new power system. In recent years, with the development of artificial intelligence technology, reinforcement learning (RL) has been gradually used in uncertain power supply power prediction, load prediction, etc., so as to support the stable and safe operation of power grid under the uncertainty of source and load. Therefore, reinforcement learning has a great application prospect in the new power system dominated by new energy. Based on this, this paper will conduct a research review on the application of reinforcement learning technology to wind power forecasting, photovoltaic power forecasting, load power forecasting, and source-load power forecasting under extreme weather. Besides, the reinforcement learning algorithm is used to predict the distributed power supply of a wind farm in Jilin Province, China and its region, which is used as the support of the calculation example. Finally, the development direction of reinforcement learning applied to source-load power prediction is prospected and analyzed.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation on Generator Tripping Strategy for Self-sustained Oscillation Induced by Hard Limit of Grid Following PMSG Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) accidents of the power system caused by wind power have received extensive attention. This paper focuses on the self-sustained oscillation problem caused by the control limit of the grid-following direct-driven permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) wind farms. When one PMSG in a multi-machine system oscillates, whether the removal of other PMSGs can affect its oscillation conditions is studied. In this paper, the generator tripping problem in the oscillation scene of the wind farm with grid-following PMSGs is transformed into the influence of the equivalent parameter change of a two-machine coupling system on the self-sustained oscillation conditions. Considering the synchronization stability condition of the phase-locked loop (PLL), the influence of the generator tripping strategy on the self-sustained oscillation condition caused by the hard limit in the control system is analyzed. Since the fundamental and harmonic currents of the self-sustained oscillation frequency can all be monitored at the terminal of each PMSG when nonlinear oscillation occurs in the wind farm, this paper proves that cutting off the part of the wind farm without the oscillating ones does not help the oscillation suppression. The necessity of accurately locating nonlinear oscillation sources is thus demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Staged Relay Protection of DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Rapid and effective identification and isolation of DC faults is one of the key technical difficulties in the development of DC distribution networks. Compared with the traditional AC system, the DC power distribution system has the characteristics of "low damping". After a DC fault occurs, the fault current is very large, and the fault development process is extremely fast. Usually, the safety of the entire distribution network can be endangered within a few milliseconds. Through analyzing the bipolar short-circuit fault characteristics and typical fault current waveforms of symmetric unipolar DC systems, this paper proposes a phased overcurrent protection strategy based on current magnitude and a phased current rate-of-change protection strategy based on current change rate. This strategy uses single-ended current data without communication. The main protection can accurately identify the faulty line within 1 millisecond after the fault, which can meet the protection requirements of the DC distribution network for power supply in remote areas. The proposed protection scheme can identify faulty lines quickly and reliably, and meet the requirements of rapidity, selectivity and reliability of protection.

articleTitle: Empirical Mode Decomposition-Based DC Measurement for Photovoltaic Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the advantages such as being clean and safe, photovoltaic (PV) power generation has become an emerging industry of widespread concern in the world. However, the connection of PV inverters and the unknowability of environmental factors cause effective operation status information submerged in interference. To this end, this paper proposes a PV-DC signal de- noising method based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) combined with wavelet adaptive threshold. The frequency-domain waveform characteristics of different operating conditions are investigated by analyzing theoretical model and fault recording data. The fast Fourier transform (FFT) based on Hanning window is used to extract the frequency-domain features. Extensive test results using simulation data demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Steady-State Security Analysis Method Considering Correlativity among Different Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A method of steady-state security analysis in wind power systems is presented. The wind farm velocity and output model are established, and Latin Hypercube Sampling is used to simulate the impact of wind farms output fluctuation which considers correlativity among different wind farms by the Cholesky Decomposition. Safety confidence is fast obtained finally by the linearized power flow function. Tests in IEEE 30 system demonstrated that the proposed approach carries out of the safety confidence accurately and rapidly and provides the reliable theoretical basis for power system steady-state security analysis.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Emission Mismatch Penalty Game to Facilitate Carbon and Electricity Market Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electricity sector is undergoing a low carbon transition to combat the looming threats caused by climate change. Given the urgency of meeting the climate goals set by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), the cap-and-trade carbon emission market has emerged as an instrumental tool for policy-makers to impose emission restrictions on generation companies (Gencos). In this paper, we seek to model the sophisticated interactions among the CMO-carbon market operator, ESO-electricity system operator, and Gencos in a coupled electricity and carbon market. We propose a two-stage structure in which CMO conducts a uniform price auction to allocate the gross emission allowance to each Genco in the form of hourly allowance allowances in the first stage. Then, in the next stage, ESO conducts an emission-aware economic dispatch whereas the Gencos may further adjust the hourly schedules based on the dispatch outcomes. The coupling of the carbon market and the electricity market is characterized by an emission mismatch penalty mechanism, and we develop an iterative solving algorithm to reach the equilibrium. Through numerical studies, we highlight that the proposed mechanism is effective in emission reduction and market management.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model of Ensemble RUSBoosted Tree Optimized by Linear Programming for Photovoltaic System Efficiency Improvement under Sudden Change of Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) farms can supply vital merits to the electrical systems economically and environmentally. Nevertheless, the variation of the PV power leads to technical challenges under partially shaded conditions (PSC). For this reason, Global maximum power point (GMPP) tracking represents a critical mechanism for power optimization uncertainty to guarantee system stability. In this study, a novel hybrid algorithm for GMPP tracking for a PV system under PSC is presented. The proposed hybrid system integrates machine learning (ML) Ensemble RUSBoosted tree (ERBT) and Metaheuristic Linear Programming (LP) to solve optimization problems under PSC with a fast response time and good convergence speed. The integration of ERBT-LP combines the benefits of the two algorithms into a single model. The presented algorithms have been tested and validated using MATLAB SIMULINK environment with very promising results.

articleTitle: Dual Similarity-based Method for Proactive Fault Detection in Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fault detection of power distribution networks is of paramount importance to ensure power supply safety and reliability as well as efficient system maintenance. However, the inadequacy of measurements and complex operational conditions bring about difficulties for conventional logic-based and model-based fault detection methods. This paper proposed a dual similarity-based method (DSM) for power distribution fault detection. It contains the operation mode similarity and temporal similarity. The former reconstructs the operation mode by matrix profile based on k-means, and Euclidean distance is used to measure the similarity of the operating modes. The latter models the temporal similarity, and the LSTM is adopted to take the advantage of high-resolution continuous measurement for fault detection. Through the dual similarity-based method, the proposed solution can effectively identify the typical anomalies in the power distribution network with high accuracy and recall performance. The proposed solution is extensively assessed through experiments for a range of tripping events in 75 distribution transformers based on realistic datasets. The numerical results confirmed that it outperforms the conventional fault detection solutions.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Steady Reactive Power for Converter Station Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Improving the transient stability of the converter bus voltage plays an important role in ensuring the safe operation of DC power transmission. In this paper, on the basis of the study of the impact of the steady-state output reactive power coordination between synchronous condenser and AC filter on the transient stability of the converter bus voltage, the regression modeling method for predicting bus voltage transient stability margin based on bus voltage and steady-state reactive power coordination state of the converter station is proposed by using voltage transient stability margin index based on multi-binary table description and support vector machine. Further, using the regression model, a coordinated optimization method of the steady-state reactive power of synchronous condenser and AC filter to improve the transient stability margin of the converter bus voltage and reduce the system network loss is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed machine learning-based reactive power coordination optimization method to enhance the bus voltage transient stability of Nanchang converter station is verified using the PSASP computational analysis model of Yazhong DC feeding into Jiangxi grid. Simulation results show that the optimization method can fully excavate the ability of the synchronous condenser to improve the transient stability of the converter bus voltage against severe fault disturbances based on dynamic reactive power support, while reducing the number of AC filters put into operation.

articleTitle: A Multi-time Scale Rolling Coordinated Scheduling Model for the Wind-Photovoltaic-Hydro Generation System with Cascade Hydropower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Addressing the uncertainties caused by high proportion of new energy connected to the grid as well as improving the level of new energy accommodation has become an urgent problem under the background of new power system. Therefore, aiming at the characteristics that the prediction accuracy of wind, photovoltaic power, and load demand (WPL) is improved with reduced time scales, a multi-time scale rolling coordinated scheduling model for the wind-photovoltaic-hydro (WPH) generation system with cascade hydropower is established. Through the coordination of the day-ahead 24-hour scheduling, the intraday 1-hour scheduling and the real-time 15-minute scheduling, the WPH output can be guaranteed to track the load and promote the accommodation level of new energy. Numerical example shows that the new energy accommodation level is greatly affected by the inflow of cascade hydropower. The proposed multi-time scale rolling coordinated dispatching model can effectively suppress the fluctuation of wind and photovoltaic output and reduce their curtailment, realizing the optimal allocation and full utilization of clean renewable energy consequently.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mining Method of Distribution Line Trip Filling Text
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a frequent fault of distribution network, the accumulated large number of trip documents are mainly handled manually, which is inefficient and has strong subjective factors. In order to solve this problem, in order to constitute a complete text causality fault phenomenon and the cause of the problem for mining the goal, put forward an intelligent power distribution line tripping fill in text mining method, the method using the distribution trip provided text narrative logic characteristics, puts forward the fusion of word segmentation and part of speech and syntactic analysis results trip provided text extraction strategy; On this basis, a two-stage filtering method is proposed. Firstly, the distributed high-dimensional vector similarity is used to realize the preliminary filtering, and then the final result of text mining is determined based on the text editing similarity. A case study based on a province shows that the accuracy of the proposed method can reach more than 72%, which significantly improves the efficiency of text processing and can initially meet the actual needs.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Planning Model to Optimize Flexible Resources from Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a larger scale of renewable energy connected to the power system, lack of regulation capacity becomes a serious problem for generation expansion planners. Flexible resources from the supply side and demand side arouse great interest. In this paper, a two-stage generation expansion planning model considering the impacts of demand response is established to study how resources from the demand side optimize the planning scheme. A case study based on XJTU-ROTS2017 is introduced to verify the efficiency of the model. And three cases are set to compare optimal results which show that with the implementation of demand response, the expansion capacity of conventional power sources can be reduced to some degree and the load curve can be modified. Based on the comparison among four cases, the importance of calling on large-scale, regular demand response participation can be concluded.

articleTitle: A Study on the Generating Set Capacity of Pumped Storage Units in a Cascade Water-Light Storage Complementary Co-generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Chunchangba shifting-speed pumped storage demonstration power plant is the first demonstration project in China that realizes cascade water-light storage complementary co-generation through a new pumped storage power plant. To effectively solve the problem of collaborative scheduling, and control problems of the small hydropower, photovoltaic power station and pumped storage units in the terraces, this paper collects and analyzes the energy storage needs of the local power grid water and light system, and initially proposes the two energy storage schemes of 5MW and 4MW. On this basis, we further compare and study four aspects: runoff regulation calculation, power balance, suppression of PV fluctuations, and construction economic indexes, select and determine the optimal solution to realize the safe, economic, and friendly operation of combined water-light storage in the demonstration area, and provide a new technical idea and application example for small and medium-sized pumped storage construction and stepwise hydropower integration transformation.

articleTitle: Multivariate Uncertainty Set Based Robust Operation of Integrated Electricity and Heating Systems with Variable Mass Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of renewable energy, system operators are placing increasing emphasis on operational flexibility and robustness. In this paper, we propose a robust operation of integrated electricity and heating system (IEHS) with variable mass flow, where heat operation with variable mass flow increases flexibility and robust operation increases safety. To reduce the conservativeness of robust optimization and capture the long-term temporal correlation of renewable energy generation, we use the multivariate uncertainty set derived from the GARCH model. Based on the duality theory, we transform the robust operation problem with the multivariate uncertainty set into a tractable deterministic convex programming by using mathematical tricks and equivalent transformation. Case studies show that: (1) The proposed robust operation has less conservativeness since the multivariate uncertainty set captures the long-term temporal correlation of renewable energy forecast errors; (2) The corresponding solution technique is effective and has greatly reduced the computational burden.

articleTitle: Research on Rapid Self-healing Technology of Smart Distribution Network with DG
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since China's urban distribution network did not consider the smart grid at the beginning of construction, it is difficult to conFigure the communication channel at present, and the distributed power supply access distribution network makes the traditional three-stage overcurrent protection difficult to adapt to the topology change and loses the criterion.. In order to solve this problem, the paper firstly analyzes the equivalent mathematical model of the inverter-type distributed power supply under the positive sequence component control strategy, and then analyzes the influence of the distributed power source on the fault current by using the symmetrical component method as an example. Finally, a non-channel protection rapid self-healing scheme suitable for distribution lines with distributed power supply is proposed. The circuit breakers are divided according to the area, and the fault line is quickly cut off by combining the eddy current repulsive vacuum high-speed switch. The solution does not rely on the communication channel, which saves the cost of constructing and maintaining the communication channel. The distribution line can achieve self-healing within 0.3s, which meets the requirements of the relay protection setting principle of the medium voltage distribution network. The correctness of the proposed method is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC fault simulation.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Simplified Service Bus in New Generation Dispatching Technical Support System and Heterogeneous System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of UHV AC / DC hybrid power grid, in order to cope with the large-scale access of new energy, the power market reform has been continuously promoted. Therefore, it is proposed to build a new generation of dispatching technical support system to meet the needs of future power system development and safe, stable and high-quality operation. This paper proposes a simplified service bus that supports a new generation of service-oriented architecture, and meets the deployment characteristics of cloud terminals that are cross platform, lightweight, easy to deploy, open and efficient. The simplified service bus can well meet the location independent characteristics and be easily deployed in and out of the system. The flexible protocol processing mode cooperating with the gateway can meet the needs of accessing the services of the system and external systems. At the same time, it supports multiple man-machine network and automatic switching of service network shutdown under N-1 mode, which greatly improves the availability and stability of the system, Which Provide a strong guarantee for the safe, stable and efficient operation of the new generation system.

articleTitle: Exploration on Market Mechanism and Certification Technology of Zero Carbon Building Groups Participating in Clean Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to statistics (UN Environment Global Status Report 2017), the construction industry accounts for nearly 40% of the global energy related carbon emissions, which means that the construction industry is one of the main battlefields to achieve the carbon neutrality goal. It is necessary to study the clean energy market trading mechanism of zero carbon building. At the same time, how to certificate and track the clean energy in market transactions and actual consumption of zero carbon building groups is also a key point. This paper makes the first exploration on market mechanism and certification technology of zero carbon building groups participating in clean energy consumption. At first, the zero carbon building standards issued by some countries are briefly introduced. Then the market mechanisms for buildings and building groups participating in clean energy consumption in developed countries is summarized. In combination with China’s current policies to promote clean energy consumption and the development of power market mechanism the framework for zero carbon building groups to participate in renewable energy trading market is proposed considering the technical characteristics of zero carbon building groups, and the relevant market trading mechanism and certification technology are preliminarily designed. It has a certain reference value for promoting zero carbon building groups to participate in the clean energy consumption market in China.

articleTitle: Research on Regulation Strategy of Energy-Saving Aggregation Control Device in Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale access of massive distributed resources, the "double-high and double-peak" characteristics of the power grid are prominent, and the flexible adjustment capacity of traditional power grids is limited. It is urgent to tap new flexible resources with adjustable potential under the existing power grid form. The resource aggregation control device can realize the unified collection of distributed resources standardization, and optimize the energy consumption of the communication module by using the intelligent sleep mode, which gives the device a great space for energy saving. Based on this characteristic, firstly, based on the aggregated air-conditioning load model, the resource regulation strategy of the energy-saving aggregated control device is proposed. Secondly, based on the establishment of the mathematical model of the adjustable potential of the device, a control strategy for energy saving of the device considering the time characteristics is proposed. Finally, the analysis results of an example show that the resource regulation strategy can fine-tune and control flexible resources, realize the sinking of control functions, at the same time, the device can realize energy-saving control, which provides an idea for exploring the adjustable potential of various communication equipment in the future.

articleTitle: Short Circuit Fault Location Method of Distribution Network Based on Fuzzy Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Facing the difficult problem of short-circuit fault diagnosis and imperfect information environment in 10kV distribution network, a short-circuit fault section location method based on fuzzy matching is established by using the multi-source data of distribution and consumption information system of distribution network and taking Elman neural network model as the center. Firstly, based on the database of power distribution information system, the feature database of distribution network short-circuit fault diagnosis is established, and then the main features are selected by i-relief algorithm as the data input of Elman neural network. Finally, the multi-source data and the type and location of distribution network short-circuit fault are fuzzy matched based on Elman neural network model. Finally, through the analysis of a practical example in Southwest China, it is concluded that the proposed model can efficiently and quickly locate the short-circuit fault of 10kV distribution network, and has good fault tolerance and practicality.

articleTitle: Research on Clearing Model of Electricity Spot Market for Cascade Hydropower with Multiple Plants in the Same Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In some provincial/regional markets dominated by hydropower in China, the economic operation of cascade hydropower is very important, and cascade hydropower has its unique physical characteristics, so it is necessary to carry out targeted modeling in the clearing model of power spot market. Therefore, in view of the fact that multiple hydropower plants share one reservoir in the process of cascade hydropower clearing, a power spot market clearing model considering one reservoir with multiple hydropower plants is proposed. The model aims to minimize the total power generation cost of the system. Based on the traditional power spot market clearing model, the abandoned water power, water level control and abandoned water flow constraints of one reservoir and multiple hydropower plants are embedded in the model. Adding the abandoned water flow restriction of hydropower plants to the optimal operation model of cascade hydropower can actually simulate the abandoned water behavior of hydropower plants and make the clearing result of cascade hydropower more reasonable. The IEEE39 standard node system is taken as an example to analyze and verify the proposed clearing model of electricity spot market for cascade hydropower with multiple plants in the same reservoir.

Author Keywords: one reservoir with multiple hydropower plants

articleTitle: Data Augmentation of Insulator Aerial Images for Intelligent Inspection of Electric Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Insulators on the electric power transmission lines are prone to defects due to outdoor exposure that can degrade the system performance or even lead to power outage. The existing solutions of defect diagnosis based on vision-based supervised deep learning algorithms suffer from the lack of defect samples. This work develops an efficient data augmentation method for aerial insulator images to promote the detection model performance. The insulator and background are separated firstly and the perspective transformation or random flip is adopted for the foreground and random erasing is used for the background in the augmentation process, respectively. In addition, the noises and weather features are incorporated for the overall image to simulate different photography scenarios. The proposed data augmentation solution is assessed through experiments using the CNN-based training models. The numerical results confirm that the proposed solution enables performance improvements for a range of models in terms of accuracy, recall and F2 score. Besides, the Grad-CAM visualization method is also used and demonstrates the superiority of models trained based on the augmented dataset for insulator defect diagnosis tasks.

articleTitle: On the Use of Spatial-temporal Feature Graph Convolutional Network for Ultra-Short Term Prediction of Wind Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale access of wind power generation units brings hidden dangers to the safe and stable operation of power systems, and accurate wind power prediction can somewhat abate the adverse effects of new energy volatility. With the development of wind farm clusters, the power of each wind farm forms a high-dimensional spatial-temporal graph with complex coupling due to natural factors such as location, distance and weather. In recent years, the graph neural network has received increasing attention due to its excellent performance on graph structure data, so this paper studies wind power prediction methods based on graph convolutional networks, and single-step prediction models and multi-step prediction models are established using graph convolutional networks to achieve collaborative prediction of multiple wind farms. Compared with the existing solutions, the proposed method obtains better ultra-short-term wind power prediction performance in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Approach for Shunt Capacitor Banks Based on Unbalanced Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Shunt capacitor bank fault detection technology is critical for the stable operation of power systems with a large share of renewable energy. A fault detection approach for shunt capacitor banks based on neutral point unbalanced current is proposed to address the problem of fuzzy fault location and low efficiency of shunt capacitor banks while considering the influence of operating environmental factors and equipment component manufacturing error on fault detection accuracy. By evaluating and calculating the changes in phase and amplitude of the unbalanced current before and after the capacitor bank's fault, the approach can rapidly determine the branch of the fault capacitor unit and compute the number of fault capacitor units.
