This paper investigates the reasons of probable mistakes in the fault detection process and raises the penalty term in the training calculation model's loss function to improve the approach's robustness and generalization ability in various application scenarios. Building a model for simulation experiments verifies the practicality of this approach.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Grid Connected System under the Influence of Grid Impedance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy power generation widely relies on grid connected inverters to connect with the power grid, and the traditional double closed-loop control strategy has been widely used. Due to the fluctuation of power grid impedance, when it changes, it may cause resonance in the system, and the grid connected waveform is seriously distorted, which poses a threat to the stability of the system. In this paper, based on the equivalent model of grid connected inverter, the concept of harmonic resonance is proposed, and the difference and connection with traditional circuit resonance are analyzed. The simulation verifies that with the gradual increase of grid impedance, the stability of the system gradually decreases, the harmonic resonance gradually appears.

articleTitle: A Hydro-Thermodynamic Dynamic Coupling Model and Its Fast Calculation Method in Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The crucial and most susceptible component in integrated energy system is the district heating system. The flow-regulation mode, compared with temperature-regulation mode, has better equipment operation conditions. But so far, there has been no a hydro-thermodynamic dynamic coupling model in terms of flow-regulation model in district heating system. This research proposes a precise model that considers the coupled dynamic hydraulics and dynamic thermodynamics in district heating system. The modified forward-backward iteration, which uses method of characteristic for hydraulic calculation and upwind difference for thermal calculation, is applied to model computation. To do quick calculations, a hybrid prediction model based on data-driven methodology is used, considering the tradeoff between accuracy and efficiency. Two cases with four situations each are utilized in the case study to certify the effectiveness of the suggested methodology.

articleTitle: Coordinative Low-Voltage-Ride-Through Control for Wind Energy Conversion System with Supercapacitor Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the grid specification, the wind energy conversion System (WECS) shall have low-voltage-ride-through (LVRT) capability. In order to improve the performance of LVRT, a coordinated control scheme of LVRT based on supercapacitor energy storage system (SC_ESS) is proposed. In this scheme, the machine-side converter (MSC), grid-side converter (GSC) and SC_ESS controller work together to deal with different low voltage sags (LVS). The positive- and negative-sequences reference of GSC current are obtained to reduce the double fundamental frequency pulsating power under unbalanced conditions. The LVRT control has four operating modes, which can adjust the control structure and improve the control effect. For three different degrees of faults, the feasibility of this LVRT control method is verified by the consequences of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) experiments.

articleTitle: Integrated Fuzzy Control Strategy for Primary Frequency Regulation of Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the proportion of new energy is gradually increasing and the frequency quality is getting worse, a comprehensive control strategy for primary frequency regulation of energy storage system based on fuzzy control is proposed. Firstly, the influence of energy storage virtual droop, virtual inertia and virtual negative inertia control on the frequency response of the system is analyzed, and the fuzzy control is used to realize the smooth switching and complementary advantages between the control modes; Then, the feedback control strategy of SOC is designed by using logistics function, and the self-recovery control strategy of energy storage SOC is introduced to make the energy storage SOC reach the ideal state and improve the frequency modulation ability of energy storage. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Frequency Constrained Source-Grid-Load-Storage Coordination Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high penetration of renewable energy sources (RESs) brings challenges to maintain the frequency stability of power systems, and energy storage systems (ESSs) will be widely installed to provide frequency supports, which raises the concern: how to coordinate the conventional sources with storage devices in generation dispatch. This paper proposes a frequency constrained source-grid-load-storage coordination dispatch model to coordinate various generation sources, which can be formulated with a mixed-integer quadratic programming (MIQP) problem. Case studies on modified IEEE 24-bus system show that our schedule method can guarantee the frequency security while improving the economics of the power systems.

articleTitle: Presentation and Performance Analysis of a Direct-Drive Traction System for Rail Trains Incorporating a Disk PM Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a novel direct-drive electric traction system that incorporates a disk permanent magnet (PM) motor, which shows practical potential to urban rail trains. The disk PM motor can be directly mounted on the train wheel, which realizes the direct contact of power and load. First, conceptual structure of the direct-drive system is described. Then, the motor structure and its specifications are presented from the viewpoint of replacing the asynchronous motor of the existing ALSTOM 04A02 urban rail system. Machine parameters are calculated and 3-D finite element (3-D FEM) simulation is carried out to analyze magnetic field distribution. Design results demonstrate that the disk PM motor has distinguished advantages in power density and efficiency over the asynchronous motor in use, which would be more suitable for heavy-load rail trains. At last, the influence of harmonic current from the inverter on the harmonic torque of the disk PM motor is studied, and results demonstrate that the 6<sup>th</sup> harmonic torque is the main factor affecting the torque ripple and could be suppressed by further optimizing the machine parameters. This work can provide some reference for improving the train traction system, and has reference values to other electric traction systems.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering the Dynamic Characteristics of Heating and Gas Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of electricity-heat-gas integrated energy system (IES) in recent years, it has become an effective way to improve energy utilization efficiency. The coordinated utilization of diverse energy forms in IES can promote the consumption of renewable energy and the operational flexibility of IES. This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for IES considering the dynamic characteristics of heating and gas networks to reduce operating cost and accommodate wind energy. Firstly, considering the slow transmission process in pipeline, the dynamic characteristics of heating network and gas network are modeled to tap the energy storage potential of the networks. Then, a day-ahead optimal scheduling model is proposed for the IES. The objective of the optimization is to minimize the operating cost. The constraints for the electricity, heating and gas networks and their coupling components are shown. The simulation results on a modified IES prove that the consideration of the dynamic characteristics helps improve the operating economy and renewable energy accommodation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Operation Optimization of Electric-gas-thermal Integrated Energy System for Improving Wind Power Accommodation Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of wind power installed capacity, its accommodation capacity becomes a huge challenge because of its uncertainty and intermittency. The introduction of power to gas(P2G) equipment makes it possible to improve wind power accommodation capacity. In this paper, a multi-objective operation optimization problem of electric-gas-thermal integrated energy system (IES) for improving wind power accommodation capacity is considered. First, an electric-gas-thermal IES model with P2G equipment considering a set of operation constraints is established. Then, it is transformed into a multi-objective operation optimization problem to minimize the operation cost and wind curtailment. Furthermore, an artificial bee colony algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by various scenarios of 9 nodes simulation with IES test system.

articleTitle: Using Energy Storage Systems in Fast Frequency Regulation: Case Study of Xinjiang Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increase of renewable penetration and load fluctuation level has brought new challenges to power system frequency regulation. With the advantage of fast response, energy storage system (ESS) can be used to improve dynamic frequency response of power system. When large frequency disturbance occurs in the power grid, ESS can participate in the fast frequency regulation of the power grid and provide support for the system frequency. For the sending-end power grid where renewable energy accounts for a relatively high proportion and a large amount of power is sent out through multiple high-voltage direct current (HVDC) lines, it puts forward higher requirement on frequency performance. In this paper, a comprehensive case study is performed to benchmark a number of fast frequency support control methods based on a practical test case from Xinjiang power grid under two typical disturbances. The results of the case study indicate model-free control need less capacity usage of ESS and has better adaptability to different operating scenarios.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Influence of Tower Wind-Induced Vibration Coefficient Calculated by Lumped-Mass Method on 66kV or under Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The transmission tower has the characteristics of high-rise, flexibility and large span, and is particularly sensitive to the wind load. Therefore, the wind load is the control load for the structural design of the transmission tower. At the same time, the fluctuating wind also has a great impact on the structural stability. The wind-induced vibration coefficient is an important parameter for calculating the wind load and pulsating wind. Load code for the design of overhead transmission line (DL/T 5551-2018) has revised the calculation of wind-induced vibration coefficient and adopted the lumped-mass method, but it has not been applied to transmission towers of 66kV or under transmission tower. By comparing the difference between Load code for the design of overhead transmission line (DL/T 5551-2018) and Code for the design of 66kV or under overhead electrical power transmission line (GB 50061-2010), this paper compares and analyzes the theoretical calculation formula, actual tower member stress, tower head displacement and tower foundation force, and obtains the impact of tower wind vibration coefficient calculated by cluster mass method on transmission towers of 66kV and below. The research provides reference and basis for the revision of wind load calculation theory of 66kV or under transmission tower structures in China.

articleTitle: Multi-scenario Two-Stage Optimal Configuration of Energy Hub Considering Preventive Maintenance Plans
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a new type of energy network, multiple energy systems can promote the operation of multiple energy sources, which is of great significance to achieve the use of clean, low-carbon, safe energy with efficiency. As an important model for analyzing multiple energy systems, energy hub has received extensive attention. In particular, how to realize its optimal configuration is one of the most concerned issues. This article focuses on the optimal configuration of energy hubs, and proposes a multi-scenario and two-stage optimal configuration method for energy hubs considering preventive maintenance plans and uncertain factors. In addition, taking an energy hub as an example, this paper analyzes the equipment configuration, maintenance plan, cost and output in the energy hub. The results show that considering the uncertainty factors and preventive maintenance plan will affect the output of the equipment in the energy hub, and can reduce the total annual cost of the energy hub, which verifies the effectiveness and economy of the proposed configuration method.

articleTitle: Software Phase Locked Loop Based on SOGI Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The basic principle of phase-locked loop is introduced, and the software phase-locking method based on synchronous rotation coordinates is adopted. The phase-locked loop simulation model is established in the Matlab/Simulink environment, and the phase-locked method of constructing orthogonal vectors by SOGI transform is simulated and verified. Finally, two phases are constructed by software phase locking method based on SOGI transform, and the software programming process is given for experimental verification.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Flywheel Energy Storage Converter during Grid Voltage Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flywheel Energy Storage System(FESS) may encounter grid voltage drop/rise disturbances during grid-connected operation, then will be disconnected from the grid for protecting itself. The control strategy of flywheel energy storage converter during grid voltage disturbances is studied in this paper. Based on the analysis of the FESS structure and the control strategy of the converter under steady operation conditions, the transient characteristics of the FESS active power and DC bus voltage during grid voltage disturbances are studied, and a control strategy flywheel energy storage converter during grid voltage disturbances is proposed. The proposed strategy can stabilize the DC bus voltage to continue non-off-grid operation of the FESS. At the same time, it can provide a certain reactive power support to the grid during grid voltage disturbances and help the voltage recovery on the grid-side. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Cross-provincial Electricity Spot Trading Model for Optimizing Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China is characterized by uneven distribution of resources and regional economic development. It is necessary to strengthen inter-provincial electricity market construction, break inter-provincial barriers, and promote the optimization of the distribution of electricity resources in a larger area. The inter-provincial market is to promote the optimal allocation of electricity resources on a larger scale in each province and to promote the flow of electricity resources from electricity-rich areas to electricity-scarce areas. Therefore, this paper firstly analyzes the significance of the inter-provincial electricity spot convergence mechanism to play the role of the inter-provincial market in optimizing the allocation of resources on a large scale, and then constructs a model of inter-provincial and intra-provincial spot market transactions, analyzes the convergence mode of the two levels of market transactions under the convergence mechanism, and finally puts forward an outlook on the construction direction of China's future inter-provincial renewable energy market transaction mechanism.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Scheduling of Natural Gas System Considering Hierarchical Station-Network Scheduling Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the hierarchical scheduling characteristics of the compressor station and natural gas network under practical operating conditions, this paper proposes a two-stage hierarchical station-network scheduling mechanism. The proposed mechanism is based on a refined compressor station model, which regards the dispatching center of the natural gas system as the decision-maker of superior scheduling and the control center of the compressor station as the decision-maker of subordinate scheduling. The effectiveness of the proposed mechanism is demonstrated by a 7-node natural gas system.

articleTitle: Multi-user Load Elasticity Assessment Method Considering Load Statistical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The premise of DR is Load elasticity assessment, that is, DR potential assessment. Neglecting actual load characteristic constraints, an evaluation model based on electricity price and incentive policies has been proposed. Consequently, there is a large deviation between the theoretical evaluation results and the actual DR potential. Moreover, when DR is applied to utilities, the DR behavior randomness is ignored, result in a scheme without the best reliability. In this paper, the Multinomial Logistic Model is utilized to represent the power consumption probability in a certain period, which taking the DR behavior randomness into account. Based on electricity demand-price elasticity, a unified electricity demand response model is proposed. Then, according to the power consumption statistical data in different sectors, the statistical models of industrial, commercial and residential loads are established respectively. Finally, the sector load elasticity assessment model and the multi-user load elasticity assessment model are derived from the unified model and the statistical model above. By applying to the load elasticity assessment of a city in China, the validity and practicability of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Optimization Based on Demand Response Considering Locational Marginal Carbon Price
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of global warming, carbon pricing mechanism has become an effective tool for more and more countries to incentivize people to reduce carbon emissions. The carbon price links the cost to the source, sending an economic signal to emitters to cut emissions. This paper proposes the concept of locational marginal carbon price (LMCP) and develops a low-carbon economic optimization model based on demand response considering LMCP, by which the carbon emission cost of generation side can be transmitted to load side, and the demand response mechanism established on this basis can guide low-carbon consumption of users. Finally, a case study based on the improved PJM-5 bus system is given to verify the effectiveness and rationality of the model in reducing the carbon emission of the system.

articleTitle: Air-Cooled PEMFC Temperature Cooperative Control and Low Temperature Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the relationship between the optimal operating temperature of the air-cooled PEMFC stack and the ambient temperature, humidity and operating current through experiments. The air-cooled fuel cell voltage model, stack temperature model and working chamber model are established. A collaborative control system based on fuzzy PID stack temperature and working chamber temperature based on BP neural network is designed, and the control effect of the control system in low temperature environment is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Economic Evaluation of Data Center Power Supply System Based on Electric Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electric energy router (EER) is gradually introduced into the power supply system of data centers to make the system operate more efficient and flexible in order to deal with the issue of the connection of the fluctuant renewable resource. This paper puts forward three feasible schemes for power supply system of data center with the PV generation and the EER. To evaluate the best performance of the data center power supply system, an optimization model is proposed with an improved EER loss model, in which the EER loss is described as a quadratic polynomial to each port power of the EER. By solving the optimization model, two indexes of minimum operating cost and power supply and distribution efficiency are obtained to evaluate the 3 schemes of the data center power supply system. Then the scenarios of the PV output variation in different seasons are analyzed, and the synthesized indexes based on the above 2 indexes are used to give an overall evaluation to the 3 schemes of the data center power supply system, in which the probability of each scenario is taken as the weight coefficient. The results show that the EER could provide more flexible operation modes to consume the fluctuant renewable PV resource while making the system operate in a better efficient way and the evaluation method considering the multi-scenario could be a reference for the analysis of the networking solutions or schemes.

articleTitle: A Flexibility Assessment Method of Thermal Storage Electric Heating Load Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the dynamic process modeling of heat loads, this paper puts forward a flexibility evaluation method for thermal storage electric heating (TSEH) load clusters. Firstly, heat load demand model is established. Then, the heat load demand power in different periods is calculated based on the temperature data from numerical weather prediction (NWP) at different periods of the next day. A dynamic model is established for the storage state of heat storage equipment. Under a peak-valley electricity price curve, an optimization model of heating equipment operation is established. Flexibility evaluation indexes are proposed for heat storage electric heating loads, including cross-period energy shift and real-time power flexibility. These indexes can be obtained through simulation. Case studies shows that the peak-valley electricity price can guide the TSEH load to shift from the peak load period to the valley load period, which alleviates the peak regulation pressure of traditional units. The upward and downward power regulation capacity of TSEH load can provide ancillary services such as automatic generation control (AGC), reserve to the power system, which is in favor to balance the power fluctuation of new energy generation.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Consumption Strategy for Residential Users Based on Time Series Analysis of Electricity Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid technology, load regulation on the demand side has become a flexible approach for load peak shaving and renewable energy accommodation. In this paper, an optimal wind power consumption strategy is proposed based on the time series analysis of electricity load. In view of the periodicity of residential load on both working days and non-working days, the double seasonal ARIMA model is applied to predict users’ behavior and the adjustable electricity load for wind power consumption. In addition, the difference between residential load and wind power generation is taken as the objective function for optimal power consumption. The problem of wind energy consumption is solved by prioritizing residential load according to the correlation between the load series and wind power series in each time slot. Experimental results demonstrated the reliability and accuracy of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization Study on the Control Strategy of DC Line Fault Recovery for Yongren-Funing HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The ±500kV Yongren-Funing HVDC transmission project is the first HVDC project whose sending and receiving ends are both located in the same province. When DC line fault happened under the condition of inter-communication fault between the pole control systems of the rectifier and inverter stations, the HVDC system cannot be blocked because of the frequent repeating actions of the DC line fault recovery in the inverter station. In order to solve the problem, an optimal control strategy of direct blocking HVDC system was proposed to solve the above issue. The optimization control strategy was verified by RTDS simulation. The simulation results showed that the proposed optimization control strategy of the DC line fault recovery could solve the above problems effectively. The proposed strategy has already been implemented on site permanently, which has great significance for the HVDC/UHVDC transmission projects in operation currently.

articleTitle: Voltage Optimization Method for PV Accessed Distribution Network Based on Local Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The penetration of distributed photovoltaic in the distribution network is gradually increasing, and its impact on the safe and stable operation of the power grid is increasing. At present, there are some problems in the distribution network, such as insufficient reactive power compensation and backward voltage regulation. Moreover, the communication capacity in the distribution network is insufficient, and it is difficult to realize the centralized control of the distributed photovoltaic system. There is a serious problem of voltage quality degradation in the 10kV distribution network. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a voltage optimization method based on local coordination control. On the double time scales of hour before the day and 15 minutes within the day, the capacitor reactor bank and distributed power inverter are used for coordination. A few days ago, centralized control was realized through capacitor reactors. In the day, the droop control is applied to adjust the PV inverter to achieve local control and optimize the voltage quality of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis and Control of PMSG Wind Farm on Subsynchronous Oscillation of Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) of synchronous generator (SG) induced by the grid connection of wind farms, this paper incorporates time-domain simulation and measurement discrimination method, analyzing the influence of PMSG wind farms damping characteristics of different SSO modes on SG. Using the signal discrimination method, the free response characteristics of SG rotor speed disturbance are observed, the interaction between PMSG wind farm and SG is identified, revealing the effect on the SSO of SG from PMSG wind farm operational conditions and control parameters. By adding a subsynchronous damping controller (SSDC) to the PMSG wind turbine, the SSO of SG is restrained. At last, verifying the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis and control strategy, which is based on PSCAD time-domain simulation.

articleTitle: Study of Secondary Market Trading on Customer Side with Participation of Multiple Types of Load Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the high efficiency operation of the new power system "source-load interaction" mode, it is needed to fully explore the regulation potential of the adjustable load on the user side. At this stage, the mining of user-side resources is mostly focused on the primary regulation market directly participated by some of the large users and load aggregators, while the trading potential of users within aggregators in the secondary market is less examined. Therefore, in this paper, we study the secondary market trading on the customer side agented by load aggregators, hoping to enhance the load regulation potential while also promoting the consumption of new energy and reducing the deviation of user-side electricity consumption. Finally, the paper concludes with the example analysis to verify the effectiveness of the trading.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Simulation Analysis of Hybrid Electric-heat Complementary Heating System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of the social economy and the advancement of the urbanization process, the application scale of the district heating mode based on cogeneration and district boiler rooms is expanding in northern China. Facing the carbon peak and carbon neutrality strategy, how to realize the carbon reduction of the central heating system still needs in-depth research. With the advancement of the construction of a new power system under the large-scale integration of renewable energy, the gradual implementation of electric energy substitution is of great significance for the low-carbon transformation of the heating industry. This paper proposes a new hybrid electric-heat complementary heating mode. We establish the simulation model of the hybrid electric-heat complementary heating system and analyze the configuration scheme of the electric heating equipment in combination with the specific case. The hybrid electric-heat complementary heating mode can further improve the system performance compared with the centralized electric-heat complementary heating mode. The higher the proportion of electricity replacing the heating load, the more noticeable this optimization effect is.

articleTitle: Improving HVRT of Offshore Wind Farms by Bunding with Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high voltage ride through (HVRT) performance of the multi-offshore wind farms and thermal power plants bundled system (MOWTPPBS) meets the standard requirements, which is one of the key technologies to ensure the safety and stability of the system. This paper investigates the effect of bundled thermal power plants on the HVRT capability of multi-offshore wind farms. The theory analysis show that the thermal power units can increase the short-circuit ratio (SCR) of the MOWTPPBSs; At the same time, the thermal power units can also regulate reactive power into the MOWTPPBS by the excitation regulator according the terminal voltage variations. Both the two above aspects can improve the HVRT capacity of the MOWTPPBSs. Finally, a model of an actual MOWTPPBS is built on PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the reasonableness of the above research results.

Author Keywords: multi-offshore wind farms and thermal power plants bundled system (MOWTPPBS)

articleTitle: Smart Meter Clock Management Method Supporting to Time-Of-Use (TOU) Tariff Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to the requirements of "the notice on further improving the TOU price mechanism" issued by the National Development and Reform Commission, this paper introduces a clock management method of smart meter based on HPLC communication module. The system scheme is based on HPLC network clock synchronization technology. The module can synchronize with the accurate perpetual calendar clock on the terminal side, and it can also monitor and calibrate the clock of smart meter. For the 2009 smart meter that cannot set parameters remotely, its communication unit can be replaced by IOT edge management unit. The IOT edge management unit contains a motor module, which can drive the mechanical arm to operate the programming key of the smart meter. When updating the TOU price parameters, the mechanical arm can automatically press the programming key to realize remote parameter update. This solution can solve the problems of clock over tolerance and parameter update in the implementation process of TOU electricity price strategy. It does not require personnel to participate on site, and can ensure the successful implementation of the TOU price policy and the accuracy of real-time settlement.

articleTitle: Coordinated Management for Off-grid Photovoltaic-Electrolyzer Systems with Battery Storage Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The production of green hydrogen from renewable energy sources using water electrolyzer (EL) devices is a promising approach to achieving a low carbon economy. This paper presents a coordinated management strategy for an off-grid Photovoltaic (PV)-EL system considering energy consumption by both hydrogen production and PV array reconfiguration. Firstly, a dynamic array reconfiguration (DAR) method is proposed to mitigate the mismatch losses and thus reduce the output fluctuation of the PV array under the mismatch conditions. Then, an optimal energy management scheme is proposed to coordinate the PV array, the battery and the EL to minimize the daily operation and maintenance (O&M) cost and degradation cost of EL and batteries. The proposed strategy is assessed through a test PV-EL system, and the numerical results confirm its validity. The proposed DAR method can improve the maximum power generation of the PV array under different mismatch conditions, and the proposed optimal energy management scheme can effectively utilize batteries to coordinate energy consumption by both hydrogen production and PV array reconfiguration.

articleTitle: A Novel EMI Attack Exploiting the Control Vulnerability of Photovoltaic Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed generation(DG), the penetration rate of photovoltaics(PVs) in the power grid continues to increase. Therefore, various security issues faced by PV inverters have also become a major challenge to ensure the stability of the power grid.Due to the complex and open environment of PVs, attackers are more likely to access key devices such as grid-tied inverters, thereby causing damage to the entire power grid. Taking advantage of the above characteristics, this paper proposes a novel electromagnetic interference(EMI) attack against inverters, instead of cyber attacks that have been explored well in many other research works. It injects a bias signal into the PV inverter sensor through EMI, so as to change the sensor value finally transmitted to the controller. An attacker can tamper with the sensor value in this way. This paper also analyzes the vulnerability in the inverter control algorithm, and exploits the vulnerability to cause damage to the inverter through EMI attacks.The attack was verified on a commercial inverter from Texas Instruments. We present the induced DC voltage offset corresponding to different EMI frequencies of different sensors to demonstrate that EMI attacks can independently control different sensors on the inverter. In addition, we also analyze the inverter control algorithm and the possible consequences of attacks, further evaluate the consequences of the attack through simulations (we do simulations instead of real device tests to ensure safety). And the results show that this novel attack can shut down/burn the PV inverter.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Methods for Solving Partial Differential Equation of Gas Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The one-dimensional dynamic flow process of gas in the pipeline can be described by a set of partial differential equations (PDEs), which are usually solved by numerical methods. This paper conducts a comparative analysis of and numerically compares several existing methods for solving PDEs, including the finite difference method, finite volume method, characteristic line method and the energy circuit theory proposed by recent research. The case study takes the results of the software Pipeline Studio as the benchmark, and compare and analyze the existing methods in terms of accuracy and speed for several cases with different pipeline parameters. The research conclusions provide a reference for the subsequent dynamic simulation research of natural gas pipeline network.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Hybrid On-Load Tap-Changer for UHV Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The on-load tap-changer (OLTC) is the core component of the converter transformer, which can realize the non-power-off and load regulation of the winding turns on the converter transformer grid side. At present, the transformer onload voltage regulation technology is a mechanical OLTC. However, as the scale of the power system becomes larger and the structure becomes more complex, the mechanical OLTC has two difficult problems to solve. One is that the mechanical contacts generate arcs during the switching process, and the other is that the mechanical transmission structure is complex, the failure rate is high, and the maintenance is large. Aiming at the shortcomings of mechanical OLTC, this paper proposes a hybrid OLTC topology, which uses power electronic devices to replace the vacuum interrupter, has the advantages of no arcing in the switching process, simple switching core structure, real-time monitoring of operation status and so on. Based on the technical parameters of the ±800kV OLTC, the working principle and switching sequence of the OLTC are analyzed, the ±800kV hybrid OLTC prototype is developed, and the test verification are carried out. The results show that the design of the hybrid on-load tap-changer is correct.

articleTitle: Short Term Power Load Forecasting Based on Image Matrix
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of short-term power load forecasting, this paper proposes a load forecasting method based on image matrix. This method converts the time series of power load into a visual graph(VG), then extracts statistical features from the visual graph, captures the fine-grained features of the time series, and constructs the image matrix of the sequence. Finally, it inputs the load forecasting model based on convolutional neural network. Compared with the traditional load features based on time series, the image matrix has more fine-grained load features. The experimental results show that the short-term load forecasting accuracy of the proposed is better than the time series.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of an Energy Hub with Multiple CCHPs for High Efficiency and Low Emissions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal operation for an energy hub with multiple combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) systems is proposed to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and improve energy efficiency. The proposed model comprises a compound objective function to minimize operation cost and GHG emissions, and a set of constraints to represent multi-energy storage, nonlinear multi-energy coupling of CCHP, and multi-energy conversion. Due to the nonlinear relationship of power efficiency and GHG emissions with the CCHP load rate, multiple CCHPs with different capacities can be reasonably scheduled, and the power for each subsystem is optimally allocated to satisfy the electricity, cooling, and heating demands. Finally, the optimal operation of an EH with multiple CCHPs is examined. Simulation results show that the proposed operation has advantages in improving energy efficiency and reducing GHG emissions, compared with the single CCHP model.

articleTitle: Modern Maintenance Strategies Prescriptive Approach Using Machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With most industrial processes requiring electric motors for all their pumps and drive mechanisms, it is not always possible to have the all the sensors that include axial movements, drive and non-drive-end temperature monitors, and if you combine all these sensors the cost of which outdo the cost of replacing the motor. It is of importance that the evaluation of the cost of downtime thereof is done to ensure whether the spent on such sensors is viable. The characteristics of the motor will always change with differing surroundings, load, and frequency of start-stop and these are the characteristics that have been taken advantage of in this research. The predictive maintenance, in this case, was made from classification models that did categorize the following critical factors that affect the performance of the small motors that include surrounding environment and running temperature, motor speed, and load current. Several experiments were carried out with the motor to find out which classification model gave the best results.

articleTitle: Unified Modeling and Verification of Renewable Energy Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Establishing the detailed transient models with consistent fault response characteristics of the actual new energy generation units is the basic problem in analyzing modern power systems with large-scale renewable energy accessed power grid. The complete low voltage ride-through (LVRT) processes of the renewable energy model are illustrated and analyzed based on the LVRT grid standards and a large number of actual data fitting studies. The active and reactive power response curves and realization schemes of these renewable energy generators during the LVRT are proposed through the analysis of their common features. And the above strategies are utilized in the double fed induction generator (DFIG), permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), and the photovoltaic (PV) power generation unit model, correspondingly. The investigations have shown that the fault responses of those models proposed in this paper are well matched with the measured data, and the accuracies met the requirements of the modeling guidelines of the wind turbine and PV unit simulation models. Thus, the validity of the proposed model has been verified.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization Scheduling of Coupled Power-Traffic System in Mining Areas Considering Time-of-Use Price
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proposal of "double carbon" goal and the advancement of electrification of mining equipment, electric dump trucks will gradually replace the traditional oil dump trucks in mining areas. At the same time, the charging behavior of electric dump trucks makes it no longer suitable for the traditional scheduling mode. In this paper, a collaborative scheduling method for the coupled power-traffic systems in mining areas considering time-of-use price is proposed, where the scheduling model is constructed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example simulation of a medium-sized open-pit coal mine, and the results show that the proposed method can not only reduce the electricity cost, but also help improve peak cutting and valley filling for the power grid. Moreover, considering the stripping ratio, the proposed method can significantly reduce the demand for soil discharge and thus reduce the cost for the proprietor.

articleTitle: A Novel Optimized Gauss Integral for Transmission Line Voltage Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gauss integral method, Chebyshev integral method, and Gauss-Legendre integral method are the main methods used for the non-contact voltage measurement to inverse the electric field. However, these methods don’t consider the influence of sensor position deviation. And the sensor position distribution might be unreasonable in these methods. Therefore, this paper proposed a novel optimized Gauss integral for transmission line voltage measurement, which combines the Gauss integral method and genetic algorithm. Furthermore, position sensitivity constraint condition is taken into the genetic algorithm. It is found that the optimized Gauss integral method improves the calculation accuracy greatly and makes the sensor distribution more reasonable for single conductors and double loop conductors, and for the catenary line, the optimized Gauss integral method used below the highest point of the catenary line is the only useful method.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Operation Optimization Considering Supply-side Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the supply side flexibility of the electricity-heat coordinated integrated energy system during optimal operation. First, the multidimensional modeling of electricity-heat coordinated integrated energy system is studied, and the flexibility model of heat equipment is discussed. Then, the electricity-heat integrated energy system operation optimization model is proposed, with the cost of power generators, heat units and energy-loss penalty considered. Finally, a cast study is applied where the electricity-heat combined system is designed and several different scenarios are compared. The validity of the IES optimal dispatch model of the considering the energy storage characteristics of the heat grid is verified. By comparing the dispatching results with and without considering the flexibility of heat grid energy storage in the integrated energy system, it shows that the improvement of flexibility have an impact on system economy and renewable energy performance.

articleTitle: Statistical Correlation Study of Temperature Humidity Index (THI) and Load in the ERCOT System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The recent development of high-penetration renewable energy resources requires better control and projection of electrical demand since renewables are non-dispatchable. While there are numerous methods for load forecasting, there is a lack of tools to study the load under extreme heat waves from a long-term planning perspective. In this paper, the correlation between a weather-related index called Temperature Humidity Index (THI) and load in the ERCOT system is studied. First, this paper outlines the methods for calculating THI and creating a piecewise linear regression model. Then, a standardized approach to data processing is provided. Next, the correlation of THI and load in the ERCOT system is analyzed and verified. Finally, the paper is concluded with general observations and discussions of other factors affecting THI-load correlation like economic or population growth. The results show that the THI versus load model is a promising tool for projecting load under extreme summer drought conditions.

articleTitle: Control of Magnetic Sensor for Tunable Measure Range
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Magnetic sensor can contactless monitor current in energy system, whose tunable measure range is very desirable in complex scenes. Here we use the Co<inf>x</inf>Fe<inf>3-x</inf>O<inf>4</inf>/(PbMg<inf>0.33</inf>Nb<inf>0.67</inf>O<inf>3</inf>)<inf>0.67</inf> -(PbTiO<inf>3</inf>)<inf>0.33</inf> heterostructure to fabricate the magnetic sensor that can be controlled by electric field. By controlling the components of Co<inf>x</inf>Fe<inf>3-x</inf>O<inf>4</inf>, we obtain the Co<inf>0.2</inf>Fe<inf>2.8</inf>O<inf>4</inf> film device with proper hall resistance and strong response to applied voltage. Under the electric field from - 5kV/m to 5kV/m, an increment of 7.5 times in linear sensing range has been realized in the heterostructure, which is much larger than that in Fe<inf>3</inf>O<inf>4</inf> film. Our finding reveals that the magnetocoupling structure has the potential for controllable sensor.

articleTitle: Research on Output Characteristics of New Energy and Peak Regulation Demand of Power Grid in Ningxia
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the actual output data of wind power, photovoltaic and new energy in Ningxia in 2020, this paper quantitatively analyzes the intra-day, daytime and monthly output characteristics to put priority on the research on the volatility of new energy output in peak valley period, evening peak climbing period and its impact on the peak regulation of power grid. The guaranteed output rate and its difference are analyzed by season. With the load rate distribution of thermal power units after the system reaches balance as an indicator, the peak regulation demand of peak valley and the evening peak climbing of thermal power in Ningxia power grid in 2025 are calculated and analyzed. The relevant conclusions can provide references for the planning and operation of power grid as well as the flexible transformation of thermal power.

articleTitle: Study on the Compatibility of Typical Materials in GIT with C4F7N/CO2 Gas Mixture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To explore the compatibility of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixture and typical materials used in gas insulated transformer (GIT), thermal accelerated aging test was carried out and the gas mixture after test was analyzed by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) to estimate the interaction intensity between the reactants. The results showed that most of selected materials have good compatibility with C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixture except for polyester cushion block and bakelite nut which caused C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N decomposed into C<inf>3</inf>F<inf>6</inf> and C<inf>3</inf>F<inf>8</inf>, indicating poor compatibility between the gas mixture and polyester cushion block and bakelite nut.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Robust Economic and Carbon Emission Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A two-stage robust optimization model with min-max-min formulation is proposed for the cooling-heating-electricity-gas integrated energy system (IES), respectively with the optimization objective of minimizing operation cost and carbon emission. The uncertainties of photovoltaic (PV) output and electricity demand are considered. The middle and inner layers are reformulated into a single-layer optimization by using duality theory and big-M method. The outer layer searches for the electricity purchase or sale decision considering the worst-case scenario, determined by the middle and inner layer. Column and constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm are employed to solve the two-stage model. Case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the presented model and shows the different scheduling results under the economic and carbon emission objectives.

articleTitle: Research on X-ray Detection Robot System for Gas Insulated Switchgear or Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Both gas insulated switchgear (GIS) and gas insulated transmission line (GIL) are applications of gas-insulated metal closure technology, while GIL is very close to the coaxially placed bus bars in GIS. This paper systematically investigates the detection method of X-ray imaging technology for mechanical type defects inside GIS/GIL. The X-ray visual detection system is used to carry out visual online detection of GIS/GIL equipment, enabling timely and effective detection of structural defects in bus bars, switchgear components and other parts. A GIS/GIL oriented X-ray detection robot system is also designed, and the X-ray visual detection system is mounted on a detection robot arm, which has a positive effect on ensuring the safety and efficiency of field detection.

articleTitle: Calculation and Simulation Analysis of Current Carrying Capacity and Thermal Effect of 500kV Tunnel Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau contains the most abundant clean energy such as hydropower, wind and solar in the world. However, it is very difficult to add overhead transmission lines on the ground due to the complex geographical environment. The large-capacity tunnel cables which is less affected by the earth surface environment, may play an important role on the energy transmission in such area. Based on the cable thermal circuit model, the electrical-magnetic-thermal multiphysics coupling of the cable is modeled in COMSOL Multiphysics. The parameter changes of the material during the temperature rising process, the influence of different ventilation conditions and different current-carrying capacities on the changes of the cable temperature field are quantitatively analyzed. The results show that the proposed model is valid in certain conditions. The research on the current carrying capacity and thermal effect of tunnel cables is of great significance for the transportation and consumption of large-scale clean energy resources.

articleTitle: Study on Power Feedforward Control Strategy for PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy and DC load, there are more and more occasions for both new energy generation and power grid to supply power to DC load. In this paper, when photovoltaic and mains power supply DC load at the same time, the grid stabilizes the DC side voltage through AC/DC. When the illumination changes greatly, the traditional double closed-loop control shows a certain degree of hysteresis, which leads to the DC side voltage cannot be adjusted in time, and the whole system dynamic performance is not ideal. To improve the DC bus voltage control dynamics, this paper introduces the load power and photovoltaic output power into the model prediction direct power control loop. Based on simulation results, the variation of DC voltage of the proposed control strategy is smaller than that of the former when the illumination changes sharply. After that, the Fourier analysis of the grid side current also shows that the proposed strategy makes the grid side harmonic content less, which verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the strategy.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Distributed Photovoltaic Access to Active Distribution Network with Different Permeability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper establishes a simulation model for the impact of the development of high-proportion distributed photovoltaic power on the distribution network, and studies the impact of distributed power on the power quality, electrical equipment and economic operation of the distribution network under various scenarios such as different access locations and different penetration rates. It is concluded that the harmonic voltage distortion rate of load nodes also monotonically increases with the increase of photovoltaic capacity, which provides a scientific basis for the collaborative planning technology of distribution network.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization of Magnetic Energy Harvesters with Field Shaping Capacitors for Energy Ethernet Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive circuit analysis method for the operation of magnetic energy harvesters with field shaping capacitors (FSC) feeding constant voltage load. The Chan model is used to model the saturation behaviour of the magnetic core and then a circuit model for the magnetic energy harvester with nonlinear inductance is constructed. Detailed analysis on the circuit operation and state transitions are provided. A mathematical model is established to replace the circuit model so that the optimization of the system parameters, such as number of turns, load voltage, could be carried out numerically. Simulation results are followed subsequently to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed circuit model.

articleTitle: Generalized Modeling of Energy Hub under Variant Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing concerns about the energy crisis, the multiple energy system (MES) has received extensive attention. The energy hub (EH), which serves as an interface among multiple energies, is an essential tool for MES modeling. Nevertheless, under variant operating conditions, the uncertain efficiencies bring challenges for the EH to accurately portray the MES. For this reason, this paper proposes a generalized modeling method of the EH under variant operating conditions. Based on the classical EH, a dynamic energy hub (DEH) considering the off-design characteristics is formulated. An efficiency correction sector is added to determine the efficiencies of converters and storage infrastructure during dispatching. Technically, polynomial fitting is used to establish the off-design models of common converters and storage infrastructure. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed generalized modeling method, which helps to promote the accuracy of the dispatching optimization of the EH under variant operating conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Management for Multi-energy Microgrid Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy microgrid (MMG) is a promising form of energy system, which can integrate various forms of energy and provide an important means to accommodate renewable energy sources. However, its internal complex energy structure and equipment coupling relationship also bring challenges to its operation optimization. To minimize operating costs, an energy management strategy is proposed in this paper considering integrated demand response. On the supply side, energy storage devices are used to realize the flexible transfer of energy. On the demand side, a integrated demand response model including interruptible loads and shiftable loads is constructed, and a response compensation mechanism is proposed. On this basis, with the goal of mini-mizing the sum of the system operating cost and the response compensation cost, comprehensively considering the schedulable resources on both sides of supply and demand, a multi-energy complementary MMG optimization model is established. The simulation results show that the proposed energy management strategy can effectively improve the energy supply flexibility and operational economy of the system.

articleTitle: Power Generation Characteristic Analysis from Natural Gas Pressure Reducing Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The utilization of residual pressure resources in natural gas pipeline network is one of the key technical paths to achieve the dual-carbon goal. The analysis of pressure energy output characteristics is the basis to support its efficient utilization. An analysis method for natural gas pressure energy output characteristics is proposed. First, a parallel natural gas pipeline network pressure energy power generation system architecture is proposed. Secondly, establish a natural gas network model and various load demand models, and calculate the flow rate of the pressure regulating station. Then, based on the theory of thermodynamics, a mathematical model for the analysis of pressure energy output exergy was constructed, the spatiotemporal characteristics of pressure energy output were analyzed, and a volatility index was proposed to measure the pressure energy output characteristics. Finally, taking a natural gas pipeline network in a city as an example, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Research on Non-intrusive Load Monitoring Based on Seq2point Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the training efficiency of load disaggregation and identification, this paper will use a deep neural network architecture based on sequence-to-point ( Seq2point ) to study the non-intrusive load disaggregation and identification method. Convolutional neural network is used to extract load characteristics and efficiently mine the temporal relationship between input and output. The model is compared with the mainstream model on the public dataset UK-dale, and the recall rate, precision rate, Matthews correlation coefficient(MCC) and Mean absolute error(MAE) of power estimation are used as evaluation indexes to evaluate the model. The results show that the model greatly shortens the training time while maintaining a low disaggregation error.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Automatic Data Backup of Cascade Basin Power Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cascade centralized control center contains multiple hydropower stations with interconnected energy sources. How to realize the backup management of the core production and operation data of multi-energy interconnected cascade centralized control center is an important technical problem that needs to be solved urgently. In this paper, the safe and convenient script language based on linux operating system is adopted, and the encryption algorithm is combined to check the security of transmission process and man-machine interaction. The remote automatic backup of real-time production data of cascade centralized control centers and hydropower stations based on energy interconnection is realized, which improves the efficient management and low-cost maintenance of production data of power generation enterprises.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Robust Planning Scheme for Simulating Renewable Energy Integration Considering Versatile Low-Carbon Policies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the power industry is the largest source of carbon emissions, it is necessary to study the low-carbon planning of power supply expansion. This paper proposes a two-stage power expansion planning model considering carbon emission control, which evaluates two policies that directly and indirectly affect carbon emissions, namely the carbon tax policy and the renewable portfolio standard policy (RPS) is expected to reduce CO2 emissions. Considering the risks brought by the uncertainty of wind power output and load demand to power planning, a two-stage power expansion planning model based on robust optimization is established. Finally, the feasibility of the model proposed in this paper is verified by example analysis. The results show that the carbon tax policy can reduce carbon emissions, and the implementation of RPS can increase the proportion of new energy and be more resistant to uncertain fluctuation risks, which can be used in actual planning, providing support for formulating relevant low-carbon policies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Industrial Load Demand Response Potential Considering Incentive Intensity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of demand response execution, the incentive intensity directly affects the demand response potential of energy-intensive enterprise. Taking the silicon carbide enterprise as an example, firstly, the production process of silicon carbide and the adjustment characteristic of key equipment smelting furnace is analyzed. Then, a refined cost model that considers various costs and benefits of demand response is established, and the optimization goal is to minimize the operating cost of the enterprise. Finally, the influence of different incentive subsidy on the user's demand response potential is analyzed. The research results can support demand response incentive subsidy price setting and demand response potential assessment.

articleTitle: Multi-source Data Fusion Method in Monitoring Domain Based on Structural Similarity-Text Clustering and Ontology Glossary
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data fusion is necessary for achieving muti-source data integration in power grid monitoring. In order to address the low accuracy of current data fusion approaches, this paper suggests a multi-source data fusion model based on structural similarity-text clustering and ontology glossary. The model uses the ontology glossary to store the clustering results and utilizes the DBSCAN algorithm based on structural similarity comparison to fuse the data. Finally, this paper compares the above model to the traditional k-means and DBSCAN model using data from the grid. The results demonstrate that the model in this paper has a higher data fusion accuracy, which suggests this model may successfully raise the level of data integration for power grid monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Selling Pricing of Electricity Retailers Considering the Independent Choice of Users
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the opening of Chinese power sales market, electricity retailers have become the emerging main body of the market, and power sales is the core business of electricity retailers. In the process of formulating power sales packages, electricity retailers should not only provide diversified packages for users, but also consider the subjective wishes of users. Therefore, this paper studies the pricing of electricity retailers considering the independent choice of users. First of all, this paper designs the structure and package of electricity retailers participating in the electricity market; Secondly, the user utility model is used to describe the user's response behavior to different packages, and the logit model is used to describe the user's choice behavior; Then, the pricing optimization model is constructed by considering the cost-benefit of the electricity retailer participating in the power market transaction. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: A State Estimation Solution Method for Electricity-Gas Integrated Energy System Based on AWPSO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electricity-gas integrated energy system (EGIES) can not only realize the energy conversion between electricity and natural gas, but also effectively improve the energy utilization rate and promote the low-carbon transformation of the energy system. State estimation technology can provide accurate operation state data for the system, and is the key cornerstone of safe and reliable operation of the system. However, the improper selection of the initial value of the gas grid in the EGIES will cause the convergence difficulty of the state estimation solution, and bring challenges to the stable operation of the EGIES. Therefore, a state estimation solution method of EGIES based on (adaptive weight particle swarm optimization) AWPSO is proposed in this paper. The EGIES measurement model was established; the EGIES state estimation model is constructed based on (weighted least square) WLS; the constraint is treated as a penalty function, and an unconstrained EGIES state estimation model is established and solved by AWPSO. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method have been verified by a case study of an EGIES coupled with a14-node power grid and a 7-node gas grid.

articleTitle: A Review on Interactive Technology between Residential Users and Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Improving the level of interaction between residents and the power grid is an important goal of the new power system construction. Firstly, this paper proposes the technical framework of interaction between residential users and power grid based on the power consumption information acquisition system. Secondly, it compares various networking methods and propose a feasible indoor networking scheme. Thirdly, it designs residential energy gateway based on IoT smart meter. Finally, it proposes the interactive control method and the coordinated operation strategy of household multi equipment. The research results of this paper have certain reference significance for promoting the interaction between power grid and residential users.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Adversarial Attacks Method on Power System Based on Model Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Artificial intelligence algorithms fit connections between features and problems from a data-driven perspective. Artificial intelligence algorithms perform iterative training of data through neural network, which provides a new thinking dimension for researchers. The researches on the power grid field are no longer limited to modeling and analysis through traditional physical mechanism methods. However, there are security risks on the neural network model established by artificial intelligence algorithms. Attackers apply model extraction attacks to structure a substitute model of target power system model, which supports other attack algorithms to attack the power system and ultimately affects the normal operation of power system. This paper proposes an enhancement method for adversarial attacks on power system based on model extraction algorithm and tests the promoting effect of adversarial sample attack in various scenarios.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Optimization of Park Integrated Energy System Based on Operation Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The carbon emission optimization method for park integrated energy system (PIES) based on operation simulation is proposed in this article. Firstly, an optimal mathematical dispatching model of PIES was built in this paper to make an accurate operation simulation of PIES. Secondly, the particle swarm optimization algorithm with good global search ability is used to solve the dispatching problem. Thirdly, the evaluation model and optimization method of carbon emission in PIES are proposed based on emission factor approach. Finally, a case study is given to simulate the PIES under different strategies. There conclusions are made by this work. The simulation results indicates that the model and algorithm can reduce the carbon emission of PIES even though it is not efficient economically. Currently, the economic benefits from gas are still the big problem for reducing the carbon emission. The price of clean electric is expected to reduced. The emission factors of both electric and gas are still high. The clean energy is very essential to reducing the carbon emission.

articleTitle: Wide-band Harmonic Coupling Characteristic Analysis of Thyristor Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wide frequency range of harmonic components introduced by the extensive access of power electronic equipment to the power grid will induce the phenomenon of under-damped high-frequency oscillation and harmonic amplification in the increasingly power electronic power grid system, which threatens the safety and reliability operation of the system. With the continuous improvement of the response frequency band of the power electronic grid system, it is necessary to conduct a more comprehensive research and description of the broadband port characteristics of the thyristor rectifier, to provide technical support for the broadband interactive response analysis of power electronic devices. So this paper analyzes the relationship between the port voltage and current of the thyristor rectifier, and establishes a small-signal model based on the harmonic transfer function matrix (HTF). The model can accurately describe the frequency coupling characteristics in a wider frequency range. On this basis, an on-demand truncated HTF description method suitable for usage scenarios is proposed. At last, the accuracy of the proposed HTF modeling results is verified by simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Control of 6-DOF Manipulator Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of sea ice sampling and analysis in polar environment, a six degree of freedom manipulator control system is designed and studied. The system is based on the robot operating system platform through the motion planning library moveit! And the visual chemical tool rviz, which controls the UR3 manipulator with six degrees of freedom, carries the pneumatic software clamping claw, and uses the sensor kinect-v2 depth camera to realize object recognition, automatic grasping of the manipulator and ice drilling sampling in the simulation and experimental environment.

articleTitle: State Monitoring of High Proportion Distributed New Energy in Distribution Network Based on Power Flow Optimization Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the global climate change, lightning strikes become more and more frequent, which brings challenges to power system operation. Based on this background, this paper monitors and optimizes the distribution network with high proportion of distributed new energy under the condition of lightning weather. Firstly, with the importance of each branch ranked, the risk assessment model based on dynamic lightning protection is established. Then the economic loss objective function is established, and constraints are set up. Taking IEEE33-node as an example, CPLEX is used to solve the problem and the feasibility of the optimal control strategy is analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of a Special Skill Training Apparatus That Can Imitate High Loss Transformer Power Supply District
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a design for a special skill training apparatus that aims to provide a scene wherein trainees can improve their abilities in diagnosing what provokes a high loss in electricity supplies and finding solutions to it in order to train line loss management skills of workers in the electricity power industries. The apparatus’ fundamental components are control elements and metering devices such as 3-phase electric power meters, single phase electric power meters, and corresponding acquisition terminals, with many virtual power sources to behave like an electric load. They have a similar organization and topological link to genuine electric power metering sites, but more controllable. The device's operation is managed by a customized computer that has been programmed and installed with a set of software. The software's main purpose is to provide a UI interactive interface for implementing specific parameters that allow the device to imitate irregularities that cause large line losses in the transformer power supply district. A line loss rate will be calculated automatically following the settings under a given algorithm in order to maximize the imitation. After its manufacture, the device has been used in the training of workers in the power marketing sector, and the completion of all features increased their skill levels to some extent.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Islanded Microgrid Based on Flexibility Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of "double carbon" policy, the access of renewable energy in the power system has increased significantly, and the impact of its uncertainty on the system operation cannot be ignored. In order to improve the islanded microgrid's ability to cope with the uncertainty of renewable energy. Firstly, the index of matching degree of flexible supply and demand (MDFSD) is established based on flexibility margin theory, which is able to reflect the ability of the system to respond to load within a certain period of time. Then, the optimal operation model of microgrid is established, taking the operation cost and MDSDF index as the objective function, considering the constraints of power balance and equipment operation, and the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve it. Finally, the example analysis shows that the proposed model can effectively improve the system's ability to cope with uncertain output and improve economic benefits. The rationality and validity of the model are verified.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Transient Modeling of Large-Capacity Offshore Full-Converter Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modeling the wind turbine, consisting with on-site fault ride-through response characteristics, is the premise to analyze the safety and stability of the power system with highpenetration wind power.
