Existing methods are mostly aimed at the simulations of small-capacity units under typical conditions, and rarely take the considerations of comprehensive simulation and verification of different voltage sags at various operating points simultaneously. To overcome this problem, based on the "black box" model of a certain-type offshore wind turbine, the model is divided into two parts: the main and control circuits. And thus, a general electromagnetic transient modeling method is proposed for large-capacity offshore wind turbines, under various operating conditions. For the main circuit, a general topology of a large-capacity full-power wind turbine, consisting of a typical half direct-drive rotary system, a neutral-point clamped parallel three-level converter and a protection circuit module, is constructed; for the control circuit, the neutral point potential balance controller and low-voltage ride-through controller in symmetry and asymmetry conditions are constructed. Through comparisons with the response characteristics of the actual wind turbine in whole fault ride-through process, it is found that they are consistent, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed modeling method.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Integrated Electricity-Water System Based on Darcy-Weisbach Formula
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Nowadays, the integrated energy system (IES) has become an inevitable development trend for energy systems. With the deepening coupling relationship between the power system and the water network, the advantages of the integrated electricity-water system (IEWS) in reducing operating costs and improving energy efficiency are highlighted gradually. However, the existing research on the state estimation (SE) of IEWS ignores the difference of various kinds of pipe’s head loss formulas. This paper proposes an integrated state-estimation framework for IEWS based on an accurate head loss formula for pipes which considers the influence of fluid physical properties with a broader application scope in flow rate. Bi-level SE framework calculates the friction factor of all pipes to get a precise SE model. Finally, a test IEWS which consists of an 11-node water network and an 18-bus power system is used to verify the effectiveness of the computational framework at high flow rate.

articleTitle: Research on Inertia Allocation Scheme for Improving Frequency Safety and Stability Characteristics of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase in the proportion of new energy power generation and DC power generation outside the region, the inertia demand under the frequency security constraints is becoming more and more urgent. Firstly, the relationship between the frequency response characteristics of the power grid and the total inertia of the system and the relationship between the frequency distribution characteristics of the multi-machine system and the inertia distribution are analyzed. Aiming at the frequency safety constraints of the power grid, an estimation method for the minimum inertia demand of the system is proposed. Considering the frequency distribution characteristics of the power grid and the distribution of load, new energy and direct current, the distribution scheme of inertia among different regions in the synchronous power grid is proposed to guide the arrangement of the power-on and output of the synchronous units in the system. The simulation analysis based on the actual large power grid in East China power grid shows that for the power system with large amount of new energy generation and DC feed, the method can effectively reduce the maximum deviation of frequency and the difference of time-space distribution, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Operation of Multi-integrated Station with New Energy Resources Based on QPSO
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the operation of the multi-integrated station with new energy resources, this paper constructs the overall architecture of the station and the model of wind turbine, photovoltaic, battery and flexible load response, considers the constraints such as the power balance in the station, the upper and lower limits of the wind turbine and photovoltaic output and the upper and lower limits of the battery capacity, adopts the QPSO optimization algorithm, then takes the life cycle cost, the loss of power supply probability (LPSP) and the energy excess percentage (EXC) as the optimization objectives, optimize the operation of the multi-integrated station with new energy resources. The influence of different flexible load response on the station cost is analyzed through a case study. It is verified that the proposed operation mode considering flexible load response can effectively minimize the station cost, reduce the energy storage configuration capacity, and reduce LPSP and EXC. This operation mode improves the new energy accommodation and the economy of the multi-integrated station, so that both suppliers and users benefit at the same time.

articleTitle: Grid Optimization Based on Sensitivity Analysis for Limiting Short-circuit Current of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing scale of the power system, short-circuit current (SCC) of power system is growing. This paper proposes a grid optimization model based on sensitivity analysis considering three strategies to limit SCC, including transmission switching, transmission line unconnected to substation, generator outage. In the model, three strategies are modeled as admittance matrix transformation by the Adding Branch Method, which is also an efficient method to calculate the sensitivities for limiting SCC in various strategies. This paper studies the effect of each strategy on SCC limiting. On this basis, a set of measures to limit SCC is determined by the maximum value of comprehensive sensitivity coefficient. The grid optimization model leads to a mixed integer linear programming (MILP), considering power flow constraints and power supply and demand balance constraints. The effectiveness of the grid optimization model is verified by several case studies, which are including IEEE 57-bus test system and local Henan Power System.

articleTitle: A Decision-Making Approach and Updating Strategy for Prosumer Participations in Transactive Energy Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The concept of transactive energy(TE) markets is proposed to promote the local consumption of renewable energy and stimulate the regulating potential of flexible resources. Some users with distributed resources or regulation capabilities are transformed into prosumers with both production and consumption attributes. They can trade energy through bidding to get more benefits. Limited by information and decision-making capabilities, prosumers do not know how to fully use their resources to maximize the benefits under their personal preferences. This paper proposes a multi-objective segmented quotation and volume distribution approach for prosumers to make trading decisions. It can integrate risk and return and achieve the full deployment of available resources. In addition, an automatic strategy updating rule is also designed for prosumers who are unfamiliar with the market environment. It is conducive to helping producers further understand the market, adjust their strategies, and thus increase their earnings. Finally, examples are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. It shows that the method can assist prosumers in making trading decisions, adjusting trading strategies and achieving personal income growth eventually.

articleTitle: Influence of LCU and Governor Combined Control of Hydropower Unit on Power System Frequency Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous optimization and adjustment of power grid structure in China, the frequency characteristics of power system also change. The frequency problem of hydropower high proportion power system is becoming increasingly prominent. After the system disturbance, the grid frequency faces the double test of slow recovery speed and low oscillation damping. In order to more accurately analyze the regulation characteristics of system frequency, it is necessary to comprehensively study the dynamic characteristics of the unit active power/frequency control system. The active power/frequency regulation of hydropower units is realized by the local control unit (LCU) active power control of the computer supervision and control system (CSCS) and the governor. The primary frequency regulation characteristics of the governor have been accurately mastered in the current electromechanical transient simulation of the system, but the influence of LCU of the unit CSCS on the frequency characteristics is less considered. In this paper, based on the full investigation of the operation status of active power joint control of main hydropower units in southwest power grid, the simulation model of LCU power closed-loop control was established, and the key parameters were measured. The influence of LCU active power joint control of CSCS on frequency oscillation damping was analyzed from the mechanism. In the simulation example, the influence of LCU active power control on frequency dynamic damping level and frequency recovery level was analyzed.

articleTitle: Plant Control Parameter Identification of Renewable Energy Station Based on Improved Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Comprehensive analysis of wind farm performance is highly dependent on the knowledge of plant control. The plant control parameters are diverse and commonly unavailable in practical power stations. In this paper, a discrete mathematical model of the plant control from the western electricity coordinating council (WECC) is developed. Based on this discrete model, a modified least square method is proposed to identify the control parameters of this typical plant control. The modified least square method employs a variable forgetting factor, offering an accurate identification with relatively high calculation efficiency. The data needed for identification is obtained by injecting disturbance signals into controller inputs and measuring controller outputs. The proposed parameter identification method of the plant control is validated in a wind farm simulated in PowerFactory of Digsilent. The proposed method is proven to be effective and accurate.

articleTitle: A Data Fusion Approach for Searching Fault Chains in Power Grid over Datasets from Multiple Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is a challenge to search fault chains for facilities in power grid to provide rapid warning for the smart power grid. In this paper, a data fusion approach for searching fault chains (DF-FCS) is proposed. We take into account the factors for the association between facilities in the fault chains in power grid, such as the operation states, fault risks, spatial distance and fault time when the cascading faults occur. Based on the datasets from WAMS, SCADA and GIS systems, the metrics and the process for determining the initial and successive faults of facilities in fault chains are presented. Experiments over the real datasets from local network of China Southern Power Grid showed the effectiveness and accuracy of DF-FCS.

articleTitle: Optimal Charging Network Operation to Provide Responsive Reserve Considering Electricity and Carbon Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continuous deployment of renewable energy sources requires dispatch power load flexibly to balance the power system continuously. The large-scale application of electric vehicles presents an opportunity for power grid flexibility. In this paper, we consider a charging network operator providing responsive reserve considering electricity and carbon markets. We model this scenario as a mixed-integer linear programming problem, which aims to maximize revenue containing incentive subsidies and charging profits. The numerical case study shows that the charging network operator preferentially meets the contract demand in the reserve market if the incentive subsidy is more profitable than charging EVs. Meanwhile, the LMPs play a significant role in affecting the charging operator decisions.

articleTitle: Combination Faults Protection Method Based on Negative Sequence Impedance Angle in Resonant Grounding Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Overvoltage in the distribution network of arc suppression coil grounded system may result in single-circuit arbitrary two points earth faults. If two fault points fall on different line sections, the first section of the faulty line protection will have the problem of rejection. In order to enable the protection to operate, a negative sequence impedance angle-based protection method is presented for single circuit arbitrary two points earth faults in arc suppression coil grounded system. Firstly, We establish a compound sequence network and a negative sequence network with single circuit arbitrary two points earth faults. Following this, the analytical expressions for the negative sequence current at the first end of the line and the negative sequence voltage at the bus bar are derived. Then by dividing the negative sequence voltage by the negative sequence current at the busbar at the head of the line, the negative sequence impedance of the line can be determined. PSCAD simulations show that the proposed protection method is independent of the location of the point faults and the transition resistances, as well as having low communication requirements.

articleTitle: Short-term Operation Optimization Considering Demand Response and Energy Storage Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proportion of renewable energy (RE) integrated into the grid increasing quickly in recent years, the problem of system flexibility is becoming more and more serious. Therefore, this paper proposes a short-term optimization strategy that considers two flexible resources: demand response (DR) and energy storage (ES). With the goal of minimizing system operating costs and curtailing RE, a mathematical model of short-term optimization considering interruptible demand response (IDR), transferable demand response (TDR), and ES is established. The contribution of different types of flexible resources to improving the RE utilization of the system and reducing load shedding in extreme operating scenarios is compared. Finally, the XJTU-ROTS example is used to verify the validity of the proposed method. The results show that even in extreme scenarios, the RE utilization and load shedding become better, and the flexibility of the power system is improved after considering DR and ES.

articleTitle: Coupled Thermal-Electrical Analysis of 110 kV Corrugated Aluminum Sheathed and Smooth Aluminum Sheath Cables Based on Finite Element Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to compare the thermal and electric field distribution inside the 110 kV smooth aluminum sheathed cable and the corrugated aluminum sheathed cable, an electro-thermal coupling model of the 110 kV corrugated aluminum sheathed cable and the smooth aluminum sheathed cable is established in this paper by means of finite element simulation. The calculation results show that the load capacity of the smooth aluminum sheathed cable is greater than that of the corrugated aluminum sheathed cable, and the internal thermal and electric fields of the smooth aluminum sheathed cable are more uniformly distributed without electric field distortion. The existence of the air gap increases the thermal resistance inside the corrugated aluminum sheath, making the temperature difference between the inside and outside of the corrugated aluminum sheath cable larger and increasing the thermal energy dissipation. Moreover, the junction of the air gap and the metal sheath increases the electric field strength.

articleTitle: Multi-scenario Applications of Wind Farms with Double Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The new power system with a high proportion of renewable energy as the main source is developing rapidly, and the randomness and volatility it brings greatly affects the stability of the power system. Energy storage can effectively improve the system stability and it is widely used in power generation, transmission, distribution and consumption. At present, the cost of energy storage is relatively high, the profit method is single, so it is necessary to study multi-scenario energy storage to share the cost. This paper proposes a multi-functional scenario coordinated operation strategy of battery energy storage system(BESS) for wind farms(WFs). Energy storage charging and discharging control strategies for three scenarios of primary frequency regulation, power prediction compensation and new energy consumption in WFs are studied. At the same time, in order to reduce the number of switches from charging to discharging and to prolong the lifespan, the BESS is divided into two parts with independent control, which also realizes a collaborative operation under multi-scenario. One year's historical data of a WF are utilized to simulate operations of the BESS-integrated WFs. Life cycle cost of energy storage, multi-scenario benefits, and profits attributed to the BESS are subsequently quantified. Simulation results show that the proposed methodology is effective.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of Offshore Oil and Gas Platform Group Based on Electricity-Gas Shared Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of shore power has brought a new energy structure to the offshore oil and gas platform group. In order to further reduce the operating cost of offshore oil and gas platform groups, this paper proposes an economic dispatch model for offshore oil and gas platform groups based on electricity-gas shared energy storage. First, the energy structure of the offshore oil and gas platform group is analyzed, and the load model of the oil and gas production unit is established. Then, the mathematical model of the energy storage device is constructed and the electric-gas shared energy storage mode is proposed. Finally, an optimal scheduling model is established with the goal of minimizing the running cost. Taking an oil and gas platform group in the Bohai Sea as an example to simulate, through the analysis and comparison of three scenarios, the effectiveness of the model in this paper in reducing the configuration of energy storage capacity and reducing operating costs is verified.

articleTitle: Study on Ice Melting Characteristics of Wind Power Transmission Line under High Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional studies on ice melting characteristics mainly focus on relevant calculations for low wind speed. Many wind power lines are located in micro-terrain areas with high altitude and high wind speed. There is always a big difference between melting characteristic values and theoretical calculation values, which may easily lead to ice melting failure or collapse of transmission lines. This paper provides theoretical guidance for wind power line ice-melting by studying the characteristics of wire ice-melting under high wind speed.

articleTitle: Study on the Potential Distribution Characteristics of Substation Grounding Grid Considering Stray Current
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intrusion of stray current from DC metro systems into power grid substations will change the potential distribution of the grounding grid, accelerate the corrosion of the substation grounding grid and affect the normal operation of the substation grounding facilities. Therefore, this paper reveals the influence of underground stray current on the grounding grid of power grid substations. This paper takes into account the interference of underground stray current and establishes a substation grounding grid model. This paper analyses the influence of factors on the potential distribution law of the grounding grid conductor, such as the location of underground stray current intrusion, materials for grounding grid conductors and grounding grid size. By analysing paths of stray current intrusion, considering the grounding grid size, depth, grounding resistance and other characteristics, a substation grounding grid simulation model is established, and for the two known paths of stray current intrusion into the substation grounding grid through soil and cable armour, the stray current are equated respectively as a current source injected into earth and directly connected to the grounding grid, and the substation grounding grid conductor potential distribution law and its influencing factors are studied. The results show that the substation grounding grid conductor potential distribution is mainly affected by the location of the cable armour grounding point, the grounding grid conductor material and the grounding grid specification.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Configuration and Operation Control Strategy in High Ratio Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the dual carbon target, the penetration of renewable energy in the power system is gradually increasing. Due to the strong stochastic fluctuation of renewable energy generation, energy storage is considered as an important method to maintain the balance of power supply and demand in the power system. First, the cost of power supply is modeled by grid operation stability considering energy storage, wind power. The loss of load and the abandoned wind power are involved in improving the wind power consumption rate as penalty terms. Next, the energy storage capacity configuration in long-time scale is combined with the energy storage charging and discharging strategy in short-time scale. Then, the two-stage optimization algorithm is used to find the energy storage configuration scheme and dispatching strategy including charging and discharging control of energy storages to cooperate with the wind power. Finally, the results show that the reasonable configuration of energy storage can improve the reliability and economy of the system including wind power.

articleTitle: Refined Modeling and Simulation of Dynamic Response of Variable-Speed Pumped-Storage Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pumped storage technology is currently the largest-scale energy storage technology. Pumped-storage plants (PSPs) can help integrate variable renewable energy, such as wind and solar power, thus playing an important role in establishing a reliable, sustainable, and clean energy system. Variable-speed pumped-storage plant (VSPSP) has become a state-of-the-art technology in the pumped-storage industry in recent years. In dealing with the intermittency of variable renewable energy, variable-speed pumped-storage plant needs to change its working conditions frequently, thus causing inevitable transient processes, which may lead to dangerous accidents if without proper countermeasures. In order to predict transient processes and avoid dangerous accidents, a refined model of VSPSP is built in this work. The prototype of the model developed in this work is the first VSPSP in China, which is still under construction. The model is validated by comparing its simulation result with that provided by the manufacturer, which used a commercial simulation software SIMSEN. Different working conditions are also simulated to prove the application of the refined model. The model proposed in this work can provide a practical tool for research and engineering purposes.

articleTitle: Series-Connected SiC MOSFETs Module with a Single Gate Driver
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of power electronics technology, the technological innovation of each generation of power semiconductors will have a profound impact on the generation, transmission, conversion and distribution of electrical energy, and has made outstanding contributions to the advancement of human civilization and economic and social development. In recent years, a new generation of wide-bandgap semiconductor power devices has developed vigorously, and new material switching devices such as SiC and GaN MOSFET have entered people's field of vision, which has brought new historical opportunities for the performance improvement of power electronic equipment, as well as new challenges. This paper presents a series-connected SiC MOSFET switching module topology with a single gate driver. Then, the working principle including static state and switching transition is analyzed. The LTspice simulations in the third section validate the analysis and show the usability of the series-connected SiC MOSFET stack topology using a single gate driver.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning of Microgrid-Level Regional Integrated Energy System Based on Cooperative Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional energy system planning generally maximizes the global or individual economic benefit of certain entities, which is somewhat subjective for particular decision maker. However, each participant may have different personalized consideration in the energy market. Therefore, a general cost-revenue model for multiple market entities in the microgrid-level regional integrated energy system (RIES) is firstly proposed in this paper, considering the life cycle cost of each unit. Furthermore, based on the game theory, four types of game models for capacity planning of RIES are developed, and the existence of the game equilibriums is mathematically demonstrated. The profit improved game strategies for units in the microgrid-level RIES are obtained, using the iterative particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm. Numerical case analysis verifies the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed model, and it also validates the merits of stable cooperative game models comparing to non-cooperative game models.

articleTitle: Frequency Support Demand Analysis of High Non-synchronous Resource Penetration Receiving-end Power Grid Based on System Frequency Response Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase in the scale of external High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission and renewable energy power generation in the receiving-end power grid, the problem of frequency stability has gradually become prominent. This paper analyzes and studies the frequency support demand of the receiving-end power grid for the typical scenario that the power shortage caused by the HVDC blocking fault causes the system frequency to drop. Firstly, the System Frequency Response (SFR) model of the receiving-end power grid is constructed, and the trajectory sensitivity analysis of the model parameters is carried out to clarify the influence of each parameter on the frequency at different stages of frequency response process. Then, the improved SFR model considering non-synchronous resource penetration is established, the analysis method of inertia and primary frequency regulation demand of the receiving-end power grid is proposed. Finally, the applicability of the proposed method is verified by a simulation example of East China power grid.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Market Performance Considering the Complementarity of Wind Park Cluster
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power systems with high penetration of renewable energy enrich the frequency regulation resources by offering more new clean wind and solar energy. In this paper, we present a bottom-top design of wind park’s participation in the frequency regulation market considering the complementarity of wind park power outputs. By defining a quantitative complementarity index, we show how the complementarity contributes to the regulation reserve reliability of wind parks and the consistent market performance, and verify the conclusions via numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Power Dual-carbon Path Optimization Model with Coal-fired Power Function Reconstruction Being Considered
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increment and stock of traditional power supply will continue to be replaced by the new energy with the characteristics of randomness, intermittence and volatility under the dual carbon goals. While ensuring a safe and reliable power supply, it is urgent to study the method to scientifically plan the function positioning and development rhythm of coal-fired power under the dual-carbon path of power. First of all, three coal-fired power functional roles in the future were put forward in the research: “flexible regulation”, “emergency standby” and “net zero decarburization”. Then, with the consideration of the internalization of the external environmental cost of carbon emissions, a power dual-carbon path optimization model with coal-fired power function reconstruction being considered is constructed, aiming at economic optimization. On this basis, a dual-carbon path simulation optimization model of China’s power industry from 2020 to 2060 is built by using the self-developed software GESP-V. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Current Carrying Capacity Between 110 kV Corrugated and Smooth Aluminum Sheathed Cables Based on Thermal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To compare the operating parameters of 110 kV smooth aluminum sheathed cables and corrugated aluminum sheathed cables, the thermal resistance, loss coefficient and current carrying capacity of the two are calculated by means of an equivalent thermal path analysis. The results show that the thermal resistance and losses of the smooth aluminum sheathed cable are less than those of the corrugated aluminum sheathed cable, which results in a load capacity of 776.88 A for the smooth aluminum sheathed cable, an increase of 10.8% compared to the load capacity of the corrugated aluminum sheathed cable. It is an indication that smooth aluminum sheathed cable has better economic and application prospects compared to corrugated aluminum sheathed cable.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Accommodation Ability Evaluation of Power System with Large-Scale Cascaded Hydro Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a method on evaluation of annual accommodation ability of high renewable energy penetrated power system with cascaded hydro power plants is proposed. Firstly, an aggregated cascaded hydro power operation model is established and a long-term unit commitment model with cascaded hydro power, thermal, wind and photovoltaic (PV) plants is formulated. The objective of the formulated model is maximizing the power generation of renewable energy, and constraints of load balance, system reserve, and operations of each power plants are considered. Secondly, the hourly power series of renewable energy is incorporated as inputs which contain theoretic power outputs of wind, PV and natural water inflows of each cascaded hydro power plant. Thirdly, a monthly sequential decomposition algorithm is adopted to solve the long-term unit commitment model. Finally, the proposed method is tested on a high renewable energy penetrated power system with large-scale wind, PV and cascaded hydro power. Testing results indicate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Flexible Coordinated Control Strategy of Energy Storage for Distributed Photovoltaic Consumption Scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of abandoned light and difficult control in the process of distributed photovoltaic grid-connected power generation, the main circuit structure of photovoltaic energy storage integration is considered, a flexible coordinated control method based on the state of charge (SOC) of the energy storage unit is proposed. The control principle of bidirectional PWM converter and the overall control structure of photovoltaics and energy storage unit are analyzed. Taking full consumption of photovoltaics as the control goal, the proposed control method fully utilizes the advantages of flexible control and fast power response of the energy storage unit, and the characteristics of bidirectional energy flow of the PWM converter, so that the energy storage unit can not only supplement the load power shortage, but also absorb the photovoltaic excess power. Finally, the proposed coordinated control strategy under different working conditions is simulated in Matlab/Simulink, which effectively verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Communication Information Security between Residents and Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to restrain security risk in interactive communication between residents and power grid, this article designs a set of communication security scheme that does not rely on ESAM. First, analyzes the security issue in interactive communication between residents and power grid. Second, hierarchical authentication and data object access authority control mechanisms are designed to safeguard data access security. Third, the communication security scheme for public network and private network is designed. Encryption key transmission flow is also designed. This scheme is of great significance in guiding communication security between residents and power grid and the secure access of downstream equipment.

articleTitle: Online Identification of Boiler Heat Storage Coefficient for Accurate Analysis of Primary Frequency Regulation of Steam Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The steam unit actually utilizes the heat storage in the boiler for primary frequency regulation (PFR). Therefore, the heat storage coefficient in the IEEE boiler model is important for accurate analysis of PFR of steam unit. However, the heat storage coefficient is not a constant but changes with the working condition of the unit. This paper proposes an online identification method of boiler heat storage coefficient. The thermodynamic process in boiler is analyzed and a dynamic mechanism model is derived from continuity equation, momentum equation and energy conservation equation. Then synchronous discretizations of both time and space are applied to simplify the model. Parameters of the model can be obtained with online parameters of working medium collected from the distributed control system of the unit. Finally, boiler heat storage coefficient is identified from response of the boiler model to a step change of control value opening. The method can obtain the boiler heat storage coefficient at the actual working condition and help to improve the accuracy of PFR analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Peak Shaving and Valley Filling Potential of Power Demand Side Response Based on Typical Large Industrial Users
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper selects 8760 load data of typical large users in a province, constructs relevant mathematical calculation models, and puts forward the specific process required for the assessment of peak shaving and valley filling potential of demand side response. Then, the net load characteristics of the province under real-time electricity price are analyzed, and the best power demand side response period is selected. Finally, the potential of peak shaving and valley filling of demand side response is evaluated for typical large users in the province, and the demand side response is modified for the original load curve, providing technical guidance for such large users to participate in the demand side response curve and scale.

Author Keywords: peak shaving and valley filling potential

articleTitle: Research on Weight Allocation Method of Renewable Energy Consumption Responsibility Based on Subjective and Objective Comprehensive Decision-making
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the enthusiasm of society to consume renewable energy power, in this paper, a weight allocation method of renewable energy consumption responsibility based on subjective and objective comprehensive decision-making is proposed. Based on various factors such as total electricity consumption, renewable energy consumption and profitability, this method adopts the combination of objective calculation and subjective evaluation to determine the weight index of consumption responsibility of various responsibility subjects, which provides a new realization approach and calculation basis for the allocation of consumption responsibility in provincial regions. The proposed method is verified by an example based on the registered market players of a provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Enhanced Random Crop with Data Augmentation for Insulator Detection in Complex Backgrounds
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the automatic inspection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), improving the detection accuracy of insulators will not only help further insulator state detection and fault diagnosis but also contribute to the early landing of the UAVs’ automatic inspection system. In this paper, we propose a data augmentation method based on the random crop to improve the detection accuracy of insulators. Firstly, it ensures the validity of the label by generating a patch that contains the centers of all ground truth boxes. Secondly, it achieves a balance between protecting the ground truth and random cropping by limiting the area ratio of each ground truth box before and after random cropping. We find that these two steps increase the attention of the model to the insulator. On the self-made insulator dataset, the solution achieves 91.2% and 89.3% mAP in YOLOv3 and RetinaNet respectively, which is 3% and 1.5% better than the random crop.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimal Scheduling Strategy for Electric Vehicles with Small-Signal Stability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To reduce the regulation pressure of generator with small-signal disturbance, a bi-level optimal scheduling strategy for electric vehicles (EVs) with small-signal stability constraints is proposed. The upper optimization model aims at minimizing the active power regulation of the generators and optimizes the scheduling plans of EVs agents by optimal power flow. The lower optimization model takes the charging demand of EVs users as the goal, optimizes the charge/discharge power of EVs under the constraints of the upper scheduling plans. The proposed strategy can improve the small-signal stability of power grid. Meanwhile, it reduces the regulation of the generator and ensures the charging demand of EVs users. The numerical simulation is carried out on an improved IEEE-14 bus system, the test results verify the effectiveness of the strategy.

articleTitle: An Industrial Park Load Shedding Scheme Based on Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load shedding scheme is utilized to deal with black-outs caused by continuously growing loads. Conventional load shedding scheme repressively shed interruptible loads ignoring the economic profits of them. This paper proposes a smart contract based load shedding scheme in an industrial park. The proposed scheme incentivizes factories in the industrial park to actively shed their interruptible loads by designing a market that maximizes the total social welfare. Furthermore, the load shedding process is implemented using a smart contract to automatically obtain trustable and transparent load shedding results. The modified IEEE 33-bus distribution case proves that the proposed load shedding scheme effectively increases the profits of all participating factories and incentivizes them to shed their interruptible loads.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Household Solar-Heat-Storage Coordination Control Software Module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed heating of Chinese residents is one of the main forms of energy consumption, but in the context of carbon neutrality, it faces the challenge of carbon emissions. And single electric heating in rural areas faces the economic constraints of power grid expansion. Relying on the easy-to-use and ubiquitous controller, the coordinated control of solar-heat-storage can effectively alleviate the problem of economic constraints. This paper proposes a coordinated optimal control algorithm for solar-heat-storage suitable for the integration of terminal resource capabilities, and through the simulation verification, the design of the coordinated control software module for integrated terminal solar-heat-storage is completed. The solar-heat-storage microgrid system achieves certain economic benefits, and obtains the power sequence for sale and purchase between the household solar-heat-storage microgrid and the external power grid, which is beneficial to the coordinated control of the solar-heat-storage comprehensive resources.

articleTitle: Research on Load Forecasting of Multi-scenario Building Air-Conditioning Based on TSO-LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a short-term air-conditioning load forecasting model of multi-scenario building based on Tuna Swarm Optimization (TSO) algorithm and long short-term memory network (LSTM). The model uses the TSO algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters of LSTM, which solves the problem that the manual selection of hyperparameters of LSTM neural network is difficult to obtain the optimal results. The TSO algorithm has the characteristics of fast global convergence and high searching optimal ability, which can optimize the number of neurons in the hidden layer, learning rate, and training times of the LSTM neural network. Through the analysis of different case data, the forecasting effect of the proposed algorithm is verified. Forecasting results of LSTM, PSO-LSTM, and TSO-LSTM algorithms are compared in different scenario building airconditioning load, which shows that the proposed TSO-LSTM algorithm has better accuracy and rapidity.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Coordinated Optimal Control Strategy of Cascade Hydro-PV-Pumped Storage Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the new energy is connected to the system, it will have a great impact on the operation of the power grid. The continuous storage capacity of cascade hydropower and the rapid regulation capacity of variable-speed pumped-storage units can smooth the photovoltaic output and improve the safety and stability performance of the power grid. Based on the three typical application scenarios of wet season, flat season and dry season, this paper introduces the structure configuration and functional design of the coordinated optimization control system for cascade Hydro-PV-PumpedStorage in detail, and the control strategy is tested and verified in the demonstration project; The test results show that the combined operation of the cascade Hydro-PV-PumpedStorage integrated system can realize the "measurable, controllable and adjustable" of the combined transmission, and the results of the project can provide useful reference for Hydro-PV complementary engineering projects.

articleTitle: Modeling Dynamic Carbon Emissions in Power System Based on Nodal Carbon Intensity Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system is the main force in the battlefield of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality. A fresh look at the power system from a carbon perspective will provide a better reference for the low-carbon transition, and how to better portray the carbon emission pattern of the power system at all times becomes the key to related research. Based on the carbon emission flow (CEF) theory of the power system and the idea of macro dynamic carbon emission factors, this paper proposes the concept of the real-time zoned carbon emission factor. User nodes with similar carbon intensities are divided into the same region through a density-based clustering method, and the dynamic carbon emission factor of this region will be shared with all users inside. The algorithm is assessed through a dynamic simulation study on the IEEE 30-bus system and the results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed solution. By this means, carbon emissions in the power system can be presented in a real-time zoned format, which is useful for the demand-side response as well as power system planning and green power dispatch.

articleTitle: An Adaptive LQR-Based Defense Strategy against False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of cyber-physical power system, the security risk caused by false data injection attacks on the power system is increasing. Due to the covert characteristics of false data injection, the existing detection methods can be deceived and lead to power system overload. To solve this problem, an adaptive defense method based on the linear-quadratic form (LQR) is proposed. Considering the impact of attack on the physical system, a physical dynamic model of the power grid is constructed. Taking the covert characteristics of false data injection attack into account, the adaptive LQR controller-based defense method is developed. Through the design of parameters of LQR, the proposed controller can respond quickly to deceptive attacks. Then, the developed LQR-based adaptive control method can ensure the stability of the system as soon as possible after being attacked. Finally, the performance of the proposed control method to restore the stability of power systems under false data injection attack is verified on the IEEE 5-bus.

articleTitle: Analysis on Operation Characteristics of Arc Suppression Device for Grounding Phase Voltage Actively Reduced Based on Phase Power Supply Feedback in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the risk that gap arc overvoltage can not be completely suppressed by the traditional arc suppression coil and serious phase short circuit overcurrent can be caused by the fault phase transfer device in the case of developmental fault, the active step-down arc suppression method of ground fault phase based on power supply potential feedback was proposed. When a single-phase grounding fault occurs, a grounding transformer and a single-phase step-up transformer are used to extract the system line voltage opposite to the fault from the secondary side of the grounding transformer, and then the neutral point of the grounding transformer is injected through the single-phase step-up transformer. adjust the transformer ratio of the single-phase boost transformer, suppress the voltage at the fault point below the recovery intensity of the arc medium at the fault point, realize arc flameout and prevent arc reignition, so as to effectively restrain the fault arc. The current flow direction and magnitude of each phase when the device is put into operation under different grounding modes were analyzed, and the fault was verified and tested in PSCAD/EMTDC simulation environment and 10kV real distribution network laboratory. The results show that the correctness of the proposed method and analysis was verified, which provides a reliable basis for device design and selection.

Author Keywords: voltage actively reduced of arc extinguishing

articleTitle: Collaborative Planning of Integrated Energy System in the Campus Considering the Operation Characteristics of Combined Cooling Heating and Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The core of the existing comprehensive energy system in a park is combined with cooling, heating and power. CCHP park, which is the core equipment for the exchange of electricity, gas, and cold and heat energy in the comprehensive energy system.

articleTitle: Research on the Regional New Energy and Its Complementary Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The modern power generation mode is transforming from traditional thermal power to new energy. Compared with traditional thermal power, wind and solar energy are renewable energy sources whose main advantages are clean, pollution-free and sustainable. At the same time, its resources are also characterized by randomness, intermittency and volatility. Effectively utilizing the complementarity of solar and wind energy resources in terms of geographical and resource characteristics, and rationally constructing wind-solar hybrid power generation systems will be of great significance to smooth the output of the system. In this paper, we design the Kendall index evaluation standard to represent complementary characteristics. In terms of short-term wind-solar complementarity, we took February 2019 as an example to calculate the Kendall rank correlation coefficient in the day, and plotted the data within one month as a line graph. The short-term wind-solar complementarity characteristic results are judged by whether the combined wind and solar output can meet the daily load peak and valley power consumption. We also illustrate the long-term complementarity by calculating the Kendall rank correlation coefficient of wind and PV output in different months and seasons.

articleTitle: A Method for Power System Stability Assessment Using Simulation Results
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to automatically determine system stability using simulation results to improve research efficiency, a data-driven method for stability assessment is proposed in this paper. The main idea is to analyze the phase-plane trajectories of extracted simulation waveform envelopes. The whole framework of the proposed method along with principles of envelope extraction and phase plane analysis method is introduced in this paper. In the end, two cases and corresponding results are provided to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Flexible Control Strategy of Micro Gas Turbine Generation System under Multiple Operation Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Micro gas turbine (MGT) generation system is one of the important components of comprehensive energy systems. MGT generation system has multiple operation modes including start-up, grid-connected and islanded operation mode. Different control strategies are used for each operation mode, and switching control strategy is required when the operation mode changes. Based on control flexibility of the bidirectional converter, the flexible control strategy for MGT generation system is proposed in this paper. The control signal of the flexible control strategy is the weighted combination of the control signal of grid-connected operation mode and that of islanded operation mode. The DC voltage is dominant in the control signal of the flexible control strategy in the case of grid-connected operation mode, while both the grid-side AC voltage and DC voltage are dominant in the case of islanded operation mode. Thus, the flexible control strategy can be adapted to multiple operation modes automatically. The proposed flexible control strategy of MGT generation system is verified by simulation on the Matlab/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Wireless Control and Synchronization Method for Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In DC transmission systems, modular multilevel converters are typically equipped with hundreds of submodules. The coordination and control between submodules are usually done through wired communication, which leads to complex hardware composition and the high wiring cost of the control system. This paper proposes a wireless communication-based control method for modular multilevel converter submodules to address the above problems. The method adopts a distributed control structure, and the central controller broadcasts the coded synchronization signal and the modulation reference signal to the submodule controllers. After clock synchronization by the submodule controller, a pulse width modulated waveform with good synchronization is generated by decoding the modulation reference signal. In addition, a carrier synchronization technique based on wireless communication is proposed. In this paper, a low-power single-phase modular multilevel converter is built in a laboratory environment. Experimental results show that the proposed wireless control method is comparable to wired control in terms of effectiveness.

articleTitle: P2P Electricity Trading Method in Community Microgrid and Blockchain Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) electricity trading market can effectively promote distributed energy resources (DER) electricity consumption in blockchain environment. Promoting the consumption of DER electricity should consider not only the supply side, but also the demand side. For the demand side, different users have different preference, which should be considered in the trading process. In this study, we propose a P2P electricity trading method of community microgrid considering user preference differences in blockchain environment. Firstly, the model structure and trading rules are introduced. Then the P2P trading process is described in detail. Finally, the proposed model is simulated on the Hyperledger Fabric platform. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively promote the consumption of DER electricity, reduce the electricity cost of users, and meet user preference.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control of Independent Optical Storage DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of DC load, the DC microgrid is expected to become the mainstream topology of future distribution networks. To solve the problem of DC bus voltage stability of microgrid caused by complex disturbances such as intermittent energy and random load switching of photovoltaic DC microgrid, this paper first establishes the corresponding mathematical model based on the volt-ampere characteristics of DC microgrid and uses the characteristics of energy storage system to develop an adaptive droop control strategy to ensure that the bus voltage is constant. MATLAB / Simulink simulation examples and experimental tests verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Harmonic Power Flow Algorithm Considering Electrified Railway
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traction load is a critical unbalanced load for power systems with electrified railway, imposing voltage distortion and impairing power quality by injecting harmonic currents. This paper proposed a harmonic power flow algorithm for the power systems with a large number of traction loads. Firstly, the harmonic currents induced by the electric railway traction power supply system are quantitatively calculated, whose characteristics are analytically evaluated. Then, the mathematical models of the power system devices considering harmonic currents are derived to form the harmonic admittance matrix. Based on the established linearization models, the harmonic power flow algorithm is elaborately designed. Furthermore, an actual power grid with traction load in China is adopted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. Case studies have shown that the proposed method has merits of high accuracy with significantly reduced computational burden.

articleTitle: A Series of Methods on Improving Energy Efficiency of Boiler
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Several dominant factors of influencing the energy efficiency of boiler have been found out with respectively the analysis the measurement results obtained by the input-output (direct) and the heat loss (indirect) methods. A series of methods on improving energy efficiency of boiler have been researched within those factors. The air temperature entering into the boiler should be monitored in real time to control the excess air coefficient and avoid oxygen excess. The heat-exchanging equipment can be installed on the gas flue to preheat the water entering into the boiler with waste heat of flue gas. Moreover, the thickness of water scale has a significant effect on the energy efficiency of boiler. As the thickness of water scale increases 1 mm, the loss of energy efficiency for boiler will increase more than 6%. Therefore, it is essential to soften water and periodically remove water scale in boiler system.

articleTitle: Time-of-Use Steam Price Optimization Study Based on User Response Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To provide demand-side optimization solutions for steam heating systems, this paper proposes an optimization method for steam time-of-use (TOU) pricing based on the analysis of user response characteristics. First, establish a model of steam heating system, then based on the demand response theory of price incentive, the optimal TOU pricing model of steam heating system is established considering the difference between supply and demand loads based on the analysis of the topology of the system and the user response characteristics. Taking an industrial park in Jiangsu in Jiangsu, China as an example, the results show that the peak-valley load differential can be reduced by up to 31.7% and the cost of purchasing is reduced by by ¥ 83,000.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method and Application of Power Grid Material Suppliers Based on Entropy Weight TOPSIS Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper constructs a holographic multi-dimensional evaluation index system for power grid material suppliers from five dimensions, including the qualification capability, production and supply, installation service, operation quality, and cost of power grid material suppliers. Through the evaluation method based on the entropy weight TOPSIS model. This paper conducts an empirical study on four power grid material suppliers. The research has effectively improved the rationality and efficiency of supplier selection.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-objective Planning Optimization of Regional Integrated Energy System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Studying the regional comprehensive energy system is an important way to reduce the energy cost, promote the consumption of renewable energy, improve the energy supply reliability and energy utilization efficiency, and reduce environmental pollution. In view of the problems of single planning technology and less resource type setting in the optimization of regional integrated energy system, this paper analyzes the integrated energy system architecture, constructs the typical structure energy flow diagram of integrated energy system, establishes the multi-objective planning optimal model, using the model to solve the lowest pollutant emission, and the model is scientific and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Side Resource Regulation and Optimization Strategy Under Hierarchical and Partition Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet technology, power grid regulation presents more intelligent and diversified technical requirements. Therefore, a hierarchical and regional regulation architecture is proposed to achieve flexible and dynamic regulation of demand side resources. Among them, the control subjects of multi regions can realize the interconnection of resources through multi-level regulation, and can optimize the control of demand side resources through horizontal cooperation among load aggregators. Finally, the effectiveness of the horizontal cooperation strategy is proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on Frequency Optimal Control of Receiving-End Grid Based on Pumped Storage Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to ensure that the recipient grid fed by large-capacity and volatile renewable energy can maintain the system frequency stability and prevent frequency collapse, this paper establishes a mathematical model of pumped storage condition conversion, and combines the theory of condition conversion of pumped storage power plant units and the frequency response characteristics of the recipient grid to establish an optimization model for frequency stability control of the recipient grid. Based on the fact that the pumped storage support can improve the frequency stability performance of the receiving-end grid, a simulation model is established to verify the effectiveness of the model in this paper, taking an actual receiving-end grid as an example.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Demand Forecasting Method Considering City Maturity under Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy load forecast is different from traditional electric energy load forecast to a certain extent, and it can not be regarded as a simple independent forecast of electricity, heat and gas loads. On the basis of fully considering the multi-energy coupling characteristics of the three loads at different user sides due to different process requirements, this paper proposes a weighted average combined forecasting to obtain the three loads per unit land of the city. Then, based on the development maturity of urban land, the load forecast value is revised to obtain the improved forecast value of electricity, heat and gas load in X city in the next five years.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of A CCHP System Model Integrated with P2G for Decarbonization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To realize the dual carbon policy, the goal of energy saving, and emission reduction, it is important to develop ways to better promote the low carbon economic operation of energy systems. Therefore, this research proposes an optimal operation strategy considering the electric-gas-cooling-heat demand response. Considering the demand response of each participant, an integrated energy system model with photovoltaic, wind energy, and traditional grid as energy supply. Also, electric energy, natural gas, cooling, and heating subsystems with co-production are established. With minimizing the overall system operation cost and optimizing environmental protection, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the multi-constrained objective optimization problem. Finally, the optimized model is tested. The results from this study show that the energy system under cogeneration can find a balance between economy and environmental friendliness, and provide a reference for the subsequent energy supply configuration.

articleTitle: HVDC Recovery Dynamics Based Short-Term Voltage Stability Optimization of Receiving-End Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the reduction of local synchronous generators in the receiving-grid, the risk of short-term voltage instability of the system under contingencies increases. During the system recovery process, the dynamic reactive power interaction between the large-capacity HVDCs and the AC grid cannot be ignored. Therefore, this paper theoretically analyzes the dynamic reactive power characteristics of HVDCs, induction motors and synchronous generators in detail. Through the comparative analysis, the critical recovery stage for short-term voltage stability is proposed. Furthermore, a short-term voltage stability optimization method based on HVDC recovery control is proposed. Besides, a quantitative indicator based on trajectory sensitivity is utilized to evaluate the influence of VDCOL parameters and provide a reference for optimization. Finally, the electromagnetic transient simulation based on PSCAD/EMTDC verifies the proposed dynamic reactive power recovery characteristics. After optimization, the short-term voltage stability of the system is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Distance Preservation Ability of Fault Location Features for Data-driven Dynamic Security Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the feature expression of fault location in the data-driven dynamic security assessment, Euclidean distance is generally used to measure the distance between features. However, Euclidean distance cannot accurately reflect the electrical distance relationship between the described fault locations, which limits the further improvement of the accuracy of data-driven dynamic security assessment. This paper proposes the concept of strict distance preservation of fault location features. Based on the fault location feature expression based on the electrical coordinate system, the mathematical definition of strict distance preservation of electrical coordinates is constructed. Based on the distance metric of p-norm, the conjecture that Chebyshev distance is the only distance metric to satisfy strict distance preservation is proposed and proved. Furthermore, the relationship between the distance preservation ability of electrical coordinates and p-norm is analyzed under the Chebyshev distance metric. Taking the transient stability crucial clearing time as an example, the contribution of the preservation ability of electrical coordinates to the accuracy of dynamic security assessment is verified based on K-nearest neighbor algorithm.

articleTitle: Migration and Reproduction Algorithm and Its Application in Hierarchical Coordinating Economic Dispatching of Multi-microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal operation of multi- microgrid system is the basis to ensure the economic and environmental benefits of microgrid operation. For diverse equipment and discrepant load in every micro-grid, the paper proposes a new versatile optimization called Migration and Reproduction Algorithm (MARA), which can be used to solve coordinated dispatching for multi-microgrids system. On the coordinated dispatching strategy model during off-peak periods for multi-microgrid system, simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm can realize that the multi-microgrids system coordinated dispatching more efficient and economic. Meanwhile, Compared with Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) and Harris hawks optimization (HHO), the proposed algorithm is proven with faster convergence speed and better optimization ability.

articleTitle: Robust Black Start Strategy with a High Share of Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy generation is expected to participate in black start in case of blackout events, as they can significantly speed up power system restoration. This paper proposes a startup strategy aiming to improve the black start robustness against uncertainties introduced by wind or photovoltaic power plants. The strategy is composed of a short-term emulation model and a long-term ordered participation model. The short-term model concerns the transient state frequency and voltage stability under black start disturbances. It emulates the regulating capability of the power plants so as to determine if they can withstand the black start events. The long-term model deals with the steady state power and energy balance during black start units ramping. It takes into consideration the uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic power and calculates the confidence power output interval, and thereby prevents generation shortage caused by renewable power fluctuations. Based on the proposed strategy, an ordered participation algorithm is presented for online decision making of black start schemes, which are validated using a practical regional power system based study case. The results show that the proposed method can improve system robustness and stability for black start with wind and photovoltaic power.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Method of Park Integrated Energy System Considering Carbon Transaction Cost
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method considering the carbon transaction cost aiming at the multi-energy coupling and low-carbon operation of the park integrated energy system, By analyzing the structure of comprehensive energy system in the park, the corresponding equipment model is established; considering the stepped carbon transaction cost, the optimal scheduling model of the park integrated energy system is established with the system revenue and user cost as the optimization goals; the particle swarm algorithm is used to simulate and verify the effectiveness of method and model.

articleTitle: Interaction Analysis of two PMSG-based Wind Turbines Connected in Parallel to a Weak AC System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the dynamic coupling problem of parallel PMSG-based wind turbines under weak AC system, a linearized model of the two-turbine parallel system has been established in this paper, and the low-frequency oscillation modes of the two-turbine system was calculated based on the eigenvalue method. By taking wind turbine 1 as the research object, the paper has put forward the damped torque model of the two-turbine system, constructed an analytical expression for the interaction between the turbines through the damping transfer function, and has carried out quantitative analysis on the trend of the interaction with grid strength, working conditions and control parameters in the form of mutual damping coefficients. The results have shown that:1) when the short-circuit ratio increases from 0.8 to 1.4, the mutual damping coefficient increases continuously and changes significantly; 2) as the working condition increases (0.75 MW to 0.95 MW), the mutual damping coefficient decreases continuously and the negative damping effect increases continuously; 3) control parameters such as DC voltage loop and phase-locked loop all influence the mutual damping coefficient.

articleTitle: Precise Voltage Regulation Technology on Load Side of Distribution Network Based on TCSC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Through TCSC technology, the impedance can be adjusted smoothly, the voltage of lines with different parameters or loads can be adjusted, so the load side voltage can be stabilized. In this paper, the differential equation of thyristor conduction time is solved by the method of linear constant system, and the equivalent fundamental impedance of TCSC is derived by mathematical deduction. The series controlled voltage source is used to eliminate the influence of thyristor on voltage drop on the equivalent fundamental capacitive reactance of TCSC. The simulation analysis of TCSC on the voltage regulation of radiation distribution line is simulated to verify that the conduction voltage drop of thyristor will affect the voltage regulation effect of TCSC, and the series receiving voltage source can effectively eliminate this effect.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Photovoltaic Arrays Based on Dropout Optimized Stack Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is difficult for the traditional photovoltaic array fault feature extraction method to include as much fault information as possible, which leads to the problem of low accuracy. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for photovoltaic arrays based on Dropout optimized Stacked autoencoder (D-SAE). Since the deep-stacked network structure of SAE superimposes multiple hidden layers, the model parameters are increased, resulting in overfitting. To prevent the model from overfitting and improve the generalization ability and convergence speed of the model, this paper introduces the Dropout method and the Adam algorithm to optimize the stacked autoencoder. In this paper, the I-V curve is used as the input of the fault diagnosis model, and the fault diagnosis model is established to realize the end-to-end fault diagnosis of the photovoltaic array. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional fault diagnosis method, the D-SAE diagnosis model can not only automatically extract the fault characteristics of the photovoltaic array, prevent the occurrence of overfitting, but also accelerate the convergence speed of the model and improve the generalization ability of the model, the accuracy rate is higher.

articleTitle: Adaptability Analysis of Distribution Network to Distributed Generation Considering Hosting Capacity and Absorption Capability
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of distributed generation in the distribution network, it has become important to evaluate the adaptability of the distribution network to distributed generation. The adaptability of the power grid to DG can be characterized by “hosting capacity” and “absorption capability”. The existing researches mainly focus on the evaluation of either " hosting capacity" or “absorption capability”, and does not involve the active transformation of the distribution network. In this paper, a top-down evaluation method is proposed to evaluate the hosting capacity of distribution network. Then the paper puts forward the reconstruction scheme of the existing power grid and gives the best operation strategy, which can make the power grid absorb DG as much as possible during operation.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control Strategy of Battery Energy Storage Participating in Hydropower Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an improved droop control strategy of battery energy storage (BES) participating in hydropower primary frequency regulation based on fuzzy variable droop regulation coefficient is proposed. The setting of droop regulation coefficient fully considers the influence of the change rate of unit active power and the state of charge (SOC) on the charging and discharging power of BES, so that the BES can be adjusted adaptively according to its own electric quantity and system frequency regulation demand in the process of primary frequency regulation. The simulation of an example shows that the strategy can take into account the effect of system frequency modulation and the effect of maintaining the SOC of BES.

articleTitle: Value-at-risk Optimization Model for Inter-provincial Transaction of New Energy Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The trans-regional and inter-provincial surplus new energy electricity transaction is an important way to overcome the disadvantage of the inverse distribution of energy supply and demand in China and promote the consumption of new energy electricity. This paper focuses on the trading plan optimization of new energy stations in sending-end province, and studies the power optimization method of surplus new energy trading stations. Firstly, based on the probability prediction of the output of the new energy station, the method of calculating the probability distribution of the surplus power of new energy is studied. Then, the conditional value at risk (CVaR) theory is applied to establish and solve the surplus new energy trading power optimization model. Finally, an example is established with the historical data of a certain area to verify the validity of the model and method, and based on the statistical results, a method to determine the reasonable model parameters in engineering application is given.

articleTitle: Closed-loop Simulation Method of Stability Control System Based on Virtual Component Technology
