publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stability control system is an important means to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system. In view of the shortcomings of the existing offline/real-time simulation test methods, a closed-loop simulation scheme based on virtual component technology is proposed. The virtual component technology of the stability control device is researched, and the virtualization method of the external hardware interface of the device is designed. On this basis, a closed-loop simulation framework of the stability control system under the offline/real-time simulation test environment is proposed. The functional logic of each component under the framework are analyzed. The calculation and feedback process of the entire closed-loop simulation system are analyzed in depth, which effectively solves the difficulty of simulation analysis and test verification of large-scale stability control system, providing a new method for the research and verification of stability control system strategy.

articleTitle: Distributed Response Characteristics of PV Cells in String Photovoltaic Power Station During LVRT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the string PV cells are widely used in the large photovoltaic power station with the increase of the PV cell capacity. In the large photovoltaic power station, each PV cell’s characteristic responses differently during the Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) which affected by the distribution position since the PV cells are located in a wide area. In this paper, a detailed string photovoltaic power station model of ideal switching characteristics for power electronics is proposed to analyze the influencing factors of the distributed steady and transient response characteristics of the PV cells during LVRT. The quantitative analysis of influencing factors such as electrical distances, distribution of real power, etc. are presented. The results show that the higher real power output of the PV cell before the LVRT may lead to the larger transient disturbance in the recovery stage of the LVRT. Finally, the validity of quantitative analysis is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Control Strategy of Islanding Microgrid Based on the SOC of Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the dual carbon goal, the existence of microgrid plays an important role in promoting the construction of a new power system with a high proportion of new energy. The microgrid can be connected to the grid or operated in an island, and the microgrid operating in an island can effectively improve the reliability of power supply, and an appropriate control strategy can ensure the long-term safety and stability of the microgrid when it runs off-grid. In this paper, a research on the cooperative control strategy of islanding microgrid based on the energy storage state of charge is proposed. On the basis of the source-load power matching, the SOC of the energy storage system is divided into three intervals, and corresponding control strategies are formulated according to different intervals, according to the size of the SOC, the source load is dynamically adjusted to ensure that the energy storage as the main control unit is not overcharged or overdischarged, and the coordinated control of the microgrid in the island state is realized to ensure its long-term stable operation. Finally, the proposed control strategy is simulated and verified by Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that this method can effectively realize the coordinated control of the island operation, avoid the overcharge and discharge of the energy storage, and realize the safe and stable operation of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium Batteries Based on CNN-GRU Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty in obtaining direct performance parameters such as capacity and internal resistance of lithium batteries, which leads to the low accuracy of predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of lithium batteries, a prediction model based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is proposed. Firstly, four indirect health factors including constant current charging time interval, constant voltage charging time interval, discharge temperature peak time and cycle times are extracted from lithium battery charging and discharging experiments, and the Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients are established. Secondly, build a lithium battery RUL prediction model based on CNN-GRU combined neural network. Finally, the rationality of extracting health factors is verified by actual data, and the prediction results are compared with SVR model, long short-term memory (LSTM) model, GRU model, and CNN-LSTM model. The mean square of the proposed model is analyzed. Thus, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed model are verified.

articleTitle: Live Line Repair of Ground Wire for UHV/EHV Transmission Line Based on Helicopter Winch Hanging Chair Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: UHV/EHV transmission lines have large transmission capacity and high requirements for stable operation of the lines. There are some problems such as high labor intensity and high safety risks when climbing the tower to repair the ground wire. In this paper, based on the helicopter winch hanging chair (HWHC) method, the linesman is suspended by a hanging chair to repair the GW when the line is energized. According to the characteristics of UHV/EHV transmission lines, the way of the helicopter to the liveline is optimized. In this way, the suspension system and GW maintenance equipment are developed, thus repairing the broken strand live GW on 500kV transmission lines. Practice has proved the safety, reliability and high efficiency of helicopter winch hanging chair method. This method will apply more to broken strand of GW, which strongly supports the safe and stable of the power grid.

articleTitle: An Analytical Method for Reliability Evaluation of Distribution System Considering Uncertainty of Renewable Energy Generation and Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The randomness of the output of renewable energy generations and the uncertainty of customer load make it difficult to evaluate the reliability of the distribution system. This paper proposes an efficient reliability evaluation method for distribution system considering the uncertainty of renewable energy generations and load. Probability density functions are used to model the renewable energy generations and loads to describe their randomness. The load nodes are divided into three types according to the availability of renewable energy generations and discussed separately whether they will lose power when components fail. The calculation formula of the reliability index considering randomness is deduced. Finally, the proposed method is verified on a modified IEEE 37-node test system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Building Optimal Scheduling Considering the Coordinated Control of Electric Vehicles and Thermostatically Controlled Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper is proposing an optimal scheduling method for intelligent buildings considering the coordinated optimal control of electric vehicles (EVs) and thermostatically controlled load. By optimizing the charging power and discharging power of the controllable load in each period, changing the time and method of power consumption, reducing load peaks to improve the economy and stability of system operation. First, considering the state of charge of EV clusters and user comfort, a smart charging pile model considering the access of electric vehicles to buildings (V2B) and thermostatically controlled load model based on comfort range are established. Secondly, the realization framework of two types of load coordinated optimal control of buildings is designed, and the optimal scheduling model of buildings is established with the goal of minimizing the cost of intelligent building economic regulation and control. Finally, an office building on a high temperature day in summer is selected as an example to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Wind Power Loss Forecasting and Early Warning Based on Transfer Learning under Extreme Weather
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extreme weather has the characteristics of low probability, high risk and great harm. With the increase of the proportion of wind power connected to the grid, extreme weather poses a serious threat to the normal operation of wind power and the normal power supply. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method of wind power loss prediction and early warning based on transfer learning. Firstly, the adjacent wind farms are migrated to the target wind farm as the source domain to make up for the insufficient sample size of extreme weather; Then the theoretical value calculation model and the actual value prediction model of wind power are given respectively, so as to calculate the power loss under extreme weather. Finally, a wind farm group in Jilin Province is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of this method, and a multi-level rolling early warning method is given.

articleTitle: Analysis of an Overhead Line Coincidence Failure Event in HVDC Network and Strategy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The removal of short circuit fault current in DC transmission engineering is a difficult point in power engineering. In recent years, HVDC circuit breakers with the ability of short circuit current removal have been demonstrated and applied in many DC projects. The HVDC circuit breaker structure and control logic are complex, and the DC protection and DC circuit breaker need to be coordinated directly. This paper analyzes a case of reclosing failure after permanent grounding fault of overhead line in HVDC power network engineering, and puts forward an optimization scheme of control strategy.

articleTitle: The Review and Prospect of Key Technologies for Distributed PV Grid-connection and Consumption under the County-wide Promotion Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The promotion of distributed photovoltaic (PV) across the county’s rooftops is an important measure for the "dual carbon" goal and rural revitalization strategy. It’s significant for building a new-type power system with a gradually increasing proportion of new energy and promoting low-carbon emission reduction. It brings new challenges to system operation and consumption because of the scale of distributed PV integrated access. The large-scale dispatching operation of distributed PV is reviewed from grid connection, consumption and new technology application in view of the morphological changes of the new-type power system. Then study and judge the future development trend of electric power, and put forward reference suggestions on key topics such as distributed PV participation system support, digital integration and market-oriented trading.

articleTitle: Optimal Photovoltaic Array Reconfiguration For Alleviating the Partial Shading Influence Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Partial shading of a photovoltaic (PV) array is the condition under which different modules in the array experience different irradiance levels. Mismatch power loss is the unfortunate problem caused by partial shading phenomenon. To relieve the entire PV system from this issue, reconfiguring the PV modules of the considered PV array is proposed as a favorable solution to disperse the shadow regularly. Therefore, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is introduced in this paper, aiming to provide the optimal reconfiguration pattern of the switching matrix to maximize the generated power from the PV array. Then, a method is proposed to minimize the number of switching actions, thereby reducing the cost in the process of PV array reconfiguration. In this method, the physical location of the modules remains unchanged, while its electrical connections are altered. To verify the proposed method, a 5×5 PV array is established in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The effectiveness of proposed PSO technique is evaluated via performance analysis based on power generation and switching action saving.

articleTitle: Optimal Bidding Strategy for Combined-Cycle Unit in Day-ahead Energy and Reserve Markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a bidding strategy model is established to analyze the bidding behavior of the combined-cycle (CC) unit in the day-ahead energy and reserve electricity markets. The CC unit can flexibly change its operation modes, take advantage of the mode transfer characteristics, and adjust the output of the CC unit to maximize its profit. Case studies are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Oil-Immersed Current Transformer Based on Accurate Oil Pressure Collection Method Development of Internal Abnormal Judgment Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, Oil-Immersed Current transformer failures occur frequently. Because of its compact internal structure, faults develop rapidly and are difficult to detect. Seriously threaten the safe and stable operation of power system. This paper mainly introduces an internal abnormal judgment device of Oil-Immersed Current Transformer Based on precise oil pressure acquisition. It provides a new idea and method for on-line anomaly diagnosis of Oil-Immersed Current transformer.

articleTitle: Improved SHGM Robust State Estimation for Power System Considering Complementary Non-smooth Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state estimation accuracy will be greatly affected when the measurement gross error exists. Schweppe-type generalized M-estimator with Huber psi-function (SHGM) can not completely eliminate the influence of bad data which exists in leverage point. On-load tap changer (OLTC) model has non-smooth characteristics such as limits, which will bring non-smooth complementary constraints. The existing SHGM robust state estimation is limited to deal with complementary constraints. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes an improved SHGM model considering complementary non-smooth constraints. In order to deal with the limits constraints introduced by the voltage control strategy of OLTC, the Fischer-Burmeister (FB) smoothing function is introduced to convert the complementary constraints into equality constraints, which improves the processing ability of SHGM state estimation for non-smooth characteristics. The correctness and practicability of the improved SHGM model are verified by 3-bus and IEEE 18-bus system. The case studies shows that considering the detailed control characteristics of OLTC and introducing FB smoothing function to deal with complementary constraints can improve the ability of SHGM robust state estimation to deal with bad data.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Schemes for Digital-Physical Hybrid Simulation of the SSCS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SSCS plays the essential role in power grid operation to ensure the control reliability and effectivity. Due to the power system becomes more complex, it is inevitable to improve the simulation technology for SSCS. Thus, a digital-physical hybrid simulation platform for SSCS is required. In this paper, the requirements of the digital-physical hybrid simulation platform are analyzed and focus on the design of communication schemes for digital-physical hybrid simulation. IEC61850 and Aurora based communication technical roadmaps are proposed for the communication between RTDS and DSSCHP. Also, two options are available for the communication between SSCDs and DSSCHP.

articleTitle: Cost Calculation and Analysis of the Impact of Peak-to-Valley Price Difference of Different Types of Electrochemical Energy Storage over the Whole Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of mass electrochemical energy storage (ESS) contributes to the efficient utilization and development of renewable energy, and helps to improve the stability and power supply reliability of power system under the background of high permeability of renewable energy. But, energy storage participation in the power market and commercialization are largely constrained by its costs. Therefore, under the condition that energy storage only participates in the electricity energy market and makes profits through the price difference between peak and valley, this paper studies the levelized cost of storage (LCOS) of four types of ESS, and analyzes the cost recovery cycles of different ESS in detail. The results show that the cost recovery cycle of ESS power station is negatively correlated with the peak-to-valley price difference. The LCOS of ESS power station is positively correlated with the initial investment cost per unit capacity; negatively correlated with the number of annual cycles.

articleTitle: Research on State Prediction of Gas Insulated Switchgear Based on CNN-GRU Combinatorial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas Insulated Switchgear is one of the core equipment of the power system. During the operation, its maintenance work is relatively complicated and time-consuming, and the power outage range sometimes involves non-faulty components, which will cause significant economic losses. Therefore, predicting the operation status of GIS can help to perceive the potential threats of GIS in time and grasp the development trend of GIS failures. This paper proposes a GIS operating state prediction method based on the combined neural network of convolutional neural network (CNN) and gated recurrent unit (GRU). Defects, historical test data, and online monitoring data are combined with AHP and multi-level variable weight evaluation ideas to evaluate their status, build equipment status correlation analysis and status prediction models, and organically combine quantitative and qualitative indicators to explore characteristic parameters. Correspondence between GIS states. The feasibility and accuracy of the method are verified by example analysis, compared with long short-term memory (LSTM) model and GRU model, it has better prediction accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Maximum Capacity Boundary of Distributed Energy Resources in Distribution Networks Considering N-1 Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network is challenged by rapidly growing distributed energy resources (DERs). Thus, the maximum acceptable capacity of DERs under the security of the distribution network is an urgent issue worthy of study. In this paper, a maximum capacity boundary (MCB) model is proposed to evaluate the positive and negative boundaries of the active power of DERs under N-1 security of distribution networks. The proposed MCB model is built similarly to two AC optimal power flow models, and the AC power flow constraints are established by reconstructing admittance matrices for each N-1 security scenario. In addition, the MCB model is decoupled into respectively solving the infimum and supremum of a series of sub-optimizations of AC optimal power flow model, each of which corresponds to one of the N-1 security scenarios of the distribution network. Case study verifies the effectiveness of the proposed MCB model.

articleTitle: Interprovincial Lead-Lag Analysis on Secondary and Tertiary Industrial Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As electricity consumption is direct feedback of industrial production and operation state, there should be links between lead-lag relation in electricity consumption volumes and inter-regional/inter-industrial driving/transferring effects. In this paper, lead-lag relation between provincial secondary industry and tertiary industry electricity consumption volume is studied base on transfer entropy theory which measures causality between time series. It is found that secondary industry and tertiary industry of Shanghai show noticeable driving effect on those of other provinces, especially those along Yangtze River or east coast of China. Meanwhile, significant causality from secondary industry to tertiary industry exists both intra-provincially and interprovincially in a large part of China. By clustering analysis on electricity consumption curves, the lead-lag relation is concretely presented, as the periodic peaks in electricity consumption of secondary emerge stably one month ahead of that of tertiary industry. By correlation analysis with gross domestic product data, it is inferred that the periodic fluctuations in electricity consumption by secondary industry mainly results from economy cycle while those in tertiary industry are more possibly caused by cooling/heating demand in summer/winter.

articleTitle: The Active Power Support Strategy of UPFC for Hybrid HVDC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs the coordinated frequency control strategy for unified power flow controller (UPFC) and the hybrid cascaded HVDC system. The UPFC can control the active and reactive power of the different AC lines. To utilize UPFC’s flexible control ability and suppress the frequency fluctuation of hybrid HVDC connected AC system, the additional active power signal is added to the series converter with a frequency coordinated control. The coordinated control concept is adjusting the UPFC’s active power reference when hybrid HVDC’s power fluctuates. Such the more frequency adjustment room can be reached and the stability of the system can be enhanced. The simulations in the PSCAD software prove the correctness of the strategy.<sup>1</sup>

articleTitle: Optimal Designation of Parameters and Control Stability Research on Current-controlled Type Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The converter is the core carrier of the energy storage system to smooth the power fluctuations of renewable energy generation. In addition, the converter is able to regulation frequency and voltage of power grid. This paper research on the operation control strategy for current-control type energy storage converters, proposed the tracking control strategy without static error, and proportional and integral control parameters designation method based on optimal damping ratio for current control loop PI controller. Then, based on the open loop logarithmic frequency characteristic, this paper proposed the current control inner loop open loop frequency model. Through the Bode stability criterion, analysis the stability effective for variable proportional and integral parameters of current control inner loop, and damping resistance and filter inductance values, while using Nyquist stability criterion verified the same results. Finally, the control stability of energy storage converter under variable integral parameters is test by RT-LAB controller-in-loop experimental platform. The results indicate proposed current-control type energy storage converter is robustness for supporting development of renewable energy generation, and the too small or overlarge PI control parameters of energy storage converter is able to effect the dynamic response characteristics.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Probabilistic Prediction for Newly Built Wind Farms Scenarios Based on W-GAN and CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate wind power probabilistic prediction is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the power system. In order to make accurate wind power probability prediction for newly built wind farms with insufficient historical training samples, this paper proposes a short-term wind power probability prediction method for new wind farms based on the combined model of W-GAN and CNN-LSTM. First, the training data is sampled based on the W-GAN network, and then CNN and LSTM are used in the prediction modeling to learn the information contained in the generated samples and the original samples, and finally the probability prediction of power is performed based on the quantile regression deep learning method. The example analysis shows that: 1) Using W-GAN for sample expansion can effectively make up for the problem of insufficient training samples for new wind farms. Compared with direct modeling, the ACE and Winkler indicators are reduced by 0.07 and 0.18 respectively under the 90% confidence interval 2) Using the combined model to learn the information of the generated samples and the original samples respectively can effectively improve the prediction accuracy. Compared with using the generative model to train the network alone, the ACE, AW, and Winkler indicators are reduced by 0.12, 0.08, 0.16.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Strategy of Microgrid Based on Interval Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the conflict of interest between microgrid operators and electric vehicle owners with the uncertainty in their operation, a two-layer interval optimization model is proposed based on the idea of dynamic non-cooperative stackelberg game. The upper-layer model introduces the interval number method to describe the uncertainty of the source and load of the microgrid, takes the minimum operating cost of the microgrid as the optimization goal, considers the power balance and energy storage system constraints, and updates the corresponding electricity price information according to the obtained upper layer target. The lower-layer optimization model solves the aggregate electric vehicle power to minimum electricity consumption cost of the electric vehicle owner based on the electricity price information, and sends it to the upper-layer optimization model. The numerical analysis results show that the proposed two-layer interval optimization model can take into account the bilateral interests of microgrid operators and electric vehicle owners and effectively improve the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Machine Learning Schemes for Information Security of Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The demand side response has been vigorously promoted by the state in order to help balance the supply and demand of electricity. As an important interactive resource of the power system, it faces the risk of data and information leakage in the process of demand-side response. Therefore, starting from the security of demand-side response, this paper analyzes which security risks that users may encounter when responding to power grid regulation, and analyzes and explains these risks one by one, and finally summarizes the protective measures for related security risks.

articleTitle: Design of Power Generation Parameter Monitoring System for Abandoned Wave Energy Buoy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A design method of wireless remote monitoring system based on MSP430+LoRa is presented to solve the difficulty of centralized monitoring of electric parameters of abandoned self-generating floating buoy. The design scheme of the object, the main hardware components of the electric parameter monitoring system and the design of data collection software are described. The wireless communication protocol is customized, and all collected data is automatically uploaded to the receiving terminal. The upper computer software of the receiving terminal is developed using QT, which can record the information of the buoy intelligently when the power generation reaches its maximum. It has been proved that the buoy works stably and the monitoring system runs reliably, which is of great significance to the exploration of the power generation of abandoned wave power generating units and the design of the monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Inverter Parameter Configuration for Renewable Energy Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proposal of the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, large-scale utilization of clean energy power generation will be the main development direction of the new generation of power system in the future. In this context, the scale of renewable energy power generation represented by photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation has expanded rapidly in recent years, which brings security and stability issues that cannot be ignored. As the grid connection interface of renewable energy power generation unit, the performance of grid connected inverter has a decisive impact on the stability of the whole system, so it is necessary to conduct in-depth research and propose a effective method on its parameter configuration. The inverter impedance model is firstly constructed with a thorough consideration of phase-locked loop (PLL) and current controller. On this basis, based on the generalized Nyquist criterion, the grid connection stability of the inverter is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed method is verified via the grid connection model of a photovoltaic power station.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Identification Based on Multiphysics Coupling Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to study the noise signal characteristics of the transformer under different working conditions, it is helpful to diagnose the operating state of the transformer. Using finite element analysis software, a multi-physics finite element model of transformer electrical-magnetic-structural force-sound field is established, and multi-physics transient simulation analysis is carried out for three working conditions of transformer normal state, winding deformation and iron core deformation. And the transformer fault diagnosis algorithm based on the similarity of feature matrix is used to analyze the similarity of the noise signal between the fault and the normal working condition of the transformer. The research results show that there are obvious differences in the noise distribution of the noise signal in the solution domain of the transformer under different working conditions. The noise signal generated by the vibration of the transformer during normal operation presents a symmetrical distribution trend, and the noise radiated when the winding and the iron core are deformed is obvious. Asymmetric distribution; the proposed transformer fault diagnosis algorithm can comprehensively realize transformer fault identification of multiple groups of noise signals and different measuring points, and identify transformer faults combined with noise distribution map.

articleTitle: Formal Verification Method Considering Electric Vehicles and Data Centers Participating in Distribution Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high proportion of renewable energy sources in power grid will bring huge challenges to the stable operation of the power systems. Compared with the traditional power systems, the energy systems have more complex hybrid dynamic behavior, and the sound formal verification can be used to check the reliability of the system operation. In this paper, energy system models for a single-station operation scenario and an inter-station cooperative operation scenario are established in Simulink. Based on MATLAB Stateflow function module, the weak links of energy station operation are found through formal verification, and the spatial load migration is verified to have a good support for regional energy system reliability. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed models.

articleTitle: Integrated Power and Hydrogen Trading in Multimicrogrid Coupled with Offsite Hydrogen Refueling Stations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel two-level electricity and hydrogen market framework for multi-microgrids (MMGs) coupled with offsite hydrogen refueling stations (HRSs), aiming to strengthen the synergy between electricity and hydrogen. The local hydrogen market among the MMG and HRSs is modeled by multi-leader multi-follower Stackelberg game theory, in which microgrids play the role of leaders to adjust hydrogen prices while HRSs participate as followers to determine their hydrogen purchase scheme. Moreover, to deal with economic and technical issues of the MMG in a holistic manner, Nash bargaining theory is used to model the electricity transaction among microgrids. A distributed algorithm is developed to solve such games, thus reducing the cost of information communication and the risk of privacy exposure. The case study demonstrates that this market mechanism guarantees benefits for all parties and boosts the independence of MMGs by reducing transactions with the main grid.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Energy Storage and Energy-intensive Load at Renewable Energy Transmission End
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power, the randomness and volatility of wind power have led to increasing pressure on peak regulation and frequency regulation of the power grid, and wind curtailment is serious, especially in the renewable energy transmission end. In this paper, large-scale energy storage and energy-intensive load with adjustable characteristics are taken as important means to promote wind power consumption and participate in the optimal dispatch of the power grid together with conventional thermal power. This work proposes a new model of source-storage-load coordination, which comprehensively considers the impact of source-load coordination on wind power consumption, system operating costs, and energy storage benefits. It optimizes thermal power, energy storage, and energy-intensive load operation to minimize the overall cost of power grid and energy storage. The study's results verify the proposed method's effectiveness in improving the consumption level of wind power and peak cutting.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Hybrid Energy Storage System Considering Flexible Resources of Source, Network and Load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The proposal of the "dual-carbon" goal has made the penetration rate of renewable energy in the power system continue to increase. The hybrid energy storage technology has been developed rapidly to accommodate the abundant renewable energy. Reliability evaluation of the renewable energy system is of great significance to evaluate whether the system can deal well with the uncertain renewable energy output. However, current research did not consider well the role the flexible resources of source, network and load play in the reliability evaluation, resulting in the inaccurate evaluation results. To address this problem, this paper proposes a hybrid energy storage reliability evaluation model integrated with the flexible resources of source, network and load. The case study results show that the reliability of the power system can be improved greatly considering the flexible resources.

articleTitle: Research on Market-Oriented Arrangement Method of Generation Unit Maintenance for Power System Based on Generation Quotation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A market-oriented arrangement method of generation unit maintenance for power system based on generation quotation has been proposed in this paper. There are four parts of the overall scheme of the method, namely generation quotation, maintenance market clearing, check of power balance and settlement of maintenance cost. The method comprehensively considers the maintenance intention of generation unit by constructing the maintenance clearing model which is a mixed integer programming model. And the model can be solved by a general solver easily, which means that it can be applied to a complex large-scale systems. The power supply is sufficiently considered and it effectively ensures the safety of system operation. And also, the maintenance payment cost and return cost fully relate the clearing result to the economic benefit, which ensures the fairness of the clearing model. The market-oriented maintenance arrangement will reflect the willingness of generation unit from the perspective of economy, so as to maximize the use of existing resources. It is also proved that by applying the above process, the market-oriented arrangement and related costs of maintenance can be obtained fairly.

articleTitle: Creative Model of Community Public Health Service Based on Power Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional community public health service faces the problems of various work categories, intensive workload, untimely service, and memory offset, etc. There are rich application scenarios for power big data, which has the advantages of timely, accurate, effective and privacy protection of public health services such as indoor activities and health protection. The framework of public health service model based on power big data was described from the topics of epidemic normalization prevention and control, analysis of home status of home health observers, care for the elderly living alone and the disabled people, and people staying up late. Through power big data analysis, models can be established to analyze the characteristics of residents' indoor activity consumption, to provide data basis for the development of public health related work and improve the accuracy and efficiency of public health services. Therefore, the application of power big data in public health related fields of disease control should be explored and deepened.

articleTitle: Intentional Electromagnetic Interference Attack against Infrared Thermal Imaging Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Infrared thermal imaging camera can be used to measure the temperature of the target object or detect the existence of the object by generating the thermal image of the object, thus it is widely used in the military and civil fields, and plays a key role in human daily life. As the core module of the infrared thermal imaging camera, the infrared thermal imaging sensor is an indispensable part of the infrared thermal imaging camera. Infrared thermal imaging cameras rely on infrared thermal imaging sensors to measure temperature and perform thermal imaging. If the infrared thermal imaging sensor detects the temperature wrong, there will be serious consequences of delaying the military situation in the military, and will seriously affect the production and life of the society in the civilian field. In this work, it is demonstrated that intentional electromagnetic interference can affect the communication process of the infrared thermal imaging sensor MLX90640. The data transmission line between MLX90640 and MCU can be tampered with through intentional electromagnetic interference attacks, which eventually lead to temperature numerical errors and abnormal infrared thermal image display.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Correlation Characteristics of Electricity Trading Price Based on Multifractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the theory of multifractal, this paper analyzes the characteristics of power trading price in different periods. On the basis of the research of shanxi 2020 spot each time data real-time electricity price, electricity market got all kinds of fractal index, shows that they have the multifractal characteristics of screening system that can reflect the working characteristic of the actual data effectively. According to these different fractal parameters, the short-term marginal electricity price prediction model of different time periods is established, and then the phase space prediction model of time period reconstruction is established to predict the short-term electricity price, which finally provides a better guarantee for market participants and managers to avoid the electricity price risk.

articleTitle: Optimized Scheduling of the AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network Considering the Operating State of Flexible Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of renewable energy and new load are connected to the distribution network. While promoting energy conservation and emission reduction, its power uncertainty also brings challenges to the stable operation of the distribution network. Compared with the traditional AC distribution network, the AC/DC hybrid distribution network has a more flexible power regulation ability, which can promote the consumption of distributed power supply and reduce the voltage fluctuation. Therefore, the power optimization method of AC-DC hybrid distribution network considering the operating state of various equipment is proposed. Multi-state probability modeling is conducted for the AC-DC distribution network and distribution network containing distributed photovoltaic, electric vehicles, communication base stations and energy storage. On this basis, the system operation cost is minimized as the goal, and the SecondOrder Cone Programming method is used to solve the model. The proposed method is verified with the AC/DC hybrid system. The results show that the proposed method can coordinate multiple devices, including converters, and effectively improve the economic benefits of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Dynamic Phasor Measurement Algorithm Based on Variable Window Length
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Discrete Fourier transform is widely used in synchronous phasor measurement of power system because of its simple and efficient calculation. However, under non power frequency conditions, due to the problem of window edge truncation, the discrete Fourier transform will have spectrum leakage and fence phenomenon, which will cause large errors in the calculation results. To solve this problem, a dynamic phasor measurement algorithm based on variable window length is proposed. Singular value decomposition is used to reduce noise and determine the number of useful signals in the sampled signal. The fundamental component is obtained by empirical wavelet transform, and the fundamental frequency is quickly determined by three-point method to realize the dynamic measurement of variable window length.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Grid-Interactive Efficient Buildings: A Case Study in South China
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Buildings play a significant role in the low-carbon transition of people’s lives and economy. Increasing the penetration of renewable energy in buildings is critical to reducing building carbon emissions in the building sector. To achieve this goal, the concept of the Energy-Flexible Building / Grid-Interactive Efficient Building was put forward for utilizing renewable energy to the utmost. Energy-flexible techniques and direct-current power systems are important components of energy-flexible buildings. However, economic analysis of these two aspects in China is rarely found in the literature. A building that has been put into operation in South China is used as the case building to explore the economic efficiency of the direct-current power system and energy-flexible techniques. By analyzing the initial investment and operational effects, it is found that the dynamic payback periods of the DC power system and energy-flexible techniques in case building are 15.11 years and 16.69 years, respectively, which provides evidence that Grid-Interactive Efficient Buildings technology can reduce the energy consumption cost of the building throughout its whole life cycle.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch Method of Power System Considering Carbon Capture Units and Renewable Portfolio Standard
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an economic dispatch method for power system considering carbon capture units and renewable portfolio standard (RPS) to further promote the consumption of wind power. First, two objective functions are constructed with the minimum total emissions and the minimum sum of thermal power purchase cost, wind power purchase cost, and transaction cost, respectively. Secondly, power balance constraint, conventional thermal power unit constraint, carbon capture thermal power unit constraint, wind power constraint, system reserve capacity constraint and tradable green certificate (TGC) constraint are constructed. Then, the established economic dispatch model is linearized, and the solution steps of the model are given. Finally, a distribution network example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in promoting wind power consumption and reducing wind curtailment rate.

articleTitle: Game Iterative Robust Optimization Strategy for AC / DC Distribution Systems Considering Source Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the wide access of distributed generation and diversified loads in AC / DC distribution system and the uncertainty fluctuation of source load, it will bring great challenges to the planning, control and operation of AC / DC distribution network. Based on this, this paper proposes a game iterative robust optimization strategy for AC / DC distribution system considering the source load uncertainty. The game between power grid dispatcher and nature realizes the robust optimization under the condition of distributed generation random output, minimizes the standard deviation of network loss and the number of possible safety limit excesses of the system, avoids the extreme adverse effects caused by the uncertainty of distributed generation, and ensures the operation safety of the system. It provides a reference for the optimal operation scheduling of AC / DC distribution system.

articleTitle: Economic Assessment of Peak-shaving Benefit for Pumped Storage Power Station in Gansu Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a region rich in new energy resources of gansu province is not coordinated in the development of all kinds of power sources, and lacks flexibility in power regulation and peak regulation ability. The combined operation mode of thermal power and pumped storage can peak load shifting, reducing the coal consumption of the system, and improving the economy and stability of power system operation. At first available capacity distribution cumulant method is put forward to simulate stochastic production in optimized peak shaving operation dispatching of pumped storage power station. Then the model of thermal power investment planning is constructed based on the consideration of the peak shaving operation of thermal power units. Finally, establishing an economic evaluation model of peak shaving benefit of pumped storage power stations. The example shows that the peak shaving is effective. On the premise of meeting the peak shaving requirements of the system, compared with no pumped storage power station, the investment cost and fuel cost of the system are greatly saved after the pumped storage power station is put into use. Therefore, it is necessary for gansu province to incorporate pumped storage power station into the power structure when selecting peak-regulating power supply.

articleTitle: Detection of Inverter Leakage Current Based on Harmonic Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces a classification and extraction method of leakage current, and a method for suppressing leakage current. First, the two-stage BOOST+HERIC photovoltaic grid-connected circuit is used for simulation. Then, the measurement of the complete current is done on the result of the simulation. Based on the measured current, harmonic extraction is done. Finally, the leakage current is suppressed.

articleTitle: Influence of Grid-following Power Electronic Equipment Using Phase-locked Loop on Frequency of Wind Turbine Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are differences in the frequency dynamic process of different nodes in the power system, and there is a spatial distribution of frequencies. There have been many studies on the frequency space distribution in the system dominated by traditional synchronous machines, but the influence of power electronic equipment on the frequency space distribution is still relatively small. This paper analyzes the influence of the grid-following power electronic equipment using the phase-locked loop on the frequency of the wind turbine terminal. The study found that the grid-following power electronic equipment does not completely track the frequency of the grid, and its internal potential will also affect the frequency of the wind turbine terminal, resulting in a deviation between the frequency of the wind turbine terminal and the system frequency in the dynamic process, showing a characteristics of a voltage source similar to that of a synchronous machine. The deviation between the terminal frequency and the system frequency of the network equipment is affected by the electrical distance, output power, and dynamic performance of the phase-locked loop. When the new energy is involved in frequency regulation, the impact of this deviation needs to be considered.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Cloud Computing in Power User Electric Energy Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the electric internet of things, higher requirements are imposed on the data processing of the distribution grid. The traditional oracle database can no longer withstand the increasing data pressure of the power user electric energy data acquisition system, so it is urgent to transform the system. This paper based on cloud computing technology to transform the power user electric energy data acquisition system in the distribution network. By setting business process verification scenarios to simulate the use of electricity information collection and storage experiments, it verified the feasibility of business migration to the cloud and the cloud platform ’ s Performance advantage. Moreover, the security of the cloud platform architecture is analyzed, and the results show that the cloud computing technology can provide a certain level of support for the existing use and acquisition systems.

Author Keywords: power user electric energy data acquisition system

articleTitle: Active Voltage Support Strategy for Microgrid Cluster under Asymmetric Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the limited capacity of a single microgrid, the active support effect on the voltage of the power network is not obvious when an asymmetric fault occurs. To solve this problem, an active voltage support strategy for microgrid cluster under asymmetric fault is proposed. Based on the instantaneous power theory, the dual current control loop is used to implement the proposed control strategy. Then, under the environment of Matlab/Simulink, the simulation model of the microgrid cluster composed of three microgrids is built to verify the support effect on the grid-connected point under the proposed control strategy. The simulation results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A Tempo-Spatially Clustered Unit Commitment with Long-Cycle Storage Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Unit commitment that addresses the flexibility restrictions of power system operation that other routines like (optimal) power flow cannot, has been given more expectation for large-scale long-term scenarios, while its computational efficiency hinders its deployment, especially with a large number of binary variables. The typical reduction method — temporal clustering method cannot be applied to systems with long-cycle storages because of the loss of chronological information. A new framework of reformulated unit commitment composed of both temporal clustering with clustering index and unit clustering in the spatial dimension is proposed here, which aims at combining the advantages of the two clustering methods for unit commitment to suffice as the operation routine in large-scale long-term long-cycle storages equipped power system optimizations. The entire tempo-spatially clustered unit commitment with long-cycle storage dispatch is evaluated on a 118-node 54-unit system.

articleTitle: Why GloVe Shows Negative Effects in Malware Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The past decades witness the development of various Machine Learning (ML) models for malware classification. Semantic representation is a crucial basis for these classifiers. This paper aims to assess the effect of semantic representation methods on malware classifier performance. Two commonly-used semantic representation methods including N-gram and GloVe. We utilize diverse ML classifiers to conduct comparative experiments to analyze the capability of N-gram, GloVe and image-based methods for malware classification. We also analyze deeply the reason why the GloVe can produce negative effects on malware static analysis.

articleTitle: Current and Power Quality Coordinated Control for VSC-HVDC Connected to Unbalanced Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When a serious asymmetrical fault occurs in the power grid, if only the effective transmission of active power is considered, the power devices in the inverter may cause severe heating or even damage to the power equipment due to overcurrent. Accordingly, the coordinated control of power and current is proposed to reduce overload current under grid-connected regulations. The method comprehensively optimizes different control objectives by introducing a coordination factor to establish a coordination function between power flow and load current. First, the VSC-HVDC model under unbalanced grid is constructed, which illustrates the contradiction between different control objectives. Then, the quantitative mathematical derivation of the proposed comprehensive control strategy is carried out, and the comprehensive target control of the inverter is carried out by adjusting the coordination factor. Finally, the simulation results under various operating conditions also show that the proposed strategy can realize the grid-connected control of the comprehensive target under the condition of grid asymmetry.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Control Strategy for Load Power Distribution of Multi Stack Fuel Cell System Based on Cuckoo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In hybrid ships, individual fuel cells suffer from low system reliability and low efficiency. In order to maximize system stability and efficiency, the hydrogen consumption of hydrogen fuel cells is reduced. The structure of hybrid power source system composed of multiple fuel cells and batteries in parallel is proposed, and the power equal allocation strategy is formulated for hybrid ships based on fuzzy logic control mode, that is, the working number of fuel cells and the output power of fuel cells are flexibly regulated according to the load power of the propulsion system and the SOC (State of Charge) of the battery, The whole hybrid power source system can quickly follow the load power demand, ensure continuous operation in the high efficiency range, and save the hydrogen consumption of the hydrogen fuel cell. The simulation results with MATLAB/Simulink show that the hybrid power source system can quickly meet the complex and changeable load power demand, and can improve the efficiency of the hybrid power source system, and reduce the hydrogen consumption by 18.26%. The proposed energy management strategy based on fuzzy control can be applied to multi stack fuel cells of hybrid ships, effectively improve the efficiency of hybrid power source system, and have practical value of energy saving and consumption reduction.

articleTitle: Research on Regional Energy Transition and Carbon Emission Trend - A Case Study on Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper conducts an evaluation of the effectiveness of energy transition in Fujian Province, and evaluates the relationship between energy consumption and various factors in Fujian Province. First, a prediction model for the relationship between carbon emissions and energy consumption is constructed, and the relationship between carbon emissions and variables such as population structure, economic development, industrial structure, energy structure, and trade level is analuzed. Then, the future trend of each influencing factor are predicted separately. The ARIMA and GM(1,1) models are used to predict the future trend of each influencing factor. Finally, the future energy consumption and carbon emissions of Fujian Province is predicted. Forecasting is done in two stages. In 2020-2030, the predicted values of relevant influencing factors are derived from the results of modeling analysis. From 2030 to 2060, the predicted value of relevant influencing factors also takes into account the trend judgments of experts and scholars.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Electric User Payment Based on SOM Neural Network Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the demand of customers' electricity service presents a diversified trend. In order to meet the diversified demands of power customers for services, power supply enterprises have continuously introduced new payment methods and actively guided power customers to pay through new payment channels. In this paper, a comprehensive index system is built based on the payment behavior data of electric power users, and strive to fit the diversified characteristics of users. Firstly, SOM neural network clustering algorithm is used to subdivide the payment behavior of electricity customers; Then, in order to optimize the clustering effect, the optimal number of clustering clusters is obtained through cluster optimization analysis, and then the SOM neural network is used to cluster the power customers, and the attributes of various groups and the overall attributes are compared and analyzed to obtain the customer segmentation results; Finally, the sales scheme for response type users is specified according to the clustering results, so as to achieve the evaluation of the target service quality level and ultimately improve the service level.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Model of Distribution Network Energy Saving Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the energy-saving transformation of the distribution network has been an important measure for power grids to save energy and reduce losses. The energy-saving transformation of the distribution network is mainly related to line structure transformation, line parameters, transformer parameters, reactive power compensation strategies, line load fluctuations and actual operating conditions. Each influencing factor can propose an energy-saving retrofit measure, and the energy saving and consumption reduction benefits of different energy-saving ret-rofit measures are often very different. Therefore, this paper proposes a distribu-tion network energy-saving retrofit strategy evaluation model to compare and analyze different energy-saving retrofits The effect, benefit and power saving of the strategy, the optimal transformation strategy is derived, and the guidance for the energy-saving transformation of the distribution network is provided.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Side Response Strategy of Active Distribution Network Considering User Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the stability and reliability problems of the active distribution network caused by the increasing peak valley difference caused by the growing diversity of loads and the large-scale new energy grid connection, in order to achieve the coordinated and efficient utilization of resources in the active distribution network, active management and ensure the economic and safe operation of the power grid at the same time, a two-stage load demand response model with space and time dimensions is established with user satisfaction as the objective function. Through the two-stage model, the load distribution after demand response, the fuel cost on the generation side and the node electricity price are obtained, and an operation mode considering the factors such as user satisfaction is proposed, which improves the operation economy of the active distribution network.

articleTitle: Energy-Grade Double Pricing Mechanism for a Combined Heat and Power System Using the Asynchronous Dispatch Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problem of heat and electricity pricing in combined-heat-and-power (CHP) systems regarding electricity’s and heat’s time scales, as well as thermal energy quality is studied. Based on the asynchronous coordinated dispatch of CHP system, an energy-grade double pricing mechanism is proposed. Under the pricing mechanism, resulting merchandise surplus of heat system operator (HSO) at each heat dispatch interval can be decomposed into interpretable parts and its revenue adequacy can be guaranteed over all heat dispatch intervals. And the electric power system operator (ESO)’s resulting merchandise surplus is composed of non-negative components at each electricity dispatch interval, also ensuring its revenue adequacy. In addition, the effects of different time scales and co-generation are analyzed in different kinds of CHP units’ pricing.

articleTitle: Study of Commutation Failure Prediction for Line Commutated Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Commutation failure (CF) is the main fault type of traditional High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission. The first time CF occurs soon after AC system fails then DC control system is generally too late to react, subsequent commutation failure will occur if the fault is not cleared or effectively controlled in time. This will threat the safe and stable operation of HVDC transmission systems Therefore, accurate and rapid prediction the probability of commutation failure can provide effective help for subsequent control.

articleTitle: Trajectory Sensitivity Based Key Parameters Analysis for Low Voltage Ride Through of Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large-scale photovoltaic(PV) power plant connected to the grid, it is important to master the low-voltage ride-through(LVRT) characteristics and key control parameters of the PV inverter to analyze the impact of the PV power plant on the grid. The active and reactive power control strategies during normal operation of the PV power plant and the active and reactive power control strategies under fault conditions are analyzed. Then a typical LVRT scenario is constructed according to the LVRT test requirements of the PV plant, and the trajectory sensitivity of each control parameter is calculated. Finally, the average sensitivity during fault ride-through and during power recovery is calculated to obtain the key parameters of LVRT for PV plants.

articleTitle: Work Assistance and Verification System Based on Standardized Workflow of Power Grid Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper has described a work assistance and verification system which was built to assist the routine work of power grid dispatching major. With the assistance of the system, faulty operations would be reduced and distinguished immediately. Operator would receive prompt information from the equipment which was being operated. Meanwhile, system would record the whole process of wrong operation. The record would be used for training course design and key performance appraisal.

articleTitle: A Method Used for Calculation of Basic Daily Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to better understand residents' electricity consumption habits, develop differentiated services, and improve the quality of electricity services, it is important to calculate the basic daily electricity consumption of consumer. In order to calculate the basic daily electricity consumption of consumers, a method based on decision tree is proposed in this paper. Three index should be calculated in order to build the model. Ten consumers' electricity consumption data have been collected to build decision tree. Four consumers' data is used to verify the proposed model. Results show that the method is effective. In future, more data should be collected and used to improve the model.

articleTitle: Progressive Multi-time-scale Voltage Stability Critical Fault Screening Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of large-scale access of new energy sources and multiple DC feeds, the operation of the power grid continues to face severe challenges, and the receiving-end power grid has the risk of voltage instability or collapse. Aiming at the problems of various forms of voltage cascading and insufficient online sensing ability in emergency scenarios, a three-stage voltage stability critical fault screening and sorting method based on static, transient and medium and long-term is proposed to realize in-depth and efficient investigation of the voltage propagation chain. The medium and long-term voltage safety assessment is carried out based on dynamic screening of fault sets, which ensures accuracy and greatly improves speed. A compatible event-driven voltage stability early warning architecture is proposed, which dynamically expands the expected fault set. The proposed method can quickly capture and locate the weak points of voltage stability on multiple time scales, search and identify the voltage disturbance propagation chain, and effectively improve the timeliness and comprehensiveness of voltage safety early warning.

articleTitle: Control of Inverters for Grid-connected Operation Based on Phase Angle Droop
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In off-grid operation of microgrids, phase angle droop control has been identified as an effective control method. But the control structure often requires significant changes when switching to grid-connected operation. In grid-connected operation, the distributed generation (DG) operates in parallel with the synchronous generators of the external grid. The inverters should participate in the frequency adjustment of the grid to achieve synchronous operation with the external grid. When frequency deviates from the standard value, the output power of the DGs is affected and cannot provide the preset power to the grid, so the control method of inverters should be adjusted accordingly. In this paper, a control method of inverters for grid-connected operation based on phase angle droop is proposed to deal with this problem. While retaining the phase angle droop control structure for grid connection, the inverters are made to participate in the frequency adjustment of the grid through the phase angle controller. If the frequency is shifted, the phase angle of coordinate transformation will be compensated accordingly to adjust the control signal of inverters and change the output power of the DGs to realize the differential-free regulation of active power. The pre-synchronization process is added in the process of off-grid connection to realize smooth switching and avoid the influence of grid-connected switching. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by example simulation.

Author Keywords: control of inverters for grid-connected operation

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of the Exergy Flow of an Integrated Energy System with Distributed Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy systems are one of the main technologies to address the issue of renewable energy consumption. Existing studies have discussed the impact of renewable energy on integrated energy systems from an energy perspective, but not from an energy quality perspective. Firstly, this paper summarizes the exergy flow mechanism model of the integrated energy system. Then, the exergy flow calculation method is proposed for wind turbines, distributed ground source heat pumps, and distributed hydrogen injection. Finally, a sensitivity analysis of distributed renewables in a typical case study. The impact of three types of distributed renewable energy on the energy quality of an integrated energy system is described.

articleTitle: Strategic Large Scale Residential Demand Management for Provision of Frequency Regulation under Spot Market Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High penetration of renewable energy sources in power system introduce significant challenges to frequency stability. Residential buildings are regarded as a typical demand response resource for regulation service. HVAC load accounts for the majority proportion of residential electricity consumption. Meanwhile, the controllable characteristic of HVAC load makes it perfectly suited for providing frequency regulation service. In this paper, a residential HVAC load shifting model is formulated as a linear programming problem. It aims to minimize the energy payment of residential customers by participating in frequency regulation market while considering the performance of tracking frequency regulation signals. The numerical case study shows that residential customers benefit from significant electricity cost reduction as long as they track the target within a small error margin.

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment of Frequency Regulation Capability of Coal-Fired Power Generating Units under Deep Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Primary frequency regulation capability assessment has attracted considerable attention with the integration of large-scale renewable energy into power system. In this work, the main interfering factor is considered in the PFC capability assessment under deep peak shaving condition of the coal-fired power generating units. Some assumptions are made and a novel prediction model is proposed under 30-100% rated load of power units. Results show that the proposed model with high accuracy can be used to evaluate the actual PFC capability.

articleTitle: State of Health Estimation for Lithium-Ion Battery during Fast-Charging Scenario Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state of health (SOH) estimation of lithium-ion batteries is essential for the safe operation and intelligent maintenance of the battery energy storage system in electric vehicles. Up to now, researches have been done a lot on the SOH estimation of the batteries under standard charging rate, but seldom touched the SOH estimation for fast-charging scenario. This paper proposes a convolutional neural network (CNN) based SOH estimation method, which can extract health features from only 3-minute partial fast-charging segment and then accurately estimate the SOH of the batteries under fast-charging. The proposed method is validated by an open-source dataset, where the root mean square percentage error and mean absolute percentage error are less than 1% and the maximum percentage error is less than 2%. The proposed method may have a great potential in real application for the advantage of high accuracy and small amount of charging data needed.

articleTitle: The Electricity Curve Decomposition of Priority Power Generation Plan Considering Generation-Demand Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the progressive establishment of inter-provincial spot markets in China, there is an urgent need to decompose the priority power generation plan into real-time electricity curves. The target of the decomposition is to better coordinate the energy-based contract with the spot market. The decomposition of traditional inter-provincial priority generation plans usually only considers the power output characteristic of the sending province. The load characteristic of the receiving province is routinely ignored, which will lead to an increase in the cost of power purchase for the receiving province and also increase imbalance funds. In this paper, we adopt a step-by-step decomposition method from yearly energy to monthly energy, from monthly energy to daily energy, and from daily energy to intra-day electricity. This manner achieves an effective synchronization with market transactions. By concurrently considering the generation and demand characteristics of the sending and receiving provinces, the proposed protects the interests of customers of the receiving provinces while ensuring the executability of the generation in the sending province. The numerical results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Linearization Based Model Equivalent Method for Distributed Photovoltaic Generation Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 6th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, increasing distributed photovoltaic (PV) generations are penetrated in power system demand side, forming PV clusters. To model the dynamics of PV clusters, the model equivalence method can be used to reduce the computation complexity and simulation time, which can benefit power system security and stability analysis. In this paper, a simple and novel PV model equivalent method based on the model linearization is proposed. Firstly, a simplified PV model structure together with its parameter identification method in this paper is introduced. Then, the process of PV model linearization and parameters simplification is discussed, after which the PV model equivalent method is proposed accordingly. Afterward, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in different situations based on the disturbance events generated in the WSCC 9 bus system. Meanwhile, the relationship between equivalence effectiveness and PV parameters is analyzed. The results show that the proposed PV equivalent model in this paper can follow the dynamics of aggregated PV clusters well.
